hymns.title: Forth in Your Name, O Lord, I Go

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Forth in your name, O Lord, I go,
My daily labor to pursue;
You only, Lord, resolved to know
In all I think or speak or do.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The task your wisdom has assigned
O let me cheerfully fulfill;
In all my works your presence find,
And prove your good and perfect will.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: You may I set at my right hand,
Whose eyes my inmost secrets view,
And labor on at your command,
And offer all my works to you.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Help me to bear your easy yoke,
In ev'ry moment watch and pray,
And still to things eternal look,
And hasten to your glorious day.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Then with delight may I employ
All that your bounteous grace has given,
And run my earthly course with joy,
And closely walk with you in heaven.

hymns.title: Holy Father, Hear Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Holy Father, hear me,
Thou art my defender,
Be Thou ever near me,
Loving, true and tender.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus, blessed Savior,
Lord of life and glory,
Grant me now thy favor,
As I kneel before thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Comforter beginnest,
Who abiding in me,
All my need Divinest,
Move me, draw me, win me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Holy, Holy, Holy,
Come and leave me never,
Thine abode most lowly,
Only Thine forever.

hymns.title: From All the Dangers of the Night

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: From all the dangers of the night,
Jesus my Lord protects,
'Am privileged to see this light,
I kneel to worship Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus my Lord keep me today,
Protect me in Thy hands,
It is only those Thou keepest,
That are safe from danger.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let me speech and my behavior,
Depict that I am thine,
So much that Thy great light of truth,
May shine thro' out the earth.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O let me not depart from Thee,
Thou, oh my Saviour dear,
Until I see with mine own eyes,
Thy Glorious face at last.

hymns.title: Come to the Morning Pray'r

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come to the morning pray'r,
Come, let us kneel and pray;
Pray'r is the Christian Pilgrim's staff,
To work with the Lord all day.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: At noon beneath the rock,
Of Ages rest and pray;
Sweet is the shadow from the heat,
When the sun smites by day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: At Eve shut to the door,
Round the home-altar pray,
And finding there the house of God,
And Heav'n's gate close the day.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When mid-night seals our eyes,
Let each in spirit say,
I sleep, but my heart waketh, Lord,
With Thee to watch and pray.

hymns.title: Awake My Soul and with the Sun

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Awake, my soul, and with the sun,
Thy daily stage of duty run;
Shake off dull sloth, and joyfully rise
To pay thy morning sacrifice.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thy precious time mis-spent redeem;
Each present day thy last esteem;
Improve thy talent with due care;
For the great day thyself prepare.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let all thy converse be sincere,
Thy conscience as the noontide clear,
Think how all see God thy ways
And all thy secret thoughts surveys.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: By influence of the light divine,
Let Thy own light to others shine:
Reflect all Heav'n propitious ways
In ardent love and cheerful praise.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Wake, and lift up thyself, my heart,
And with the angels bear thy path
Who all night long unwearied sing
High praise to the eternal King.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: I wake, I wake, ye heav'nly choir,
May your devotion me inspire,
That I like you my age may spend,
Like you may on my God attend.

hymns.title: Come to Me Lord, when First I  Wake.

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come to me, Lord, when first I wake,
As the faint light of morning break;
Bid purest thoughts within me rise,
Like crystal dew-drops to the skies.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Come to me in the saultry noon,
Or earth's low communings will soon;
For Thy dear face, eclipse the light,
And change my fairest day to night.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Come to me in my evening shade,
And if my heart from Thee
Hath-strayed,
Oh bring it back, and from afar,
Smile on me like Thine ev'ning star.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Come to me in the midnight hour,
When sleep withhold it's balmy pow'r;
Let my lone spirit find her rest,
Like John, upon my saviour's breast.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Come to me through life's varied way
And when it's pulses cease to play,
Then, saviour, bid me come to Thee,
That where Thou art, Thy child may be.

hymns.title: Once More the Sun Is Beaming

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Once more the sun is beaming bright,
Once more to God we pray ,
That His eternal light may guide,
And cheer our souls this day.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O may no sin our hands defile,
Or cause our minds to rove,
Upon our lips be simple truth,
And in our hearts be love!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Throughout the day, O Christ, in Thee
May ready help be found,
To save our souls from Satan's wiles,
Who still is hov'ring round.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Subservient to Thy daily praise,
Our daily toil shall be;
So may our works, in Thee begun,
Be further'd, Lord, by Thee

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And lest the flesh, profane and proud,
Subdue the yielding soul,
May self-constraining temperance,
Carnal desires control.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: To God the father ,God the Son,
And God the Holy Ghost,
Eternal glory be from man,
And from the angel host.

hymns.title: The Morning Bright with Rosy Light

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The morning bright with rosy light,
Has waked me from my sleep,
Father, I own Thy love alone,
Thy little one doth keep.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All through the day I humbly pray,
Be thou my guard and guide,
My sins forgive, and let me live,
Lord Jesus, near Thy side.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh make Thy rest within my breast,
Great Spirit of all grace,
Make me like Thee, then shall I be,
Prepared to see Thy face.

hymns.title: Awake My Soul and Rise with Joy

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Awake my soul and rise with joy
Oh sing praises to thy Saviour,
His grace and glory opens my song
How great is His love and kindness.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He knows I am lost when I fall
Yet His love to me is complete,
He has saved me from afflictions
How great is His love and kindness.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Darts from my foes at me are hurled
World and satan stand in my way
Graciously He had led me through,
How great is his love and kindness.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: This weak heart of mine is always
Transgressing the laws of the Lord
The more I tend to forget Him
His endless love will never fall.

hymns.title: There Is Sunshine in the Valley

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is sunshine in the valley,
There is sunshine on the hill,
Jesus brought it to this darkened world below,
There is sunshine in the flowers,
Blooming by the rippling rill,
There is blessed sunshine ev'ry where I go.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sunshine, sunshine of His love divine,
Sunshine, sunshine beams so brightly shine,
Sunshine, sunshine, in this world below,
Sunshine, sunshine ev'ry where I go.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There is sunshine on the meadow,
And upon the mossy lane,
Where the birds are warbling notes of joy and praise,
There is sunshine on the mountain,
There is sunshine on the plain,
Let all nature now the happy chorus praise.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sunshine, sunshine of His love divine,
Sunshine, sunshine beams so brightly shine,
Sunshine, sunshine, in this world below,
Sunshine, sunshine ev'ry where I go.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Tho' the world is full of sunshine
Brightly beaming ev'ry day,
There are souls who live in darkness all the while,
They have never heard of Jesus
Nor His tender, loving care,
Let us help and cheer them with a sunny smile.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sunshine, sunshine of His love divine,
Sunshine, sunshine beams so brightly shine,
Sunshine, sunshine, in this world below,
Sunshine, sunshine ev'ry where I go.

hymns.title: Mercy and Judgement Will I Sing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Mercy and Judgement will I sing
I sing, O Lord, to Thee;
O when wilt Thou descend and bring
Thy light and life to me?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: A perfect way in wisdom trod,
A perfect heart at home,
A way, a heart, a house, O God,
I seek, where Thou wilt come.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I seek the faithful and the just;
May I their help enjoy!
Be these the friends in whom I trust,
The servants I employ!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: From lies, from slander, and deceit,
My dwelling shall be free;
May it be found a dwelling meet,
O righteous Lord, for Thee!

hymns.title: Love Divine, All Loves Excelling

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Love divine, all loves excelling
Joy of heav'n, to earth come down
Fix in us Thy humble dwelling
All Thy faithful mercies crown
Jesus, Thou art all compassion
Pure, unbounded love Thou art
Visit us with Thy salvation
Enter every trembling heart.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Breathe, oh, breathe Thy loving Spirit,
Into every troubled breast
Let us all in Thee inherit
Let us find the promised rest
Take away the love of sinning
Alpha and Omega be
End of faith, as its beginning
Set our hearts at liberty.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Come Almighty to deliver,
Let us all Thy grace receive!
Suddenly return, and never,
Never more Thy temples leave;
Thee we would be always blessing,
Serve Thee as Thy hosts above,
Pray, and praise Thee without ceasing
Glory in Thy perfect love.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Finish then Thy new creation,
Pure and spotless may we be;
Let us see our whole salvation
Perfectly secured by Thee!
Changed from glory into glory,
Till in heaven we take our place;
Till we cast our crowns before Thee,
Lost in wonder, love and praise.

hymns.title: We Are Never Never Weary of the Grand Old Song

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We are never, never weary of the grand old song,
Glory to God Hallelujah,
We can sing it loud as ever, with our faith more strong,
Glory to God, Halleluyah.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O, the children of the Lord have right to shout and to sing,
For the way is growing bright, and our souls are on the wings,
We are going by and by to the palace of the King,
Glory to God Halleluyah.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We are lost amid the rapture of redeeming love,
Glory to God, Halleluyah,
We are rising on its pinions to the hills above,
Glory to God, Halleluyah.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O, the children of the Lord have right to shout and to sing,
For the way is growing bright, and our souls are on the wings,
We are going by and by to the palace of the King,
Glory to God Halleluyah.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We are going to a palace that is built of gold,
Glory to God, Halleluyah.
Where the King in all His splendour we shall soon behold,
Glory to God, Halleluyah.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O, the children of the Lord have right to shout and to sing,
For the way is growing bright, and our souls are on the wings,
We are going by and by to the palace of the King,
Glory to God Halleluyah.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There we'll shout redeeming mercy in a glad new song,
Glory to God, Halleluyah.
There we'll sing the praise of Jesus with the blood washed throng,
Glory to God, Halleluyah.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O, the children of the Lord have right to shout and to sing,
For the way is growing bright, and our souls are on the wings,
We are going by and by to the palace of the King,
Glory to God Halleluyah.

hymns.title: Sweet Is the Work, My God, My King

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Sweet is the work, my God, my King,
To praise Thy name give thanks and sing;
To show Thy love by morning light,
And talk of all Thy truth at night.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Sweet is the day of sacred rest,
No mortal cares disturb my breast,
O may my heart in tune be found,
Like David's harp of solemn sound!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My heart shall triumph in the Lord,
And bless His works and bless His word:
Thy works of grace, how bright they shine!
How deep Thy counsels, how divine!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: All I shall share a glorious part,
When grace has well refined my heart,
And fresh supplies of joy are shed,
Like holy oil, to cheer my head.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Then shall I see, and hear, and know,
All I desired or wished below;
And every power find sweet employ,
In that eternal world of joy.

hymns.title: Come, Let Us Join Our Cheerful Songs

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, let us join our cheerful songs,
With angels round the throne;
Ten thousand thousand are their tongues,
But all their joys are one.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "Worthy the Lamb that died", they cry,
"To be exalted thus."
"Worthy the Lamb," Our lips reply,
"For He was slain for us."

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus is worthy to receive
Honour and power divine:
And blessings more than we can give
Be, Lord, for ever Thine.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Let all that dwell above the sky,
And air, and earth, and seas,
Conspire to lift Thy glories high,
And speak Thine endless praise

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: The whole creation join in one,
To bless the sacred name
Of Him that sits upon the throne,
And to adore the Lamb.

hymns.title: Jesus, Stand Among Us

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, stand among us
In Thy risen power
Let this time of worship
Be a hallowed hour.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Breathe Thy Holy Spirit
Into every heart
Bid the fears and sorrows
From each soul depart.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thus with quickened footsteps
We'll pursue our way
Watching for the dawning
Of eternal day.

hymns.title: O Worship the Lord in the Beauty of Holiness

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness!
Bow down before Him, His glory proclaim;
With gold of obedienc bye, and incense of lowliness
Kneel and adore Him, the Lord is His name.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Low at His feet lay thy burden of carefulness,
High on His heart He will bear it for thee,
Comfort thy sorrows, and answer thy prayerfulness,
Guiding thy steps as may best for thee be.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Fear not to enter His courts in the slenderness
Of the poor wealth thou wouldst reckon as thine;
Truth in its beauty, and love in its tenderness,
These are the offerings to lay on His shrine.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: These, though we bring them in trembling and fearfulness,
He will accept for the Name that is dear;
Mornings of joy give for evenings of fearfulness,
Trust for our trembling, and hope for our fear.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness,
Bow down before Him, His glory proclaim;
With gold of obedience, and incense of lowliness,
Kneel and adore Him; the Lord is His name.

hymns.title: Come, Ye that Love the Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, ye that love the Lord,
And let your joys be known
Join in a song with sweet accord,
Join in a song with sweet accord,
And thus surround the throne,
And thus surround the throne.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We're marching to Zion;
Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We're marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let those refuse to sing,
Who never knew our God;
But children of the heavenly King,
But children of the heavenly King,
Must speak their joys abroad,
Must speak their joys abroad.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We're marching to Zion;
Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We're marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The hill of Zion yields
A thousand sacred sweets,
Before we reach the heav'nly fields,
Before we reach the heav'nly fields
Or walk the golden streets,
Or walk the golden streets.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We're marching to Zion;
Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We're marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Then let our songs abound,
And every tear be dry,
We're marching through Immanuel's ground,
We're marching through Immanuel's ground
To fairer worlds on high
To fairer worlds on high.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We're marching to Zion;
Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We're marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

hymns.title: The Heav'nly Host Are All Astir

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The heav'nly host are all astir,
The angels take up their harps
The saints all set with their voices
To join the glorious worship
Our God's day of rest has now come
It is a most glorious day
Heav'n is fill'd with joyful noises
How delightful their worship.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let us with the heav'nly throng,
To praise God, He is our King,
Let us cleanse and prepare our hearts,
And sing with holy voices
Ours can only be a foretaste
Of their rest in heav'n above
Until we see the Lord our God,
Whom we worship face to face.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And until then, let us go on
Worshipping on the Lord's day
Let's set aside our anxious cares
Invoke His presence 'midst us
He has commanded so to do
His blessings He will bestow
Let us serve Him without fainting
He will surely reward us.

hymns.title: All Hail the Pow'r of Jesus Name

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: All hail the pow'r of Jesus name!
Let angels prostrate fall;
Bring forth the royal diadem,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Crown Him, ye martyrs of our God,
Who from His altar call;
Extol the stem of Jesse's rod,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Ye chosen seed of Israel's race,
A remnant weak and small,
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Ye Gentile sinners, ne'er forget
The wormwood and the gall;
Go, spread your trophies at His feet,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Let every kindred, every tribe,
On this terrestrial ball,
To Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall.
Join in the everlasting song,
And crown Him Lord of all.

hymns.title: Praise My Soul, the King of Heaven

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Praise my soul, the King of Heaven,
To His feet thy tribute bring;
Ransom'd, heal'd, restor'd, forgiven,
Who like Thee His praise should sing?
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Praise the everlasting King.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Praise Him for His grace and favour
To our fathers in distress;
Praise Him, still the same forever
Slow to chide and swift to bless:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Glorious in His faithfulness.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Father-like He tends and spares us,
Well our feeble frame He knows,
In His hands he gently bear us,
Rescues us from all our foes:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Widely as His mercy flows.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Angels, help us to adore Him!
Ye behold Him face to face:
Sun and moon, bow down before Him:
Dwellers all in time and space,
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Praise with us the God of grace.

hymns.title: The God of Abraham Praise

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The God of Abraham praise,
Who reigns enthroned above,
Ancient of everlasting days,
And God of love!
Jehovah! great I AM!
By earth and heav'n confess,
I bow, and bless the sacred Name,
For ever blest.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The God of Abraham praise,
At whose supreme command
From earth I rise, and seek the joys
At His right hand.
I all on earth forsake,
Its wisdom, fame and power;
And Him my only portion make,
My shield and tower.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He by Himself hath sworn;
I on His oath depend:
I shall, on eagles' wings upborne,
To heaven ascend.
I shall behold His face,
I shall His power adore.
And sing the wonders of His grace
For evermore.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The whole triumphant host
Give thanks to God on high;
"Hail, Father, Son and Holy Ghost!"
They ever cry.
Hail, Abraham's God and mine!
I join the heavenly lays;
All might and majesty are Thine,
And endless praise.

hymns.title: Oh, for a Thousand Tongues to Sing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Oh, for a thousand tongues to sing
My great Redeemer's praise,
The glories of my God and King,
The triumphs of His grace!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: My gracious Master and my God,
Assist me to proclaim,
To spread through all the earth abroad,
The honours of Thy Name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus! the name that charms our fears,
That bids our sorrows cease;
'Tis music in the sinner's ears,
'Tis life, and health, and peace.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He breaks the power of cancelled sin,
He sets the pris'ner free;
His blood can make the foulest clean
His blood availed for me.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Hear Him, ye deaf, His praise, ye dumb,
Your loosened tongues employ;
Ye blind behold your Saviour come;
And leap, ye lame, for joy!

hymns.title: O Worship the King

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O worship the King,
All glorious above,
O gratefully sing
His power and His love;
Our Shield and Defender,
The Ancient of Days,
Pavilion'd in splendour,
And girded with praise.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O tell of His might,
O sing of His grace,
Whose robe is the light,
Whose canopy space.
His chariots of wrath
The deep thunder-clouds form,
And dark is His path
On the wings of the storm.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thy bountiful care,
What tongue can recite?
It breathes in the air,
It shines in the light,
It streams from the hills,
It descends to the plain,
And sweetly distils
In the dew and the rain.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Frail children of dust,
And feeble as frail;
In Thee do we trust,
Nor find Thee to fail;
Thy mercies, how tender,
How firm to the end,
Our maker, Defender,
Redeemer, and Friend!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: O measureless Might!
Ineffable Love!
While angels delight
To hymn Thee above,
The humbler creation,
Though feeble their lays,
With true adoration,
Shall lisp to Thy praise.

hymns.title: Praise Him, Praise Him, Jesus Our Blessed Redeemer

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Praise Him, Praise Him, Jesus our blessed Redeemer,
Sing, O earth, His wonderful love proclaim.
Hail Him, Hail Him! Highest arch-angels in glory,
Strength and honour give to His holy name.
Like a shepherd, Jesus will guard His children,
In His arms He carries them all day long.
O ye saints that dwell on the mountain of zion.
Praise Him! Praise Him! ever in joyful song.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Praise Him, Praise Him, Jesus our blessed Redeemer,
For our sins He suffer'd and bled and died;
He, our rock, our hope of eternal salvation,
Hail Him! hail Him! Jesus the crucified.
Loving Saviour, meekly enduring sorrow,
Crowned with thorns that cruelly pierced His brow;
Once for us rejected, despised and forsaken.
Prince of Glory, ever triumphant now.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Praise Him, Praise Him, Jesus our blessed Redeemer,
Heav'nly portals loud with hosannahs ring;
Jesus, Saviour, reigneth for ever and ever.
Crown Him, crown Him, Prophet and Priest and King!
Death is vanquished! Tell it with joy, ye faithful.
Where is now thy victory, boasting grave?
Jesus lives! no longer thy portals are cheerless,
Jesus lives, the mighty and strong to save.

hymns.title: Praise Ye the Lord! 'Tis Good to Raise

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Praise ye the Lord! 'Tis good to raise
Your hearts and voices in His praise
His nature and His works invite
To make this duty our delight.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He formed the stars, those heavenly flames,
He counts their numbers, calls their names;
His wisdom's vast, and knows no bound,
A deep where all our thoughts are drowned.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Sing to the Lord! Exalt Him high,
Who spreads His clouds along the sky;
There He prepares the fruitful rain,
Nor lets the drops descend in vain.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He makes the grass the hills adorn,
And clothes the smiling fields with corn;
The beasts with food His hands supply,
And the young ravens when they cry.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: What is the creature's skill or force?
The sprightly man, or warlike horse?
The piercing wit, the active limb?
All are too mean delights for Him.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: But saints are lovely in His sight,
He views His children with delight,
He sees their hope, He knows their fear.
And looks, and loves His image there.

hymns.title: O Magnify the Lord with Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O magnify the Lord with me,
Ye people of His choice!
Let all to whom He lendeth breath
Now in His Name rejoice;
For love'st blest revelation,
For rest from condemnation,
For uttermost salvation
To Him give thanks.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Let all (let all) the people praise Thee,
Let all (let all) the people praise Thee!
For ever and for ever more,
For ever more, O Lord!
Let all (let all) the people praise Thee,
Let all (let all) the people praise Thee,
Let all (let all) the people praise Thy name
For ever and for ever more.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O praise Him for His holiness,
His wisdom and His grace;
Sing praises for the precious blood,
Which ransom'd all our race;
In tenderness He sought us,
From depths of sin He brought us,
The way of life then thought us,
To Him give thanks.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Let all (let all) the people praise Thee,
Let all (let all) the people praise Thee!
For ever and for ever more,
For ever more, O Lord!
Let all (let all) the people praise Thee,
Let all (let all) the people praise Thee,
Let all (let all) the people praise Thy name
For ever and for ever more.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Had I a thousand tongues to sing.
The half could ne'er be told
Of love so rich, so full and free,
Of blessings manifold;
Of grace that faileth never,
Peace flowing as a river
From God the glorious Giver,
To Him give thanks.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Let all (let all) the people praise Thee,
Let all (let all) the people praise Thee!
For ever and for ever more,
For ever more, O Lord!
Let all (let all) the people praise Thee,
Let all (let all) the people praise Thee,
Let all (let all) the people praise Thy name
For ever and for ever more.

hymns.title: Now Thank We All Our God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Now thank we all our God,
With hearts, and hands and voices;
Who wondrous things hath done,
In Whom His world rejoices;
Who, from our mother's arms,
Hath bless'd us on our way
With countless gifts to love
And still is ours to-day.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O may this bounteous God
Through all our life be near us,
With ever-joyful hearts
And blessed peace to cheer us,
And keep us in His grace
And guide us when perplexed,
And free us from all ills
In this world and the next.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: All praise and thanks to God
The Father now be given,
The Son, and Him who reigns
With them in the highest heaven
The One, Eternal God,
Whom earth and heaven adore;
For thus it was, is now,
And shall be evermore.

hymns.title: Praise the King of Glory, He Is God Alone

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Praise the King of Glory, He is God alone.
Praise Him for the wonders He to us hath shown;
For His promised presence all the pilgrim way,
For the flaming pillar, and the cloud by day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Praise .... Him, shining angels,
Strike .... your harps of gold;
All .... His host adore Him,
Who .... His face behold ....
Through .... His great dominion,
While .... the ages roll,
All His works shall praise Him;
All His works shall praise Him;
All His works shall praise Him;
Bless the Lord, my soul!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Praise Him for redemption, free to every soul;
Praise Him for the fountain that can make us whole,
For His gifts of kindness, and His loving care;
For the blest assurance that He answers prayer.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Praise .... Him, shining angels,
Strike .... your harps of gold;
All .... His host adore Him,
Who .... His face behold ....
Through .... His great dominion,
While .... the ages roll,
All His works shall praise Him;
All His works shall praise Him;
All His works shall praise Him;
Bless the Lord, my soul!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Praise Him for the trials, sent as cords of love,
Binding us more closely to the things above;
For the faith that conquers, hope that naught can dim;
For the land where loved ones gather unto Him.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Praise .... Him, shining angels,
Strike .... your harps of gold;
All .... His host adore Him,
Who .... His face behold ....
Through .... His great dominion,
While .... the ages roll,
All His works shall praise Him;
All His works shall praise Him;
All His works shall praise Him;
Bless the Lord, my soul!

hymns.title: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of Creation

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of creation;
O my soul, praise Him, for He is thy health and salvation;
All ye who hear,
Brothers and sisters draw near,
Praise Him in glad adoration.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Praise to the Lord, who doth prosper thy work and defend thee;
Surely His goodness and mercy here daily attend thee;
Ponder anew
What the Almighty can do,
If with His love He befriend thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Praise to the Lord, who when tempest their warfare are waging,
Who, when the elements madly around thee are raging,
Biddeth them cease,
Turneth their fury to peace,
Whirlwinds and waters assuaging.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Praise to the Lord, who, when darkness and sin is abounding
Who, when the godless do triumph, all virtue confounding,
Sheddeth His light,
Chaseth the horrors of night,
Saints with His mercy surrounding.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Praise to the Lord! O let all that is in me adore Him!
All that hath life and breath, come now with praises before Him!
Let the Amen
Sound from His people again:
Gladly for aye we adore Him.

hymns.title: Let Us with a Gladsome Mind

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Let us with a gladsome mind
Praise the Lord for He is kind;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For His mercies shall endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let us sound His name abroad,
For of gods He is the God;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For His mercies shall endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He, with all-commanding might,
Filled the new-made world with light;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For His mercies shall endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: All things living He doth feed,
His full hand supplies their need;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For His mercies shall endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: He His chosen race did bless
In the wasteful wilderness;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For His mercies shall endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: He hath with a piteous eye
Looked upon our misery;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For His mercies shall endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Let us then with gladsome mind
Praise the Lord, for He is kind.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For His mercies shall endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

hymns.title: Praise to the Holiest in the Height

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Praise to the Holiest in the height,
And in the depth be praise:
In all His words most wonderful
Most sure in all His ways.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O loving wisdom of our God!
When all was sin and shame
A second Adam to the fight,
And to the rescue came.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O wisest love! that flesh and blood
Which did in Adam fail
Should strive afresh against the foe
Should strive and should prevail.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And that a higher gift than grace
Should flesh and blood refine,
God's presence, and His very self
And essence all-divine.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: O generous love! that He, who smote
In man for man the foe,
The double agony in man
For man should undergo.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: And in the garden secretly,
And on the cross on high,
Should teach his brethren, and inspire
To suffer and to die.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Praise to the Holiest in the height,
And in the depth be praise:
In all His words most wonderful,
Most sure in all His ways.

hymns.title: Alleluia, Song of Sweetness

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Alleluia, song of sweetness,
Voice of joy that cannot die,
Alleluia is the anthem
Ever dear to choirs on high,
In the house of God abiding
Thus they sing eternally.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Alleluia, Church victorious
Thou mays't lift the joyful strain,
Alleluia songs of triumph
Well befit the ransom'd train
Faint and feeble are our praises
While in exile we remain.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Alleluia may not always
Be our song while here below;
Alleluia, our transgressions,
Make us for a while forego;
For the solemn time is coming
When our tears for sin must flow.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Therefore in our hymns we pray Thee,
Grant us, Blessed Trinity,
At the last to keep Thine Easter,
In our Home beyond the sky,
There to Thee for ever singing
Alleluia joyfully.

hymns.title: Let Me Come Closer to Thee, Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Let me come closer to Thee, Jesus,
Oh, closer day by day!
Let me lean harder on Thee, Jesus
Yea, harder all the way.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let me show forth Thy beauty, Jesus,
Like sunshine on the hills,
Oh let my lips pour forth Thy sweetness
In joyous, sparkling rills!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Yes, like a fountain precious Jesus,
Make me new and let me be;
Keep me and use me daily, Jesus,
For Thee, and only Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In all my heart and will, O Jesus,
Be altogether, King!
Make me a loyal subject, Jesus
To Thee in everything.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thirsting and hungering for Thee, Jesus
With blessed hunger here,
Longing for home on Zion's mountain
No thirst, on hunger there.

hymns.title: When All Thy Mercies, O My God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When all Thy mercies, O my God,
My rising soul surveys,
Transported with the view, I'm lost
In wonder, love and praise.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Unnumbered comforts on my soul
Thy tender care bestowed,
Before my infant heart conceived,
From whom these comforts flowed.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When in the slippery paths of youth
With heedless steps I ran,
Thine arm, unseen, conveyed me safe,
And led me up to man.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Through hidden dangers, toils and deaths,
It gently cleared my way,
And through the pleasing snares of vice,
More to be feared than they.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: When worn with sickness oft hast Thou
With health renewed my face,
And when in sins and sorrows sunk,
Revived my soul with grace.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Ten thousand thousand precious gifts
My daily thanks employ;
Nor is the least a cheerful heart
That tastes gifts with joy.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Through every period of my life
Thy goodness I'll pursue;
And after death, in distant worlds,
The glorious theme renew.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Through all eternity to Thee
A joyful song I'll raise;
But oh, eternity's too short
To utter all Thy praise.

hymns.title: To God Be the Glory, Great Things He Hath Done

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: To God be the glory, great things He hath done,
So loved He the world that He gave us His Son,
Who yielded His life an atonement for sin,
And open'd the life gate that all may go in.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
Let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
Let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father, through Jesus the Son;
And give Him the glory! great things, He hath done!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood,
To every believer the promise of God;
The vilest offender who truly believes
That moment from Jesus a pardon receives.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
Let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
Let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father, through Jesus the Son;
And give Him the glory! great things, He hath done!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Great things He hath taught us, great things He hath done,
And great our rejoicing through Jesus the Son;
But purer, and higher, and greater will be,
Our wonder, our triumph when Jesus we see.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
Let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
Let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father, through Jesus the Son;
And give Him the glory! great things, He hath done!

hymns.title: Praise, O Praise Our God and King

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Praise, O praise our God and King,
Hymns of adoration sing;
For His mercies still endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Praise Him that He made the sun,
Day by day his course to run;
For His mercies still endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And the silver moon by night,
Shining with her gentle light;
For His mercies still endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Praise Him that He gave the rain
To mature the swelling grain;
For His mercies still endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And hath bid the fruitful field
Crops of precious increase yield;
For His mercies still endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Praise Him for our harvest store,
He hath filled the gamer floor,
For His mercies still endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: And for richer food than this,
Pledge of everlasting bliss;
For His mercies still endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Glory to our bounteous King!
Glory let creation sing!
Glory to the Father, Son,
and blest Spirit, Three in One.

hymns.title: What Shall I Render to My God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: What shall I render to my God,
For all His mercy's store?
I'll take the gifts He hath bestowed,
And humbly ask for more.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The sacred cup of saving grace,
I will with thanks receive
And all His promise embrace,
And to His glory live.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My vows I will to His great name
Before His people pay;
And all I have, and all I am,
Upon His altar lay.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thy lawful servant, Lord, I owe
To Thee whate'er is mine,
Born in Thy family below;
And by redemption Thine.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thy hands created me, Thy hands
From sin have set me free,
The mercy that hath loosed my bands
Hath bound me fast to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: The God of all-redeeming grace
My God I will proclaim,
Offer the sacrifice of praise,
And call upon His name.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Praise Him ye saints, the God of love
Who hath my sins forgiven
Till gathered to the church above,
We sing the songs of heaven.

hymns.title: King of Glory, King of Peace

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: King of glory, King of peace,
I will love Thee;
And, that love may never cease,
I will move Thee,
Thou hast granted my request,
Thou hast heard me;
Thou didst note my working breast,
Thou hast spared me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Wherefore with my utmost art
I will sing Thee;
And the cream of all my heart
I will bring Thee;
Though my sins against me cried,
Thou didst clear me;
And alone, when they replied,
Thou didst hear me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Seven whole days, not one in seven,
I will praise Thee;
In my heart, though not in heav'n,
I can raise Thee
Small it is, in this poor sort
To enrol Thee;
E'en eternity's too short
To extol Thee.

hymns.title: To Thee, O Comforter Divine

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: To Thee, O Comforter divine
For all Thy grace and pow'r benign
Sing we Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: To Thee, whose faithful love had place,
In God's great covenant of grace,
Sing we Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: To Thee, whose faithful pow'r doth heal
Enlighten, sanctify and seal
Sing we Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: To Thee, our teacher and our friend
Our faithful leader to the end.
Sing we Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: To Thee, by Jesus Christ sent down,
Of all his gifts the sun and crown,
Sing we Alleluia!

hymns.title: Praise the Lord! Ye Heavens Adore Him

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Praise the Lord! Ye heavens adore Him;
Praise Him, angels in the height;
Sun and moon, rejoice before Him;
Praise Him, all ye stars and light.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Praise the Lord, for He hath spoken;
Worlds His mighty voice obeyed;
Laws, that never shall be broken,
For their guidance He hath made.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Praise the Lord, for He is glorious;
Never shall His promise fail:
God hath made His saints victorious;
Sin and death shall not prevail.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Praise the God of our salvation;
Hosts on high His power proclaim;
Heaven and earth, and all creation,
Laud and magnify His name.

hymns.title: Before Jehovah's Awful Throne

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Before Jehovah's awful throne,
Ye nations, bow with sacred joy;
Know that the Lord is God alone;
He can create, and He destroy.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: His sovereign power, without our aid,
Made us of clay, and formed us men;
And, when like wandering sheep we strayed,
He brought us to His fold again.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We are His people, we His care,
Our souls and all our mortal fame:
What lasting honours shall we rear,
Almighty Maker, to Thy Name?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: We'll crowd Thy gates with thankful songs,
High as the heavens our voices raise;
And earth, with her ten thousand tongues,
Shall fill Thy courts with sounding praise.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Wide as the world is Thy command,
Vast as eternity Thy love;
Firm as a rock Thy truth shall stand,
When rolling years shall cease to move.

hymns.title: O God, Our Help in Ages Past

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come
Our shelter from the stormy blast
And our eternal home.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Under the shadow of Thy throne
Thy saints have dwelt secure
Sufficient is Thine arm alone
And our defence is sure.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Before the hills in order stood
Or earth received her frame
From everlasting Thou art God
To endless years the same.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: A thousand ages in Thy sight
Are like an evening gone
Short as the watch that ends the night
Before the rising sun.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Time, like an ever-rolling stream
Bears all its sons away
They fly forgotten, as a dream
Dies at the opening day.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: O God, our help in ages past
Our hope for years to come
Be Thou our guard while troubles last
And our eternal home.

hymns.title: O God, the Rock of Ages

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O God, the Rock of Ages
Who evermore hast been,
What time the tempest rages,
Our dwelling place serene;
Before Thy first creations,
O Lord, the same as now,
To endless generations,
The everlasting Thou!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Our years are like the shadows
On sunny hills that lie,
Or grasses in the meadows
That blossom but to die:
A sleep, a dream, a story
By strangers quickly told,
An unremaining glory
Of things that soon are old.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O Thou, who canst not slumber,
Whose light grows never pale,
Teach us aright to number
Our years before they fail,
On us Thy mercy lighten,
On us Thy goodness rest,
And let Thy Spirit brighten
The hearts Thyself hast blessed.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lord, crown our faith's endeavour
With beauty and with grace,
Till, clothed in light for ever,
We see Thee face to face;
A joy to language measures,
A fountain brimming o'er,
And endless flow of pleasures;
An ocean without shore.

hymns.title: My Soul Shouts Glory to the Son of God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My soul shouts glory to the Son of God,
For the work free grace hath done;
My faith looks upward with a steadfast eye
That is clear as the noonday-sun.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah to the Saviour I adore
I will praise Him, I will praise Him,
Hallelujah! I will praise Him ever more.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: My souls shouts glory to the Son of God,
Not a cloud nor a care I see;
My hope is clinging with a perfect trust
To the cross He has borne for me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah to the Saviour I adore
I will praise Him, I will praise Him,
Hallelujah! I will praise Him ever more.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My souls shouts glory to the Son of God,
In His secret place I dwell;
His constant presence overshades me there,
And my joy there is none can tell.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah to the Saviour I adore
I will praise Him, I will praise Him,
Hallelujah! I will praise Him ever more.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: My souls shouts glory to the Son of God,
And I know it will not be long;
Till o'er the river, where the saints have gone,
I shall join their eternal song.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah to the Saviour I adore
I will praise Him, I will praise Him,
Hallelujah! I will praise Him ever more.

hymns.title: My God, the Spring of All My Joys

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My God, the spring of all my joys,
The life of my delights,
The glory of my brightest days,
And comfort of my nights!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In darkest shades, if Thou appear,
My dawning is begun:
Thou art my soul's bright morning star,
And Thou my rising sun.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The opening heavens around me shine,
With beams of sacred bliss,
If Jesus shows His mercy mine,
And whispers I am His.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: My soul would leave this heavy clay,
At that transporting word;
Run up with joy the shining way,
To meet my dearest Lord.

hymns.title: No More Veil! God Bids Me Enter

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: No more veil! God bids me enter
By the new and living way
Not in trembling hope I venture,
Boldly I His call obey:
There, with Him, my God I meet,
God upon the mercy seat!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In the robes of spotless whiteness,
With the blood of priceless worth,
He has gone into that brightness,
Christ rejected from the earth
Christ accepted there on high,
And in Him do I draw nigh.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh, the welcome I have found there,
God in all His love made known!
Oh, the glories that surround there,
Those accepted in His Son!
Who can tell the depths of bliss
Spoken by the Father's kiss?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: One with Him, O Lord, before Thee,
There I live, and yet not I;
Christ it is who there adores Thee;
Who more dear, or who more nigh?
All the Father's heart mine own
Mine and yet His Son's alone.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: All the worth I have before Him
Is the value of the Blood;
I present when I adore Him,
Christ the first-fruits unto God;
Him with joy doth God behold,
Thus is my acceptance told.

hymns.title: Great Is Thy Faithfulness

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "Great is Thy faithfulness,"
O God my Father!
There is no shadow of turning with Thee:
Thou changest not, Thy compassion, they fail not,
As Thou has been Thou forever wilt be.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "Great is Thy faithfulness!"
Great is Thy faithfulness!
Morning by morning new mercies I see.
All I have needed Thy hand hath provided
'Great is Thy faithfulness, Lord unto me!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Summer and winter, and spring time and harvest
Sun, moon and stars in their courses above,
Join with all nature in manifold witness
To Thy great faithfulness, mercy and love.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "Great is Thy faithfulness!"
Great is Thy faithfulness!
Morning by morning new mercies I see.
All I have needed Thy hand hath provided
'Great is Thy faithfulness, Lord unto me!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth
Thine own dear presence to cheer and to guide!
Strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow.
Blessings all mine, with ten thousand beside!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "Great is Thy faithfulness!"
Great is Thy faithfulness!
Morning by morning new mercies I see.
All I have needed Thy hand hath provided
'Great is Thy faithfulness, Lord unto me!

hymns.title: Pleasant Are Thy Courts Above

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Pleasant are Thy courts above,
In the land of light and love;
Pleasant are Thy courts below,
In this land of sin and woe,
O, my spirit longs and faints
For the converse of Thy saints,
For the brightness of Thy face,
For Thy fulness; God of grace!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Happy birds that sing and fly
Round Thy altars, O Most High!
Happier souls that find a rest,
In a heavenly Father's breast!
Like the wandering dove that found
No repose on earth around,
They can to their ark repair,
And enjoy it ever there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Happy souls! their praises flow
Even in this vale of woe,
Waters in the desert rise,
Manna feeds them from the skies,
On they go from strength to strength,
Till they reach Thy throne at length;
At Thy feet adoring fall;
Who hast led them safe through all.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lord, be mine this prize to win:
Guide me through a world of sin;
Keep me by Thy saving grace;
Give me at Thy side a place
Sun and shield alike Thou art;
Guide and guard my erring heart:
Grace and glory flow from Thee:
Shower, oh shower them, Lord, on me!

hymns.title: Fill Thou My Life, O Lord My God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Fill Thou my life, O Lord my God,
In every part with praise,
That my whole being may proclaim
Thy being and Thy ways.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Not for the lip of praise alone,
Not e'en the praising heart,
I ask, but for a life made up
Of praise in every part:

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Praise in the common things of life,
Its goings out and in
Praise in each duty and each deed,
However small and mean.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Fill every part of me with praise;
Let all my being speak
Of Thee and of Thy love, O Lord,
Poor though I be and weak.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: So shall Thou, Lord, from me, e'en me,
Receive the glory due;
And so shall I begin on earth
The song for ever new.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: So shall no part of day or night
From sacredness be free;
But all my life, in every step,
Be fellowship with Thee.

hymns.title: Eternal God! We Raise to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Eternal God! We raise to Thee,
Our songs of praise this solemn hour;
Now let Thy Spirit make us free
To magnify Thy grace and pow'r;
We worship, and Thy name adore,
And Thou art blest for ever-more.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: To Thee all holy angels sing,
The seraph and the cherub throng,
Worship the everlasting King,
In notes of unexpiring song;
Before Thy throne their anthem raise,
And fill the heavens with their praise.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The God of patriachs who face
Thy throne while round The seers stand,
Oh, how they magnify Thy grace,
Delight to go at Thy command;
The prophet and the saintly throng
Extol Thy name with heavenly song.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The God of all the martyred host,
The slain upon the rock of shame,
Of Thee they make their glorious boast,
And fall in wonder at Thy name.
The Church throughout remotest bounds
Now sings Thy praise till heaven resounds!

hymns.title: From All that Dwell Below the Skies

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: From all that dwell below the skies
Let the Creator's praise a rise:
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Let the Redeemer's name be sung
Thro' ev-'ry land in ev-'ry tongue
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Eternal are Thy mercies, Lord:
Eternal truth attends Thy word:
Hallelujah!
Thy praise shall sound from shore to shore
Till suns shall rise and set no more,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah!

hymns.title: If I but Knew Thee as Thou Art

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: If I but knew Thee as Thou art,
O loveliness unknown,
With what desire, O Lord, my heart
Would claim Thee for its own.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thy glory would my shame conceal,
Thy purity my dross:
I should rejoice with Thee to feel
The sorrow of the cross.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: But I am dull and blind, O Lord,
Unapt of Thee to learn;
Thee I but dimly in Thy word,
As in a glass, discern.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: With faith's warm finger, through the veil,
I seek to touch Thy hand:
I feel the imprint of the nail
And partly understand.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: But, ah, my lonely spirit tires
Of knowing Thee in part.
O Jesus, how my soul desires
To see Thee as Thou art!

hymns.title: Here Is Love, Vast as the Ocean

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Here is love, vast as the ocean,
Loving-kindness as the flood;
When the Prince of life my ransom,
Shed for me His precious blood.
Who His love will not remember?
Who can cease to sing His praise?
He shall never be forgotten,
Thro' heav'n's everlasting days.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: On the mount of crucifixion,
Fountains open'd deep and wide,
Thro' the flood gates of God's mercy
Flow'd the vast and gracious tide;
Grace and love like mighty rivers
Pour'd incessant from above,
And heav'n's peace and perfect justice
Kiss'd a guilty world in love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let me all Thy love accepting,
Love Thee, ever all my days;
Let me seek Thy kingdom only
And my life be to Thy praise;
Thou alone shalt be my glory,
Nothing in the world I see:
Thou hast cleansed and sanctified me,
Thou Thyself hast set me free.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In Thy truth Thou dost direct me
By Thy Spirit through Thy Word;
And Thy grace my need is meeting,
As I trust in Thee, my Lord.
All Thy fullness Thou art pouring
In Thy love and power in me,
Without measure, full and boundless,
As I yield myself to Thee.

hymns.title: Hark! The Song of Jubilee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hark! the song of jubilee,
Loud as mighty thunders roar,
Or the fullness of the sea
When it breaks upon the shore:
"Hallelujah! for the Lord
God omnipotent shall reign:
Hallelujah!" let the word
Echo round the earth and main.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "Hallelujah!" Hark! the sound
From the depths unto the skies,
Wake above, beneath, around,
All creation's harmonies;
See Jehovah's banner furled,
Sheathed His sword; He speaks-'tis done,
And the kingdoms of this world
Are the kingdom of His Son.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He shall reign from pole to pole
With illimitable sway;
He shall reign when like a scroll
Yonder heavens have passed away:
Then the end, beneath His rod
Man's last enemy shall fall;
"Hallelujah!" Christ in God,
God in Christ is All in all!

hymns.title: O God of Our Salvation

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O God of our salvation,
Our Spirit soul and life
Our health, shield and defender,
Our everlasting peace
We Thy children humbly stand
To glorify Thy name
For the great gift you bestow,
Through Jesus Christ Thy Son.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Our hearts are filled with praises
For all Thy ceaseless care
On all of Thy dear children
Scattered all o'er the world
We implore Thee to help us,
Continue in Thy will
And that our light may so shine
Upon the whole wide world.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Glory to God the Father
Glory to God the Son
To Holy Ghost give glory
Ever blessed Three-in-One
Accept our songs of praises
Also the prayer we bring
For the great gift you bestow
Through Jesus Christ Thy Son.

hymns.title: Begin, My Soul, some Heav'nly Theme

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Begin, my soul, some heav'nly theme;
Awake, my voice, and sing
The mighty works, or mightier name,
Of our eternal King.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Tell of His wondrous faithfulness,
And sound His power abroad,
Sing the sweet promise of His grace,
And the performing God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Proclaim salvation from the Lord,
For wretched, dying men:
His hand hath writ the sacred word
With an immortal pen.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Engraved as in eternal brass
The mighty promise shines;
Nor can the powers of darkness 'rase
Those everlasting lines.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: His every word of grace is strong,
As that which built the skies;
The voice that rolls the stars along
Speak all the promises.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Now shall my fainting heart rejoice
To know Thy favour sure:
I trust the all-creating voice,
And faith desires no more.

hymns.title: Lord Jesus Christ, We Seek Thy Face

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord Jesus Christ, we seek Thy face;
Within the veil we bow the knee;
Oh, let Thy glory fill the place,
And bless us while we wait on Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We thank Thee for the precious blood
That purged our sins and brought us nigh;
All cleansed and sanctified to God,
Thy holy Name to magnify.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Shut in with Thee, far, far above
The restless world that wars below:
We seek to learn and prove Thy love,
Thy wisdom and Thy grace to know.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The brow that once with thorns was bound,
Thy hands, Thy side, we fain would see;
Draw near, Lord Jesus, glory crowned,
And bless us while we wait on Thee.

hymns.title: Angel Voices, Ever Singing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Angel voices, ever singing,
Round Thy throne of light,
Angel harps, for ever ringing,
Rest not day nor night;
Thousands only live to bless Thee,
And confess Thee
Lord of might.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou who art beyond the farthest
Mortal eye can scan,
Can it be that Thou regardest
Songs of sinful man?
Can we know that Thou art near us
And wilt hear us?
Yea, we can.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: In Thy house, great God, we offer
Of thine own to Thee,
And for Thine acceptance proffer,
All unworthily,
Hearts, and minds, and hands, and voices
In our choicest
Psalmody.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Honour, glory, might, and merit
Thine shall ever be,
Father, Son, and Holy Spirit,
Blessed Trinity,
Of the best that Thou hast given
Earth and heaven
Render Thee.

hymns.title: O Lord of Heav'n and Earth and Sea

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Lord of heav'n and earth and sea,
To Thee all praise and glory be;
How shall we show our love to Thee?
Who gavest all?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou didst not spare Thine only Son,
But gav'st Him for a world undone;
And freely with the blessed One
Thou gavest all.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We lose what on ourselves we spend,
We have as treasure without end
Whatever, Lord, to Thee we lend,
Who givest all.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: To Thee, from whom we all derive,
Our life, our gifts, our power to give!
O may we ever with Thee live,
Who givest all.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thou giv'st the Spirit's blessed dower,
Spirit of life, and love, and power,
And dost His sevenfold graces shower,
Upon us all.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: For souls redeemed, for sins forgiven,
For means of grace and hopes of heaven,
Father, all praise to Thee be given,
Who givest all.

hymns.title: Jesus, the Very Thought of Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, the very thought of Thee
With sweetness fills my breast;
But sweeter far Thy face to see,
And in Thy presence rest.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Nor voice can sing, nor heart can frame,
Nor can the memory find
A sweeter sound than Thy blest name,
O Saviour of mankind.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O Hope of every contrite heart,
O joy of all the meek,
To those who fall, how kind Thou art!
How good to those who seek!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: But what to those who find? Ah, this
Nor tongue nor pen can show;
The love of Jesus, what it is,
None but His loved ones know.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Jesus, our only joy be Thou,
As Thou our prize wilt be;
Jesus, be Thou our glory now,
And through eternity.

hymns.title: Jesus, Thy Boundless Love to Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, Thy boundless love to me
No thought can reach, no tongue declare;
O knit my thankful heart to Thee,
And reign without a rival there;
Thine wholly, Thine alone, I am,
Be Thou alone my constant flame.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O grant that nothing in my soul
May dwell but Thy pure love alone;
O may Thy love possess me whole,
My joy, my treasure, and my crown:
Strange flames far from my heart remove;
My every act, word, thought, be love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O Love, how cheering is Thy ray;
All pain before Thy presence flies,
Care, anguish, sorrow, melt away,
Where'er Thy healing beams arise,
O Jesus, nothing may I see,
Nothing desire, or seek, but Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Unwearied may I this pursue,
Dauntless to the high prize aspire;
Hourly within my soul renew,
This holy flame, this heav'nly fire;
And day and night be all my care,
To guide the sacred treasure there.

hymns.title: The King of Love My Shepherd Is

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The King of love my Shepherd is,
Whose goodness faileth never;
I nothing lack if I am His,
And He is mine for ever.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Where streams of living water flow
My ransomed soul He leadeth,
And where the verdant pastures grow,
With food celestial feedeth.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Perserve and foolish oft I strayed;
But yet in love He sought me,
And on His shoulder gently laid,
And home rejoicing brought me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In death's dark vale I fear no ill
With Thee, dear Lord, beside me;
Thy rod and staff my comfort still,
Thy cross before to guide me.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thou spread'st a table in my sight;
Thy unction grace bestoweth;
And O what transport of delight,
From Thy pure chalice floweth!

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: And so through all the length of days
Thy goodness faileth never;
Good Shepherd, may I sing Thy praise
Within Thy house for ever!

hymns.title: Thine, Lord, Is Wisdom, Thine Alone

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thine, Lord, is wisdom, Thine alone;
Justice and truth before Thee stand;
Yet, nearer to Thy sacred throne,
Mercy withholds Thy lifted hand.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Each evening shows Thy tender love,
Each rising morn Thy plenteous grace;
Thy waken'd wrath doth slowly move,
Thy willing mercy flies apace.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: To Thy benigh indulgent care,
Father, this light, this breath we owe,
And all we have, and all we are,
From Thee, great source of being, flow.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Parent of good, Thy bounteous hand,
Incessant blessing down distils,
And all in air, or sea, or land,
With plenteous food and gladness fills.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: All things in Thee, live, move and are,
Thy pow'r infused doth all sustain;
Ev'n those Thy daily favours share
Who thankless spun Thy easy reign.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Thy sun Thou bidd'st his genial ray
Alike on all impartial pour;
To all, who hate or bless Thy sway,
Thou budd'st descend the fruitful shower.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Yet while at length who scorned Thy might,
Shall feel Thee a consuming fire,
How sweet the joys, the crown how bright,
Of those who to Thy love aspire!

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Thrice Holy! Thine the kingdom is,
The pow'r omnipotent is Thine;
And when created nature dies
Thy never-ceasing glories shine.

hymns.title: O for a Closer Walk with God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O for a closer walk with God,
A calm and heav'nly frame,
A light to shine upon the road
That leads me to the Lamb.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Where is the blessedness I knew
When first I saw the Lord?
Where is that soul-refreshing view
Of Jesus and His word?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: What peaceful hours I once enjoyed!
How sweet their memory still!
But they have left an aching void
The world can never fill.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Return, O holy Dove! return,
Sweet messenger of rest!
I hate the sins that made Thee mourn,
And drove Thee from my breast.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: The dearest idol I have known,
Whate'er that idol be,
Help me to tear it from Thy throne,
And worship only Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: So shall my walk be close with God,
Calm and serene my frame;
So purer light shall mark the road
That leads me to the Lamb.

hymns.title: Jesus, Let Thy Splendour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, let Thy splendour
Like a mantle fall,
On this waiting spirit,
Whilst I yield Thee all;
Clothe me with Thy beauty,
Bathe me in Thy will,
And with life triumphant
All my nature fill.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Fellowship with Jesus,
This is victory,
They who own His Lordship
Know true liberty.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Give to me a vision
Reaching to the throne
Let me see earth's problems
In that light alone;
'Tis Thy word assures me
All shall work for good,
Things that long have baffled
Soon be understood.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Fellowship with Jesus,
This is victory,
They who own His Lordship
Know true liberty.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Blessed cross of Jesus,
I Thy pow'r would prove,
'Neath Thy shadow living,
Naught this soul shall move,
Sanctify me wholly,
Purge from every stain,
All that makes for bondage,
Let it now be slain.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Fellowship with Jesus,
This is victory,
They who own His Lordship
Know true liberty.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Fired with holy passion,
Moved by urge divine,
What shall henceforth hinder
Victory being mine?
Men may raise their way-cry,
Lift their standards high,
But before love's challenge
Each vain thought shall fly.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Fellowship with Jesus,
This is victory,
They who own His Lordship
Know true liberty.

hymns.title: Be Glad in the Lord and Rejoice

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Be glad in the Lord and rejoice,
All ye that are upright in heart;
And ye that have made Him your choice,
Bid sadness and sorrow depart.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rejoice!.. rejoice!..
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice!
Rejoice!.. rejoice!..
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Be joyful, for He is the Lord,
On earth and in heaven supreme;
He fashions and rules by His word;
The "Mighty" and "Strong" to redeem.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rejoice!.. rejoice!..
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice!
Rejoice!.. rejoice!..
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: What tho' in the conflict for right
Your enemies almost prevail!
God's armies, just hid from your sight,
Are more than the foes which assail.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rejoice!.. rejoice!..
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice!
Rejoice!.. rejoice!..
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Tho' darkness surround you by day,
Your sky by the night be o'ercast,
Let nothing your spirit dismay,
But trust till the danger is past.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rejoice!.. rejoice!..
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice!
Rejoice!.. rejoice!..
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice,
His praises proclaiming in song;
With harp, and with organ, and voice,
The loud hallelujahs prolong!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rejoice!.. rejoice!..
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice!
Rejoice!.. rejoice!..
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice!

hymns.title: The Lord's My Shepherd, I'll Not Want

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The Lord's my Shepherd, I'll not want;
He makes me down to lie
In pastures green; He leadeth me
The quiet waters by.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: My soul He doth restore again;
And me to walk doth make
Withing the paths of righteousness,
E'en for His own name's sake.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Yea, though I walk in death's dark vale.
Yet will I fear none ill;
For Thou art with me; and Thy rod
And staff me comfort still.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: My table Thou hath furnished
In presence of my foes;
My head Thou hast with oil anoint
And my cup overflows.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Goodness and mercy all my life
Shall surely follow me,
And in God's house for evermore
My dwelling place shall be.

hymns.title: Come Ye Yourselves Apart and Rest Awhile

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come ye yourselves apart and rest awhile,
Weary, I know it, of the press and throng;
Wipe from your brow the sweat and dust of toil,
And in My quiet strength again be strong.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Come ye aside from all the world holds dear,
For converse which the world has never known;
Alone with Me, and with My Father here,
With Me, and with my Father not alone.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Come, tell Me all that ye have said and done,
Your victories and failures, hopes and fears;
I know how hardly souls are wooed and won;
My choicest wreaths are always wet with tears.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Come ye, and rest the journey is too great,
And ye will faint beside the way and sink;
The bread of life is here for you to eat,
And here for you the wine of love to drink.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Then, fresh from converse with the Lord, return
And work till daylight softens into even;
The brief hours are not lost in which ye learn
More of your Master and His rest in Heaven.

hymns.title: Father, Before Thy Throne of Light

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Father, before Thy throne of light,
The guardian angels bends,
And ever in Thy presence bright,
Their psalms adoring blend:
And casting down each golden crown.
Beside the crystal sea,
With voice and lyre, in happy choir,
Hymn glory, Lord to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: And as the rainbow lustre falls
Athwart their glowing wings,
While Seraph unto Seraph calls,
And each Thy goodness sings;
Oh may we feel, as low we kneel
To pray Thee for Thy grace,
That Thou art here, for all who fear
The brightness of Thy face.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Here, where the Angels see us come,
To worship day by day,
Teach us to seek our heav'nly home,
And serve Thee e'en as they;
With them to raise our notes of praise,
With them Thy love to own;
Till life's first flow'r and fullest pow'r,
Be Thine and Thine alone.

hymns.title: Thou Great Redeemer, Dying Lamb

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thou great Redeemer, dying Lamb,
We love to hear of Thee;
No music's like thy charming name.
Nor half so sweet can be. (2ce)

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O may we ever hear Thy voice
In mercy to us speak!
And in our Priest we will rejoice,
Thou great Melchizedek!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Our Jesus shall be still our theme
While in this world we stay;
We'll sing our Jesus' lovely name
When all things else decay.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When we appear in yonder cloud,
With all the favoured throng,
Then will we sing more sweet, more loud,
And Christ shall be our song.

hymns.title: My God, How Wonderful Thou Art

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My God, how wonderful Thou art,
Thy Majesty how bright!
How beautiful Thy mercy-seat,
In depths of burning light!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: How dread are Thine eternal years,
O everlasting Lord,
By prostrate spirits day and night
Incessantly adored!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: How beautiful, how beautiful,
The sight of Thee must be,
Thine endless wisdom, boundless power
And awful purity!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O how I fear Thee, living God,
With deepest, tenderest fears,
And worship Thee with trembling hope,
And penitential tears!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Yet I may love Thee too, O Lord,
Almighty as Thou art,
For Thou hast stooped to ask of me
The love of my poor heart.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: No earthly father loves like Thee;
No mother, e'er so mild,
Bears and forbears as Thou hast done
With me, Thy sinful child.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Father of Jesus, love's reward,
What rapture will it be,
Prostrate before Thy throne to lie,
And gaze, and gaze on Thee!

hymns.title: O Thou, My Soul, Bless God the Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O thou, my soul, bless God the Lord;
And all that in me is
Be stirred up His holy name
To magnify and bless.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Bless, O my soul, the Lord thy God.
And not forgetful be
Of all His gracious benefits
He hath bestowed on thee:

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: All thine iniquities who doth
Most graciously forgive:
Who thy diseases all and pains
Doth heal, and thee relieve.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Who doth redeem thy life, that thou
To death may'st not go down:
Who thee with loving-kindness doth
And tender mercies crown.

hymns.title: For Mercies, Countless as the Sands

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: For mercies, countless as the sands,
Which daily I receive,
From Jesus, my Redeemer's hands,
My Soul, what canst thou give?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Alas, from such a heart as mine,
What can I bring His forth?
My best is stain'd and dyed with sin,
My all is nothing worth.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Yet this acknowledgment I'll make,
For all He has bestow'd,
Salvation's sacred cup I'll take,
And call upon my God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The best return for one like me,
So wretched and so poor,
Is from His gifts to draw a plea,
And ask Him still for more.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: I cannot serve Him as I ought,
No works have I to boast;
Yet would I glory in the thought
That I shall owe Him most.

hymns.title: Lord of the Worlds Above

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord of the worlds above,
How pleasant and how fair
The dwellings of Thy love,
Thine earthly temples, are!
To thine abode my heart aspires,
With warm desires to see my God.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O happy souls that pray
Where God delights to hear!
O happy men that pay
Their constant service there!
They praise Thee still, and happy they
Who love the way to Zion's hill!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: They go from strength to strength,
Through this dark vale of tears,
Till each o'ercomes at length,
Till each in heaven appears:
O glorious seat! Thou God, our King,
Shalt thither bring our willing feet.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: God is our sun and shield,
Our lights and our defence;
With gifts His hands are filled,
We draw our blessings thence:
He shall bestow upon our race
His saving grace, and glory too.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: The Lord His people loves;
His hand no good withholds
From those His hearts approves,
From holy, humble souls
Thrice happy he, O Lord of Hosts,
Whose spirits trusts alone in Thee!

hymns.title: Join All the Glorious Names

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Join all the glorious names
Of wisdom, love and pow'r,
That mortals ever knew,
That angels ever bore:
All are too mean to speak His worth,
Too mean to set my Saviour forth.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Great Prophet of my God,
My tongue would bless Thy name;
By Thee the joyful news
Of our salvation came:
The joyful news of sin for-giv'n,
Of hell sub-dued, and peace with heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus, my great High Priest,
Offer'd His blood and died;
My guilty conscience seeks
No sacrifice beside:
His pow'rful blood did once atone
And now it pleads before the throne.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: My dear Almighty Lord,
My Conqueror and my King!
Thy matchless power and love,
Thy saving grace, I sing:
Thine is the power oh, may I sit
In willing bonds beneath Thy feet.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Then let my soul arise,
And tread the tempter down;
My Captain leads me forth
To conquest and a crown.
The feeblest saint shall win the day,
Though death and hell obstruct the way.

hymns.title: All People that on Earth Do Dwell

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: All people that on earth do dwell,
Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice;
Him serve with mirth, His praise forth tell;
Come ye be-fore Him and rejoice.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Know that the Lord is God indeed;
Without our aid He did us make;
We are His flock, He doth us feed,
And for His sheep He doth us take.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O enter then His gates with praises,
Approach with joy His courts unto;
Praise, laud, and bless His name always,
For it is seemly so to do.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: For why? The Lord our God is good;
His mercy is for ever sure;
His truth at all times firmly stood,
And shall from age to age endure.

hymns.title: Holy, Holy, Holy

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Holy, Holy, Holy,
Lord God Almighty!
Early in the morning
Our song shall rise to Thee;
Holy, Holy, Holy,
Merciful and mighty!
God in Three Persons,
Blessed, Trinity!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Holy, Holy, Holy!
All the saints adore Thee,
Casting down their golden crowns
Around the glassy sea;
Cherubim and Seraphim
Falling down before Thee,
Which wert and art,
And evermore shalt be.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Holy, Holy, Holy!
Though the darkness hide Thee,
Though the eye of sinful man
Thy glory may not see,
Only Thou art holy;
There is none beside Thee,
Perfect in power, in love,
And purity.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Holy, Holy, Holy,
Lord God Almighty!
All Thy works shall praise
Thy name, in earth and sky, and sea;
Holy, Holy, Holy,
Merciful and mighty,
God in Three Persons,
Blessed, Trinity.

hymns.title: O Lord My God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Lord my God!
When I in awesome wonder,
Consider all
The worlds Thy hands hath made
I see the stars,
I hear the rolling thunder
Thy pow'r thro'out
The universe displayed.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee;
How great Thou art!
How great Thou art!
Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee;
How great Thou art,
How great Thou art!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When through the woods
And forest glades I wander,
And hear the birds
Sing sweetly in the trees;
When I look down
From lofty mountain grandeur
And hear the brook
And feel the gentle breeze;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee;
How great Thou art!
How great Thou art!
Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee;
How great Thou art,
How great Thou art!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And when I think
That God, His Son not sparing
Sent Him to die,
I scarce can take it in;
That on the cross,
My burden gladly bearing,
He bled and died
To take away my sin.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee;
How great Thou art!
How great Thou art!
Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee;
How great Thou art,
How great Thou art!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When Christ shall come
With shout of acclamation,
And take me home
What joy shall fill my heart!
Then I shall bow
In humble adoration
And there proclaim,
My God, how great Thou art!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee;
How great Thou art!
How great Thou art!
Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee;
How great Thou art,
How great Thou art!

hymns.title: Immortal, Invisible, God only Wise

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Immortal, invisible, God only wise,
In light inaccessible hid from our eyes
Most blessed, most glorious, the Ancient of days,
Almighty, victorious, Thy great name we praise.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Unresting, unhasting, and silent as light,
Nor wanting, nor wasting, thou rulest in might!
Thy justice like mountains high soaring above,
Thy cloud which are fountains of goodness and love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: To all life thou givest to both great and small;
