In all life Thou livest, the true life of all;
We blossom and flourish as leaves on the tree,
And wither and perish-but nought changeth Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Great Father of Glory, pure Father of Light,
Thine angels adore Thee, all veiling their sight;
All laud we would render; O help us to see;
'Tis only the splendour of light hideth Thee.

hymns.title: God the Lord Is King: Before Him

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God the Lord is King: before Him,
Earth, with all thy nations, wait!
Where the cherubim adore Him,
Sitteth He in royal state:
He is holy;
Blessed, only Potentate!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: God the Lord is King of Glory,
Zion, tell the world His fame;
Ancient Israel, the story
Of His faithfulness proclaim:
He is holy;
Holy is His awful name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: In old times when dangers darkened,
When, invoked by priest and seer;
To His people's cry He hearkened
Answer'd them in all their fear:
He is holy;
As they call'd, they found Him near.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Laws divine to them were spoken,
From the pillar of the cloud,
Sacred precepts, quickly broken!
Fiercely then His vengeance flow'd,
He is holy;
To the dust their hearts were bowed.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: But their Father God forgave them,
When they sought His face once more;
Even ready was to save them,
Tenderly did He restore;
He is holy;
We too will His grace implore.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: God in Christ is all forgiving,
Waits His promise to fulfil:
Come, exalt Him all the living;
Come, ascend His holy hill!
He is holy;
Worship at His holy hill.

hymns.title: Father of All to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Father of all to Thee,
With loving hearts we pray
Through Him in mercy giv'n
The Life, the Truth, the Way
From heav'n, Thy throne, in mercy shed
Thou blessings on each bended head.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Father of all to Thee,
Our contrite hearts we raise
Unstrung by sin and pain
Long voiceless in Thy praise
Breathe Thou the silent chords along
Until they tremble into song.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Father of all to Thee,
We breathe unuttered fears
Deep hidden in our souls
That have no voice but tears
Take Thou our hand, and through the wild
Lead gently on each trustful child.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Father of all may we
In praise our tongues employ
When gladness fills the soup
With deep and hallow'd joy
In storm and calm give us to see
The path of peace which leads to Thee

hymns.title: Standing at the Portal

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Standing at the portal
Of the op'ning year,
Words of comfort meet us,
Hushing ev'ry fear;
Spoken thro' the silence
By our Father's voice,
Tender, strong, and faithful,
Making us rejoice.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Onward, then, and fear not,
Children of the day!
For His Word shall never,
Never pass away!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I, the Lord, am with thee,
Be thou not afraid!
I will help and strengthen,
Be thou not dismayed!
Yea, I will uphold thee
With My own right hand;
Thou art called and chosen
In My sight to stand.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Onward, then, and fear not,
Children of the day!
For His Word shall never,
Never pass away!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: For the year before us,
O what rich supplies!
For the poor and needy
Living streams shall rise;
For the sad and sinful
Shall His grace abound;
For the faint and feeble
Perfect strength be found.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Onward, then, and fear not,
Children of the day!
For His Word shall never,
Never pass away!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He will never fail us,
He will not forsake;
His eternal covenant
He will never break!
Resting on His promise,
What have we to fear?
God is all-sufficient
For the coming year.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Onward, then, and fear not,
Children of the day!
For His Word shall never,
Never pass away!

hymns.title: The Spacious Firmament on High

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The spacious firmament on high,
With all the blue ethereal sky,
And spangled heav'ns , a shining frame,
Their great Original proclaim.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Th' unwearied sun, from day to day,
Doth his Creator's power display;
And publishes to every land
The work of an Almighty hand.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Soon as the evening shades prevail,
The moon takes up the wondrous tale,
And nightly to the listening earth
Repeats the story of her birth:

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: While all the stars that round her burn,
And all the planets in their turn,
Confirm the tidings as they roll,
And spread the truth from pole to pole.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: What though in solemn silence all
Move round this dark terrestrial ball;
What though no real voice nor sound
Amidst the radiant orbs be found:

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: In reason's ear they all rejoice,
And utter forth a glorious voice,
For ever singing as they shine:
The hand that made us is divine!

hymns.title: Thou, Whose Almighty Word

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thou, whose almighty word
Chaos and darkness heard,
And took their flight,
Hear us, we humbly pray,
And where the Gospel day,
Sheds not its glorious ray.
Let there be light!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou, who didst come to bring
On Thy redeeming wing
Healing and sight,
Health to the sick in mind,
Sight top the inly blind,
Oh now, to all mankind
Let there be light!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Spirit of truth and love,
Life-giving, holy Dove,
Speed forth thy flight:
Move on the water's face,
Spreading the beams of grace,
And in earth's darkest place
Let there be light!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Blessed and holy Three,
Glorious Trinity,
Wisdom, love, might;
Boundless as ocean's tide
Rolling in fullest pride,
Through the earth far and wide,
Let there be light!

hymns.title: My Heart Is Open to Thee, Dear Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My heart is open to Thee, dear Lord
Come in, come in
My faith is clinging to thy dear word
Come in, come in

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come not to tarry, but stay dear Lord
All shall be thine love can afford
Here in my heart ever make thine abode
Come in, come in

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Yes there is room in my heart dear Lord
Come in, come in
Thy presence makes heaven real to me
Come in, come in

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come not to tarry, but stay dear Lord
All shall be thine love can afford
Here in my heart ever make thine abode
Come in, come in

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I kept thee standing outside so long
Come in, come in
I pray thee pardon this shameful wrong
Come in, come in

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come not to tarry, but stay dear Lord
All shall be thine love can afford
Here in my heart ever make thine abode
Come in, come in

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I hear thee knocking at my hearts door
Come in, come in
I'll keep thee waiting outside no more
Come in, come in

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come not to tarry, but stay dear Lord
All shall be thine love can afford
Here in my heart ever make thine abode
Come in, come in

hymns.title: How Firm a Foundation, Ye Saints of the Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: How firm a foundation, ye saints of the Lord,
Is laid for your faith in His excellent Word!
What more can He say than to you He hath said,
You who unto Jesus for refuge have fled?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Fear not, I am with Thee, O be not dismayed!
I, I am thy God and will still give thee aid:
I'll strengthen thee, help thee, and cause thee to stand,
Upheld by My righteous, omnipotent hand.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When through the deep waters I call thee to go,
The rivers of grief shall not Thee overflow:
For I will be with thee in trouble to bless:
And sanctify to thee thy deepest distress.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The soul that on Jesus hath leaned for repose,
I will not, I will not, desert to its foes!
That soul, through all hell should endeavour to shake,
I'll never, no, never, no, never forsake!

hymns.title: O Word, of Words the Sweetest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O word, of words the sweetest
O word, in which there lie
All promise, all fulfilment,
And end of mystery!
Lamenting, or rejoicing
With doubt or terror nigh,
I hear the "Come!" of Jesus,
And to His cross I fly.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "Come!... oh, come to Me!"
Come!... oh, come to Me!
Weary, heavy - laden,
Come!... oh, come to Me!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O soul! why shouldst thou wander,
From such a loving Friend!
Cling closer, closer to Him,
Stay with Him to the end:
Alas! I am so helpless,
So very full of sin,
For I am wand'ring,
And coming back again.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "Come!... oh, come to Me!"
Come!... oh, come to Me!
Weary, heavy - laden,
Come!... oh, come to Me!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh, each time draw me nearer,
That soon the "Come" may be,
Naught but a gentle whisper,
To one close, close to Thee;
Then, over sea and mountain,
Far from, or near my home,
I'll take Thy hand and follow,
At that sweet whisper, "Come!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "Come!... oh, come to Me!"
Come!... oh, come to Me!
Weary, heavy - laden,
Come!... oh, come to Me!

hymns.title: Lord, Thy Word Abideth

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord, Thy Word abideth,
And our footsteps guideth,
Who its truth believeth,
Light and joy receiveth.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When our foes are near us,
Then Thy Word doth cheer us,
Word of consolation,
Message of salvation.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When the storms are o'er us,
And dark clouds before us,
Then its light directeth,
And our way protecteth.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Who can tell the pleasure,
Who recount the treasure,
By Thy Word imparted
To the simple hearted?

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Word of mercy, giving
Succour to the living;
Word of life, supplying
Comfort to the dying!

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: O that we, discerning
Its most holy learning,
Lord, may love and fear Thee,
Evermore be near Thee!

hymns.title: Thy Word Is Like a Garden, Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thy word is like a garden, Lord,
With flowers bright and fair,
And every one that seeks may find
A lovely garland there.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thy word is like a deep, deep mine,
And jewels rich and rare
Are hidden in its mighty depths
For every searcher there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thy word is like the starry host!
A thousand rays of light
Are seen to guide the traveller,
And make his pathway bright.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thy word is like a glorious choir,
And loud its anthems ring;
Though many tongues and parts unite,
It is one song they sing.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thy word is like an armoury,
Where soldiers may repair,
And find for life's long battle day
And needful weapons there.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Oh! may I love Thy precious Word,
May I explore its mine!
May I its fragrant flowers glean,
May light upon me shine!

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Oh! may I find my armour there,
Thy word my trusty sword;
I'll learn to fight with every foe
The battle of the Lord.

hymns.title: The Spirit Breathes upon the Word

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The Spirit breathes upon the Word,
And brings the truth to sight;
Precepts and promise afford,
A sanctifying light.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: A glory gilds the sacred page,
Majestic, like the sun:
It gives a light to every age,
It gives, but borrows none.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The hand that gave it still supplies
The gracious light and heat;
Its truth upon the nations rise
They rise, but never set.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Let everlasting thanks be Thine
For such a bright display,
As makes a world of darkness shine
With beams of heavenly day.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: My soul rejoices to pursue
The steps of Him I love,
Till glory breaks upon my view
In brighter worlds above.

hymns.title: Master, Speak! Thy Servant Heareth

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Master, speak! Thy servant heareth,
Waiting for Thy gracious word,
Longing for thy voice that cheereth
Master, let it now be heard.
I am listening, Lord for Thee
What hast Thou to say to me?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Speak to me by name, O Master,
Let me know it is to me,
Speak that I may follow faster,
With a step more firm and free,
Where the shepherd leads the flock,
In the shadow of the Rock.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Master, speak though least and lowest,
Let me not unheard depart;
Master, speak! for oh, Thou knowest,
All the yearning of my heart!
Knowest all its truest needs;
Speak, and make me bless indeed

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Master, speak! And make me ready,
When Thy voice is truly heard,
With obedience glad and steady
Still to follow every word,
I am listening, Lord for thee;
Master, speak, oh, speak to me!

hymns.title: Cling to the Bible, Though All Else Be Taken

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Cling to the Bible, though all else be taken
Lose not it's precepts so precious and pure;
Souls that are sleeping, it's tidings awaken;
Life from the dead in its promises sure.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Cling to the Bible! cling to the Bible!
Cling to the Bible! Our lamp and our Guide.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Cling to the Bible! the jewel and treasure;
Brings life eternal, and saves fallen man:
Surely its value no mortal can measure;
Seek for its blessing O soul while you can.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Cling to the Bible! cling to the Bible!
Cling to the Bible! Our lamp and our Guide.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Lamp for the feet that in by ways have wandered,
Guide for the youth that would otherwise fall;
Hope for the sinner whose life has been squandered,
Staff for the aged and best seek of all.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Cling to the Bible! cling to the Bible!
Cling to the Bible! Our lamp and our Guide.

hymns.title: Just as God Who Reigns on High

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Just as God who reigns on high,
Spake to men in days gone by,
So the Lord is calling men today;
And, my brother, this is true,
Whatsoe'er He says to you,
There is but one thing to do just obey.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just obey, just obey
Is the way,(2ce) God's way;
When His message comes to you,
There is but one thing to do,
Just obey, just obey.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: If you're in the Saviour's hands,
You must do as He commands,
For there is no other gospel way;
Never put the message by,
Never stop to reason "why?"
When the Saviour speaks to you just obey.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just obey, just obey
Is the way,(2ce) God's way;
When His message comes to you,
There is but one thing to do,
Just obey, just obey.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: If for mansions fair you sigh,
In that land beyond the sky,
After time with you has pass'd away;
Though the way you may not see,
Christ is calling "follow me"
Faith and duty both will cry just obey

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just obey, just obey
Is the way,(2ce) God's way;
When His message comes to you,
There is but one thing to do,
Just obey, just obey.

hymns.title: Holy Bible, Book Divine

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Holy Bible, book divine,
Precious treasure, thou art mine;
Mine, to tell me whence I came;
Mine, to teach me what I am.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Mine, to chide me when I rove;
Mine, to show a Saviour's love;
Mine Thou art to guard and guide
Mine, to punish or reward.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Mine to comfort in distress,
Suffering in this wilderness;
Mine to show by living faith,
Man can triumph over death.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Mine to tell of joys to come,
Light and life beyond the tomb;
Holy Bible, book divine,
Precious treasure, thou art mine.

hymns.title: Wonderful Bible! Book of God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Wonderful Bible! Book of God;
Guide and counsel to mortal giv'n;
Lamp to the path by the ransomed trod,
Lighting the way from earth to heav'n.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Shine, O wonderful light divine,
Lamp of Truth, in this dark work shine
Shine thr'o the night of doubt, and fears,
Shine till the morn of God appears.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Wonderful Bible"! Law of the Lord;
All its precepts in grace abound
And in their keeping is great reward
Life everlasting there is found.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Shine, O wonderful light divine,
Lamp of Truth, in this dark work shine
Shine thr'o the night of doubt, and fears,
Shine till the morn of God appears.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Wonderful Bible! Radiance brought;
Ray serene from the world above,
Fairest of stars in humanity's night,
Fill now our hearts with light and love.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Shine, O wonderful light divine,
Lamp of Truth, in this dark work shine
Shine thr'o the night of doubt, and fears,
Shine till the morn of God appears.

hymns.title: They Word, O Lord, Thy Precious Word Alone

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thy word, O Lord, Thy precious Word alone,
Can lead me on;
By this, until the darksome night be gone,
Lead Thou me on;
Thy word is light, Thy word is life and power,
By it, O guide me in each trying hour!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: This all I have; around no light appears,
O lead me on!
With eyes on Thee, though gazing through my tears,
Lead Thou me on!
The good and best might lead me far astray,
Omniscient Saviour, lead Thou me, I pray!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Whate'er my path, led by Thy Word, 'tis good;
O lead me on!
Be my poor heart Thy blessed de, Word's abode,
Lead Thou me on!
Thy Holy Spirit gives the light to see,
And leads me, by
Thy Word, close following Thee!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Let by aught else, I tread a devious way;
O lead me on!
Speak, Lord, and help me ever to obey,
Lead Thou me on!
My every step shall then be well defined,
And all I do according to Thy mind!

hymns.title: O Word of God Incarnate

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Word of God incarnate,
O wisdom from on high,
O truth unchang'd, unchanging,
O Light of our dark sky,
We praise Thee for the radiance
That from the hallowed page,
A lantern to our footsteps,
Shines on from age to age.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The Church from her dear Master
Received the gift divine,
And still that light she lifteth,
O'er all the earth to shine;
It is the golden casket
Where gems of truth are stored;
It is the heaven-drawn picture
Of Christ, the living Word;

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: It floateth like a banner
Before God's host unfurled;
It shineth like a beacon
Above the darkling world;
It is the chart and compass
That, o'er life's surging sea,
'Mid mists, and rocks, and quicksands,
Still guides, O Christ, to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O make Thy Church, dear Saviour,
A lamp of burnished gold,
To bear before the nations
Thy true light, as of old;
O teach Thy wandering pilgrims
By this their path to trace,
Till, clouds and darkness ended,
They see Thee face to face.

hymns.title: Shine Thou upon Us, Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Shine Thou upon us, Lord,
True Light of men, today;
And through the written word,
The very self display;
That so from hearts which burn
With gazing on Thy face,
The little ones may learn
The wonders of Thy grace.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Breathe Thou upon us, Lord,
Thy Spirit's living flame
That so with one accord
Our lips may tell Thy name;
Give thou hearing ear,
Fix Thou the wandering thought,
That those we teach may hear
The great things Thou hast wrought.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Speak Thou for us, O Lord,
In all we say of Thee;
According to Thy word
Let all our teaching be;
That so Thy lambs may know
Their own true Shepherd's voice
Where'er He leads them go,
And in His love rejoice.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Live Thou within us, Lord;
Thy mind and will be ours;
Be Thou beloved, adored,
And served, with all our powers;
That so our lives may teach
Thy children what Thou art,
And plead, by more than speech,
For Thee with every heart.

hymns.title: There Is a Book, Who Runs May Read

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is a book, who runs may read,
Which heav'nly truth imparts;
And all the lore its scholars need,
Pure eyes and Christian hearts.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The works of God above, below
Within us and around,
Are pages in that book to show
How God Himself is found.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The glorious sky embracing all
Is like the Maker's love;
Wherewith encompass'd, great and small
In peace and order move.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: One Name, above all glorious names,
With its ten thousand tongues
The everlasting sea proclaims
Echoing angelic songs.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thou who hast giv'n me eyes to see
And love this sight so fair,
Give me a heart to find out Thee,
And read Thee everywhere.

hymns.title: The Bible Everlasting Book

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The Bible everlasting book!
Who knows thy deep secrets?
Your beginning on earth who knows?
And who can know Thy end?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The secrets of the God of heaven,
Ambassador from heaven;
The sword that kill'd the sting of death,
God's own image divine.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: A book indeed among thousands,
A book of ancient days;
Thou made salvation way so plain
To all mankind on earth.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The treasure of the Three-in-One,
The blessed Trinity;
Do, interpret Thyself to me,
And all my doubts dispel.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thy pages I'll open with pray'r,
To learn Thy doctrines Lord;
The everlasting Book divine,
Show me the Saviour's love.

hymns.title: Speak to My Soul, Lord Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Speak to my soul, Lord Jesus,
Speak now in tend'rest tone;
Whisper in loving-kindness;
"Thou art not left alone."
Open my heart to hear Thee,
Quickly to hear Thy voice,
Fill Thou my soul with praises,
Let me in Thee rejoice,

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Speak Thou in softest whispers,
Whispers of love to me;
"Thou shalt be always conqu'ror
Thou shalt be always free."
Speak Thou to me each day, Lord,
Always in tend'rest tone,
Let me now hear Thy whisper,
"Thou art not left alone."

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Speak to Thy children ever,
Lead in the holy way;
Fill them with joy and gladness,
Teach them to watch and pray,
May they in consecration
Yield their whole lives to Thee,
Hasten Thy coming kingdom,
Till our dear Lord we see.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Speak Thou in softest whispers,
Whispers of love to me;
"Thou shalt be always conqu'ror
Thou shalt be always free."
Speak Thou to me each day, Lord,
Always in tend'rest tone,
Let me now hear Thy whisper,
"Thou art not left alone."

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Speak now as in the old time,
Thou didst reveal Thy will;
Let me know all my duty,
Let me Thy Word fulfil,
Lead me to glorify Thee,
Help me to show Thy praise,
Gladly to do Thy bidding,
Honour Thee all my days.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Speak Thou in softest whispers,
Whispers of love to me;
"Thou shalt be always conqu'ror
Thou shalt be always free."
Speak Thou to me each day, Lord,
Always in tend'rest tone,
Let me now hear Thy whisper,
"Thou art not left alone."

hymns.title: O How Blest the Hour, Lord Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O how blest the hour, Lord Jesus,
When we can to Thee draw near,
Promises so sweet and precious
From Thy gracious lips to hear!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Be with us this day to bless us,
That we may not hear in vain;
With the saving truths impress us,
Which the words of life contain.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: See us, eager for salvation,
Sit, graat Master, at Thy feet,
And with breathless expectation,
Hang upon Thine accents sweet.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Open Thou our minds, and lead us
Safely on our heavenward way;
With the lamp of truth precede us,
That we may not go astray.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Make us gentle, meeek, and humble,
And yet bold in doing right;
Scatter darkness, lest we stumble;
Men walk safely in the light.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Lord, endue Thy word from heaven,
With such light, and love, and pow'r
That in us its silent leaven
May work on from hour to hour.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Give us grace to bear our witness,
To the truths we have embrace;
And let others both their sweetness,
And their quick'ning virtue taste.

hymns.title: How Shall Our Children and Young Ones

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: How shall our children and young ones
Take heed and cleanse their way,
Only by taking heed thereto
According to Thy word.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The word entered into the heart,
And shed its light abroad,
It gives wisdom to the simple,
And the knowledge of God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The word, is sun, our light divine,
Our guide in noon-day bright,
A lamp unto our feet always,
From dangers of the night.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thy word is everlasting Truth
It is all clean and pure,
Our guide in all our joyful days,
A staff for our old age.

hymns.title: Almighty God, Thy Word Is Cast

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Almighty God, thy word is cast
Like seed into the ground;
Now let the dew of heav'n descend,
And righteous fruits abound.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let not the foe of Christ and man
This holy seed remove;
But give it root in every heart,
To bring forth fruits of love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let not the world's deceitful cares
The rising plant destroy,
But let it yield a hundred fold
The fruits of peace and joy.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oft as the precious seed is sown,
Thy quickening grace bestow,
That all whose souls the truth receive
Its saving pow'r may know.

hymns.title: Thy Words Unto My Taste Are Sweet

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thy words unto my taste are sweet,
O Lord of hosts, Thy truth I love;
The light it shed, before my feet,
Streams from Thy dazzling place above.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O joy, within the page to find
Such wondrous treasures all my own;
To trace the mysteries of thy mind,
And reach the splendours of Thy throne!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: No human wisdom touched that height,
No creature tongue sang that high strain
Thy breath breath'd forth the holy light,
Thy finger scroll'd the message plain.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Yet, Mighty Word, Thou stopedst low
To falt'ring lip and feeble hand,
For humble men spake long ago,
Such wisdom as Thy Spirit planned.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: To profit him that hungereth
With rich delight and doctrine pure,
To quicken love and strengthen faith
And make his heav'nly calling sure.

hymns.title: I Am so Glad that Our Father in Heaven

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I am so glad that our Father in heaven
Tell of His love in the book He has given;
Wonderful things in the Bible I see;
This is the dearest, that Jesus loves me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me,
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus loves me and I know I love Him;
Love brought Him down my lost soul to redeem;
Yes, it was love made Him die on the tree:
Oh, I am certain that Jesus love me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me,
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: In this assurance I find sweetest rest,
Trusting in Jesus I know I am blest;
Satan dismayed from my soul doth now flee
When I just tell him that Jesus loves me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me,
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh, if there's only one song I can sing,
When in His beauty I see the great King,
This shall my song in eternity be,
"Oh, what a wonder that Jesus loves me!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me,
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: If one should ask of me, how can I tell?
Glory to Jesus, I know very well!
God's Holy Spirit with mine doth agree,
Constantly witnessing-Jesus loves me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me,
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

hymns.title: Come, O Thou Prophet of the Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, O Thou Prophet of the Lord,
Thou great interpreter divine,
Explain Thine own transmitted word,
To teach and to inspire is Thine;
Thou only canst Thyself reveal,
Open the book and loose the seal.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Whate'er the ancient prophets spoke
Concerning Thee, O Christ, make known;
Chief subject of the sacred book,
Thou fillest all, and Thou alone;
Yet there our Lord we cannot see,
Unless Thy Spirit lend the key.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Now, Jesus, now the veil remove,
The folly of our darkened heart;
Unfold the wonders of Thy love,
The knowledge of Thyself impart:
Our ear, our inmost soul, we bow,
Speak, Lord, Thy servants hearken now.

hymns.title: Father of Mercies, in Thy Word

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Father of mercies, in Thy Word
What endless glory shines!
For ever be Thy name adored
For these celestial lines.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Here may the wretched sons of want
Exhaustless riches find;
Riches, above what earth can grant,
And lasting as the mind.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Here the fair tree of knowledge grows,
And yields a free repast;
Sublimer sweets than nature knows
Invite the longing taste.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Here the Redeemer's welcome voice
Spreads heavenly peace around;
And life and everlasting joys
Attend the blissful sound.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Divine instructor, gracious Lord,
Be Thou for ever near;
Teach me to love Thy sacred Word,
And view my Saviour there.

hymns.title: Jesus Was Slain for Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus was slain for me,
At Calvary.
Crowned with thorns was He,
At Calvary.
There He in anguish died,
There from His opened side,
Poured forth the crimson tide,
At Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Pardoned is all my sin,
At Calvary.
Cleansed in my hearth within,
At Calvary.
Now robes of praise I wear,
Gone are my grief and care,
Christ bore my burdens there,
At Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Wondrous His love for me,
At Calvary.
Glorious His victory,
At Calvary.
Vanquished are death and hell,
Oh, let His praises swell,
Ever my tongues shall tell,
Of Calvary.

hymns.title: Sweet Is the Promise 'I Will Not Forget Thee'

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Sweet is the promise 'I will not forget thee',
Nothing can molest or turn my soul away,
E'en though the night be dark within the valley,
Just beyond is shining an eternal day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I will not forget thee or leave thee,
In my hands I'll hold thee,
In My arms I'll fold thee;
I will not forget thee or leave thee
I am Thy Redeemer, I will care for thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: How can I show my gratitude to Jesus,
For His love unfailing and His tender care
I will proclaim to others His salvation,
That they may accept Him and His promise share.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I will not forget thee or leave thee,
In my hands I'll hold thee,
In My arms I'll fold thee;
I will not forget thee or leave thee
I am Thy Redeemer, I will care for thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Trusting the promise 'I will not forget Thee',
Onward will I go with songs of joy and praise;
Though earth despise me, though my friends forsake me,
Jesus will be near me, gladdening my days.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I will not forget thee or leave thee,
In my hands I'll hold thee,
In My arms I'll fold thee;
I will not forget thee or leave thee
I am Thy Redeemer, I will care for thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When at my golden portals I am standing,
All my tribulations, all my sorrows past,
How sweet to hear the blessed proclamation:
"Enter faithful servant, welcome home at last."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I will not forget thee or leave thee,
In my hands I'll hold thee,
In My arms I'll fold thee;
I will not forget thee or leave thee
I am Thy Redeemer, I will care for thee.

hymns.title: Wonderful Story of Love

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Wonderful story of love;
Tell it to me again;
Wonderful story of love;
Wake the immortal strain!
Angels with rapture announce it,
Shepherds with wonder receive it;
Sinner, O won't you believe it?
Wonderful story of love.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Wonderful! Wonderful! Wonderful!
Wonderful story of love!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Wonderful story of love,
Though you are far away;
Wonderful story of love;
Still He doth call today;
Calling from Calvary's mountain,
Down from the crystal bright fountain,
E'en from the dawn of creation,
Wonderful story of love.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Wonderful! Wonderful! Wonderful!
Wonderful story of love!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Wonderful story of love:
Jesus provides a rest:
Wonderful story of love;
For all the pure and blest,
Rest in those mansions above us,
With those who've gone on before us
Singing the rapturous chorus,
Wonderful story of love.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Wonderful! Wonderful! Wonderful!
Wonderful story of love!

hymns.title: How Sweet the Name of Jesus Sounds

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: How sweet the name of Jesus sounds,
Blessed be the name of the Lord;
It soothes my sorrow heals my wounds,
Blessed be the name of the Lord;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Blessed be the name, blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name of the Lord
Blessed be the name, blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name of the Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It makes the wounded spirit whole,
Blessed be the name of the Lord;
'Tis manna to the hungry soul,
Blessed be the name of the Lord.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Blessed be the name, blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name of the Lord
Blessed be the name, blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name of the Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Then will I tell the sinners round,
Blessed be the name of the Lord;
What a dear Saviour I have found;
Blessed be the name of the Lord.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Blessed be the name, blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name of the Lord
Blessed be the name, blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name of the Lord.

hymns.title: How Sweet the Name of Jesus Sounds

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: How sweet the name of Jesus sounds
In a believer's ear;
It soothes his sorrows, heals his wounds
And drives away his fear.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It makes the wounded spirit whole,
And calms the troubled breast;
'Tis manna to the hungry soul!
And to the weary rest.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Dear name, the Rock on which I build
My shield and hiding-place,
My never-failing treasury filled
With boundless stores of grace.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus, my Shepherd, Saviour, Friend
My Prophet, Priest and King
My Lord, my LIfe, my Way, my End.
Accept the praise I bring.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Weak is the effort of my heart,
And cold my warmest thought;
But when I see Thee as Thou art
I'll praise Thee as I ought.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: I would Thy boundless love proclaim
With every fleeting breath;
So shall the music of Thy name
Refresh my soul in death.

hymns.title: Crown Him with Many Crowns

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Crown Him with many crowns,
The Lamb upon His Throne;
Hark! how the heav'nly anthems drowns
All music but its own:
Awake, my soul, and sing
Of Him who died for thee,
And hail Him as thy matchless King
Thro' all eternity.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Crown Him the virgin's Son,
The God incarnate born,
Whose arm those crimson trophies won
Which now His brow adorn:
Fruit of the mystic Rose,
As of that Rose the Stem;
The Root whence mercy ever flows,
The Babe of Bethlehem.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Crown Him the Lord of love:
Behold His hands and side,
Those wounds yet visible above
In beauty glorified:
No angel in the sky
Can fully bear that sight,
But downward bends his burning eye
At mysteries so bright.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Crown Him the Lord of life,
Who triumphed o'er the grave,
And rose victorious in the strife,
For those He came to save;
His glories now we sing;
Who died, and rose on high,
Who died-eternal life to bring,
And lives, that death may die.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Crown Him the Lord of peace,
Whose power a sceptre sways
Form pole to pole, that wars may cease,
And all be prayer and praise:
His reign shall know no end,
And round His pierced feet
Fair flowers Paradise extend
Their fragrance ever sweet.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Crown Him the Lord of years,
The Potentate of time,
Creator of the rolling spheres,
Ineffably sublime:
All hail, Redeemer, hail!
For Thou hast died for me;
Thy praise shall never, never fail
Throughout eternity.

hymns.title: Head of Thy Church Triumphant

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Head of Thy Church triumphant,
We joyfully adore Thee
Till Thou appear,
Thy members here
Shall sing like those in glory.
We lift our hearts and voices
With blest anticipation,
And cry aloud.
And give to God
The praise of our salvation.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The name we still acknowledge
That bursts our bonds asunder
And loudly sing
Our conq'ring King
In songs of joy and wonder
In every day's deliverance
Our Jesus we discover
"Tis He, 'tis He
That smote the sea
And led us safely over.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: While in affliction's furnace
And passing through the fire
Thy love we praise
Which knows our days
And ever brings us nigher
We clap our hands exalting
In Thine Almighty favour
The love divine
Which made us Thine
Shall keep us Thine for ever.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: By faith we see the glory
To which Thou shalt restore us
The cross despise
For that high prize
Which Thou hast set before us
And if Thou count us worthy
We each, as dying Stephen
Shall see Thee stand
At God's right hand
To take us up to heaven.

hymns.title: Not All the Blood of Beasts

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Not all the blood of beasts,
On jewish altar slain,
Could give the guilty conscience peace,
Or wash away the stain.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: But Christ the heavenly Lamb,
Takes all our sins away;
A sacrifice of nobler name
And richer blood than they.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My faith would lay her hand
On that dear head of Thine,
While like a penitent I stand,
And there confess my sin.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: My soul looks back to see
The burdens Thou didst bear,
When hanging on the cursed tree,
And knows her guilt was there.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Believing, we rejoice
To see the curse remove:
We bless the Lamb with cheerful voice
And sing His bleeding love!

hymns.title: Take the Name of Jesus with You

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Take the name of Jesus with you,
Child of sorrow and of woe;
It will joy and comfort give you
Take it then where'er you go.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Precious name... oh, how sweet!..
Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.
Precious name... oh, how sweet!..
Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It makes the wounded spirit whole,
Blessed be the name of the Lord;
'Tis manna to the hungry soul,
Blessed be the name of the Lord.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Precious name... oh, how sweet!..
Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.
Precious name... oh, how sweet!..
Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh, the precious name of Jesus!
How it thrills our souls with joy,
When His loving arms receive us,
And His songs our tongues employ!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Precious name... oh, how sweet!..
Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.
Precious name... oh, how sweet!..
Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: At the name of Jesus bowing,
Falling prostrate at His feet;
King of kings in heav'n we'll crown Him
When our journey is complete.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Precious name... oh, how sweet!..
Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.
Precious name... oh, how sweet!..
Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.

hymns.title: Jesus Shall Reign Where'er the Sun

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus shall reign where'er the sun
Doth his successive journeys run;
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore,
Till suns shall rise and set no more.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For Him shall endless prayer be made,
And praises throng to crown His head;
His Name like sweet perfume shall rise
With every morning sacrifice.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song;
And infant voices shall proclaim
Their young hosannas to His name.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Blessings abound where'er He reigns;
The prisoner leaps to lose his chains;
The weary find eternal rest;
And all the sons of want are blest.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Where He displays His healing power;
Death and the curse are known no more,
In Him the tribes of Adam boast
More blessings than their father lost.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Let every creature rise and bring,
Its grateful honours to our King;
Angels descend with songs again,
And earth prolong the joyful strain.

hymns.title: Let Earth and Heav'n Agree

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Let earth and heav'n agree,
Angels and men be joined,
To celebrate with me
The Saviour of mankind;
To adore the all-atoning Lamb,
And bless the sound of Jesus' name.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus, transporting sound!
The joy of earth and heaven;
No other help is found,
No other name is given,
By which we can salvation have;
But Jesus came the world to save.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus, harmonious name!
It charms the hosts above;
They evermore proclaim,
And wonder at His love;
'Tis all their happiness to gaze
'Tis heaven to see our Jesus' face.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: His name the sinner hears,
And is from sin set free;
'Tis music in his ears,
'Tis life and victory;
New songs do now his lips employ,
And dances his glad heart for joy.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Stung by the scorpion sin,
My poor expiring soul
The balmy sound drinks in,
And is at once made whole:
See there my Lord upon the tree!
I hear, I feel, He died for me.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: O unexampled love!
O all-redeeming grace!
How swiftly didst Thou move
To save a fallen race!
What shall I do to make it known
What Thou for all mankind hast done?

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: O for a trumpet voice
On all the world to call;
To bid their hearts rejoice
In Him who died for all,
For all my Lord was crucified,
For all, for all my Saviour died!

hymns.title: There Is a Name I Love to Hear

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is a name I love to hear,
I love to sing its worth,
It sounds like music in mine ear,
The sweetest name on earth.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It tell me of a Saviour's love
Who died to set me free,
It tells me of His precious blood,
The sinner's perfect plea.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: It bids my trembling soul rejoice,
And dries each rising tear;
It tells me in a "still small voice,"
To trust and never fear.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus, the name I love so well,
The name I love to hear,
No saint on earth its worth can tell,
No heart conceive how dear.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: This name shall shed its fragrance still
Along this thorny road,
Shall sweetly smooth the rugged hill
That leads me up to God.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: And there, with all the blood-bought throng,
From sin and sorrow free,
I'll sing the new eternal song
Of Jesus' love to me.

hymns.title: All Glory, Laud, and Honour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: All glory, laud, and honour
To Thee, Redeemer, King
To whom the lips of children
Made sweet Hosannas ring!
Thou art the King of Israel,
Thou David's Royal Son,
Who in the Lord's name comest,
The King and Blessed One.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All glory, laud, and honour
To Thee, Redeemer, King
To whom the lips of children
Made sweet Hosannas ring.
The company of angels
Are praising Thee on high:
And mortal men, and all things
Created, make reply.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: All glory, laud, and honour
To Thee, Redeemer, King
To whom the lips of children
Made sweet Hosannas ring.
The people of the Hebrews
With palms before Thee went;
Our praise and prayer and anthems
Before Thee we present.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: All glory, laud, and honour
To Thee, Redeemer, King
To whom the lips of children
Made sweet Hosannas ring.
To Thee before Thy passion
They sang their hymns of praise;
To, Thee, now high exalted,
Our melody we raise.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: All glory, laud, and honour
To Thee, Redeemer, King
To whom the lips of children
Made sweet Hosannas ring.
Thou didst accept their praises;
Accept the prayers we bring,
Who in all good delightest
Thou good and gracious King.

hymns.title: In the Name of Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: In the Name of Jesus
Ev'ry knee shall bow,
Ev'ry tongue confess Him
King of glory now:
'Tis the Father's pleasure
We should call Him Lord,
Who from the beginning
Was the Mighty Word.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: At His voice, creation
Sprang at once to sight,
All the angel faces,
All the hosts of light,
Thrones and Dominations,
Stars upon their way,
All the heavenly orders,
In their great array.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Humbled for a season,
To receive a name
From the lips of sinners
Unto whom He came;
Faithfully He bore it,
Spotless to the last,
Brought it back victorious,
When from death He passed.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Bore it up triumphant,
With its human light,
Through all ranks of creatures,
To the central height,
To the throne of Godhead,
To the Father's breast,
Filled it with the glory,
Of that perfect rest.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: In your hearts enthrone Him;
There let Him subdue
All that is not holy,
All that is not true;
Crown Him as your Captain
In temptation's hour;
Let His will enfold you
In its light and power.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Brothers, this Lord Jesus
Shall return again
With His Father's glory,
With His angel train;
For all wreaths of empire
Meet upon His brow,
And our hearts confess Him,
King of glory now.

hymns.title: 'Tis Finished! The Messiah Dies

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: 'Tis finished! the Messiah dies:
Cut off for sins, but not His own:
Accomplished is the sacrifice,
The great redeeming work is done.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "Tis finished! all the debt is paid;
Justice divine is satisfied;
The grand and full atonement made;
God for a guilty world hath died.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The veil is rent in Christ alone;
The living way to heaven is seen;
The middle wall is broken down,
And all mankind may enter in.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The types and figures are fulfilled,
Exacted is the legal pain;
The precious promises are sealed;
The spotless Lamb of God is slain.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: The reign of sin and death is o'er
And all may live from sin set free;
Satan hath lost his mortal power;
"Tis swallowed up in victory.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Saved from the legal curse I am,
My Saviour hangs on yonder tree;
See there the meek, expiring Lamb!
"Tis finished! He expires for me.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Accepted in the Well-beloved,
And clothed in righteousness divine,
I see the bar to heaven removed;
And all Thy merits, Lord, are mine.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Death, hell, and sin are now subdued;
All grace is now to sinners given;
And lo, I plead the atoning blood,
And in Thy right I claim Thy heaven.

hymns.title: O Head Once Fill'd with Bruises

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O head once fill'd with bruises,
Oppress'd with pain and scorn:
O'erwhelm'd with sore abuses,
Mock'd with a crown of thorn!
O head to death once wounded,
In shame upon the tree,
In glory now surrounded,
With brightest Majesty!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou, Lord, of all transcendent;
Thou life-creating Sun
To worlds on Thee dependent
Yet bruised and spit upon!
O Lord! what Thee tormented
Was our sin's heavy load;
We had the debt augmented
Which Thou didst pay in blood.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We give Thee thanks unfeigned,
Lord Jesus, Friend in need,
For what Thy Soul sustained,
When Thou for us didst bleed;
Grant us to lean unshaken
Upon Thy faithfulness,
Until to glory taken,
We see Thee face to face.

hymns.title: Low in the Grave He Lay

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Low in the grave He lay
Jesus, my Saviour!
Waiting the coming day
Jesus, my Lord!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Up from the grave He arose,...
With a mighty triumph o'er His foes;
He arose, a Victor from the dark domain,
And He lives for ever with
His saints to reign;
He arose!... He arose!..
Halleluyah! Christ arose!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Vainly they watch His bed
Jesus, my Saviour!
Vainly they seal the dead
Jesus, my Lord!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Up from the grave He arose,...
With a mighty triumph o'er His foes;
He arose, a Victor from the dark domain,
And He lives for ever with
His saints to reign;
He arose!... He arose!..
Halleluyah! Christ arose!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Death cannot keep His prey
Jesus, my Saviour!
He tore the bars away
Jesus, my Lord!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Up from the grave He arose,...
With a mighty triumph o'er His foes;
He arose, a Victor from the dark domain,
And He lives for ever with
His saints to reign;
He arose!... He arose!..
Halleluyah! Christ arose!

hymns.title: Ride On! Ride on in Majesty!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Ride on! ride on in majesty!
Hark! all the tribes 'Hosanna!' cry;
O Saviour meek, pursue Thy road
With palms and scatter'd garments strow'd.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Ride on! ride on in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die;
Oh Christ, Thy triumphs now begin
O'er captives death and conquer'd sin.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Ride on! ride on in majesty!
The winged squadrons of the sky
Look down with sad and wondering eyes
To see approaching sacrifice.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Ride on! ride on in majesty!
Thy last and fiercest strife is nigh;
The Father on His sapphire throne
Expects His own anointed Son.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Ride on! ride on in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die;
Bow Thy meek head to mortal pain,
Then take, O God, Thy power, and reign.

hymns.title: Jesus My Saviour to Bethlehem Came

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus my Saviour to Bethlehem came
Born in a manger to sorrow and shame;
Oh, it was wonderful - blest be His name!
Seeking for me, for me!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: CHORUS:
Coming for me!.. for me!.
Coming for me!.. for me!.
Oh, I shall see Him descending the sky,
Coming for me, for me!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus my Saviour, on Calvary's tree
Paid the great debt, and my soul He set free,
Oh, it was wonderful - How could it be?
Dying for me, for me!..

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: CHORUS:
Coming for me!.. for me!.
Coming for me!.. for me!.
Oh, I shall see Him descending the sky,
Coming for me, for me!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus my Saviour, the same as of old,
While I was wandering afar from the fold,
Gently and long did He plead with my soul,
Calling for me, for me!..

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: CHORUS:
Coming for me!.. for me!.
Coming for me!.. for me!.
Oh, I shall see Him descending the sky,
Coming for me, for me!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus my Saviour shall come from on high
Sweet is the promise as weary years fly;
Oh, I shall see Him descending the sky,
Coming for me, for me!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: CHORUS:
Coming for me!.. for me!.
Coming for me!.. for me!.
Oh, I shall see Him descending the sky,
Coming for me, for me!

hymns.title: Oh, How Sweet the Glorious Message

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Oh, how sweet the glorious message,
Simple faith may claim;
Yesterday, today, forever, Jesus is the same.
Still He loves to save the sinful,
Heal the sick and lame;
Cheer the mourner, still the tempest,
Glory to His name!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yesterday, to-day, for ever,
Jesus is the same,
All may change, but Jesus never!
Glory to His name,
Glory to His name,
Glory to His name,
All may change, but Jesus never!
Glory to His name.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Him who pardon'd erring Peter,
Never need'st thou fear;
He that came to faithless Thomas,
All thy doubt will clear.
He who let the lov'd disciple
On His bosom rest,
Bids thee still, with love as tender,
Lean upon His breast.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yesterday, to-day, for ever,
Jesus is the same,
All may change, but Jesus never!
Glory to His name,
Glory to His name,
Glory to His name,
All may change, but Jesus never!
Glory to His name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He who mid the raging billows
Walk'd upon the sea;
Still can hush our wildest tempest,
As on Galilee.
He who wept and pray'd in anguish,
In Gethsemane,
Drinks with us each cup of trembling,
In our agony.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yesterday, to-day, for ever,
Jesus is the same,
All may change, but Jesus never!
Glory to His name,
Glory to His name,
Glory to His name,
All may change, but Jesus never!
Glory to His name.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: As of old He walked to Emmaus,
With them to abide;
So thro' all life's way He walketh,
Ever near our side.
Soon again shall we behold Him,
Hasten, Lord, the day!
But 'twill still be "this same Jesus,"
As He went away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yesterday, to-day, for ever,
Jesus is the same,
All may change, but Jesus never!
Glory to His name,
Glory to His name,
Glory to His name,
All may change, but Jesus never!
Glory to His name.

hymns.title: Thou Didst Leave Thy Throne

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thou didst leave Thy throne
And Thy kingly crown,
When Thou camest to earth for me;
But in Bethlehem's home
Was there found no room
For Thy holy nativity:
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus;
There is room in my heart for Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Heaven's arches rang
When the angels sang,
Proclaiming Thy royal degree;
But lowly birth
Cam'st Thou, Lord, on earth,
And in great humility:
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus;
There is room in my heart for Thee

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The foxes found rest,
And the birds their nest,
In the shade of the cedar tree;
But Thy couch was the sod,
O Thou Son of God,
In the deserts of Galilee;
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus;
There is room in my heart for Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou camest, O Lord,
With the living word
That should set Thy people free;
But with mocking scorn,
And with crown of thorn,
They bore Thee to Calvary:
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus;
Thy cross is my only plea.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: When heav'n arches ring,
And her choirs shall sing,
At Thy coming to victory,
Let Thy voice call me home,
Saying, "Yet there is room,
There is room at My side for thee!"
And my heart shall rejoice, Lord Jesus,
When Thou comest and callest for me.

hymns.title: There's Not a Friend Like the Lowly Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's not a friend like the lowly Jesus,
No, not one! no, not one!
None else could heal all our soul's diseases,
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus knows all about our struggles,
He will guide till the day is done;
There's not a friend like the lowly Jesus,
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: No friend like Him is so high and holy,
No, not one! no, not one!
And yet no friend is so meek and lowly,
No not one! no, not one!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus knows all about our struggles,
He will guide till the day is done;
There's not a friend like the lowly Jesus,
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There's not an hour that He is not near us,
No, not one! no, not one!
No night so dark but His love can cheer us,
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus knows all about our struggles,
He will guide till the day is done;
There's not a friend like the lowly Jesus,
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Did ever saint find this Friend forsake him?
No, not one! no, not one!
Or sinner find that He would not take him?
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus knows all about our struggles,
He will guide till the day is done;
There's not a friend like the lowly Jesus,
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Was e'er a gift like the Saviour given?
No, not one! no, not one!
Will He refuse us a home in heaven?
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus knows all about our struggles,
He will guide till the day is done;
There's not a friend like the lowly Jesus,
No, not one! no, not one!

hymns.title: Hosanna Unto David's Son

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hosanna unto David's Son,
Hosanna, raise the strain,
For blessed is He that will come,
In the name of the Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Hosanna unto David's Son
The angel host did sing
All creatures, join the loud refrain
Hosanna to our King.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Hosanna for the Hebrew throng
Spread palm fronds on the road
Hosanna we have brought our gifts
For to prepare His way.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Both young and old sing hosanna
Before His suffering comes
Today we all sing hosanna
As Jesus reigns above.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: As Thou received the children's praise
Accept the prayers we bring
And join the heavenly host to sing.
Hosanna to our King.

hymns.title: O Come All Ye Faithful

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O come, all ye faithful! joyfully triumphant,
To Bethlehem hasten now with glad accord;
Lo! in a manger lies the God Almighty;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Raise, raise choirs of angels, songs of loudest triumph,
Through heaven’s high arches be your praises poured:
Now to our God be glory in the highest;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Amen! Lord, we bless Thee, born for our salvation!
O Jesus! forever be Thy Name adored;
Word of the Father, late in flesh appearing;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord!

hymns.title: While Shepherds Watched Their Flocks

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: While shepherds watched their flocks by night,
all seated on the ground,
an angel of the Lord came down,
and glory shone around.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Fear not, said he; for mighty dread
had seized their troubled mind;
Glad tidings of great joy I bring
to you and all mankind.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: To you, in David's town, this day
is born of David's line
a Savior, who is Christ the Lord
And this shall be the sign:

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The heavenly babe you there shall find
to human view displayed
all meanly wrapped in swaddling bands
and in a manger laid.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thus spake the seraph; and forth-with a shining throng
of angels praising God, who thus
Addressed their joyful song.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: All glory be to God on high
and to the earth be peace;
Good will henceforth
From heaven men
Begin and never cease!

hymns.title: Christians, Awake, Salute the Happy Morn

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Christians, awake, salute the happy morn,
whereon the Savior of the world was born;
rise to adore the mystery of love,
which hosts of angels chanted from above;
with them the joyful tidings were begun
of God incarnate and the Virgin’s son.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Then to the watchful shepherds it was told,
who heard the angelic herald’s voice: Behold,
I bring good tidings of a Savior’s birth
to you and all the nations on the earth:
this day hath God fulfilled his promised word,
this day is born a Savior, Christ the Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He spake, and straightway the celestial choir
in hymns of joy, unknown before, conspire;
the praises of redeeming love they sang,
and heaven's whole orb with Hallelujahs rang,
God’s highest glory was their anthem still,
peace on the earth, and unto men goodwill.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: To Bethlehem straight the happy shepherds ran,
to see the wonder God had wrought for man;
Then to their flocks, still praising God, return,
And their glad hearts, with holy rapture burn;
Amazed,  the wondrous tidings they proclaim,
The first apostles of His infant fame

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Oh, may we keep and ponder in our mind
God’s wondrous love in saving lost mankind!
Trace we the babe, who hath retrieved our loss,
from his poor manger to the bitter cross.
Tread in his steps, assisted by his grace,
till man's first heavenly state again takes place.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Then may we hope, the angelic among,
to sing, redeemed, a glad triumphal song;
he that was born upon this joyful day
around us all his glory shall display
saved by his love, incessant we shall sing
eternal praise to heaven’s almighty King.

hymns.title: Hark! The Herald Angels Sing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hark! the herald angels sing,
“Glory to the new-born King;
Peace on earth, and mercy mild;
God and sinners reconciled.”
Joyful, all ye nations, rise,
Join the triumph of the skies;
With th'angelic hosts proclaim,
Christ is born in Bethlehem.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Christ, by highest heav’n adored,
Christ, the everlasting Lord,
Late in time behold Him come,
Offspring of a virgin’s womb!
Veiled in flesh the Godhead see,
Hail the incarnate Deity!
Pleas'd as man with man to dwell,
Jesus our Immanuel.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Hail the heav’n-born Prince of Peace!
Hail the Sun of righteousness!
Light and life to all He brings,
Risen with healing in His wings,
Mild He lays His glory by,
Born that man no more may die,
Born to raise the sons of earth
Born to give them second birth.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Come, Desire of nations, come,
Fix in us Thy humble home;
Rise, the woman’s conquering seed,
Bruise in us the serpent’s head.
Adam’s likeness now efface,
Stamp Thine image in its place:
Second Adam from above,
Reinstate us in Thy love.

hymns.title: Angels From the Realms of Glory

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Angels from the realms of glory,
Wing your flight o'er all the earth;
Ye who sang creation's story,
Now proclaim Messiah's birth:
Come and worship
Come and worship
Worship Christ, the new-born King!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Shepherds in the field abiding,
Watching o'er your flocks by night;
God with man is now residing,
Yonder shines the infant light:
Come and worship
Come and worship
Worship Christ, the new-born King!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Sages, leave your contemplations;
Brighter visions beam afar;
Seek the great "Desire of nations;
Ye have seen His natal star;
Come and worship
Come and worship
Worship Christ, the new-born King!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Saints, before the altar bending,
Watching long with hope and fear,
Suddenly the Lord, descending,
In His temple shall appear;
Come and worship
Come and worship
Worship Christ, the new-born King!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: All creation, join in praising,
God the Father, Spirit, Son,
Evermore your voices raising,
To th' Eternal Three in One;
Come and worship
Come and worship
Worship Christ, the new-born King!

hymns.title: Joy to the World! The Lord Is Come

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Joy to the world! The Lord is come;
Let earth receive her King,
Let every heart prepare Him room,
And heaven and nature sing,
And heaven and nature sing,
And heav'n, and heav'n and nature sing.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Joy to the earth! the Saviour reigns;
Let men their songs employ;
While fields and floods, rocks, hills and plains.
Repeat the sounding joy;
Repeat the sounding joy;
Repeat the sounding, joy.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: No more let sins and sorrows grow,
Nor thorns infest the ground;
He comes to make His blessings flow
Far as the curse is found,
Far as the curse is found,
Far as the curse is found

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He rules the world with truth and grace,
And makes the nations prove,
The glories of His righteousness
And wonders of His love,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders of His love.

hymns.title: As with Gladness Men of Old

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: As with gladness men of old
Did the guiding star behold,
As with joy they hailed its light,
Leading onward, beaming bright;
So, most gracious Lord, may we
Evermore be led to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: As with joyful steps they sped,
Saviour, to Thy lowly bed,
There to bend the knee before
Thee, whom heav'n and earth adore;
So may we with willing feet
Ever seek the mercy-seat.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: As they offered gifts most rare
At thy cradle rude and bare;
So may we with holy joy,
Pure, and free from sin's alloy,
All our costliest treasures bring,
Christ, to Thee, our heav'nly King.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Holy Jesus, every day,
Keep us in the narrow way;
And, when earthly things are past,
Bring our ransomed souls at last
Where they need no star to guide,
Where no clouds Thy glory hide.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: In the heavenly country bright
Need they no created light;
Thou its light, its joy, its crown,
Thou its sun which goes not down;
There for ever may we sing
Hallelujahs to our King.

hymns.title: Joy Fills Our Inmost Heart To-Day

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Joy fills our inmost heart to-day
The royal Child is born;
And angel hosts in glad array
His advent keep this morn.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rejoice, rejoice! the incarnate Word
Has come on earth to dwell;
No sweeter sound than this is heard
Emmanuel.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Low at the cradle throne we bend,
We wonder and adore;
And feel no bliss can ours transcend,
No joy was sweet before.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rejoice, rejoice! the incarnate Word
Has come on earth to dwell;
No sweeter sound than this is heard
Emmanuel.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: For us the world must lose its charms
Before the manger shrine,
When, folded in Thy mother's arms
We see Thee Babe divine.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rejoice, rejoice! the incarnate Word
Has come on earth to dwell;
No sweeter sound than this is heard
Emmanuel.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou Light of uncreated Light,
Shine on us, Holy Christ;
That we may keep Thy birthday bright
With service undefiled.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rejoice, rejoice! the incarnate Word
Has come on earth to dwell;
No sweeter sound than this is heard
Emmanuel.

hymns.title: Brightest and Best of the Sons of the Morning

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Brightest and best of the sons of the morning
Dawn on our darkness, and lend us thine aid,
Star of the East, the horizon adorning
Guide where our infant Redeemer is laid.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Cold on His cradle the dew-drops are shining;
Low lies His head with the beasts of the stall;
Angels adore Him in slumber reclining
Maker, and Monarch, and Saviour of all.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Say, shall we yield Him, in costly devotion,
Odours of Edom, an offerings divine,
Gems of the mountain and pearls of the ocean,
Myrrh from the forest of gold from the mine?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Vainly we offer each ample oblation;
Vainly with gifts would His favour secure;
Richer by far is the heart's adoration;
Dearer to God are the pray'rs of the poor.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Brightest and best of the sons of the morning,
Dawn on our darkness, and lend us thine aid;
Star of the East, the horizon adorning.
Guide where our infant Redeemer is laid.

hymns.title: Songs of Praise the Angels Sang

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Songs of praise the angels sang,
Heav'n with alleluias rang,
When creation was begun,
When God spake, and it was done.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Songs of praise awoke the morn
When the Prince of Peace was born;
Songs of praise arose when He
Captive led captivity.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Heav'n and earth must pass away;
Songs of praise shall crown that day;
God will make new heav'ns and earth
Songs of praise shall hail their birth.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And can man alone be dumb
Till that glorious Kingdom come?
No! the church delights to raise
Psalms, and hymns, and songs of praise.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Saints below, with heart and voice,
Still in songs of praise rejoice,
Learning here, by faith and love,
Songs of praise to sing above.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Borne upon their latest breath,
Songs of praise shall conquer death;
Then, amidst eternal joy,
Songs of praise their pow'rs employ.

hymns.title: Awake, Awake, All Nations

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Awake, awake, all nations
No longer slumber on
Our light of lights supernal
Now makes its rays appear
The sun gives natural light
Christ illuminates the hearts
Must the hope of our Fathers
Dawn upon us in vain?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He comes from sin to set free
Rejoice Christ's kingdom bring us
A great era of peace
To Him let's bring our offerings
Of worship, love and praise
Wise men brought gifs from afar
Shall we not give our hearts.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let us give our hearts to Him
Let Him be enthroned there
Surrender all to Jesus,
Be subject to His will,
Rejoice, again rejoice, ye
For Christ the Lord is come,
For the riches and the poor,
Our Lord Jesus is come.

hymns.title: Peace on the Earth Good Will Unto Men

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Peace on the earth good will unto men
Was the song of the angels,
Shepherd abiding in the field,
Heard, and herald Jesus birth.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: 'Twas upon the mount of Judea
There was great light of stars seen
To guide the wise men on their way.
To look for this precious gift.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And the three wise men saw the light
As it was shown unto them
To the child they brought precious gifts.
Gold, Silver and Frankincense.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: By the manger where Jesus laid
They fell and worship'd their King
In humble they offer'd their gifts
To Him that brought salvation.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Our Lord Jesus is born newly,
As the year is passing by
In the heart of all His children
As foretold by the angels.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Behold we see the star newly
Like the time of Jesus birth
May His blessing be upon us
As the year is passing by.

hymns.title: Christians Lift Your Voice in Praises

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Christians lift your voice in praises,
On this memorable day,
Hear the voices of the angels,
Singing praises to our God,
Singing praises,
Singing praises,
Peace of the earth goodwill to men.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let the whole earth now sing praises,
To the glorious Lord and King
The begotten Son of Father
Who is born of virgin's birth
Wonderful Lord,
Wonderful Lord,
Is the Saviour born today

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: In the midst of chaos and danger
And the evils of the world
In the distraction of our sins
The Son of God come to save
The Counsellor,
The Counsellor,
Jesus Christ the Prince of Peace.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Almighty and most gracious Lord
Born today as newly babe
Father, who is everlasting
Now our Controller to be
O be joyful,
O be joyful,
The Son of David now reigns.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: He has come to save us from sin,
Our Advocator to be
Satan's chain the Lord hath broken
He is made the glorious being.
Therefore rejoice,
Therefore rejoice,
We are now sav'd from the death.

hymns.title: Arise, My Soul, Arise

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Arise, my soul, arise,
Shake off thy guilty fears:
The bleeding sacrifice
In my behalf appears;
Before the throne my surety stands
My name is written on His hands.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He ever lives above,
For me to intercede;
His all redeeming love,
His precious blood to plead;
His blood atoned for all our race,
And sprinkles now the throne of grace.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Five bleeding wounds He bears,
Receiv'd on Calvary;
They pour effectual pray'r
They strongly plead for me;
"Forgive him, oh, forgive," they cry,
"Nor let that ransom'd sinner die".

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The Father hears Him pray,
His dear Anointed One:
He cannot turn away
The presence of His Son:
His Spirit answers to the blood,
And tells me I am born of God.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: My God is reconciled,
His pad'ning voice I hear;
He owns me for His child,
I can no longer fear;
With confidence I now draw nigh,
And "Father, Abba, Father," cry.

hymns.title: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of glory died
My richest gain I count by loss,
And pour contempt on all my pride.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast,
Save in the death of Christ, my God:
All the vain things that charm me most
I sacrifice them to His blood.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: See from His head, His hands, His feet,
Sorrow and love flow mingled down;
Did e'er such love and sorrow meet,
Or thorns compose so rich a crown?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Were the whole realm of nature mine,
That were an offering far too small
Love so amazing, so divine,
Demands my soul, my life, my all.

hymns.title: There Is a Green Hill Far Away

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is a green hill far away,
Without a city wall,
Where the dear Lord was crucified
Who died to save us all.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We may not know, we cannot tell
What pains He had to bear;
But we believe it was for us
He hung and suffered there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He died that we might be forgiven
He died to make us good,
That we might go at last to heaven,
Saved by His precious blood

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There was no other good enough
To pay the price of sin,
He only could unlock the gate
Of heaven, and let us in.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: O dearly, dearly has He loved,
And we must love Him too,
And trust in His redeeming blood
And try His works to do.

hymns.title: "Man of Sorrows" What a Name

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "Man of sorrows" what a name
For the Son of God who came
Ruined sinners to reclaim!
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Bearing shame and scoffing rude,
In my place condemned He stood;
Sealed my pardon with His blood:
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Guilty, vile, and helpless we,
Spotless Lamb of God was He,
"Full atonement,", can it be?
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lifted up was He to die,
"It finished," was His cry,
Now in heaven exalted high,
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: When He comes, our glorious King,
All His ransomed home to bring;
Then anew this song we'll sing:
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!

hymns.title: Alas! And Did My Saviour Bleed?

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Alas! and did my Saviour bleed?
And did my Sovereign die?
Would He devote that sacred head
For such a worm as I.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: At the cross, at the cross where
I first saw the Light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Was it for crimes that I have done
He groaned upon the tree?
Amazing pity! grace unknown!
And love beyond degree!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: At the cross, at the cross where
I first saw the Light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Well might the sun in darkness hide,
And shut his glories in,
When Christ, the mighty Maker died,
For man, the creature's sin.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: At the cross, at the cross where
I first saw the Light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thus might I hide my blushing face,
Whilst His dear cross appears,
Dissolve my heart in thankfulness
And melt mine eyes to tears.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: At the cross, at the cross where
I first saw the Light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: But drops of grief can ne'er repay
The debt of love I owe,
Here, Lord, I give myself away,
"'Tis all that I can do.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: At the cross, at the cross where
I first saw the Light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day.

hymns.title: Have You Read the Story of the Cross

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Have you read the story of the cross,
Where Jesus bled and died;
Where your debt wa paid by His precious blood
That flowed from His wounded side?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He died of a broken heart for you
He died of a broken heart;
Up-on a tree, for you, for me,
He died of a broken heart,

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Have you read how they placed the crown of thorns
Up-on His brow for you
When He prayed, "Forgive them, Oh, forgive,
They know not what they do?"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He died of a broken heart for you
He died of a broken heart;
Up-on a tree, for you, for me,
He died of a broken heart,

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Have you read how He saved the dying thief
When hanging on the tree,
When He looked with pleading eyes and said,
"Dear Lord remember me?"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He died of a broken heart for you
He died of a broken heart;
Up-on a tree, for you, for me,
He died of a broken heart,

hymns.title: Hark! The Voice of Love and Mercy

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hark! the voice of love and mercy
Sounds aloud from Calvary;
See, it rends the rocks asunder!
Shakes the earth and veils the sky.
"It is finished!" "It is finished!"
Hear the dying Saviour cry.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "It is finished!" Oh, what pleasure
Do the wondrous words afford!
Heav'nly blessings without measure
Flow to us through Christ the Lord,
"It is finished!" "It is finished!"
Saints the dying words record.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Tune your harps anew, ye Seraphs;
Strike them to Emmanuel's name;
All on earth and all in heaven
Join the triumph to proclaim
"It is finished!" "It is finished!"
Glory to the bleeding Lamb.

hymns.title: Great High Priest, We See Thee Stooping

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Great High Priest, we see Thee stooping,
With our names upon Thy breast;
In the garden groaning drooping,
To the ground with horrors prest:
Wond'ring angels stood confounded,
To behold their Maker thus;
And can we remain unwounded,
When we know 'twas all for us?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Nothing but Thy blood, O Jesus,
Can our wayward souls convert;
Nothing else from guilt release us,
Nothing else can melt the heart,
Law and terrors do but harden,
All the while they work alone;
But the sense of blood-bought pardon
Can dissolve a heart of stone.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus, all our consolations
Flow from Thee, the sovereign good;
Love, and faith, and hope, and patience,
All are purchas'd by Thy blood:
From Thy fullness we receive them;
We have nothing of our own;
Freely Thou delight'st to give them
To the needy who have none.

hymns.title: Dark Was the Night and Cold the Ground

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Dark was the night and cold the ground
Where Jesus Christ knelt down
