His sweat was like great drops of blood
In deep prevailing prayers.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: 'Father, let this cup pass from me'
Thy will be done not mine.
If it be not so, I will drink
Thy will be done, not mine.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Sinner, go see Him in the court
Stained with His holy blood
He bore the heavy load for you
In deep humility.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Do, learn to bear the cross of shame
Do the Father's good will
Then when temptation's very close,
Wake up and watch and pray.

hymns.title: Glory Be to Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Glory be to Jesus,
Who, in bitter pains,
Pour'd for me the Life-blood
From His sacred veins.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Grace and life eternal
In that blood I find;
Blest be His compassion
Infinitely kind.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Blest through endless ages
Be the precious stream,
Which from endless torments
Did the world redeem.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Abel's blood for vengeance
Pleaded to the skies;
But the blood of Jesus
For our pardon cries.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Oft as it is sprinkled
On our guilty hearts,
Satan in confusion
Terror-struck departs.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Oft as earth exulting
Wafts its praise on high,
Angel-hosts rejoicing,
Make their glad reply.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Lift ye then your voices;
Swell the mighty flood;
Louder still and louder
Praise the precious blood.

hymns.title: O Perfect Life of Love!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O perfect life of love!
All, all is finished now,
All that He left His throne above,
To do for us below.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: No work is left undone
Of all the Father willed;
His toils and sorrows, one by one,
The Scriptures have fulfilled.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: No pain that we can share
But He has felt its smart;
All forms of human grief and care
Have pierced that tender heart.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And on His thorn-crowned head,
And on His sinless soul,
Our sins in all their guilt were laid
That He might make us whole.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: In perfect love He dies;
For me He dies, for me!
O all atoning sacrifice,
I cling by faith to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: In every time of need,
Before the judgement throne,
Thy work, O Lamb of God, I'll plead,
Thy merits, not my own.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Yet work, O Lord, in me,
As Thou for me hast wrought;
And let my love the answer be
To grace Thy love his brought.

hymns.title: 'Tis Midnight; and on Olive's Brow

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: 'Tis midnight; and on Olive's brow
The star is dimmed that lately shone;
'Tis midnight, in the garden now,
The suffering Saviour prays alone.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: 'Tis midnight; and from all removed,
The Saviour wrestles 'lone with fears;
E'en that disciple whom He loved
Heeds not his Master's grief and tears.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: 'Tis midnight; and for other's guilt,
The Man of sorrows weeps in blood;
Yet He that hath in anguish knelt
Is not forsaken by His God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: 'Tis midnight; and from other plains
Is borne the song that angels know;
Unheard by mortals are the strains
That sweetly soothe the Saviour's woe.

hymns.title: Thine Is Tomorrow Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thine is tomorrow Lord
It is in Thy control
If we are bless'd to see morrow
It is by Thy command.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: This time is running fast
Carrying our souls away
O fill Thy servants with wisdom
That they may live for Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The time that is passing
Rests the everlasting
O Lord with Thy power fill us
Revive the young and old.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: One thing that we should seek
That we should now pursue
That time of Thy visit may not
Depart to come no more.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Let us flee to our Lord
And flee as fast as could
That our soul may not die and drown
Into intense darkness.

hymns.title: Let Us Sing a Song that Will Cheer Us by the Way

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Let us sing a song that will cheer us by the way,
In a little while we are going home;
For the night will end in the everlasting day,
In a little while we're going home.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In a little while, in a little while (In a little while, In a little while)
We shall cross the billow's foam,
We shall meet at last,
When the stormy winds are past,
In a little while we're going home.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We will do the work that our hands may find to do
In a little while we're going home;
And the grace of God will our daily strength renew,
In a little while we're going home.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In a little while, in a little while (In a little while, In a little while)
We shall cross the billow's foam,
We shall meet at last,
When the stormy winds are past,
In a little while we're going home.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We will smooth the path for some weary, way-worn feet,
In a little while we're going home;
O may loving hearts spread around an influence sweet!
In a little while we're going home

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In a little while, in a little while (In a little while, In a little while)
We shall cross the billow's foam,
We shall meet at last,
When the stormy winds are past,
In a little while we're going home.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There's a rest beyond, there's relief from ev'ry care,
In a little while we're going home;
And no tears shall fall in that city bright and fair,
In a little while we're going home.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In a little while, in a little while (In a little while, In a little while)
We shall cross the billow's foam,
We shall meet at last,
When the stormy winds are past,
In a little while we're going home.

hymns.title: Extended on a Cursed Tree

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Extended on a cursed tree,
Besmeared with dust, and sweat, and blood,
See there, the King of Glory see!
Sinks and expires the Son of God.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Who, who my Saviour, this hath done?
Who could Thy sacred body wound?
No guilt Thy spotless heart hath known,
No guile hath in Thy lips been found.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I, I alone, have done the dead!
"Tis I Thy sacred flesh have torn;
My sins have caused Thee, Lord, to bleed,
Pointed the nail, and fixed the thorn.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The burden, for me to sustain
Too great, on Thee, my Lord, was laid;
To heal me, Thou hast borne my pain;
To bless me, Thou a curse wast made.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: My Saviour, how shall I proclaim?
How pay the mighty debt I owe?
Let all I have and all I am,
Ceaseless to all Thy glory show.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Too much to Thee I cannot give;
Too much I cannot do for Thee;
Let all Thy love, and all Thy grief,
Graven on my heart for ever be!

hymns.title: Christ the Lord Is Risen Today!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Christ the Lord is risen today!
Hallelujah!
Sons of men and angels say,
Hallelujah!
Raise your songs and triumphs high: Hallelujah!
Sing! ye heav'ns; thou earth reply; Hallelujah!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Love's redeeming work is done,
Fought the fight, the battle won:
Lo! our sun's eclipse is o'er;
Lo! he sets in blood no more:

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Vain the stone, the watch, the seal,
Christ hath burst the gates of hell;
Death in vain forbids Him rise,
Christ hath opened Paradise.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lives again our glorious King:
Where, O death, is now thy sting?
Once He died our souls to save;
Where's thy victory, O grave?

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Soar we now where Christ hath led,
Following our exalted Head:
Made like Him, like Him we rise;
Ours the cross, the grave, the skies.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Hail! the Lord of earth and heaven;
Praise to Thee by both be given,
Thee we greet triumphant now:
Hail! the Resurrection, Thou!

hymns.title: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!
The strife is o'er, the battle done;
The victory of life is won;
The song of triumph has begun, Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The powers of death have done their worst
But Christ their legions hath dispersed,
Let shouts of holy joy outburst.
Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The three sad days have quickly sped,
He rises glorious from the dead,
All glory to our risen Head,
Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He brake the age bound chains of hell,
The bars from heaven's high portals fell,
Let hymns of praise His triumph tell;
Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Lord, by the stripes which wounded Thee,
From death's dread sting Thy servants free,
That we may live, and sing to Thee,
Alleluia!

hymns.title: Welcome Happy Morning Age to Age Shall Say

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Welcome happy morning age to age shall say,
Hell today is vanquish'd heaven is won today
Lo the Dead is living, God for evermore!
Him their true Creator all His works adore.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Welcome happy morning age to age shall say
Hell today is vanquish'd heaven is won today.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Maker and Redeemer, life and health of all,
Thou from heaven beholding human nature's fall,
Of the father's Godhead true and only Son
Manhood to deliver, manhood didst put on.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Welcome happy morning age to age shall say
Hell today is vanquish'd heaven is won today.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou of life the Author, death didst undergo,
Tread the path of darkness, saving strength to show
Come then, True and Faithful, now fulfil Thy word
'Tis Thine own third morning; rise my buried Lord

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Welcome happy morning age to age shall say
Hell today is vanquish'd heaven is won today.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Loose the hearts long prison' bound with Satan's chain
All that now is fallen raise to life again,
Show Thy face in brightness, bid the nations see,
Bring again our daylight day returns with Thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Welcome happy morning age to age shall say
Hell today is vanquish'd heaven is won today.

hymns.title: On the Resurrection Morning

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: On the resurrection morning
Soul and body meet again;
No more sorrow, no more weeping
No more pain!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Here a while they must be parted,
And the flesh its Sabbath keep,
Waiting in a holy stillness,
Wrapt in sleep.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: For a while the tired body
To its resting-place its borne
Till there dawns the last and brightest
Easter morn.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: But the soul in contemplation
Utters earnest prayer and strong,
Breaking at the resurrection
Into song.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Soul and body reunited
Thenceforth nothing shall divide
Waking up in Christ's own likeness,
Satisfied.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Oh! the beauty, oh! the gladness
Of that resurrection day
Which shall not through endless ages
Pass away!

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Oh that happy easter morning
All graves their dead restore;
Father, mother, child, and brethen
Meet once more.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: To that brightest of all meetings
Bring us, Jesus Christ, at last;
To Thy cross, through death and judgement,
Holding fast.

hymns.title: Hallelujah, Hallelujah!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hallelujah, Hallelujah!
Hearts to heav'n and voices raise;
Sing to God a hymn of gladness,
Sing to God a hymn of praise!
He who on the cross a victim
For the world's salvation bled,
Jesus Christ, the King of Glory,
Now is risen from the dead.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Now the iron bars are broken,
Christ from death to life is born,
Glorious life, and life immortal,
On this holy easter morn:
Christ has triumph'd, and we conquer
By His mighty enterprise,
We with Him to life eternal
By His resurrection rise.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Christ is risen, Christ the first-fruits;
Of the holy harvest-field;
Which will all its full abundance
At His second coming yield;
Then the golden ears of harvest,
Will their heads before Him wave,
Ripen'd by His glorious sunshine,
From the furrows of the grave.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Christ is risen; we are risen;
Shed upon us heav'nly grace,
Rain and dew and gleams of glory
From the brightness of Thy face,
That we, Lord, with hearts in heaven,
Here on earth may fruitful be gather'd,
And be ever safe with Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Hallelujah, Hallelujah!
Glory be to God on high;
Hallelujah to the Saviour,
Who has gain'd the victory;
Hallelujah to the Spirit,
Fount of love and sanctity;
Hallelujah, Hallelujah
To the Triune Majesty.

hymns.title: The Day of Resurrection

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The day of resurrection!
Earth, tell it out abroad;
The passover of gladness,
The passover of God!
From death to life eternal,
From earth unto the sky;
Our Christ hath brought us over
With hymns of victory.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Our hearts be pure from evil,
That we may see aright
The Lord in rays eternal
Of resurrection light,
And, list'ning to His accents,
May hear, so calm and plain,
His own "All hail!" and hearing,
May raise the victor-strain.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Now let the heav'ns be joyful;
Let earth her song begin;
The round world keep high triumph,
And all that is therein;
Let all things seen and unseen,
Their notes of gladness blend:
For Christ the Lord hath risen,
Our joy that hath no end.

hymns.title: If Sinners Join Their Hands

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: If sinners join their hands
And rise against the Lord,
Rebel against the Christ,
And despise the great King;
The world may mock,
Satan may threat,
It's all deceipts,
It's all in vain.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Our risen Saviour reigns,
On Zion's holy hill,
It is the Lord's decree
Upholds and keeps His Son
From the cold tomb
He bids Him rise
And to ascend
That He might save.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O serve the Lord in fear,
Revere His blest command
With gladness come to Him
In awe stand before Him
Bow down the knee
And prostrate fall
Tell of His might
Kiss thou the Son

hymns.title: The Lord Is Risen Indeed

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The Lord is risen indeed.'
Now is his work performed;
Now is the mighty captive freed,
And death's strong castle stormed.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The Lord is risen indeed.'
The grave has lost his prey;
With Him is risen the ransomed seed;
To reign in endless day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: 'The Lord is risen indeed.'
He lives, to die no more;
He lives, the sinner's cause to plead,
Whose curse and shame He bore.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The Lord is risen indeed.'
Attending angels hear
Up to the courts of heaven with speed
The joyful tidings bear.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Then, angels, tune your lyres,
And strike each cheerful chord;
Join, all ye bright celestial choirs,
To sing our risen Lord!

hymns.title: On Wings of Living Light

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: On wings of living light,
At earliest dawn of day,
Came down the angel bright,
And rolled the stone away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Your voices raise with one accord,
To bless and praise your risen Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The keepers watching near,
At that dread sight and sound
Fell down with sudden fear,
Like dead men, to the ground.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Your voices raise with one accord,
To bless and praise your risen Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Then rose from death's dark gloom,
Unseen by mortal eye,
Triumphant o'er the tomb,
The Lord of earth and sky.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Your voices raise with one accord,
To bless and praise your risen Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Ye children of the light
Arise with Him, arise;
See how the Day-star bright,
Is burning in the skies!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Your voices raise with one accord,
To bless and praise your risen Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Leave in the grave beneath,
The old things passed away;
Buried with Him in death,
O live with Him to-day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Your voices raise with one accord,
To bless and praise your risen Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: We sing Thee, Lord divine,
With all our hearts and powers;
For we are ever Thine,
And Thou art ever ours.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Your voices raise with one accord,
To bless and praise your risen Lord.

hymns.title: Jesus Lives! Thy Terrors Now

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus lives! thy terrors now
Can, O death, no more appall us;
Jesus lives! By this we know
Thou, O grave, canst not enthrall us.
Hallelujah!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus lives! Henceforth is death
Entrance gate of life immortal;
This shall calm our trembling breath,
When we pass its gloomy portal.
Hallelujah!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus lives! For us He died;
Hence may we, to Jesus living,
Pure in heart and act abide,
Praise to Him and glory giving.
Hallelujah!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus lives! Our hearts know well
Nought from us His love shall sever;
Life, nor death, nor pow'rs of hell
Part us now from Christ forever.
Hallelujah!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Jesus lives! to Him the throne
High o'er heav'n and earth is given;
We may go where He is gone,
Live and reign with Him in heaven.
Hallelujah!

hymns.title: O Day of Rest and Gladness

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O day of rest and gladness,
O day of joy and light,
O balm of care and sadness,
Most beautiful, most bright!
On Thee the high and lowly,
Through ages joined in tune,
Sing, holy, holy, holy,
To the great God Triune.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: On Thee, at the creation,
The light first had its birth;
On Thee, for our salvation,
Christ rose from depths of earth;
On Thee, our Lord victorious
The Spirit sent from heaven:
And thus on Thee most glorious
A triple light was given.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou art a port protected
From storms that round us rise;
A garden intersected
With streams of paradise;
Thou art a cooling fountain
In life's dry dreary sand;
From Thee, like Pisgah's mountain,
We view our promised land.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou art a holy ladder,
Where angels go and come;
Each Sunday finds us gladder,
Nearer to heaven, our home;
A day of sweet reflection,
Thou art a day of love;
A day of resurrection
From earth to things above.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Today on weary nations
The heavenly manna falls;
To holy convocations
The silver trumpet calls,
Where gospel light is glowing
With pure and radiant beams,
And living water flowing
With soul-refreshing streams.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: New gates ever gaining
From this our day of rest,
We reach the rest remaining
To spirits of the blest.
To Holy Ghost be praises,
To Father, and to Son:
The Church her voice upraises
To Thee, blest Three in One.

hymns.title: This Is the Day the Lord Hath Made

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: This is the day the Lord hath made
He calls the hours His own;
Let heaven rejoice, let earth be glad;
And praise surround the throne.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: To-day He rose and left the dead,
And Satan's empire fell;
To-day the saints His triumph spread,
And all His wonders tell.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Hosanna to the anointed King,
To David's Holy Son!
Help us O Lord! descend and bring
Salvation from Thy throne.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Blest be the Lord, who comes to men
With messages of grace;
Who comes in God His Father's name,
To save our sinful race.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Hosanna, in the highest strains
The church on earth can raise;
The highest heavens in which He reigns
Shall give Him nobler praise.

hymns.title: The Lord's Own Hallow'd Day of Rest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The Lord's own hallow'd day of rest
O day most beautiful and bright:
A day given to us by God
For us, a day to rest therein.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Six days He provided for us
To do all that we have to do;
The seventh day He set aside,
It is God's hallow'd day of rest.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let us forsake our vain pursuits
Our daily duties for six days,
Our work today, let hallow'd be,
Because the day belongs to God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Strength from above enerves us well
For service in the house of God;
Let us sing a joyful anthem,
On the Lord's day; this early morn.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Very early in the morning
On the Lord's hallowed day of rest
Let us raise a joyful chorus
And let us lift our hearts to pray.

hymns.title: Hallowed Day and Holy

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hallowed Day and Holy
Thou holy day of rest,
We ought to give one full day
To God, the good and kind
Other days bring the tear drops
Thou wipes the tears away
Thou art a day of gladness
I love thy happy morn.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Hallowed Day and Holy
There is no work today
We will suspend our labour
Until tomorrow's day
How beautiful and how bright
Thou blessed day of rest
Other days speak of troubles
But thou give hope of rest.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Hallowed Day and Holy
Hear how the Church bell says
Give one day to thy Maker
Who gave to you six days,
We shall take leave of labour
To go and worship there
Both we and all our dear friends
On to the house of pray'r.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Hallowed Day and Holy
Thy hour delights me so
A taste of heav'n you give us
Like that eternal rest
Lord, let me be partaker
Of rest beyond the grave.
To sing and serve Thee ever
With all Thy saints above.

hymns.title: Awake Ye Saints Awake

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Awake ye saints awake,
Salute this holy morn
With songs of joy and praise
In adoration fall
Come, bless the blessed Holy day
The like of the rest, yet in heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: On this blest holy morn
The Lord rose from the dead
He broke the gates of death,
Triumphant o'er our foe
And now He pleads for us above
Gathering the harvest of love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: All hail to Thee thou King!
Hosannas raise above,
The earth in humble voice
Joins in the glad refrain;
Worthy is the Lamb that was slain
To live and reign for ever more.

hymns.title: Ere Another Sabbath Close

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Ere another Sabbath close,
Ere again we seek repose,
Lord, our song ascends to Thee,
At Thy feet we bow the knee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For the mercies of the day;
For this rest upon our way,
Thanks to Thee alone be giv'n
Lord and King of earth and heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Cold our services have been;
Pray'rs and praises stain'd with sin;
But Thou canst and wilt forgive
By Thy grace alone we live.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Whilst this thorny path we tread,
May Thy love our footsteps lead:
When our journey here is past,
May we rest with Thee at last.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: May our earthly Sabbaths prove
Foretastes of our joy above;
While our pilgrim steps we bend
To the rest, which knows no end.

hymns.title: This Is the Day of Light

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: This is the day of light,
Let there be light today;
O Day-spring, rise upon our night,
And chase its gloom away.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: This is the day of rest:
Our failing strength renew;
On weary brain and troubled breast
Shed Thou Thy fresh'ning dew.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: This is the day of peace;
Thy peace our spirits fill;
Bid Thou the blasts of discord cease,
The waves of strife be still.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: This is the day of pray'r,
Let earth to heav'n draw near,
Lift up our hearts to seek Thee there,
Come down to meet us here.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: This is the first of days:
Send forth Thy quick'ning breath,
And wake dead souls to love and praise,
O vanquisher of death!

hymns.title: We All Love to See Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We all love to see Thee
O thou, good sabbath day
All the days of the week inquire
How long wilt thou tarry?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou teacheth us to know
That Christ rose from the dead
All the days of the week inquire
How long wilt thou tarry?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou telleth of Thy power
As Jesus rose from dead
All the days of the week inquire
How long wilt thou tarry?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou speak of living rest
In the city of peace
For all blessed saints in Jesus
How long wilt thou tarry?

hymns.title: Jesus We Love to Meet

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus we love to meet
On this Thy holy day
We gather round Thy throne
On this Thy holy day,
Thou art our heav'nly Friend
Our pray'rs ascend to Thee
Look on our spirits, Lord
On this Thy holy day.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let us shake off dull sloth
On this Thy holy day.
We kneel in reverence, Lord
On this Thy holy day.
Our sins may Thou forgive
And may Thou teach us, Lord
To worship as we ought
On this Thy holy day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We listen to Thy word
On this Thy holy day.
Bless all the word we hear
On this Thy holy day.
As we part, be with us
Thy salvation impart
To every heart, dear Lord
On this Thy holy day.

hymns.title: Clap Your Hands, Ye People All

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Clap your hands, ye people all,
Praise the God on whom ye call;
Lift your voice, and shout His praise,
Triumph in His sov'reign grace!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Glorious is the Lord most High,
Terrible in majesty;
He His sovereign sway maintains,
King o'er all the earth He reigns.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus is gone up on high,
Takes His seat above the sky:
Shout the angel-choirs aloud,
Echoing to the trump of God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Sons of earth, the triumph join,
Praise Him with the host divine;
Emulate the heavenly powers,
Their victorious Lord is ours.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Shout the God enthroned above,
Trumpet forth His conquering love;
Praises to our Jesus sing,
Praises to our glorious King!

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Power is all to Jesus given,
Power o'er hell, and earth, and heaven!
Power He now to us imparts;
Praise Him with believing hearts.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Wonderful in saving power,
Him let all our hearts adore;
Earth and heaven repeat the cry,
"Glory be to God most High!"

hymns.title: Majestic Sweetness Sits Enthron'd

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Majestic sweetness sits enthron'd
Upon the Saviour's brow;
His head with radiant glories crown'd,
His lips with grace o'erflow.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: No mortal can with Him compare,
Among the sons of men;
Fairer is He than all the fair
That fill the heavenly train.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He saw me plunged in deep distress,
He flew to my relief;
For me He bore the shameful cross,
And carried all my grief.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: To Him I owe my life and breath,
And all the joys I have;
He makes me triumph over death,
He saves me from the grave.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: To heaven, the place of His abode,
He brings my weary feet,
Shows me the glories of my God,
And makes my joy complete.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Since from His bounty I receive
Such proofs of love divine;
Had I a thousand hearts to give,
Lord, they should all be Thine!

hymns.title: O Christ, Thou Hast Ascended

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Christ, Thou hast ascended
Triumphantly on high;
By cherub guards attended
And armies of the sky:
Let earth tell forth the story,
Our very flesh and bone,
Emmanuel, in glory,
Ascends His Father's throne.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Heav'ns gates unfold above Thee;
But canst Thou, Lord, forget
The little band who love Thee
And gaze from Oliver?
Nay, on Thy breast engraven
Thou bearest every name,
Our Priest in earth and heaven
Eternally the same.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There, there Thou standest pleading
The virtue of Thy blood,
For sinners interceding,
Our Advocate with God;
And every changeful fashion
Of our brief joys and cares
Finds thoughts in Thy compassion
And echo in Thy prayers.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh, for the priceless merit
Of Thy redeeming cross,
Vouchsafe Thy sev'n fold Spirit
And turn to gain our loss;
Till we by strong endeavour
In heart and mind ascend
And dwell with Thee for ever
In glories without end.

hymns.title: O Hear the Song of Rejoicing in Heaven

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O hear the song of rejoicing in heaven
The song of joy of the triumph of Christ
All enemies have bowed down their heads for
Sin and death and the cold, dark grave also.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He is prepared to receive the kingdom
For God the Father, Creator of all,
He is prepared to receive a great praise
That's meet for Captain of our salvation.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: His departure was a thing of sorrow
For His chosen disciples who loved Him,
Do not despair was the word of comfort.
"I will go to prepare a place for you."

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The clouds received the Lord out of their gaze,
The firmament hid the Saviour from view,
The hosts of heaven burst out in shouts of joy
For the return of the Lord of glory.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Do not allow your heart to be troubled,
Jesus our hope shall surely come again;
He shall come to take His own people where
They shall live and reign with Him for ever.

hymns.title: See the Conqueror Mounts in Triumph

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: See the Conqueror mounts in triumph,
See the King in royal state,
Riding on the clouds His chariot,
To the heavenly palace gate;
Hark, the choirs of angel voices
Joyful Hallelujahs sing,
And the portals high are lifted,
To receive, their heav'nly King.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Who is this that comes in glory,
With the trump of jubilee?
Lord of battles, God of armies,
He has gain'd the victory:
He who on the cross did suffer,
He who from the grave arose,
He has vanquish'd sin and Satan,
He by death has spoil'd His foes.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: While He raised His hands in blessing,
He was parted from His friends,
While their eager eyes behold Him,
He upon the clouds ascends;
He who walk'd with God and pleased Him,
Preaching truth and doom to come,
He, our Enoch, is translated
To His everlasting home.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Now our heav'nly Aaron enters,
With His blood within the veil;
Joshua now is come to Canaan,
And the kings before Him quail:
Now He plants the tribes of Israel
In their promised resting-place;
Now our great Elijah offers
Double portion of His grace.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thou hast raised our human nature
In the clouds of God's right hand,
There we sit in heav'nly places,
There with Thee in glory stand;
Jesus reigns adored by angels;
Man with God is on the throne;
Mighty Lord in Thine ascension,
We by faith behold our own.

hymns.title: Thou Art Gone up on High

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thou art gone up on high
To mansions in the skies,
And round Thy throne unceasingly,
The songs of praise arise:
But we are lingering here,
With sin and care oppressed;
Lord, send Thy promised Comforter
And lead us to our rest.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou art gone up on high;
But Thou didst first came down,
Through earth's most bitter agony
To pass unto Thy crown;
And girt with grieves and fears
Our onward course must be;
But only let that path of tears
Lead us at last to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou art gone up on high;
But Thou shalt come again,
With all the bright one of the sky
Attendant in Thy train,
O by Thy saving pow'r
So make us live and die,
That we may stand, in that dread hour,
At Thy right hand on high.

hymns.title: Hark! Tis the Watchman's Cry

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: HARK! tis the watchman's cry
Wake, brethen, wake
Jesus Himself is nigh
Wake, brethen, wake
Sleep is for sons of night
Ye are children of the light
Yours is the glory bright
Wake, brethen, wake.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Call to each wakening band,
Watch, brethen, watch
Clears is our Lord's command,
Watch, brethen, watch
Be ye as men that wait
Always at their Master's gate,
E'en though He tarry late,
Watch, brethen, watch.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Heed we the Steward's call
Work, brethen, work
There's room enough for all
Work, brethen, work
This vineyard of the Lord
Constant labour will afford
He will your work reward
Work, brethen, work.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Hear we the Shepherd's voice
Pray, brethen, pray
Would ye His heart rejoice,
Pray, brethen, pray
Sin calls for ceaseless fear,
Weakness needs the Strong One near
Long as ye struggle here
Pray, brethen, pray.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Sound now the final chord,
Praise, brethen, praise
Thrice holy is the Lord
Praise, brethen, praise
What more, befits the tongues
Soon to join the angels' songs?
Whilst heav'n the note prolongs
Praise, brethen, praise.

hymns.title: Jesus Is Coming with Joy to the Sky

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus is coming with joy to the sky
Oh happy day! Oh happy day
Then all who love Him shall heaven-ward fly
Oh happy day! Oh happy day
Upward shall fly to the Lord in the air
Together with Jesus we all shall be there
Far from the earth, and from sorrow and care
Oh happy day! Oh happy day.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Parents and children shall then again meet
Oh happy day! Oh happy day
Sisters and brothers, oh, it will be sweet
Oh happy day! Oh happy day
We miss'd them of earth, to Jeus they went
We love them as ever, their absence lament
Soon we shall meet them, and then be content
Oh happy day! Oh happy day

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Are we all ready, should Jesus now call
Oh happy day! Oh happy day
Would each one answer, the great and the small
Oh happy day! Oh happy day
We long to rise up and with Thee to be
Thy face, blessed Jesus, our Saviour to see
Would you then dear children sing sweetly with me
Oh happy day! Oh happy day

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Some will stay weeping unable to sing
Oh happy day! Oh happy day
Yet all may rejoice their glad praises bring
Oh happy day! Oh happy day
For Jesus still waits, He tarries that we
May trust in His name, and thus ready may be
When, brightly beaming, His glory we see
Oh happy day! Oh happy day

hymns.title: The Lord Is Coming World Trembles

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The Lord is coming world trembles
All the hills shall shift where they stay
And all the stars of the heavens
Shall cease from brin-ging forth their light

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The Lord is coming not as 'fore
When He came in humility
The Lamb of God that was slaughtered
The great suff'rer who died to save.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The Lord is coming in wonder
In fire and in full armour
On the Cherubim wings He flies
To judge the dwellers of the world.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And this once was the man who walked
Like the people by the highways
He was persecuted often
Ah this was crucified for us.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: An act like this is wickedness
Fit to be buried in the sand
But the faith that succeeds at last
Rejoicing shall sing "Lord has come."

hymns.title: Lo! He Comes with Clouds Descending

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lo! He comes with clouds descending,
Once for favour'd sinners slain;
Thousand thousand saints attending,
Swell the triumph of His train!
Hal-le-lu-jah!
Jesus comes, and comes to reign.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Every eye shall now behold Him
Robed in dreadful majesty;
Those who set at naught and sold Him,
Pierced and nailed Him to the tree,
Deeply wailing
Shall the true Messiah see.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When the solemn trump has sounded,
Heaven and earth shall flee away;
All who hate Him must, confounded,
Hear the summons of that day
Come to judgement!
Come judgement, come away!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Now redemption, long expected
See in solemn pomp appear!
All His saints, by men rejected.
Now shall meet Him in the air
Hallelujah!
See the day of God appear!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Yea, Amen! Let all adore Thee,
High on Thine eternal throne;
Saviour, take the power and glory,
Claim the kingdom for Thine Own!
Oh, come quickly!
Hallelujah! Come, Lord, come!

hymns.title: Jesus Is Coming! Sing the Glad Word!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus is coming! Sing the glad word!
Coming for those He redeem'd by His blood,
Coming to reign as the glorified Lord!
Jesus is coming again!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus is coming, is coming again!
Jesus is coming again!
Shout the glad tidings o'er mountain and plain!
Jesus is coming again!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus is coming! The dead shall arise,
Loved ones shall meet in a joyful surprise,
Caught up together to Him in the skies,
Jesus is coming again!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus is coming, is coming again!
Jesus is coming again!
Shout the glad tidings o'er mountain and plain!
Jesus is coming again!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus is coming! His saints to release;
Coming to give to the warring earth peace
Sinning, and sighing, and sorrow, shall cease,
Jesus is coming again!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus is coming, is coming again!
Jesus is coming again!
Shout the glad tidings o'er mountain and plain!
Jesus is coming again!

hymns.title: On Jordan's Bank the Baptist's Cry

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: On Jordan's bank the Baptist's cry
Announces that the Lord is nigh;
Come then hearken, for he brings
Glad tidings from the King of kings.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Then cleans'd be every breast from sin;
Make straight the way of God within;
Prepare we in our hearts a home,
Where such a mighty Guest may come.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: For thou art our salvation, Lord,
Our refuge, and our great reward,
Without thy grace we waste away;
Like flow'rs that wither and decay.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Stretch forth thine hand, to heal our sore,
And make us rise to fall no more;
Once more upon thy people shine,
And fill the world with love divine.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: All praise, eternal Son, to thee,
Whose advent sets the people free,
Whom with the Father wer adore,
And Holy Ghost, for evermore.

hymns.title: Jesus Cries Out that "I Am Come"

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus cries out that "I am come
I am come with great love"
My heart in answer says come Lord
And bring salvation nigh.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Come, Thou and do Thy father's will
And glorify His name
Come, wake up thy dead messengers
And quickens them once more.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Come Thou amidst Thy glorious throng
And take Thy own title
And bring back our full assembly
All to surround thy throne.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Our great Redeemer, come quickly,
Make Thou the day draw near
Come quickly that our heart faint not
When you tarry too long.

hymns.title: In the Advent Light, O Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: In the Advent Light, O Saviour,
I am living day by day;
Waiting, working, watching ever,
Knowing Thou art on Thy way.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "Separated" unto Jesus,
"Loosed" from all the world beside;
Blinded by the Advent glory,
Hour by hour would I abide.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: So "from glory unto glory,"
Gladdened by the Advent ray;
All the path is growing brighter,
Shining unto "perfect day!"

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In the Advent light to witness,
To a dark and dying world;
This the holy ordination
May His banner be unfurled.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: In the Advent light rejoicing!
Songs of praise along the road
Seem to make the journey shorter,
Mounting upward to our God!

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: He is coming! He is coming!
Pass the heav'nly watchword on!
Go ye forth to meet the Bridegroom,
Hail! to God's anointed Son!

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: See the Advent glory breaking!
Faith will soon be lost in sight;
"Face to face" I shall behold Him
Bathed in His eternal light!

hymns.title: Hail to the Lord's Anointed

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hail to the Lord's Anointed,
Great David's greater Son;
Hail in the time appointed,
His reign on earth begun!
He comes to break oppression,
To set the captive free,
To take away transgression,
And rule in equity.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He shall come down like showers
Upon the fruitful earth:
And love, joy, hope, like flowers,
Spring in His path to birth
Before Him on the mountains
Shall peace, the herald go;
And righteousness in fountains
From hill to valley flow.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Kings shall fall down before Him,
And gold and incense bring;
All nations shall adore Him,
His praise all people sing,
For He shall have dominion
O'er river, sea, and shore,
Far as the eagle's pinion
Or dove's light wing can soar.

hymns.title: When He Cometh, when He Cometh

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When He com-eth, when He com-eth
To make up His jew-els,
All His jew-els, precious jew-els,
His loved and His own.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Like the stars of the morning,
His bright crown adorning,
They shall shine in their beauty,
Bright gems for his crown.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He will gath-er, He will gath-er
The gems for His Kingdom,
All the pure ones, all the bright ones,
His loved and His own.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Like the stars of the morning,
His bright crown adorning,
They shall shine in their beauty,
Bright gems for his crown.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Lit-tle chil-dren, lit-tle chil-dren
Who love their Re-deem-er,
Are the jew-el, pre-cious jew-els,
His loved and His own.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Like the stars of the morning,
His bright crown adorning,
They shall shine in their beauty,
Bright gems for his crown.

hymns.title: When the Trumpet of the Lord Sound

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When the trumpet of the Lord sound,
And time shall be no more,
And the morning breaks, eternal bright and fair;
When the saved of earth shall gather over on the other shore,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder I'll be there.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: On that bright and cloudless morning,
When the dead in Christ shall rise,
And the glory of His resurrection share;
When His chosen ones shall gather to their home beyond the skies,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder I'll be there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let us labour for the Master from the dawn till setting sun,
Let us talk of all His wondrous love and care,
Then, when all of life is over, and our work on earth is done,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder I'll be there.

hymns.title: On that Bright and Golden Morning

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: On that bright and golden morning when the Son of Man shall come,
And the radiance of His glory we shall see;
When from ev'ry clime and nation He shall call His people home
What a gath'ring of the ransomed that will be!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: What a gath'ring! what a gath'ring!
What a gath'ring of the ransom'd! In the summer land of love!
What a gath'ring! what a gath'ring
Of the ransom'd in that happy home above!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When the blest who sleep in Jesus at His bidding shall arise
From the silence of the grave and from the sea;
And with bodies all celestial they shall meet Him in the skies
What a gath'ring and rejoicing there will be!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: What a gath'ring! what a gath'ring!
What a gath'ring of the ransom'd! In the summer land of love!
What a gath'ring! what a gath'ring
Of the ransom'd in that happy home above!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When our eyes behold the city, with it's "Many mansions" bright,
And its river, calm and restful flowing free
When the friends that death has parted shall in bliss again unite
What a gath'ring and a greeting there will be!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: What a gath'ring! what a gath'ring!
What a gath'ring of the ransom'd! In the summer land of love!
What a gath'ring! what a gath'ring
Of the ransom'd in that happy home above!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh, the King is surely coming, and the time is drawing nigh
When the blessed day of promise we shall see;
Then the changing "in a moment," "in the twinking of an eye,"
And for ever in His presence we shall be!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: What a gath'ring! what a gath'ring!
What a gath'ring of the ransom'd! In the summer land of love!
What a gath'ring! what a gath'ring
Of the ransom'd in that happy home above!

hymns.title: The Church Has Waited Long

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The Church has waited long,
Her absent Lord to see;
And still in loneliness she waits,
A friendless stranger she.
Age after age has gone,
Sun after sun has set,
And still, of her dear Lord bereft,
She weeps, a mourner yet,
Come then, Lord Jesus, come!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Saint after saint on earth
Has lived, and loved, and died;
And as they left us one by one,
We laid them side by side,
We laid them down to sleep
But not in hope forlorn
We laid them but to slumber there
Till the last glorious morn
Come then, Lord Jesus, come!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The serpent's brood increase,
The powers of hell grow bold,
The conflict thickens, faith is low,
And love is waxing cold.
How long, O Lord our God,
Holy, and true, and good,
Wilt thou not judge Thy suffering Church,
Her sighs, and tears, and blood?
Come then, Lord Jesus, come!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: We long to hear Thy voice,
To see Thee face to face,
To share Thy crown and glory then,
As now we share thy grace,
Come, Lord, and wipe away
The curse, the sin, the stain,
And make the blighted world of ours
Thine own fair world again,
Come then, Lord Jesus, come!

hymns.title: Rejoice, All Ye Believers

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Rejoice, all ye believers,
And let your lights appear,
The ev'ning is advancing
And darker night is near.
The Bridegroom is arising,
And soon will He draw nigh;
Up, pray and watch and wrestle,
At midnight comes the cry.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: See that your lamps are burning,
Replenish them with oil;
Look now for your salvation,
The end of earthly toil.
The watchers on the mountain
Proclaim the Bridegroom near,
Go meet Him as He cometh,
With Hallelujahs clear.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Ye wise and holy virgins,
Raise your voices higher,
Until in songs of triumph
They meet the angel choir.
The marriage feast is waiting,
The gates wide open stand:
Up up! Ye heirs of glory;
The Bridegroom is at hand.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Our hope and expectation,
O Jesus now appear:
Arise, Thou Sun, so long'd for,
O'er this benighted sphere:
With hearts and hands uplifted
We plead, O Lord, to see
The day of our redemption
That brings us unto Thee.

hymns.title: Holy Spirit Come Down

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Holy Spirit come down
On this Thy day of rest
Without Thee our worship is vain,
Vanity is our pray'r.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Vanity is our song
Our preaching will be vain
Unprofitable our gathering,
Except, if thou be there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Great Messenger from Heav'n
Who know Thy beginning?
Talk Thou to us by Thy ownself
Through this Thy servant here.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Teach us how to seek Thee
For all of our requests
With groanings that can't be uttered,
Take to Jesus our pray'rs.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Through Thy gracious leading
We hope for Thy mercy
Our service will be bless'd indeed
If Thou be with us here.

hymns.title: "With One Accord," Within an Upper Room

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "With one accord," within an upper room
The faithful followers of Jesus met;
One was the hope of ev'ry waiting soul,
And on one object great each heart was set.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "With one accord," until the mighty gift
Of Pentecostal power was outpoured.
Then forth as witnesses possessed of God,
To preach the resurrection of the Lord!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: "With one accord," within the House of God,
A Hallelujah song is daily raised,
As with the voice of one, from vocal hearts
Jehovah's name is glorified and praised.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Pour down Thy Spirit once again dear Lord;
Our cry goes up to Thee for "latter rain"
Unite Thy people as the "heart of one"
And Pentecostal days shall come again!

hymns.title: Search Me, O God, and Know My Heart Today

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Search me, O God, and know my heart today
Try me, O Lord, and know my thoughts I pray:
See if there be some wicked way in me,
Cleanse me from ev'ry sin and set me free.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I praise Thee, Lord, for cleansing me from sin;
Fulfil Thy Word, and make me pure within;
Fill me with fire, where once I burned with shame
Grant my desire to magnify Thy name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Lord, take my life, and make it wholly Thine;
Fill my poor heart with Thy great love divine;
Take all my will, my passion, self and pride;
I now surrender-Lord, in me abide.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O Holy Ghost, revival comes from Thee;
Sent a revival-start the work in me:
Thy Word declares Thou wilt supply our need;
For blessing now; O Lord, I humbly plead.

hymns.title: Our Blest Redeemer, Ere He Breathed

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Our blest Redeemer, ere He breathed
His tender, last farewell,
A Guide, a Comforter, bequeath'd
With us to dwell.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He came in tongues of living flame,
To teach, convince, subdue;
All powerful as the wind He came,
As viewless too.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He came sweet influence to impart,
A gracious, willing Guest;
Where He can find one humble heart
Wherein to rest.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And His that gentle voice we hear,
Soft as the breath of even,
That checks each thought, and calms each fear,
And speaks of heaven.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And every virtue we possess,
And every conquest won,
And every thought of holiness
Are His alone.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Spirit of purity and grace,
Our weakness pitying see:
O make our heart Thy dwelling place,
And worthier Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: O praise the Father, praise the Son;
Blest Spirit, praise to Thee;
All praise to God, the Three in One,
The One in Three.

hymns.title: Spirit Divine, Attend Our Prayers

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Spirit divine, attend our prayers,
And make our hearts Thy home;
Descend with all Thy gracious powers,
O come, great Spirit, come.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Come as the light-to us reveal
Our need of Thee below;
And lead us in those paths of life
Where all the righteous go.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Come as the fire and purge our hearts
With sacrificial flame;
Let our whole self an offering be
To our Redeemer's name.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Come as the dew-and sweetly bless
This consecrated hour;
May bareness rejoice to own
Thy fertilising power.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Come as the Dove-and spread Thy wings,
The wings of peaceful love;
And let Thy Church on earth become
Blest as the Church above.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Come as the wind-with rushing sound
And pentecostal grace;
The all of woman born may see
The glory of Thy face.

hymns.title: When the Pow'r of God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When the pow'r of God descended
On the day of Pentecost
All the days of waiting ended
They received the Holy Ghost

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
And baptize every one

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Tongues of flame came down upon them
And they preach'd the word in pow'r
Listening multitudes awakened
Turn'd to God that very hour

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
And baptize every one

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We are waiting Holy Spirit
We are all of one accord
Lord fulfil just now the promise
That is given in Thy word

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
And baptize every one

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Fill and thrill us with Thy presence
Grant the blessing that we need
Flood our souls with wondrous glory
While the pray'r of faith we plead.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
O Lord send Thy pow'r just now
And baptize every one

hymns.title: Lord, in Thy Presence We Are Met

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord, in Thy presence we are met,
A full salvation to proclaim;
To testify of grace received,
Or offered now in Jesus' Name;
Dear Lord, to Thee our spirits cry,
Our every longing satisfy.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We ask Thee, Lord-for Thou art here
Make this a Pentecostal hour,
When hungering souls from Thee receive
Pardon, or purity, or power
Unstop deaf ears, let blind eyes see,
Bring souls into Thy liberty.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou knowest sin-sick souls are here,
Sick with depravity within,
Restless, discouraged, wearied ones,
And Thou art here to cleanse from sin;
Oh! speak the word "I will, be whole";
And save and sanctify each soul.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Grant to Thy servant boldness now,
That faithfully they speak Thy Word,
"By stretching forth Thy hand to heal",
Let sign and wonders from The Lord,
Here in our midst today be done,
So, Father, glorify Thy Son.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: We wait-according to Thy Word,
Lord, let it to Thy servants be;
May nothing-self, pride, prejudice,
Or unbelief-still, hinder Thee;
Bless'd Spirit, have unhindered way
In yielded hearts and lives today.

hymns.title: Thou Holy Spirit, Come Down

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thou Holy Spirit, come down,
Reveal the things of heav'n,
May He bring light to the earth
Upon men everywhere.
That we who are in darkness
May have the light and see
Because Jesus Christ has died
He died for all mankind.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Make me to know that I am
A sinner, lost, indeed
That I may put all my trust
In Him my Saviour, Lord
When I was washed by His blood
Away from all my sins
That I may give the glory
To Thee, Most Holy One.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Grant that I have the longing,
To go unto Jesus
That He may reign in my heart
And sanctify my soul
May heart and soul and body
Join together to serve
Our great God the Holy One
The blessed Three in One.

hymns.title: Gracious Spirit, Dwell with Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Gracious Spirit, dwell with me!
I myself would gracious be,
And with words that help and heal,
Would Thy life in mine reveal,
And with actions bold and meek
Would for Christ my Saviour speak.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Truthful Spirit, dwell with me!
I myself would truthful be,
And with wisdom kind and clear
Let Thy life in mine appear,
And with actions brotherly,
Speak my Lord's sincerity.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Tender Spirit, dwell with me!
I myself would tender be:
Shut my heart up like a flower
At temptation's darksome hour;
Open it when shines the sun,
And His love by fragrance own.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Mighty Spirit, dwell with me!
I myself would mighty be,
Mighty so as to prevail
Where unaided man must fail,
Ever by a mighty hope
Pressing on and bearing up.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Holy Spirit, dwell with me!
I myself would holy be;
Separate from sin, I would
Choose and cherish all things good,
And whatever I can be,
Give to Him who gave me Thee.

hymns.title: Come, Holy Spirit, Heavenly Dove

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove,
With all Thy quickening pow'rs,
Kindle a flame of sacred love
In these cold hearts of ours.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In vain we tune our formal songs,
In vain we strive to rise;
Hosannas languish on our tongues
And our devotion dies.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And shall we then for ever live
At this poor dying rate?
Our love so faint, so cold to Thee,
And Thine to us so great?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Come, Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove,
With all Thy quick'ning powers;
Come, shed abroad the Saviour's love
And that shall kindle ours.

hymns.title: Breathe on Me, Breath of God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Breathe on me, Breath of God;
Fill me with life anew,
That I may love what Thou dost love,
And do what Thou wouldst do.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Breathe on me, Breath of God;
Until my heart is pure,
Until with Thee I will one will,
To do and to endure.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Breathe on me, Breath of God;
Till I am wholly Thine,
Until this earthly part of me
Glows with Thy fire divine.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Breathe on me, Breath of God;
So shall I never die,
But live with Thee the perfect life
Of Thine eternity.

hymns.title: O Come and Dwell in Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O come and dwell in me,
Spirit of pow'r within!
And bring the glorious liberty
From sorrow, fear, and sin.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The seed of sin's disease,
Spirit of health, remove,
Spirit of finished holiness,
Spirit of perfect love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Hasten the joyful day
Which shall my sins consume
When old things shall be passed away,
And all things new become.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The original offence
Out of my soul erase;
Enter Thyself, and drive it hence,
And take up all the place.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: I want the witness, Lord,
That all I do is right,
According to Thy will and word,
Well-pleasing in Thy sight.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: I ask no higher state;
Indulge me but in this,
And soon or later then translate
To my eternal bliss.

hymns.title: O Breath of God, Breathe on Us Now

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Breath of God, breathe on us now,
And move within us while we pray;
The spring of our new life art Thou,
The very light of our new day.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O strangely art Thou with us Lord,
Neither in height nor depth to seek:
In nearness shall Thy voice be heard;
Spirit to spirit Thou dost speak.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Christ is our Advocate on high;
Thou art our Advocate within:
O plead the truth and make reply
To every argument of sin.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: But ah, this faithless heart of mine!
The way I know; I know my guide;
Forgive me, O my Friend divine,
That I so often turn aside.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Be with me when no other friend
The mystery of my heart can share;
And be Thou known, when fears transcend,
By Thy best name of Comforter.

hymns.title: O Holy Spirit, Come

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Holy Spirit, come,
Anoint us one and all,
And let some mighty deed be done,
While at Thy feet we fall.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thy presence now we feel,
To Thee our all we give,
Oh, let Thy love our spirits seal,
Henceforth for Thee to live.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The glow of love divine
Refines us, at Thy feet;
For this our souls will always pine,
And yearn to be complete.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O Unction from on high,
Come, permeate within;
Then I shall bear Thy searching eye
Without a trace of sin.

hymns.title: Breathe upon Us, Lord From Heaven

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Breathe upon us, Lord from heaven,
Fill us with the Holy Ghost,
Promise of the Father given,
Send us now a Pentecost.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Breath upon us, breathe upon us,
With Thy love our hearts inspire;
Breathe upon us, breathe upon us,
Lord, baptize us now with fire.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: While the Spirit hover o'er us,
Open all our hearts, we pray;
To Thine image, Lord, restore us,
Witness in our souls today.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Breath upon us, breathe upon us,
With Thy love our hearts inspire;
Breathe upon us, breathe upon us,
Lord, baptize us now with fire.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: From all sin grant us exemption,
Wash us in the cleansing flood;
Let us know the full redemption
Purchased for us by the blood.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Breath upon us, breathe upon us,
With Thy love our hearts inspire;
Breathe upon us, breathe upon us,
Lord, baptize us now with fire.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lift us, Lord, Oh lift us higher,
From the carnal mind set free;
Fill us with refining fire,
Give us perfect liberty.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Breath upon us, breathe upon us,
With Thy love our hearts inspire;
Breathe upon us, breathe upon us,
Lord, baptize us now with fire.

hymns.title: Come, Holy Spirit, Raise Our Songs

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, Holy Spirit, raise our songs,
To reach the wonders of that day,
When, with Thy fiery cloven tongues,
Thou didst such glorious scenes display.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lord, we believe to us and ours,
The Apostolic promise given;
We wait the Pentecostal showers,
The Holy Ghost sent down from heaven.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Assembled here with one accord,
Calmly we wait the promised grace,
The purchase of our dying Lord;
Come, Holy Ghost and fill the place.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: If every one that asks may find,
If still Thou dost on sinners fall,
Come as a mighty rushing wind,
Great grace be now upon us all.

hymns.title: Lord, as of Old at Pentecost

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord, as of old at Pentecost,
Thou didst Thy pow'r display,
With cleansing, purifying flame
Descend on us today.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lord, send the old-time pow'r,
The pentecostal pow'r!
Thy floodgates of blessing on us throw open wide!
Lord, send the old-time pow'r,
The Pentecostal pow'r
That sinners be converted and
Thy name glorified!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For mighty works for Thee prepare,
And strengthen every heart;
Come, take possession of Thine own,
And nevermore depart.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lord, send the old-time pow'r,
The pentecostal pow'r!
Thy floodgates of blessing on us throw open wide!
Lord, send the old-time pow'r,
The Pentecostal pow'r
That sinners be converted and
Thy name glorified!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: All self consume, all sin destroy!
With earnest zeal endue
Each waiting heart to work for Thee;
Oh, Lord, our faith renew!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lord, send the old-time pow'r,
The pentecostal pow'r!
Thy floodgates of blessing on us throw open wide!
Lord, send the old-time pow'r,
The Pentecostal pow'r
That sinners be converted and
Thy name glorified!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Speak, Lord! Before Thy throne we wait,
Thy promise we believe,
And will not let Thee go until
The blessing we receive!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lord, send the old-time pow'r,
The pentecostal pow'r!
Thy floodgates of blessing on us throw open wide!
Lord, send the old-time pow'r,
The Pentecostal pow'r
That sinners be converted and
Thy name glorified!

hymns.title: We Come Nigh, Our Heav'nly Father

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We come nigh, our heav'nly Father
We Thy children weak and faint
Fill us with Thy Holy Spirit
Grant that we be all renewed;
Come, Thou Holy Spirit do, come
Speak through us in a new tongue
For Thy great gift we are pleading
Thy great gift of Pentecost.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lord, remember Thou Thy promise
Pour Thy Spirit on all flesh,
Give us of Thy peace, we pray Thee
Peace, the world cannot afford,
Come Thou Holy Spirit, do come
Sin destroy Thou in our hearts
For Thy great gift we are pleading,
Thy great gift of Pentecost.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Heav'nly Dove, descend upon us
Fill us with Thy pow'r divine,
That the nations all may worship
To our Saviour yielded be,
Let us hear of Thy great pow'r through,
This dark continent of ours
For Thy great gift we are pleading,
Thy great gift of Pentecost.

hymns.title: O Spirit of the Living God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Spirit of the living God,
In all Thy plentitude of grace,
Where'er the foot of man hath trod,
Descend on our apostate race,

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Give tongues of fire and hearts of love,
To preach the reconciling word;
Give power and unction from above,
Whene'er the joyful sound is heard.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Be darkness, at Thy coming, light;
Confusion, order in Thy path:
Souls without strength inspire with might;
Bid mercy triumph over wrath.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O Spirit of the Lord, prepare
All the round earth her God to meet;
Breathe thou abroad, like morning air,
Till hearts of stone begin to beat.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Baptize the nations; far and nigh
The triumphs of the cross record;
The name of Jesus glorify,
Till every kindred call Him Lord.

hymns.title: There Shall Be Showers of Blessing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "There shall be showers of blessing:"
This is the promise of love;
There shall be seasons refreshing,
Sent from the Saviour above.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need;
Mercy drops 'round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "There shall be showers of blessing:"
Precious reviving again;
Over the hills and the valleys,
Sound of abundance of rain.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need;
Mercy drops 'round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: "There shall be showers of blessing:"
Send them upon us, Oh Lord!
Grant to us now a refreshing;
Come and now honour Thy Word.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need;
Mercy drops 'round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: "There shall be showers of blessing:"
Oh, that today they might fall,
Now, as to God, we're confessing,
Now as on Jesus we call!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need;
Mercy drops 'round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: "There shall be showers of blessing:"
If we but trust and obey;
There shall be seasons refreshing,
If we let God have His way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need;
Mercy drops 'round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

hymns.title: Lord Jesus, Thou Thy Church Hast Graced

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord Jesus, Thou Thy Church hast Graced
With gifts supernal and divine;
Gifts of Thy Spirit, pure and chaste,
With heavenly lustre here to shine.
Ascending to Thy Father's throne,
Thou hast bestowed them on Thine own.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In Thee, our living Head, are stored
Treasures of wisdom, light and love;
On us, Thy members, Thou hast poured
This wealth of blessing from above.
Oh, may we prove, this very hour,
The nine-fold splendour of Thy pow'r!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Speak, Lord! By Word of Wisdom pure,
Thy will reveal, Thy mind impart;
By Word of Knowledge, swift and sure,
Illume, instruct, and guide each heart,
So shall we trace Thy way divine,
Line upon line, in clear design.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thy mighty faith on us bestow,
Beyond our measure or our thought;
Let gifts of healing from Thee flow,
And wonders in Thy name be wrought.
Make bare Thine arm, confirm Thy Word,
That all may own Thee Christ and Lord!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Touch Thou our lips! We would aspire
To speak the praises of Thy love,
Gifted with pure prophetic fire
And holy unction from above;
Whilst, through Thy searching Spirit, taught
The secret springs of life and thought.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: With tongues of men or Seraph strain,
Speak forth Thy words, in praise, in prayer;
Then make each heaven-sent message plain,
That we Thy glories may declare.
Grace every gift with love's high theme:
Yea, reign o'er all, O Love supreme!

hymns.title: Jesus, We Look to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, we look to Thee,
Thy promised presence claim;
Thou in the midst of us shalt be,
Assembled in Thy name.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thy name salvation is,
Which here we come to pride;
Thy name is life, and health, and peace,
And everlasting love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Not in the name of pride,
Or selfishness we meet;
From nature's paths we turn aside,
And worldly thoughts forget.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: We meet, the grace to take
Which Thou hast freely given;
We meet on earth for Thy dear sake,
That we may meet in heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Present we know Thou art,
But O Thyself reveal!
Now, Lord, let every bounding heart
The mighty comfort feel.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: O may Thy quick'ning voice
The death of sin remove;
And bid our inmost souls rejoice
In hope of perfect love!

hymns.title: I Will Not Leave You Comfortless

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "I will not leave you comfortless,"
But if I go away,
Will send the Holy Comforter,
Your royal Guest for evermore,
Abiding day by day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Has he come to you, to you, to you?
Has the Comforter come to you?
The Lord will reprove the world of sin,
When the Comforter comes to you.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Church of the Living God arise
The fullness to receive,
Until the lost in every place,
Shall feel the need of saving grace,
And shall on Christ believe.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Has he come to you, to you, to you?
Has the Comforter come to you?
The Lord will reprove the world of sin,
When the Comforter comes to you.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: God's skies are full of Pentecost,
For you, for me, for all;
Then let us humbly, boldly press,
Our heritage in Christ possess,
That power from heaven may fall.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Has he come to you, to you, to you?
Has the Comforter come to you?
The Lord will reprove the world of sin,
When the Comforter comes to you.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Then quickly "back to Pentecost,"
That blessed upper room;
And pray the mighty Lord of Hosts
To send on us the Holy Ghost,
And tarry till He come.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Has he come to you, to you, to you?
Has the Comforter come to you?
The Lord will reprove the world of sin,
When the Comforter comes to you.

hymns.title: Oh, Spread the Tidings Round

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Oh, spread the tidings round, wherever man is found,
Wherever human hearts, and human woes abound;
Let every Christian tongue proclaim the joyful sound,
The Comforter has come!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: The comforter has come, The Comforter has come!
The Holy Ghost from heav'n, the Father's promise giv'n;
Oh, spread the tidings round, wherever man is found
The Comforter has come!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lo, the Great King of kings, with healing in His wings,
To every captive soul a full deliverance brings;
And thro' the vacant cells the song of triumph rings;
The Comforter has come.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: The comforter has come, The Comforter has come!
The Holy Ghost from heav'n, the Father's promise giv'n;
Oh, spread the tidings round, wherever man is found
The Comforter has come!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O boundless Love divine! how shall this tongue of mine
To wond'ring mortals tell the matchless grace divine -
That I a child of hell, should in His image shine!
The Comforter has come!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: The comforter has come, The Comforter has come!
The Holy Ghost from heav'n, the Father's promise giv'n;
Oh, spread the tidings round, wherever man is found
The Comforter has come!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Sing, till the echoes fly above the vaulted sky,
And all the saints above to all below reply,
In strains of endless love, the song that ne'er will die;
The Comforter has come!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: The comforter has come, The Comforter has come!
The Holy Ghost from heav'n, the Father's promise giv'n;
Oh, spread the tidings round, wherever man is found
The Comforter has come!

hymns.title: Lord God, the Holy Ghost

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord God, the Holy Ghost,
In this accepted hour,
As on the day of Pentecost,
Descend in all Thy power!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We meet with one accord
In our appointed place,
And wait the promise of our Lord,
The Spirit of all grace.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Like mighty rushing wind
Upon the waves beneath,
Move with one impulse every mind,
Our soul, one feeling breathe.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The young, the old inspire
With wisdom from above,
And give us hearts and tongues of fire
To pray, and praise, and love.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Spirit of Light, explore
And chase our gloom away,
With lustre shining more and more
Unto the perfect day!

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Spirit of Truth, be Thou
In life and death our Guide!
O Spirit of Adoption, now
May we be sanctified.

hymns.title: God Sent His Mighty Power

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God sent His mighty power
To this poor, sinful heart,
To keep me ev'ry hour,
And needful grace impart:
And since His Spirit came
To take supreme control,
The love enkindled flame
Is burning in my soul.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: 'Tis burning in my soul,
'Tis burning in my soul;
The fire of heav'nly love is burning is my Soul;
The Holy Spirit came,
All glory to His name!
The fire of heav'nly love is burning in my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Before the cross I bow,
Upon the altar lay
A willing off'ring now,
My all from day to day;
My Saviour paid the price,
My name He sweetly calls;
Upon the sacrifice
The fire from heaven falls.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: 'Tis burning in my soul,
'Tis burning in my soul;
The fire of heav'nly love is burning is my Soul;
The Holy Spirit came,
All glory to His name!
The fire of heav'nly love is burning in my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: No good that I have done,
His promise I embrace;
Accepted in the Son,
He saves me by His grace;
All glory be to God!
Let hallelujahs roll;
His love is shed abroad,
The fire is in my soul.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: 'Tis burning in my soul,
'Tis burning in my soul;
The fire of heav'nly love is burning is my Soul;
The Holy Spirit came,
All glory to His name!
The fire of heav'nly love is burning in my soul.

hymns.title: In Thy Name, O Blessed Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: In Thy name, O blessed Saviour,
Gather'd in this sacred place;
Here we seek a Father's blessing,
Plead and pray for needed grace;
From the ocean of Thy fullness,
Boundless, fathomless and free;
Let a tidal wave come sweeping,
Setting hearts at liberty.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lift the floodgates, lift the floodgates,
Let the tide come sweeping in;
Blessed tide of full salvation,
Washing, cleansing, from all sin.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lift the floodgates, let salvation
In tremendous currents flow,
To the uttermost fulfilling
Thy blest mission here below;
Until myriads of sinners,
Borne on love's resistless tide,
Shall be swept into the kingdom,
And believer's sanctified.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lift the floodgates, lift the floodgates,
Let the tide come sweeping in;
Blessed tide of full salvation,
Washing, cleansing, from all sin.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: It is coming, we believe it,
Thou dost hear and answer prayer;
It is coming, we shall see it,
Thine almighty arm made bare;
Tides of power, tides of glory,
Holy tides of perfect love,
Satisfying, overflowing,
Coming on us from above.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lift the floodgates, lift the floodgates,
Let the tide come sweeping in;
Blessed tide of full salvation,
Washing, cleansing, from all sin.

hymns.title: Thou Christ of Burning, Cleansing Flame

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thou Christ of burning, cleansing flame,
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!
Thy blood bought gift today we claim,
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!
Look down and see this waiting host
Give us the promised Holy Ghost,
We want another Pentecost,
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: God of Elijah, hear our cry!
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!
Oh, make us fit to live or die!
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!
To burn up every trace of sin,
To bring the light and glory in,
The revolution now begin,
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: 'Tis fire we want, for fire we plead
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!
The fire will meet our every need,
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!
For strength to ever do the right,
For grace to conquer in the fight,
For power to walk the world in white,
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: To make our weak heart strong and brave,
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!
To live a dying world to save,
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!
Oh, see us on Thy altar lay
Our lives, our all, this very day;
To crown the offering now, we pray,
Send the fire! Send the fire! Send the fire!

hymns.title: Come, Gracious Spirit, Heavenly Dove

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, gracious Spirit, heavenly Dove,
With light and comfort from above;
Be Thou our Guardian, Thou our Guide,
O'er every thought and step preside.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The light of truth to us display,
And make us know and choose Thy way;
Plant holy fear in every heart,
That we from God may ne'er depart.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Lead us to Christ, the living way,
Nor let us from His pastures stray;
Lead us to holiness, the road,
That we must take to dwell with God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lead us to Heav'n, that we may share
Fullness of joy for ever there;
Lead us to God, our final rest,
To be with Him for ever blest.

hymns.title: For God so Loved the Sinful World

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: For God so loved the sinful world,
His Son He freely gave,
That whosoever would believe,
Eternal life should have.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: 'Tis true O yes, 'tis true,
God's wonderful promise is true;
For I've trusted, and tested, and tried it,
And I know God's promise is true.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I was a wayward wand'ring child,
A slave to sin and fear,
Until this blessed promise fell,
Like music on my ear.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: 'Tis true O yes, 'tis true,
God's wonderful promise is true;
For I've trusted, and tested, and tried it,
And I know God's promise is true.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The "whosoever" of the Lord,
I trusted was for me;
I took Him at His gracious word,
From sin to set me free.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: 'Tis true O yes, 'tis true,
God's wonderful promise is true;
For I've trusted, and tested, and tried it,
And I know God's promise is true.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Eternal life began below
Now fills my hearts and soul:
I'll sing His praise for evermore,
Who has redeemed my soul.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: 'Tis true O yes, 'tis true,
God's wonderful promise is true;
For I've trusted, and tested, and tried it,
And I know God's promise is true.

hymns.title: The Gospel Bells Are Ringing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The gospel bells are ringing
Over land, from sea to sea
Blessed news of free salvation
Do they offer you and me,
"For God so loved the world
That His only Son He gave!
Whosoe'er believeth in Him
Everlasting life shall have."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Gospel bells how they ring
Over land from sea to sea
Gospel bells freely bring
Blessed news to you and me

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The gospel bells invite us
To a feast prepared for all;
Do not slight the invitation,
Nor reject the gracious call.
