"I am the bread of life;
Eat of Me, thou hungry soul;
Though your sins be red as crimson,
They shall be as white as wool"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Gospel bells how they ring
Over land from sea to sea
Gospel bells freely bring
Blessed news to you and me

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The gospel bells give warning,
As they sound from day to day
Of the fate which doth await them,
Who for ever will delay.
"Escape thou for thy life!
Tarry not in all the plain:
Nor behind thee look, oh, never,
Lest thou be consumed in pain."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Gospel bells how they ring
Over land from sea to sea
Gospel bells freely bring
Blessed news to you and me

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The gospel bells are joyful
As they echo far and wide,
Bearing notes of perfect pardon,
Through a Saviour crucified:
"Good tidings of great joy
To all people do I bring;
Unto you is born a Saviour,
Which is Christ the Lord and King"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Gospel bells how they ring
Over land from sea to sea
Gospel bells freely bring
Blessed news to you and me

hymns.title: There Is Life for a Look at the Crucified One

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is life for a look at the crucified One
There is life at this moment for thee
Then look, sinner, look unto Him and be saved
Unto Him who was nailed on the tree

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Look, look, look and live
There is life for a look at the Crucified One
There is life at this moment for thee

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh, why was He there as a Bearer of sin,
If on Jesus thy sins were not laid?
Oh, why from His side flowed the sin-cleansed blood
If His dying thy debt has not paid

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Look, look, look and live
There is life for a look at the Crucified One
There is life at this moment for thee

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: It is not thy tears of repentance nor prayers,
But the blood that atones for the soul;
On Him then believe, and a pardon receive
For His blood can now make thee quite whole

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Look, look, look and live
There is life for a look at the Crucified One
There is life at this moment for thee

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: We are healed by His stripes; wouldst thou add to the word?
And He is our righteousness made;
The best robe of heaven He bids thee to wear.
Oh, couldst thou be better arrayed?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Look, look, look and live
There is life for a look at the Crucified One
There is life at this moment for thee

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Then doubt not thy welcome, since God has declared
There remaineth no more to be done;
That once in the end of the world He appeared,
And completed the work He begun.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Look, look, look and live
There is life for a look at the Crucified One
There is life at this moment for thee

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: But take, with rejoicing, from Jesus at once
The life everlasting He gives;
And know with assurance thou never canst die,
Since Jesus thy righteousness lives.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Look, look, look and live
There is life for a look at the Crucified One
There is life at this moment for thee

hymns.title: Who'll Be the Next to Follow Jesus?

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Who'll be the next to follow Jesus?
Who'll be the next His cross to bear?
Someone is ready, someone is waiting
Who'll be the next a crown to wear

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Who'll be the next, who'll be the next
Who'll be the next to follow Jesus?
Who'll be the next to follow Jesus now?
Follow Jesus now?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Who'll be the next to follow Jesus?
Come and bow at His precious feet
Who'll be the next to lay every burden
Down at the Father's mercy seat?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Who'll be the next, who'll be the next
Who'll be the next to follow Jesus?
Who'll be the next to follow Jesus now?
Follow Jesus now?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Who'll be the next to follow Jesus?
Who'll be the next to praise His name?
Who'll swell the chorus of free redemption
Sing Hallelujah! Praise the Lamb

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Who'll be the next, who'll be the next
Who'll be the next to follow Jesus?
Who'll be the next to follow Jesus now?
Follow Jesus now?

hymns.title: Blessed Invitation From the King of Heav'n

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Blessed invitation from the King of Heav'n
Blessed invitation by the Spirit giv'n,
Falling on the weary, like refreshing dew,
"Whoso'er believeth" That means you

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: That means you, brother that means you
Trust the Saviour's promise, tried and true (my brother)
That means you, brother that means you
"Whoso'er believeth" That means you

sections.label: VERSE 2

He hath wrought salvation blessed Son of God
All the work is finished there is naught to do,
"But to claim the blessing" That means you

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: That means you, brother that means you
Trust the Saviour's promise, tried and true (my brother)

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Saving all who trust Him to the utter-most,

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: That means you, brother that means you
Trust the Saviour's promise, tried and true (my brother)

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Doubt His word no longer, come to Him today,
Turning from your sins for ever more away;
Through His boundless mercy, all shall be forgiven,
He will safely guide you home to heaven

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: That means you, brother that means you
Trust the Saviour's promise, tried and true (my brother)
That means you, brother that means you
"Whoso'er believeth" That means you

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: There in realms of glory, we will sing His praise
With the shout of triumph through eternal days,
