sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: That means you, brother that means you
Trust the Saviour's promise, tried and true (my brother)
That means you, brother that means you
"Whoso'er believeth" That means you

hymns.title: Sinners, Turn Why Will Ye Die?

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Sinners, turn why will ye die?
God your maker, asks you why
God, who did your being give
Made you with Himself to live
He the fatal cause demands
Ask the work of His own hands
Why, ye thankless creatures, why
Will you cross His love, and die?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Sinners, turn why will ye die?
God, your Saviour, asks you why
God who did your soul retrieve
Died Himself that ye might live
Will you let Him die in vain?
Crucify the Lord again
Why, ye ransom'd sinners, why
Will you slight His grace, and die?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Sinners, turn why will ye die?
God the Spirit, asks you why
He who all your lives hath strove
Urged you to contend for heaven
Will you not His grace receive?
Will you still refuse to live?
Why, ye long sought sinners, why?
Will you grieve your God, and die?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Can you doubt if God is love
If to all His yearnings move?
Will you not His word receive
Will you not His oath believe?
See, your dying Lord appears
Jesus weeps believe His tears
Mingled with His blood they cry
Why will you resolve to die?

hymns.title: Come, Oh, Come! While Christ Is Calling

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, oh, come! while Christ is calling
Linger not in paths of sin
Sever ev'ry tie that binds you
And the heavenly race begin

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Calling now, calling now
Hear the Saviour calling now
Calling now, calling now
Hear the Saviour calling now

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Come, oh, come, while Christ is pleading
Oh, What love His tones convey
Will you slight His proffer'd mercy
Will you longer from Him stray?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Calling now, calling now
Hear the Saviour calling now
Calling now, calling now
Hear the Saviour calling now

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Come, oh, come, delay no longer
For th'accepted time is now,
Yield, oh, yield yourself to Jesus
And before His sceptre bow.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Calling now, calling now
Hear the Saviour calling now
Calling now, calling now
Hear the Saviour calling now

hymns.title: Yet There Is Room! The Lamb's Bright Hall of Song

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Yet there is room! The Lamb's bright hall of song,
With its fair glory, beckons thee along

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Room, room, still room!
Oh, enter, enter now!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Day is declining, and the sun is low
The shadows lengthen, light makes haste to go

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Room, room, still room!
Oh, enter, enter now!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The bridal hall is filling for the feast
Pass in! pass in! and be the Bridegroom's guest.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Room, room, still room!
Oh, enter, enter now!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: It fills, it fills, that hall of jubilee
Make haste, make haste! 'tis not too full for thee!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Room, room, still room!
Oh, enter, enter now!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Yet there is room! still open stand the gate
The gate of love, it is not yet too late

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Room, room, still room!
Oh, enter, enter now!

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Pass in! pass in! That banquet is for thee
That cup of everlasting love is free.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Room, room, still room!
Oh, enter, enter now!

hymns.title: Today the Saviour Calls

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Today the Saviour calls;
Ye wand'rers, come;
Oh, ye benighted souls,
Why longer roam?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Today the Saviour calls:
Oh, listen now!
Within these sacred walls
To Jesus bow.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Today the Saviour calls:
For refuge fly:
The storm of justice falls,
And death is nigh.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Today Spirit calls today:
Yield to His power;
Oh, grieve Him not away!
'Tis mercy's hour.

hymns.title: I've a Message From the Lord, Halleluyah!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I've a message from the Lord, Halleluyah!
The message: unto you I'll give
'Tis recorded in his word, Hallelujah
It is only that you "Look and live"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Look and live" my brother live
Look to Jesus now and live
'Tis recorded in His word, Hallelujah
It is only that you "look and live

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I've a message full of love, Halleluyah
A message, O my friend, for you
'Tis a message from above Hallelujah
Jesus said it and I know 'tis true

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Look and live" my brother live
Look to Jesus now and live
'Tis recorded in His word, Hallelujah
It is only that you "look and live

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Life is offered unto you, Halleluyah
Eternal life your soul shall have
If you'll only look to Him Hallelujah
Look to Jesus who alone can save.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Look and live" my brother live
Look to Jesus now and live
'Tis recorded in His word, Hallelujah
It is only that you "look and live

hymns.title: I Have a Precious Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I have a precious Saviour,
He came from Heav'n above
And died for me on Calvary,
To prove His matchless love
This love so freely given,
He offers now to you;
Won't you let my Saviour be your Saviour too?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Won't you let Him be your Saviour too?
He would prove a faithful friend to you;
He would purify your soul,
Keep you ever pure and whole,
Won't you let my Saviour be your Saviour too.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I have a loving Saviour,
He hears me when I call;
He helps to bear each load of care,
And lifts me when I fall;
So kind is He, so tender,
Compassionate and true
Won't you let my Saviour be your Saviour too?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Won't you let Him be your Saviour too?
He would prove a faithful friend to you;
He would purify your soul,
Keep you ever pure and whole,
Won't you let my Saviour be your Saviour too.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I have a faithful Saviour,
With me He will abide,
And hold my hand until I land
Upon the other side
Someday in all His glory,
My Saviour I shall view
Brother, won't you let Him be your Saviour too?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Won't you let Him be your Saviour too?
He would prove a faithful friend to you;
He would purify your soul,
Keep you ever pure and whole,
Won't you let my Saviour be your Saviour too.

hymns.title: Come Unto Me, Ye Weary

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "Come unto Me, ye weary,
And I will give you rest."
Oh, blessed voice of Jesus,
Which comes to hearts oppress'd!
It tells of benediction,
Of pardon, grace, and peace,
Of joy that hath no ending,
Of love which cannot cease.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "Come unto Me, dear, children,
And I will give you light",
Oh, loving voice of Jesus,
Which comes to cheer the night!
Our hearts were fill'd with sadness
And we had lost our way,
But morning brings us gladness,
And songs the break of day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: "Come unto Me, ye fainting,
And I will give you life
Oh, peaceful voice of Jesus,
Which comes to end our strife:
The foe is stern and eager,
The fight is fierce and long,
But Thou hast made us mighty,
And stronger than the strong.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: "And whosoever cometh,
I will not cast him out."
Oh, patient voice of Jesus,
Which drives away our doubt,
Which calls us, very sinners,
Unworthy though we be
Of love so free and boundless,
To come dear Lord, to Thee.

hymns.title: Come, Soul and Find Thy Rest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, soul and find thy rest,
No longer be distress'd,
Come to thy Saviour's breast,
Oh don't stay away,

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Pray'rs are ascending now
Angels are bending low
Both words are blending now,
Oh don't stay away.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Dark is the world and cold,
Her cares cannot be told,
Come to thy Saviour's fold,
Oh don't stay away,

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Pray'rs are ascending now
Angels are bending low
Both words are blending now,
Oh don't stay away.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Come with thy load of sin,
Christ died thy soul to win;
Now He will take thee in.
Oh don't stay away,

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Pray'rs are ascending now
Angels are bending low
Both words are blending now,
Oh don't stay away.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Time here will soon be past,
Moments are flying fast;
Judgement will come at last,
Oh don't stay away,

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Pray'rs are ascending now
Angels are bending low
Both words are blending now,
Oh don't stay away.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Come, O we pray thee, come,
Come, and no longer roam:
Come now and start for home,
Oh don't stay away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Pray'rs are ascending now
Angels are bending low
Both words are blending now,
Oh don't stay away.

hymns.title: Come to the Saviour, Make No Delay

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come to the Saviour, make no delay,
Here in His Word He has shown us the way,
Here in our midst He's standing today,
Tenderly saying, "Come!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Joyful, joyful will be the meeting
When from sin our hearts are pure and free
And we shall gather, Saviour with Thee
In our eternal home.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "Suffer the children", oh, hear His voice
Let every heart leap forth and rejoice
And let us freely make Him our choice
Do not delay, but come

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Joyful, joyful will be the meeting
When from sin our hearts are pure and free
And we shall gather, Saviour with Thee
In our eternal home.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Think once again, He's with us today
Heed now His blest command and obey
Hear now His accents tenderly say
"Will you, My children, come?"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Joyful, joyful will be the meeting
When from sin our hearts are pure and free
And we shall gather, Saviour with Thee
In our eternal home.

hymns.title: Ring the Bells of Heaven! There Is Joy Today

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Ring the bells of Heaven! There is joy to-day,
For a soul returning from the wild?
See! the Father meets Him out upon the way,
Welcoming His weary, wandering child.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Glory! glory! how the angels sing!
Glory! glory! how the loud harps ring!
'Tis the ransomed army, like a mighty sea,
Pealing forth the anthem of the free!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Ring the bells of Heaven! There is joy today
For the wanderer now is reconciled;
Yes, a soul is rescued from his sinful way,
And is born anew a ransomed child.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Glory! glory! how the angels sing!
Glory! glory! how the loud harps ring!
'Tis the ransomed army, like a mighty sea,
Pealing forth the anthem of the free!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Ring the bells of Heaven! Spread the feast today!
Angels swell the glad triumphant strain!
Tell the joyful tidings! bear it far away!
For a precious soul is born again.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Glory! glory! how the angels sing!
Glory! glory! how the loud harps ring!
'Tis the ransomed army, like a mighty sea,
Pealing forth the anthem of the free!

hymns.title: Redeem'd, How I Love to Proclaim It

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Redeem'd, how I love to proclaim it,
Redeem'd by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeem'd through His infinite mercy,
His child and forever, I am.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Redeem'd, Redeem'd,
Redeem'd by the blood of the Lamb,
Redeem'd, Redeem'd,
His child and forever I am.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Redeem'd and so happy in Jesus,
No language my rapture can tell;
I know that the light of His presence
With me doth continually dwell.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Redeem'd, Redeem'd,
Redeem'd by the blood of the Lamb,
Redeem'd, Redeem'd,
His child and forever I am.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I think of my blessed Redeemer,
I think of Him all the day long;
I sing, for I cannot be silent,
His love is the theme of my song.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Redeem'd, Redeem'd,
Redeem'd by the blood of the Lamb,
Redeem'd, Redeem'd,
His child and forever I am.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I know I shall see in His beauty,
The King in whose law I delight;
Who lovingly guardeth my footsteps,
And giveth me songs in the night.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Redeem'd, Redeem'd,
Redeem'd by the blood of the Lamb,
Redeem'd, Redeem'd,
His child and forever I am.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: I know there's a crown that is waiting
In yonder bright mansion for me;
And soon with the spirits made perfect,
At home with the Lord I shall be.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Redeem'd, Redeem'd,
Redeem'd by the blood of the Lamb,
Redeem'd, Redeem'd,
His child and forever I am.

hymns.title: Look to Jesus, and Be Saved

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Look to Jesus, and be saved,
See Him hanging on the tree;
Guilty art thou and enslaved,
But He bears thy guilt for thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Look, till thou canst see thy sin
In His body crucified;
All the lusts that lurked within
All thy wilfulness and pride.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Look, and see the judgement fall
On that guiltless, guilt-bowed head;
He is made our sin: for all
One hath died, and all are dead.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Look to Jesus, look and live,
He has died thy death for thee;
Look, and trust, and love, and give
All thou art His prize to be.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Look with awe, till wondering love
Melts thy heart and dims thine eyes,
And, with prostrate saints above,
Rapt in praise thy spirit lies.

hymns.title: Tell Me the Old, Old Story

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Tell me the old, old story,
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love;
Tell me the story simply,
As to a little child
For I am weak and weary,
And helpless and defiled.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Tell me the story slowly,
That I may take it in
That wonderful redemption,
God's remedy for sin;
Tell me the story often,
For I forget so soon,
The "early dew" of morning
Has passed away at noon.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Tell me the story softly,
With earnest tones and grave;
Remember! I'm the sinner
Whom Jesus came to save;
Tell me the story always,
If you would really be,
In any time of trouble,
A comfort to me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Tell me the same old story,
When you have cause to fear
That this world's empty glory
Is costing me too dear;
Yes, and when that world's glory
Is dawning on my soul,
Tell me the old, old story;
"Christ Jesus makes thee whole."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.

hymns.title: Softly and Tenderly Jesus Is Calling

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling for you and for me;
See, on the portals He's waiting and watching,
Watching for you and for me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come home, come home,
Ye who are weary, come home,
Earnestly, tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling, "O sinner, come home!"

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Why should we tarry when Jesus is pleading,
Pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger and heed not His mercies,
Mercies for you and for me?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come home, come home,
Ye who are weary, come home,
Earnestly, tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling, "O sinner, come home!"

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Time is now fleeting, the moments are passing,
Passing from you and from me;
Shadows are gathering, death beds are coming,
Coming for you and for me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come home, come home,
Ye who are weary, come home,
Earnestly, tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling, "O sinner, come home!"

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh for the wonderful love He has promised,
Promised for you and for me;
Though we have sinn'd He has mercy and pardon,
Pardon for you and for me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come home, come home,
Ye who are weary, come home,
Earnestly, tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling, "O sinner, come home!"

hymns.title: If You're Tir'd of the Load of Your Sin

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: If you're tir'd of the load of your sin,
Let J-esus come in to your heart;
If you de-sire a new life to begin,
Let Je-sus come in-to your heart.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just now, your doubt-ings give o'er;
Just now, reject Him no more;
Just now, throw open the door;
Let Jesus come into your heart.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: If 'tis for pur-i-ty now that you sigh,
Let Je-sus come in-to your heart;
Foun-tains for cleansing are flowing near by,
Let Je-sus come in-to your heart.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just now, your doubt-ings give o'er;
Just now, reject Him no more;
Just now, throw open the door;
Let Jesus come into your heart.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: If there's a tem-pest your voice cannot still,
Let J-esus come in-to your heart;
If there's a void this world ne-ver can fill,
Let Je-sus come in-to your heart.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just now, your doubt-ings give o'er;
Just now, reject Him no more;
Just now, throw open the door;
Let Jesus come into your heart.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: If friends, once trust-ed have pro-ven un-true,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
Find what a Friend He will be un-to you,
Let Je-sus come in-to your heart.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just now, your doubt-ings give o'er;
Just now, reject Him no more;
Just now, throw open the door;
Let Jesus come into your heart.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: If you would join the glad songs of the blest,
Let Je-sus come in-to your heart;
If you would en-ter the mansions of rest,
Let Je-sus come in-to your heart.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just now, your doubt-ings give o'er;
Just now, reject Him no more;
Just now, throw open the door;
Let Jesus come into your heart.

hymns.title: From Greenland's Icy Mountains

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: From Greenland's icy mountains,
From India's coral strand;
Where Afric's sunny fountains
Roll down their golden sand,
From many ancient river,
From many a palmy plain,
They call us to deliever
Their land from error's chain.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: That though the spicy breezes
Blow soft o'er Ceylon's Isle,
Though ev'ry prospect pleases,
And only man is vile;
In vain with Iavish kindness,
The gifts of God are strown,
The heathen in his blindness
Bows down to wood and stone.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Can we, whose souls are lighted
With wisdom from on high,
Can we to men benighted
The lamp of life deny?
Salvation! Oh, salvation!
The joyful sound proclaim,
Till each remotest nation
Has learnt Messiah's name

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Waft, waft, ye winds His story,
And you, ye waters roll,
Till, like a sea of glory,
It spreads from pole to pole;
Till o'er our ransomed nature
The Lamb for sinners slain,
Redeemer, King, Creator,
In bliss returns to reign.

hymns.title: Once A-Gain the Gos-Pel Message

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Once a-gain the Gos-pel message
From the Saviour you have heard;
Will you heed the invitation?
Will you turn and seek the Lord?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come believing! Come believing
Come to Jesus! look and live!
Come believing! Come believing
Come to Jesus! look and live!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Many summers you have wasted,
Ripened harvests you have seen;
Winter snows by Spring have melted
Yet you linger in your sin.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come believing! Come believing
Come to Jesus! look and live!
Come believing! Come believing
Come to Jesus! look and live!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus for your choice is waiting;
Tarry not; at once decide!
While the Spirit now is striving,
Yield, and seek the Saviour's side.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come believing! Come believing
Come to Jesus! look and live!
Come believing! Come believing
Come to Jesus! look and live!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Cease of fitness to be thinking;
Do not longer try to feel
It is trusting, and not feeling
That will give the Spirit's seal.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come believing! Come believing
Come to Jesus! look and live!
Come believing! Come believing
Come to Jesus! look and live!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Let your will to God be given
Trust in Christ's atoning blood;
Look to Jesus now in heaven,
Rest on His unchanging word.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Come believing! Come believing
Come to Jesus! look and live!
Come believing! Come believing
Come to Jesus! look and live!

hymns.title: O Men of God, Arise! The Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O men of God, arise! the Lord
Has giv'n thee in His wondrous Word
Great promises of mighty signs
To ratify the sacred lines
Of His salvation's perfect plan
As thou dost preach to fallen man.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: If He, the Lord of Glory, need
Arresting sign and glowing deed
Credentials of Messiahship
Thy helpless hand and faltering lip
Must surely share an equal flame
To blazon forth Messiah's Name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: These signs shall follow them,
He saith who speak His word in simple faith
They shall with heaven's authority
Bid foul tormenting spirits flee
They shall in other tongues speak things
Beyond the range of finite wings.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: So spake they after Pentecost
High myst'ries of the Holy Ghost
They shall the fearsome Serpent tame
And bind its venom in His Name
If any deadly thing they take
It shall not hurt them, for His sake.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Upon the sick they shall lay hands
Who shall arise from Satan's bands
Leaving their fev'rous beds of pain
To leap like youngling harts again
O men of God! These signs must be
As Christ's authority to thee.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: There is no other way! The Word
Not heav'n-confirmed must fail unheard
For wondrous act and mighty sign
Are still the Saviour's own design
To wing His message to each heart
And bid the pow'rs of hell depart.

hymns.title: Do You Ever Stop, My Friend to Think

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Do you ever stop, my Friend to think
The while this world you're passing thro'
Some-one may be saved from ruin's brink,
By just a lit-tle help from you?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just a lit-tle help from you,
Just a lit-tle help from you;...
Won-drous things the Lord may do,
By just a lit-tle help from you.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Just a lit-tle deed of kind-ness now,
It may the faith of one re-store,
Who beneath some load of grief doth bow,
Is al-most ready to give o'er.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just a lit-tle help from you,
Just a lit-tle help from you;...
Won-drous things the Lord may do,
By just a lit-tle help from you.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Just a lit-tle word of Jesus' love,
Some precious soul may help de-cide
To for-sake the wrong and look a-bove,
And let the Lord his foot-step guide.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just a lit-tle help from you,
Just a lit-tle help from you;...
Won-drous things the Lord may do,
By just a lit-tle help from you.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Let us do our part, ere day is done,
And to our calling faith-ful be;
For the world to Christ must now be won,
By help of you, by help of me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just a lit-tle help from you,
Just a lit-tle help from you;...
Won-drous things the Lord may do,
By just a lit-tle help from you.

hymns.title: Jesus, Lover of My Soul

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll,
While the tempest still is high:
Hide me, O my Saviour, hide,
Till the storm of life is past,
Safe into the haven guide
Oh, receive my soul at last.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Other refuge have I none;
Hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
Leave, ah! leave me not alone,
Still support and comfort me.
All my trust on Thee is stayed,
All my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenseless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou, O Christ! art all I want;
More than all in Thee I find;
Raise the fallen cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the blind.
Just and Holy is Thy name
I am all unrighteousness;
Vile and full of sin I am;
Thou art full of truth and grace.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Plenteous grace with Thee is found,
Grace to cover all my sin;
Let the healing streams abound,
Make and keep me pure within,
Thou of life the fountain art,
Freely let me take of Thee
Spring Thou up within my heart,
Rise to all eternity.

hymns.title: How Can a Weary Heart Find Rest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: How can a weary heart find rest,
By doubt dismayed, by sin oppressed;
I strive to wash my sins away,
And weeping, pray both night and day.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Hark, weary one, the work was done
By God the Father's only Son
Could all mankind unite to pray
'Twould never wash one sin away.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: For man is lost and dead in sin,
But Jesus died our souls to win,
He bore our guilt, endured our shame,
Oh, blessed be His holy name.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I now receive Him, and His power,
It fills my soul this very hour
His changeless word I now believe,
And life eternal I receive.

hymns.title: There Is Fountain Fill'd with Blood

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is fountain fill'd with blood,
Drawn from Emmanuel's veins,
And sinners plung'd beneath that flood
Loose all their guilty stains.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The dying thief rejoiced to see
That fountain in his day;
And there may I, though vile as he,
Wash all my sins away.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I do believe, I will believe,
That Jesus died for me
That on the cross He shed His blood,
From sin to set me free.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Dear dying Lamb! Thy precious blood
Shall never lose its power,
Till all the ransomed church of God
Be saved to sin no more.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: E'er since by faith I saw the stream
Thy flowing wounds supply,
Redeeming love has been my theme
And shall be till I die.

hymns.title: Just as I Am, without One Plea

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Just as I am, without one plea,
But that Thy blood was shed for me
And that Thou bidst me come to Thee,
Oh Lamb of God I come, I come.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Just as I am, and waiting not
To rid my soul of one dark blot
To Thee, whose blood can cleanse each spot
Oh Lamb of God I come, I come.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Just as I am though tossed about,
With many a conflict, many a doubt,
Fightings and fears within, without,
Oh Lamb of God I come, I come.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Just as I am poor, wretched, blind,
Sight, riches, healing of the mind
Yea, all I need, in Thee to find
Oh Lamb of God I come, I come.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Just as I am, Thou wilt receive,
Wilt welcome, pardon, cleanse, relieve,
Because Thy promise I believe
Oh Lamb of God I come, I come.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Just as I am Thy love unknown
Has broken every barrier down;
Now to be Thine, yea Thine alone,
Oh Lamb of God I come, I come.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Just as I am, of that free love
The breadth, length, depth and height to prove,
Here for a season, then above,
Oh Lamb of God I come, I come.

hymns.title: I Hear the Saviour Say

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I hear the Saviour say
"Thy strength indeed is small
Child of weakness, watch and pray
Find in me thine all in all"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus paid it all
All to Him I owe
Sin had left a crimson stain
He washed it white as snow.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lord, now indeed I find
Thy power and Thine alone
Can change the leper's sports
And melt the heart of stone.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus paid it all
All to Him I owe
Sin had left a crimson stain
He washed it white as snow.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: For nothing good have I
Whereby Thy grace to claim
I'll wash my garments white
In the Blood of Calvary's Lamb.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus paid it all
All to Him I owe
Sin had left a crimson stain
He washed it white as snow.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And when before the throne
I stand in Him complete
"Jesus died my soul to save"
My lips shall still repeat.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus paid it all
All to Him I owe
Sin had left a crimson stain
He washed it white as snow.

hymns.title: Grace 'Tis a Charming Sound

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Grace 'tis a charming sound
Harmonious to the ear
Heav'n with the echo shall resound
And all the earth shall hear

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saved by grace alone
This is all my plea
Jesus died for all mankind
And Jesus died for me

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: 'Twas grace that wrote my name
In life's eternal book
'Twas grace that gave me to the Lamb
Who all my sorrows took

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saved by grace alone
This is all my plea
Jesus died for all mankind
And Jesus died for me

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Grace taught my wand'ring feet
To tread the heavenly road
And new supplies each hour I meet
While pressing up to God

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saved by grace alone
This is all my plea
Jesus died for all mankind
And Jesus died for me

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Grace taught my soul to pray
And made mine eyes o'erflow
'Tis grace has kept me to this day
And will not let me go.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saved by grace alone
This is all my plea
Jesus died for all mankind
And Jesus died for me

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Oh, let Thy grace inspire
My soul with strength divine
May all my powers to Thee aspire
And all my days be Thine.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saved by grace alone
This is all my plea
Jesus died for all mankind
And Jesus died for me

hymns.title: Jesus Is Tenderly Calling Thee Home

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus is tenderly calling thee home
Calling today, calling today
Why from sunshine of love wilt thou roam
Farther and farther away?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Calling today, calling today
Jesus is calling, is tenderly calling today!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus is calling the weary to rest
Calling today, calling today
Bring Him thy burden and thou shalt be blest;
He will not turn thee away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Calling today, calling today
Jesus is calling, is tenderly calling today!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus is waiting; O come to Him now
Waiting today, waiting today;
Come with thy sins; at his feet lowly bow
Come, and no longer delay.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Calling today, calling today
Jesus is calling, is tenderly calling today!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus is pleading; O listen to His voice
Hear Him today, hear Him today;
They who believe on His name shall rejoice;
Quickly arise and away!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Calling today, calling today
Jesus is calling, is tenderly calling today!

hymns.title: If You From Sin Are Longing to Be Free

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: If you from sin are longing to be free,
Look to the Lamb of God;
He, to redeem you, died on Calvary,
Look to the Lamb of God.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When Satan tempts, and doubts and fears assail,
Look to the Lamb of God;
You in His strength shall over all prevail
Look to the Lamb of God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Are you a weary, does the way seem long?
Look to the Lamb of God
His love will cheer and fill your heart with song,
Look to the Lamb of God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Fear not when shadows on your pathway fall,
Look to the Lamb of God
In joy or sorrow Christ is all in all,
Look to the Lamb of God.

hymns.title: Fling Out the Banner! Let It Float

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Fling out the banner! Let it float
Skyward and seaward high and wide,
The sun that lights its shining folds,
The cross on which the Saviour died.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Fling out the banner! Angels bend
In anxious silence o'er the sign
And vanity seek to comprehend
The wonder of the love divine.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Fling out the banner! heathen lands
Shall see from far the glorious sight,
And nations crowding to be born
Baptize their spirits in its lights.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Fling out the banner! let it float
Skyward and seaward, high and wide
Our glory only in the cross,
Our only hope the Crucified.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Fling out the banner! wide and high,
Seaward and skyward let it shine:
Nor skill, nor might, nor merit ours:
We conquer only in that sign.

hymns.title: Must I Go and Empty Handed?

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Must I go and empty handed?
Thus my dear Redeemer meet?
Not one day of service give Him
Lay no trophy at His feet?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Must I go and empty handed?
Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him?
Must I empty handed go

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Not at death I shrink or falter
For my Saviour saves me now
But to meet Him empty handed
Thought of that now clouds my brow.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Must I go and empty handed?
Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him?
Must I empty handed go

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh, the years of sinning wasted
Could I but recall them now
I would give them to my Saviour
To His will I'd gladly bow.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Must I go and empty handed?
Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him?
Must I empty handed go

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O ye saints, arouse, be earnest
Up and work while yet 'tis day
Ere the night of death o'er take thee
Strive for souls while still you may.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Must I go and empty handed?
Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him?
Must I empty handed go

hymns.title: Would Jesus Have the Sinner Die?

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Would Jesus have the sinner die?
Why hangs He then on yonder tree?
What means that strange expiring cry?
Sinners, He prays for you and me
Sinners, He prays for you and me
Forgive, them, Father, oh forgive
They know not that by Me they live
They know not that by Me they live.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou loving, all-atoning Lamb
Thee-by Thy painful agony
Thy blood-like sweat, Thy grief and shame
Thy cross and passion on the tree
Thy cross and passion on the tree
Thy precious death and life-I pray
Take all, take all my sins away
Take all, take all my sins away.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh let me kiss Thy pierced feet
And bathe and wash them with my tears
The story of Thy love repeat
In every drooping sinner's ears
In every drooping sinner's ears
That all may hear the quick'ning sound
Since, I e'en I, have mercy found
Since, I e'en I, have mercy found.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh let Thy love my heart constrain
Thy love for ev'ry sinner free
That ev'ry fallen soul of man
May taste the grace that found out me
May taste the grace that found out me
That all mankind with me may prove
Thy sovereign everlasting love
Thy sovereign everlasting love.

hymns.title: Great God of Wonders! All Thy Ways

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Great God of wonders! all Thy ways
Display the attributes divine;
But countless acts of pard'ning grace
Beyond Thine other wonders shine:

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Who is a pard'ning God like Thee?
Or who has grace so rich and free?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In wonder lost, with trembling joy
We take the pardon of our God;
Pardon for crimes of deepest dye,
A pardon bought with Jesus' blood:

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Who is a pard'ning God like Thee?
Or who has grace so rich and free?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Pardon from an offended God!
Pardon-for sins of deepest dye!
Pardon bestowed through Jesus' blood!
Pardon that brings the rebel nigh!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Who is a pard'ning God like Thee?
Or who has grace so rich and free?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O may this strange, this matchless grace,
This God-like miracle of love,
Fill the wide earth with grateful praise,
As now it fills the choirs above!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Who is a pard'ning God like Thee?
Or who has grace so rich and free?

hymns.title: I Have a Saviour, He's Pleading in Glory

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I have a Saviour, He's pleading in glory,
A dear, loving Saviour though earth friends be few;
And now He is watching in tenderness o'er me:
And oh, that my Saviour were your Saviour too!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
I'm praying for you.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I have a Father: To me He has given
A hope for eternity, blessed and true;
And soon He will call me to meet Him in heaven,
But oh, may He lead you to go with me too!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
I'm praying for you.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I have a robe: 'tis resplendent in whiteness,
Awaiting in glory my wondering view;
Oh, when I receive it all shining in brightness,
Dear friend, could I see you receiving one too!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
I'm praying for you.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I have a peace: it is calm as a river,
A peace that the friends of this world never knew;
My Saviour alone is its Author and Giver,
And oh, could I know it was given to you!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
I'm praying for you.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: When Jesus has found you, tell others the story,
That my loving Saviour is your Saviour too;
Then pray that your Saviour may bring them to glory,
And prayer will be answered, 'twas answered for yo

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
I'm praying for you.

hymns.title: There Is a Fountain Fill'd with Blood

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is a fountain fill'd with blood,
Drawn from Immanuel's veins,
And sinners plung'd beneath that flood,
Lose all their guilty stains,

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He was wounded for our transgressions,
He was bruised for our iniquities,
The chastisement of our peace was upon Him,
And with His stripes we are heal'd
He was wounded for our transgressions,
He was wounded for our transgressions,
And with His stripes we are heal'd,
With His stripes we are heal'd.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The dying thief rejoic'd to see
That fountain in his day,
And there may I, though vile as he,
Wash all my sins away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He was wounded for our transgressions,
He was bruised for our iniquities,
The chastisement of our peace was upon Him,
And with His stripes we are heal'd
He was wounded for our transgressions,
He was wounded for our transgressions,
And with His stripes we are heal'd,
With His stripes we are heal'd.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou dying Lamb: Thy precious blood
Shall never lose its pow'r,
Till all the ransomed Church of God
Be saved to sin no more.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He was wounded for our transgressions,
He was bruised for our iniquities,
The chastisement of our peace was upon Him,
And with His stripes we are heal'd
He was wounded for our transgressions,
He was wounded for our transgressions,
And with His stripes we are heal'd,
With His stripes we are heal'd.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Then in a nobler, sweeter song,
I'll sing Thy pow'r to save,
When this poor, lisping, stamm'ring tongue
Lies seeing in the grave.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He was wounded for our transgressions,
He was bruised for our iniquities,
The chastisement of our peace was upon Him,
And with His stripes we are heal'd
He was wounded for our transgressions,
He was wounded for our transgressions,
And with His stripes we are heal'd,
With His stripes we are heal'd.

hymns.title: And Can It Be, that I Should Gain?

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: And can it be, that I should gain?
An interest in the Saviour's blood?
Died He for me, who caused His pain?
For me, who Him to death pursued?
Amazing love! how can it be
That thou my God shouldst die for me?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: 'Tis mystery all! The Immortal dies!
Who can explore His strange design?
In vain the first born seraph tries
To sound the depth of love divine!
'Tis mercy all! let earth adore,
Let angel-minds inquire no more.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He left His Father's throne above
So free, so infinite His grace!
Emptied Himself of all but love,
And bled for Adam's helpless race:
'Tis mercy all, immense and free,
For, O my God, it found out me!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Long my imprisoned spirit lay
Fast bound in sin and nature's night;
Thine eye diffused a quickening ray,
I woke the dungeon flamed with light:
My chains fell off, my heart was free,
I rose went forth, and followed Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: No condemnation now I dread,
Jesus, and all in Him, is mine,
Alive in Him, my living Head
And clothed in righteousness divine,
Bold I approach the eternal throne,
And claim the crown, through Christ, my own.

hymns.title: Seeking the Lost, Yes, Kindly Entreating

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Seeking the lost, yes, kindly entreating
Wanderers on the mountain astray,
Come unto "Me" His message repeating
Words of the Master speaking today

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Going afar... upon the mountain
Bringing the wand'rer back again,
Into the fold... of my Redeemer,
Jesus the Lamb for sinners slain, for sinners slain.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Seeking the lost and pointing of Jesus
Soul that are weak, and hearts that are sore
Leading them forth in way of Salvation
Showing the path of life evermore.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Going afar... upon the mountain
Bringing the wand'rer back again,
Into the fold... of my Redeemer,
Jesus the Lamb for sinners slain, for sinners slain.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thus would we go on mission of mercy
Following Christ from day to day
Cheering the faint and raising the fallen
Pointing the lost to Jesus the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Going afar... upon the mountain
Bringing the wand'rer back again,
Into the fold... of my Redeemer,
Jesus the Lamb for sinners slain, for sinners slain.

hymns.title: There's a Stranger at the Door

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's a stranger at the door,
Let Him in;
He has been there oft before,
Let Him in;
Let Him in, ere He is gone,
Let Him in, the Holy One,
Jesus Christ, the Father's Son,
Let Him in.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Open now to Him your heart,
Let Him in;
If you wait He will depart,
Let Him in;
Let Him in, He is your friend,
He your soul will sure defend,
He will keep you to the end,
Let Him in.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Hear you now His loving voice?
Let Him in;
Now, oh, now make Him your choice,
Let Him in;
He is standing at your door,
Joy to you He will restore,
And His name you will adore,
Let Him in.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Now admit the Heavenly Guest,
Let Him in;
He will make for you a feast,
Let Him in;
He will speak your sins forgiven,
And when earth ties all are riven,
He will take you home to heaven,
Let Him in.

hymns.title: Come, Ev'ry Soul by Sin Oppress'd

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, ev'ry soul by sin oppress'd,
There's mer-cy with the Lord,
And He will sure-ly give you rest
By trust-ing in His word.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Only trust Him, only trust Him,
Only trust Him now;
He will save you,
He will save you,
He will save you now.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For Je-sus shed His precious blood,
Rich bless-ings to bestow;
Plunge now in-to the crims-on flood
That wash-es white as snow.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Only trust Him, only trust Him,
Only trust Him now;
He will save you,
He will save you,
He will save you now.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Yes, Je-sus is the Truth, the Way,
That leads you in-to rest;
Be-lieve in Him without de-lay,
And you are ful-ly blest.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Only trust Him, only trust Him,
Only trust Him now;
He will save you,
He will save you,
He will save you now.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Come, then, and join the ho-ly band,
And on to glo-ry go,
To dwell in that ce-les-tial land,
Where joys im-mor-tal flow.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Only trust Him, only trust Him,
Only trust Him now;
He will save you,
He will save you,
He will save you now.

hymns.title: The Great Physician Now Is Near

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The great Physician now is near,
The sympathising Jesus;
He speaks the drooping heart to cheer,
Oh, hear the voice of Jesus.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sweetest note in seraph song
Sweetest name on mortal tongue
Sweetest carol ever sung
Jesus, Blessed Jesus.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Your many sins are all forgiven,
Oh, hear the voice of Jesus;
Go on your way in peace to heaven,
And wear a crown with Jesus.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sweetest note in seraph song
Sweetest name on mortal tongue
Sweetest carol ever sung
Jesus, Blessed Jesus.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: All glory to the dying Lamb!
I now believe in Jesus;
I love the blessed Saviour's name,
I love the name of Jesus.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sweetest note in seraph song
Sweetest name on mortal tongue
Sweetest carol ever sung
Jesus, Blessed Jesus.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: His name dispels my guilt and fear,
No other name but Jesus
Oh! how my soul delights to hear
The precious name of Jesus.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sweetest note in seraph song
Sweetest name on mortal tongue
Sweetest carol ever sung
Jesus, Blessed Jesus.

hymns.title: God Loved the World of Sinners Lost

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God loved the world of sinners lost
And ruined by the fall
Salvation full, at highest cost,
He offers free to all.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, 'twas love, 'twas wondrous love!
The love of God to me;
It brought my Saviour from above,
To die on Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Eternal praises, Lord, to Thee,
Thou blessed Son of God;
For Thy deep love in cleansing me,
In Thy most precious blood.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, 'twas love, 'twas wondrous love!
The love of God to me;
It brought my Saviour from above,
To die on Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Love brings the glorious fulness in
And to His saints makes known
The blessed rest from inbred sin
Through faith in Christ alone.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, 'twas love, 'twas wondrous love!
The love of God to me;
It brought my Saviour from above,
To die on Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Believing souls, rejoicing go;
There shall to you be given
A glorious foretaste, here below,
Of endless life in heaven.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, 'twas love, 'twas wondrous love!
The love of God to me;
It brought my Saviour from above,
To die on Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Of victory now o'er Satan's power
Let all the ransomed sing,
And triumph in the dying hour
Through Christ the Lord, our King.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, 'twas love, 'twas wondrous love!
The love of God to me;
It brought my Saviour from above,
To die on Calvary.

hymns.title: I Love to Tell the Story

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I love to tell the story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love.
I love to tell the story,
Because I know 'tis true;
It satisfies my longings
As nothing else would do.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I love to tell the story,
More wonderful it seems
Than all the golden fancies
Of all our golden dreams,
I love to tell the story,
It did so much for me;
And that is just the reason
I tell it now to thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I love to tell the story,
'Tis pleasant to repeat
What seems, each time I tell it,
More wonderfully sweet.
I love to tell the story,
For some have never heard
The message of salvation
From God's own holy Word.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I love to tell the story,
For those who know it best
Seem hungering and thirsting
To hear it like the rest.
And when, in scenes of glory,
I sing the new, new song,
'Twill be the old, old story
That I have loved so long.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.

hymns.title: For My Sake and the Gospel's Go

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "For my sake and the Gospel's go
And tell Redemption's story;"
His heralds answer, "Be it so,
And Thine, Lord, all the glory!"
They preach His birth, His life, His cross,
The love of His atonement,
For whom they count the world but loss
His Easter, His enthronement.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Hark, hark, the trump of Jubilee
Proclaims to every nation,
From pole to pole, by land and sea,
Glad tidings of salvation:
As nearer draws the day of doom,
While still the battle rages,
The heavenly Dayspring, through the gloom
Breaks on the night of ages.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Still on and on the anthems spread
Of Hallelujah voices,
In concert with the holy dead
The warrior church rejoices;
Their snow-white robes are wash'd in blood,
Their golden harps are ringing;
Earth, and the Paradise of God,
One triumph song are singing.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He comes, whose Advent Trumpet drowns
The last of time's evangels-
Emmanuel crowned with many crowns,
The Lord of saints and angels:
O Life, Light, Love, the great I am,
Triune, who changest never;
The Throne of God and of the Lamb
Is Thine, and Thine for ever!

hymns.title: Hark! 'Tis the Shepherd's Voice

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hark! 'tis the shepherd's voice I hear,
Out in the desert dark and drear,
Calling the sheep who've gone astray,
Far from the shepherd's fold away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring them in from the fields of sin;
Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring the wandering ones to Jesus.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Who'll go and help this shepherd kind,
Help Him the wandering ones to find ?
Who'll bring the lost ones to the fold,
Where they'll be sheltered from the cold.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring them in from the fields of sin;
Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring the wandering ones to Jesus.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Out in the desert hear their cry,
Out on the mountain wild and high;
Hark! 'tis the Master speak to thee,
"Go, find My sheep where' er they be.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring them in from the fields of sin;
Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring the wandering ones to Jesus.

hymns.title: I Am Happy Today and the Sun Shines Bright

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I am happy today and the sun shines bright,
The clouds have been rolled away;
For the Saviour said, whosoever will
May come with Him to stay (to stay).

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Whosoever, surely meaneth me,
Surely meaneth me, O surely meaneth me;
Whosoever, surely meaneth me,
Whosoever, meaneth me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All my hopes have been rais'd, O His name be praised,
His glory has filled my soul;
I've been lifted up, and from sin set free,
His blood has made me whole (me whole).

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Whosoever, surely meaneth me,
Surely meaneth me, O surely meaneth me;
Whosoever, surely meaneth me,
Whosoever, meaneth me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O what wonderful love, O what grace divine,
That Jesus should die for me;
I was lost in sin, for the world I pined,
But now I am set free (set free).

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Whosoever, surely meaneth me,
Surely meaneth me, O surely meaneth me;
Whosoever, surely meaneth me,
Whosoever, meaneth me.

hymns.title: Go and Tell of the Glad Tidings

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Go and tell of the glad tidings,
Make all the world to hear the news,
Who hears and believes shall be saved,
Those who refuse shall be condemned.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I'll reveal to you great mysteries,
Ye shall show forth my word of truth
In all the works that I have done,
And the miracles ye shall do.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Go heal the sick and raise the dead,
In my great name cast out demons,
Let not my prophet ever fear,
Though Jews and Gentiles should deride.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Teach all the world my commandments
And lo, I am with you always;
To me belong all pow'r and might
I can kill and can make alive.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: A light encircled Him around;
He ascended in great glory,
The news was proclaim'd far and near
The ascension of our Saviour.

hymns.title: A Ruler Once Came to Jesus by Night

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: A Ruler once came to Jesus by night,
To ask Him the way of salvation and light;
The Master made answer in words true and plain,
"Ye must be born again!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Ye must be born again!"
"Ye must be born again!"
I verily, verily say unto you:
"Ye must be born again!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Ye children of men attend to the word,
So solemnly uttered by Jesus, the Lord
And let not this message to you be in vain
"Ye must be born again!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Ye must be born again!"
"Ye must be born again!"
I verily, verily say unto you:
"Ye must be born again!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O ye who would enter the glorious rest,
And sing with the ransomed the song of the blest;
The life everlasting if ye would obtain
"Ye must be born again!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Ye must be born again!"
"Ye must be born again!"
I verily, verily say unto you:
"Ye must be born again!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: A dear one in heaven thy heart yearns to see,
At the beautiful gates may be watching for thee;
Then list to the note of this solemn refrain,
"Ye must be born again!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Ye must be born again!"
"Ye must be born again!"
I verily, verily say unto you:
"Ye must be born again!

hymns.title: Blow Ye the Trumpet, Blow

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Blow ye the trumpet, blow,
The gladly solemn sound:
Let all the nations know,
To earth's remotest bound,
The year of Jubilee is come:
Return ye ransom'd sinners, home.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Extol the Lamb of God
The all-atoning Lamb;
Redemption by His blood
Throughtout the world proclaim
The year of Jubilee is come:
Return ye ransom'd sinners, home.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Ye, who have sold for nought
Your heritage above
Receive it back unbought,
The gift of Jesus' love
The year of Jubilee is come:
Return ye ransom'd sinners, home.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus, our great High Priest,
Hath full atonement made;
Ye weary spirits, rest
Ye mournful souls be glad
The year of Jubilee is come:
Return ye ransom'd sinners, home.

hymns.title: Thy Kingdom Come, O God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thy kingdom come, O God,
Thy rule, O Christ, begin;
Break with Thine iron rod
The tyrannies of sin.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Where is Thy reign of peace
And purity, and love?
When shall all hatred cease
As in the realms above?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When comes the promised time
That war shall be no more,
And lust, oppression, crime,
Shall flee Thy face before?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: We pray Thee, Lord, arise,
And come in Thy great might;
Revive our longing eyes,
Which languish for Thy sight.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Men scorn Thy sacred Name,
And wolves devour Thy fold;
By many deeds of shame
We learn that love grows cold.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: O'er heathen lands afar
Thick darkness broodeth yet;
Arise, O Morning Star,
Arise, and never set.

hymns.title: Tell It Out Among the Nations that the Lord Is King

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Tell it out among the nations that the Lord is King;
Tell it out! Tell it out!
Tell it out among the nations, bid them shout and sing;
Tell it out! Tell it out!
Tell it out with adoration that He shall increase,
That the mighty King of Glory is the King of Peace;
Tell it out with jubilation, let the song ne'er cease;
Tell it out! Tell it out!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Tell it out among the people that the Saviour reigns;
Tell it out! Tell it out!
Tell it out among the heathen, bid them break their chains;
Tell it out! Tell it out!
Tell it out among the weeping ones that Jesus lives,
Tell it out among the weary ones what rest He gives;
Tell it out among the sinners that He came to save;
Tell it out! Tell it out!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Tell it out among the people Jesus reigns above;
Tell it out among the nations, that His reign is love;
Tell it out! Tell it out!
Tell it out among the highways and the lanes at home,
Let it ring across the mountains and the ocean's foam,
That the weary, heavy laden, need no longer roam;
Tell it out! Tell it out!

hymns.title: Hark! The Swelling Breezes Rising From Afar

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hark! the swelling breezes rising from afar,
Brings the sounds of conflict from the holy war,
God is with our armies, He the word has giv'n.
He is watching o'er you, messengers of heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Go, thou mighty Gospel, conq'ering on the way;
Night upon the mountains changes into day;
Idols bow before thee, heathen temples fall;
Soon the world shall own the victor over all.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O Thou blessed Saviour reigning now on high,
May Thy faithful soldiers find Thee ever nigh,
Bid the glorious mission speed from sea to sea.
Till the whole creation worship only Thee.

hymns.title: In the Misty Days of Yore

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: In the misty days of yore,
Jesus' precious blood had power;
E'en the thief upon the Cross to save;
Like a bird his spirit flies to its home in Paradise,
Thro' the power of Calv'ry's crimson wave.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: And the blood has never lost its pow'r
No, never; no never;
Jesus' blood avails for sin for ever,
And will never lose it's pow'r.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I was lost and steep'd in guilt,
But the blood for sinners spilt
Washed away my sins and set me free;
Now and evermore the same,
Praise, Oh, praise His holy name!
Will the cleansing stream availing be.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: And the blood has never lost its pow'r
No, never; no never;
Jesus' blood avails for sin for ever,
And will never lose it's pow'r.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: God in mercy asks you why,
Brother sinner, will you die,
When such full redemption He provides?
You have but to look and live, life eternal He will give,
For the pow'r of Calv'ry still abides.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: And the blood has never lost its pow'r
No, never; no never;
Jesus' blood avails for sin for ever,
And will never lose it's pow'r.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Bring your burdens, come today, turn from all your sins away,
He can fully save and sanctify;
From the wrath to come now flee, let your name recorded be
With the blood wash'd and redeem'd on high.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: And the blood has never lost its pow'r
No, never; no never;
Jesus' blood avails for sin for ever,
And will never lose it's pow'r.

hymns.title: Beautiful Words of Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Beautiful words of Jesus,
Spoken so long ago,
Yet as we sing them over,
Dearer to us they grow,
Calling the heavy laden,
Calling to hearts oppressed,
"Come unto Me, ye weary,
Come, I will give you rest".

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hear the call of His voice so sweet;
Bring your load to the Saviour's feet;
Lean your hearts on His loving breast
Come, O come, and He will give you rest.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Beautiful words of Jesus,
Cheering us, day by day;
Throwing a gleam of sunshine
Over a cloudy way:
Casting on Him the burden
We are too weak to bear,
He will give grace sufficient,
He will regard our prayer.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hear the call of His voice so sweet;
Bring your load to the Saviour's feet;
Lean your hearts on His loving breast
Come, O come, and He will give you rest.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Beautiful words of Jesus,
Tokens of endless rest,
When, by and by, we enter
Into His presence blest;
There shall we see His beauty,
Meet with Him face to face;
There shall we sing His glory,
Praising His matchless grace.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hear the call of His voice so sweet;
Bring your load to the Saviour's feet;
Lean your hearts on His loving breast
Come, O come, and He will give you rest.

hymns.title: Have You Been to Jesus for the Cleansing Power?

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Have you been to Jesus for the cleansing power?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you fully trusting in His grace this hour?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Are you washed in the blood
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Are you walking daily by the Saviour's side?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Do you rest each moment in the Crucified?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Are you washed in the blood
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When the Bridegroom cometh will your robes be white?
Pure and white in the blood of the Lamb?
Will your soul be ready for the mansions bright,
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Are you washed in the blood
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lay aside the garments that are stained with sin,
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb;
There's a fountain flowing for the soul unclean,
Oh be washed in the blood of the Lamb.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Are you washed in the blood
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

hymns.title: Lord, I Hear of Show'rs of Blessing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord, I hear of show'rs of blessing,
Thou art scatt'ring full and free
Show'rs the thirsty land refreshing,
Let some drops now fall on me,
Even me. Even me,
Let some drops now fall on me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Pass me not, O God, my Father,
Sinful though my heart may be,
Thou might'st leave me, but the rather,
Let Thy mercy light on me,
Even me. Even me,
Let Thy mercy light on me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Pass me not, O mighty Spirit,
Thou canst make the blind to see,
Witnesser of Jesus' merit
Speak the word of pow'r to me,
Even me. Even me,
Speak the word of pow'r to me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Love of God, so pure and changeless,
Blood of Christ, so rich and free,
Grace of God, so rich and boundless,
Magnify it all in me,
Even me. Even me,
Magnify it all in me.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Pass me not, Thy lost one bringing;
Bind my heart, O Lord, to Thee,
Whilst the streams of life are springing,
Blessing others, oh bless me!
Even me. Even me,
Blessing others, oh bless me.

hymns.title: Rock of Ages, Cleft for Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee!
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy riven side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure;
Cleanse me from its guilt and power.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Not the labours of my hands,
Can fulfill Thy law's demands;
Could my zeal no respite know,
Could my tears for ever flow,
All for sin could not atone,
Thou must save and Thou alone.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Nothing in my hand I bring,
Simply to Thy cross I cling
Naked, come to Thee for dress,
Helpless, look to Thee for grace,
Foul, I to the fountain fly
Wash me, Saviour, or I die.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: While I draw this fleeting breath,
When my eyelids close in death,
When I soar to worlds unknown,
See Thee on Thy judgement throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

hymns.title: There's a Call Comes Ringing O'er the Restless Wave

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's a call comes ringing o'er the restless wave,
Send the light! Send the light!
There are souls to rescue, There are souls to save,
Send the light! Send the light

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Send the light! the blessed gospel light
Let it shine from shore to shore!
Send the light! and let its radiant beams
Light the world for ever more.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We have heard the Macedonian call today,
Send the light! Send the light!
And a golden offering at the cross we lay,
Send the light! Send the light!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Send the light! the blessed gospel light
Let it shine from shore to shore!
Send the light! and let its radiant beams
Light the world for ever more.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let us pray that grace may everywhere abound,
Send the light! Send the light!
And a Christlike spirit everywhere be found,
Send the light! Send the light!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Send the light! the blessed gospel light
Let it shine from shore to shore!
Send the light! and let its radiant beams
Light the world for ever more.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Let us not grow weary in the work of love,
Send the light! Send the light!
Let us gather jewels for a crown above,
Send the light! Send the light!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Send the light! the blessed gospel light
Let it shine from shore to shore!
Send the light! and let its radiant beams
Light the world for ever more.

hymns.title: I'm Revived, My Soul Is at Rest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I'm revived, my soul is at rest
When I know my Saviour
All my sins, He has forgiven
Glory be to the Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: One day we shall reach heav'n above.
And all problems shall cease
No more sorrow to molest us
We shall rejoice always.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: E'en tho' I inherit the world
It's vanity to me
The uncorruptible treasures
Awaits me in the high.

hymns.title: Where Will You Spend Eternity?

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Where will you spend eternity?
This question comes to you and me!
Tell me, what shall your answer be
Where will you spend eternity?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Many are choosing Christ to-day,
Turning from all their sins away;
Heaven shall their happy portion be:
Where will you spend eternity?.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Leaving the strait and narrow way,
Going the downward road to-day,
Sad will the final ending be
Lost through a long eternity!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Repent, believe this very hour,
Trust in the Saviour's grace and power;
Then shall your joyous answer be,
Saved through a long eternity!

hymns.title: O What a Wonderful Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O What a wonderful Saviour,
In Jesus my Lord I have found,
Though I had sins without number,
His grace unto me did abound.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: His grace aboundeth more,
His grace aboundeth more,
Tho' sin aboundeth in my heart,
His grace aboundeth more

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When a poor sinner He found me,
No goodness to offer had I;
Often His law I had broken,
And merited naught but to die.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: His grace aboundeth more,
His grace aboundeth more,
Tho' sin aboundeth in my heart,
His grace aboundeth more

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Nothing of merit possessing,
All helpless before Him Iay ,
But in the precious blood flowing
He washed all my sin-stains away

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: His grace aboundeth more,
His grace aboundeth more,
Tho' sin aboundeth in my heart,
His grace aboundeth more

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In Him my gracious Redeemer,
My Prophet, my Priest and my King;
Mercy I find and forgiveness,
My all to His Keeping I bring.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: His grace aboundeth more,
His grace aboundeth more,
Tho' sin aboundeth in my heart,
His grace aboundeth more

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: How can I keep from rejoicing?
I'll sing of the joy in my soul;
Praising the love of my Saviour,
While years of eternity roll.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: His grace aboundeth more,
His grace aboundeth more,
Tho' sin aboundeth in my heart,
His grace aboundeth more

hymns.title: Hark! The Gospel News Is Sounding

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hark! the Gospel news is sounding,
Christ has suffer'd on the tree;
Streams of mercy are abounding,
Grace for all is reach and free.
Now, poor sinner, Now, poor sinner,
Come to Him who died for thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh! escape to yonder mountain,
Refuge find in Him today;
Christ invites you to the fountain,
Come and wash your sins away;
Do not tarry, Do not tarry,
Come to Jesus while you may.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Grace is flowing like a river,
Millions there have been supplied;
Still it flows as fresh as ever
From the Saviour's wounded side;
No need perish, No need perish,
All may live, for Christ hath died.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Christ alone shall be our portion;
Soon we hope to meet above;
Then we'll bathe in the full ocean
Of the great Redeemer's love;
All His fullness, All His fullness,
We shall then forever prove.

hymns.title: Years I Spent in Vanity and Pride

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Years I spent in vanity and pride,
Caring not my Lord was crucified,
Knowing not it was for me He died
On Calvary.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Mercy there was great and grace was free,
Pardon there was multiplied to me,
There my burdened soul found liberty,
At Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: By God's Word at last my sin I learned,
Then I trembl'd at the law I'd spurned,
Till my guilty soul, imploring turned
To Calvary.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Mercy there was great and grace was free,
Pardon there was multiplied to me,
There my burdened soul found liberty,
At Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Now I've given to Jesus everything,
Now I gladly own Him as my King,
Now my raptured soul can only sing
Of Calvary.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Mercy there was great and grace was free,
Pardon there was multiplied to me,
There my burdened soul found liberty,
At Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh! the love that drew salvation's plan,
Oh! the grace that brought it down to man,
Oh! the mighty gulf that God did span
At Calvary.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Mercy there was great and grace was free,
Pardon there was multiplied to me,
There my burdened soul found liberty,
At Calvary.

hymns.title: Just as I Am, Thine Own to Be

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Just as I am, Thine own to be,
Friend of the young, who lovest me,
To consecrate myself to Thee,
O Jesus Christ, I come.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In the glad morning of my day,
My life to give, my vows to pay,
With no reserve, and no delay,
With all my heart, I come.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I would live ever in the light,
I would work ever for the right,
I would serve Thee with all my might
Therefore to Thee I come.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Just as I am, young, strong and free,
To be the best that I can be,
For truth, and righteousness, and Thee,
Lord of my life I come.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And for Thy sake to win renown,
And then to take the victor's crown,
And at Thy feet to lay it down,
O Master, Lord I come.

hymns.title: Sinners Jesus Will Receive

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Sinners Jesus will receive!
Sound this word of grace to all
Who the heav'nly pathway leave,
All who linger, all who fall!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sing it o'er and o'er again,
Christ receiveth sinful men;
Make the message clear and plain:
Christ receiveth sinful men.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Come: and He will give you rest;
Trust Him; for His word is plain;
He will take the sinfulest;
Christ receiveth sinful men.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sing it o'er and o'er again,
Christ receiveth sinful men;
Make the message clear and plain:
Christ receiveth sinful men.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Now my heart condemns me not,
Pure before the law I stand;
He who cleansed me from all spot
Satisfied its last demand.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sing it o'er and o'er again,
Christ receiveth sinful men;
Make the message clear and plain:
Christ receiveth sinful men.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Christ receiveth sinful men,
Even me with all my sin;
Purged from ev'ry spot and stain,
Heav'n with Him I enter in.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sing it o'er and o'er again,
Christ receiveth sinful men;
Make the message clear and plain:
Christ receiveth sinful men.

hymns.title: Jesus only Is Our Message

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus only is our Message
Jesus all our theme shall be,
We will lift up Jesus ever,
Jesus only we will see.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus only, Jesus ever,
Jesus all in all we sing;
Saviour, Sanctifier, Healer,
Glorious Lord and coming King.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus only is our Saviour,
All our guilt He bore away,
All our righteousness He gives us,
All our strength from day to day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus only, Jesus ever,
Jesus all in all we sing;
Saviour, Sanctifier, Healer,
Glorious Lord and coming King.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus is our Sanctifier,
Cleansing us from self and sin,
And with all His Spirit's fullness,
Filling all our hearts within.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus only, Jesus ever,
Jesus all in all we sing;
Saviour, Sanctifier, Healer,
Glorious Lord and coming King.
