pairs: Suffer a sinner whose heart over flows
Loving his Saviour to tell what he knows
Once more to tell it would I embrace
I'm only a sinner saved by grace.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Only a sinner saved by grace
Only a sinner saved by grace
This is my story
To God be the glory
I'm only a sinner saved by grace.

hymns.title: Come, O Thou All-Victorious Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, O Thou all-victorious Lord,
Thy pow'r to us make known;
Strike with the hammer of Thy word,
And break these hearts of stone.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O that we all might now begin,
Our foolishness to mourn,
And turn at once from every sin,
And to our Saviour turn!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Give us ourselves and Thee to know,
In this our gracious day;
Repentance unto life bestow,
And take our sins away.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Conclude us first in unbelief,
And freely then release
Fill every soul with sacred grief,
And then with sacred peace.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Improv'rish, Lord, and then relieve,
And then enrich the poor;
The knowledge of our sickness give,
The knowledge of our cure.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: That blessed sense of guilt impart
And then remove the load;
Trouble, and wash the troubled heart
In the atoning blood.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Our desp'rate state through sin declare,
And speak our sins forgiv'n;
By perfect holiness prepare,
And take us up to heav'n.

hymns.title: Loving Saviour, Hear My Cry

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Loving Saviour, Hear my cry,
Hear my cry, hear my cry;
Trembling to Thine arms I fly:
O save me at the cross!
I have sinn'd but Thou hast died,
Thou hast died, Thou hast died,
In Thy mercy let me hide;
O save me at the cross!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lord Jesus, receive me,
No more would I grieve Thee,
Now, blessed Redeemer,
O save me at the Cross!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Tho' I perish I will pray,
I will pray I will pray;
Thou of life the Living way;
O save me at the cross!
Thou last said Thy grace is free,
Grase is free, grace is free,
Have compassion, Lord on me;
O save me at the cross!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lord Jesus, receive me,
No more would I grieve Thee,
Now, blessed Redeemer,
O save me at the Cross!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Wash me in Thy cleansing Blood,
Cleansing blood, cleansing blood;
Plunge me now beneath the flood:
O save me at the cross!
Only faith will pardon bring;
In that faith to Thee I cling;
O save me at the cross!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lord Jesus, receive me,
No more would I grieve Thee,
Now, blessed Redeemer,
O save me at the Cross!

hymns.title: Jesus, My Lord, to Thee I Cry

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, my Lord, to Thee I cry,
Unless Thou help me, I must die;
Oh, bring Thy free salvation nigh,
And take me as I am!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: And take me as I am!
And take me as I am!
My only plea- Christ died for me!
Oh take me as I am!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Helpless I am, and full of guilt;
But yet for me Thy blood was split,
And thou canst make me what Thou wilt,
And take me as I am!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: And take me as I am!
And take me as I am!
My only plea- Christ died for me!
Oh take me as I am!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: No preparation can I make;
My best resolves I only break
Yet save me for Thine own name's sake,
And take me as I am!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: And take me as I am!
And take me as I am!
My only plea- Christ died for me!
Oh take me as I am!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Behold me, Saviour, at Thy feet,
Deal with me as Thou see-est meet;
Thy work begin, Thy work complete,
But take me as I am!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: And take me as I am!
And take me as I am!
My only plea- Christ died for me!
Oh take me as I am!

hymns.title: Sinful, Sighing to Be Blest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Sinful, sighing to be blest,
Bound, and longing to be free;
Weary, waiting for my rest;
God be merciful to me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Goodness I have none to plead;
Sinfulness in all I see,
I can only bring my need;
God be merciful to me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Broken heart and downcast eyes
Dare not lift themselves to Thee;
Yet Thou canst interpret sighs
God be merciful to me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: From this sinful heart of mine,
To Thy bosom I would flee;
I am not my own but Thine,
God be merciful to me.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: There is One beside the Throne,
And my only hope and plea;
Are in Him, and Him alone:
God be merciful to me.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: He my cause will undertake,
My interpreter will be,
He's my all and for His sake;
God be merciful to me.

hymns.title: Jesus, the Sinner's Friend, to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, the sinner's Friend, to Thee,
Lost and undone, for aid I flee,
Weary of earth, myself, and sin;
Open Thine arms, and take me in!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Pity, and heal my sin-sick soul;
'Tis Thou alone canst make me whole;
Fallen, till'n me Thine image shine,
And cursed I am, till Thou art mine.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The mansion for Thyself prepare,
Dispose my heart by ent'ring there;
'Tis this alone can make me clean,
'Tis this alone can cast out sin.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: At last I own it cannot be,
That I should it myself for Thee:
Here then to Thee I all resign;
Thine is the work and only Thine.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: What shall I say Thy grace to move?
Lord, I am sin, but Thou art love:
I give up every plea beside-
Lord, I am lost, but Thou hast died!

hymns.title: Once I Was Far 'Way From the Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Once I was far 'way from the Lord,
I frustrate Him with my manners
But now Jesus hath sav'd me

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, how sweet shall it be
Sweet oh sweet it shall be
Oh, how sweet shall it be
For Jesus to dwell within me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Now indignation and anger
Satan now bound me with its chain
Jesus had now cut the chain.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, how sweet shall it be
Sweet oh sweet it shall be
Oh, how sweet shall it be
For Jesus to dwell within me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Lusts of the world now fill'd my hearts
And all sorts of arrogancy
Now all burnt by spirit's fire.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, how sweet shall it be
Sweet oh sweet it shall be
Oh, how sweet shall it be
For Jesus to dwell within me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Now I am free from depression
From all sorts of lukewarmness
Oh praise Jehovah with me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, how sweet shall it be
Sweet oh sweet it shall be
Oh, how sweet shall it be
For Jesus to dwell within me.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: I am singing just everyday
In happiness I jump and dance
It's by the Spiritual pow'r.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, how sweet shall it be
Sweet oh sweet it shall be
Oh, how sweet shall it be
For Jesus to dwell within me.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Thy precious blood now cleanseth me
The water of life in me flow
My salvation now is full.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, how sweet shall it be
Sweet oh sweet it shall be
Oh, how sweet shall it be
For Jesus to dwell within me.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: All ye my brothers and friends
Who dare this deliverance neglect?
To Him salvation is free.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, how sweet shall it be
Sweet oh sweet it shall be
Oh, how sweet shall it be
For Jesus to dwell within me.

hymns.title: He Gave Me a Ransom

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: He gave me a ransom
Of all the debts I owe
As He gave me a smile He beamed
Saying "Don't forget Me"

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He gave me a ransom
He paid the debts I owe
As He gave me a smile He beamed
Saying "Remember Me"

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The ransom I would keep
Though the debts is rid off
It tells the love of him who paid
The debts on my behalf

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I behold and I smiled
I look again, I wept
His love's testimony for me
For aye I'll cherish it

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: 'Tis no more a ransom
But it's a remembrance
That all the burden of my debts
Emmanuel ransomed

hymns.title: Jesus, We Lift Our Souls to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, we lift our souls to Thee,
Thy Holy Spirit breathe;
And let these little infants be
Baptized into Thy death.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh let Thine unction on them rest
Thy grace their souls renew;
And write within their tender breast,
Thy name and nature too.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thy faithful servants let them prove
Girded with truth divine;
Be sharers in Thy dying love,
And followers of Thine.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lord, plant us all into Thy death,
That we Thy life may prove;
Partakers of Thy cross beneath,
And of Thy crown above.

hymns.title: Almighty, God of Heav'n and Earth

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Almighty, God of heav'n and earth
Jesus the Son, that became flesh,
Holy Spirit, for all our care
Hear us and receive all our vows.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We accept Thee, Thou who art slain
Thou who ascended up to heav'n
With Thee, we are dead unto sin,
Our hearts would be raised up with Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We want to believe Thy gospel
We go, and Thy hand leads us on;
At Jordan, we seek for the way
That Thy own disciples have trod.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: By baptism a great token
We surrender ourselves to Thee;
Put Thy seal on the covenant,
And make us forever Thine own.

hymns.title: Stand, Soldier of the Cross

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Stand, soldier of the Cross,
Thy high allegiance claim,
And vow to hold the world but loss
For thy Redeemer's name.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Arise, and be baptized,
And wash thy sins away;
Thy league with God be solemnized,
Thy faith avouched today.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: No more thine own, but Christ's
With all the saints of old,
Apostles, seers, evangelists,
And martyr throngs enrolled.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In God's whole armour strong,
From hell's embattled powers,
The warfare may be sharp and long
The victory must be ours.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: O bright the conqueror's crown,
The song of triumph sweet,
When faith casts every trophy down
At our great Captain's feet!

hymns.title: Jesus Who Came Down to Save

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus who came down to save,
Went down to River Jordan,
He came out from the water
And we know Him as God's Son,
Through the Father's voice from heav'n.
And the descent of the dove
Jesus Christ, my great guide Thou
I would be baptized like Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In the garden, where He prayed
Grief o'er flow'd Him like a flood,
On the cross of Calvary
There, the Saviour died for me,
Nail'd together with the Lord
My hope is that, Jesus died;
I have my place by His feet,
I suffer all things for Him.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: In a new tomb was He laid
He, the fear and dread removed,
He, the stone grave could not hold
And was glorified for aye;
I would be buried with Christ,
As th' ordinance I partake,
As I'm raised from the water
A new life with God to live.

hymns.title: The Voice that Sound in Desert

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The voice that sound in desert
Its the voice of watchman
Hark as the voice now calling
Calling for repentance
The voice as it was sounding
Art thou not now concern'd
And why, O brothers, sisters
Do you feel unconcern'd.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The Kingdom is now at hand
The Kingdom of our Lord
And those that wash their garments
Shall sit on royal throne,
Why do you feel unconcern'd?
To the voice of watchman?
Which sound new to thee clearly
Seeking for repentance.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The Abner and Pharpar stream
They may be clean water
But the command of cleans is in river Jordan
Throw all thy thoughts to one side
And do the will of God
Now descend into this stream
And wash and be thou clean.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: What's now keeping you waiting?
What can be your excuse?
Behold the stream and Thy John
All things are now ready
You have argued for long time
Will you die with spirit?
Sinners hear the watchman's voice
And come to repentance.

hymns.title: We Are Baptized Unto His Death

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We are baptized unto His death
By water baptism
And we go down into the grave,
Buried with Jesus Christ.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Buried with Christ to sin no more
That we may rise with Him,
That we may partake of new grace
That fits us for the skies.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O Holy Ghost, come unto us
That all our words may be
The hope of His soon appearing,
And Christ's revelation.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lord, let our faith be glorified,
Our joy and crown fulfil;
To live a life of heav'n on earth,
On high, to reign with Thee.

hymns.title: Rejoice, the Lord Is King!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Rejoice, the Lord is King!
Your Lord and King adore;
Mortals, give thanks, and sing,
And triumph evermore;
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice, again I say, Rejoice.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus the Saviour reigns
The God of truth and love;
When He had purg'd our stains,
He took His seat above:
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice, again I say, Rejoice.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He sits at God's right hand,
Till at His foes submit
And bow to His command,
And fall beneath His feet:
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice, again I say, Rejoice.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Rejoice in glorious hope;
Jesus the Judge shall come,
And take His servants up
To their eternal home:
We soon shall hear the archangel's voice
The trump of God shall sound, Rejoice.

hymns.title: Jesus Whom God Hath Exalted

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus whom God hath exalted,
From foundation of the world,
The same Jesus will soon come back,
To judge the quick and the dread.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Behold, Jesus will surely come,
Shall we not prepare for Him?
Then full salvation we shall have
On that great and glorious day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus will appear in the sky,
All the eyes shall there see Him,
And those that nail'd Him on the cross
All people shall give account.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Now with faith, I can boldly say,
That I'll go up with my Lord,
With Him to reign for thousand years,
And at eternity too.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: But others would not be able,
With the Lord, go to the sky,
Because their works has no reward,
Which were done while here on earth.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: We are waiting for Thy coming,
Thou who art the hope of world,
Come Thou Lord, Jesus our Saviour
All our sorrows cease to be.

hymns.title: O God of Bethel, by Whose Hand

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O God of Bethel, by whose hand,
Thy people still are fed
Who through this weary pilgrimage
Hast all our Fathers led.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Our vows, our prayers we now present
Before Thy throne of grace
God of our fathers, be the God
Of their succeeding race.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Through each perplexing path of life
Our wand'ring footsteps guide
Give us, each day, our daily bread
And raiment fit provide.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O spread thy covering wings around,
Till all our wand'rings cease
And at our Father's loved abode
Our souls arrive in peace.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Such blessings from Thy gracious hand
Our humble prayers implore
And Thou shalt be our chosen God
And portion evermore.

hymns.title: My Times Are in Thy Hand

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My times are in Thy hand
My God, I wish them there
My life, my friends my soul I leave
Entirely to Thy care.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: My times are in Thy hand
Whatever they may be
Pleasing or painful, dark or bright
As best may seem to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My times are in Thy hand
Why should I doubt or fear?
A father's hand will never cause
His child a needless tear.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: My times are in Thy hand
Jesus, the crucified
The hands my cruel sins had pierced
Are now my guard and guide.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: My times are in Thy hand
I'll always trust in Thee
And after death, at Thy right hand
I shall for ever be.

hymns.title: The Master Hath Come, and He Calls Us to Follow

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The Master hath come, and He calls us to follow
The track of the footprints He leaves on our way;
Far over the mountain, and through the deep hollow,
The path leads us on to the mansions of day.
The Master hath called us, the children who fear Him,
Who march 'neath Christ's banner, His own little band;
We love Him, and seek Him, we long to be near Him,
And rest in the light of His beautiful land.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The Master hath called us; The road may be dreary,
And dangers and sorrows are strewn on the track;
But God's Holy Spirit shall comfort the weary
We follow the Saviour, and cannot turn back.
The Master hath called us: though doubt and temptation
May compass our journey, we cheerfully sing,
"Press onward, look onward," through much tribulation
The children of Zion must follow their King.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The Master hath called us; in life's early morning
With spirits as fresh as the dew on the sod;
We turn from the world, with its smiles and its scorning,
To cast in our lot with the people of God.
The Master hath called us, His sons and His daughters,
We plead for His blessing, and trust in His love;
And through the green pastures, beside the still waters,
He'll lead us at last to His kingdom above.

hymns.title: Sound the Battle Cry! See! The Foe Is Nigh

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Sound the battle cry! see! the foe is nigh;
Raise the standard high for the Lord;
Gird your armour on, Stand firm ev'ry one;
Rest your cause upon His holy word.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rouse, then, soldier! rally round the banner!
Ready, steady, pass the word along;
Onward, forward, shout aloud Hosanna!
Christ is Captain of the mighty throng.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Strong to meet the foe, Marching on we go,
While our cause we know must prevail;
Shield and banner bright,
Gleaming in the light;
Battling for the right, We ne'er can fail.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rouse, then, soldier! rally round the banner!
Ready, steady, pass the word along;
Onward, forward, shout aloud Hosanna!
Christ is Captain of the mighty throng.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh! Thou God of all, Hear us when we call;
Help us one and all, By Thy grace;
When the battle's done,
And the vict'ry won,
May we wear the crown before Thy face.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rouse, then, soldier! rally round the banner!
Ready, steady, pass the word along;
Onward, forward, shout aloud Hosanna!
Christ is Captain of the mighty throng.

hymns.title: Peace Like a River Is Flooding My Soul

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Peace like a river is flooding my soul,
Since Christ my Saviour, maketh me whole;
Sweet peace abiding my portion shall be
Jesus, my Saviour, is precious to me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Precious to me, Precious is He
Jesus shall ever be precious to me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Joy is abounding-my heart gaily sings
Cleave I the heavens, mount up on wings
Christ hath exalted, my soul He set free
Jesus, my Saviour, is precious to me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Precious to me, Precious is He
Jesus shall ever be precious to me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh, precious Jesus, how lovely Thou art
Come and abiding rule in my heart
Break ev'ry fetter, Thy face let me see
Then thou shalt ever be precious to me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Precious to me, Precious is He
Jesus shall ever be precious to me.

hymns.title: My Soul Is so Ha-Ppy in Je-Sus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My soul is so ha-ppy in Je-sus,
For He is so precious to me;
His voice it is music to hear it;
His face it is hea-ven to see.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am happy in Him
I am happy in Him,
My soul will delight,
He fills me day and night
I am happy in Him.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He sought me so long ere I knew Him,
When wand-ring afar from the fold;
Safe home in His arms he hath brought me,
To where there are pleasure un-told.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am happy in Him
I am happy in Him,
My soul will delight,
He fills me day and night
I am happy in Him.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: His love and His mer-cy surround me,
His grace like a riv-er doth flow;
His Spirit, to guide and to comfort,
Is with me wherever I go.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am happy in Him
I am happy in Him,
My soul will delight,
He fills me day and night
I am happy in Him.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: They say I shall someday be like Him,
My cross and my burden lay down;
Till then I will ever be faithful.
In gathering gems for his crown.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am happy in Him
I am happy in Him,
My soul will delight,
He fills me day and night
I am happy in Him.

hymns.title: Out of My Bondage, Sorrow and Night

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Out of my bondage, sorrow and night,
Jesus I come, Jesus, I come;
Into Thy freedom, gladness and light,
Jesus I come, to Thee;
Out of my sickness into Thy health,
Out of my want and into Thy wealth,
Out of my sin and into Thyself, Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Out of my shameful failure and loss,
Jesus I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the glorious gain of Thy cross,
Jesus, I come to Thee;
Out of earth's sorrows into Thy balm,
Out of life's storms and into Thy calm,
Out of distress to jubilant psalm,
Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Out of unrest and arrogant pride,
Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into Thy blessed will to abide,
Jesus, I come to Thee;
Out of myself to dwell in Thy love
Out of despair into raptures above,
Upward for aye on wings like a dove,
Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Out of the fear and dread of the tomb,
Jesus I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the joy and light of my home,
Jesus, I come to Thee;
Out of the depths of ruin untold,
Into the peace of Thy sheltering fold,
Ever Thy glorious face to behold, Jesus, I come to Thee.

hymns.title: I Came Unto Jesus Confessing My Sin

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I came unto Jesus confessing my sin,
Forsaking the wrongs of the past;
He promised me pardon and cleansing within,
He promised I trusted at last.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: His promises hold, hallelujah!
His promises hold, praise His name;
His promises hold, hallelujah!
For He is for ever the same.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I sought for the Comforter promised to all
Who all on the altar would lay;
I trusted the promise and blessing did fall
Upon me that glorious day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: His promises hold, hallelujah!
His promises hold, praise His name;
His promises hold, hallelujah!
For He is for ever the same.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He promised to keep me so safe in His fold,
That no one should lead me astray;
His arms everlasting will ever uphold,
And He will be with me alway.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: His promises hold, hallelujah!
His promises hold, praise His name;
His promises hold, hallelujah!
For He is for ever the same.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: My constant Companion, my Guide and my Friend,
My Saviour, my Keeper is He;
His love and compassion shall never more end,
In life or in death He keeps me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: His promises hold, hallelujah!
His promises hold, praise His name;
His promises hold, hallelujah!
For He is for ever the same.

hymns.title: I'm Pressing on the Upward Way

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I'm pressing on the upward way,
New heights I'm gaining everyday;
Still praying as I onward bound
"Lord, plant my feet on higher ground."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lord, lift me up and let me stand,
By faith, on Heaven's table-land;
Where love, and joy, and light abound,
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: My heart has no desire to stay
Where doubts arise, and fears dismay;
Though some may dwell where these abound,
My constant aim is higher ground.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lord, lift me up and let me stand,
By faith, on Heaven's table-land;
Where love, and joy, and light abound,
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Beyond the mist I fain would rise,
To rest beneath unclouded skies,
Above earth's turmoil peace is found

If our God our Father be.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Saviour, breathe forgiveness o'er us;
All our weakness Thou dost know;
Thou didst tread this earth before us,
Thou didst feel its keenest woe;
Lone and dreary, faint and weary,
Through the desert Thou didst go.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Spirit of our God, descending,
Fill our hearts with heavenly joy,
Love with every passion blending,
Pleasure that can never cloy;
Thus provided, pardoned guided,
Nothing can our peace destroy.

hymns.title: Guide Me, O Thou Great Jehovah

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Guide me, O Thou Great Jehovah!
Pilgrim through this barren land;
I am weak, but Thou art mighty,
Hold me with Thy powerful hand:
Bread of heaven! Bread of heaven!
Feed me now and evermore,
Feed me now and evermore.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Open Thou the crystal fountain,
Whence the healing stream doth flow:
Let the fiery, cloudy pillar,
Lead me all my journey through:
Strong deliverer! Strong deliverer!
Be Thou still my strength and shield,
Be Thou still my strength and shield.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: If I tread the verge of Jordan,
Bid my anxious fears subside:
Bear me through the swelling torrent,
Land me safe on Canaan's side:
Songs of praises! Song of praises!
I will ever give to Thee,
I will ever give to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Saviour, come! We long to see Thee,
Long to dwell with Thee above;
And to know in full communion,
All the sweetness of Thy love,
Come, Lord Jesus! Come Lord Jesus!
Take Thy waiting people home,
Take Thy waiting people home.

hymns.title: Like a Shepherd, Tender True

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Like a shep-herd, ten-der, true
Je-sus leads, Je-sus leads!
Dai-ly finds us pas-tures new,
Je-sus leads, Je-sus leads!
Tho' the mists hang o'er the way
Or the flock 'mid dan-ger feeds,
He will watch them lest they stray
Je-sus leads, Je-sus leads!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All a-long life's rug-ged road,
Je-sus leads, Je-sus leads!
Till we reach your blest abode,
Je-sus leads, Je-sus leads!
All the way, be-fore, He's trod
And He now the flock precedes,
Safe in-to the fold of God
Je-sus leads, Je-sus leads!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thro' the sun-lit ways of life
Je-sus leads, Je-sus leads!
Through the war-rings and the strife
Je-sus leads, Je-sus leads!
When we reach the Jor-dan's tide,
Where life's boun-d'ry line recedes,
He will turn waves a-side
Je-sus leads, Je-sus leads!

hymns.title: O Thou in Whose Presence My Soul Takes Delight

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Thou in whose presence my soul takes delight,
On whom in affliction I call,
My comfort by day and my song in the night,
My hope, my salvation, my all!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Where dost thou, dear Shepherd, resort with Thy sheep,
To feed them in pastures of love?
Say, why in the valley of death should I weep,
Or alone in this wilderness rove?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O why should I wander an alien from Thee
Or cry in the desert for bread?
Thy foes will rejoice when my sorrows they see
And smile at the tears I have shed.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Dear shepherd! I hear, all I will follow
Thy call I know the sweet sound of Thy sound
Restore and defend me, for Thou art my call
And in thee I will ever rejoice.

hymns.title: Loved with Everlasting Love

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Loved with everlasting love,
Led by grace that love to know,
Spirit breathing from above,
Thou hast taught me it is so.
Oh, this full and perfect peace!
Oh, this transport all divine!
In a love which cannot cease
In a love which cannot cease
I am His and He is mine
I am His and He is mine.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Heav'n above is softer blue,
Earth around is sweeter green;
Something lives in ev'ry hue
Christless eyes have never seen:
Birds with gladder songs o'erflow,
Flow'rs with deeper beauties shine,
Since I know, as now I know,
Since I know, as now I know,
I am His and He is mine,
I am His and He is mine.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Things that once were wild alarms
Cannot now disturb my rest;
Closed in everlasting arms,
Pillowed on the loving breast:
Oh, to lie for ever here!
Doubt and care and self resign,
While He whispers in my ear,
While He whispers in my ear,
I am His and He is mine,
I am His and He is mine.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: His for ever, only His;
Who the Lord and me shall part?
At, with what a rest of bliss,
Christ can fill the loving heart:
Heaven and earth may fade and flee;
First-born light in gloom decline;
But while God and I shall be,
But while God and I shall be,
I am His and He is mine,
I am His and He is mine.

hymns.title: My Blessed Saviour, Is Thy Love

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My blessed Saviour, is Thy love,
So great, so full, so free?
Behold, I give my love, my heart,
My life, my all to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I love Thee for the glorious worth
Which in Thyself I see;
I love Thee for that shameful cross
Thou hast endured for me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Though in the very form of God,
With heav'nly glory crown'd,
Thou wouldst partake of human flesh,
But with troub's around.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou wouldst like wretched man be made
In every thing but sin,
That we as like Thee might become
As we unlike had been.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Like Thee in faith, in meekness, love
In every beauteous grace;
From glory thus to glory chang'd,
As we behold Thy face.

hymns.title: My Happy Heart Is Singing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My happy heart is singing
My heav'nly Father's love;
He send so many blessings
Like sunbeams from above.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: But Jesus is the best of all
Yes Jesus is the best of all
Of all the joys that may surround me,
The best of all is Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Tho' other joy may fail me,
And sorrows may befall,
My Saviour will be with me.
And He is best of all.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: But Jesus is the best of all
Yes Jesus is the best of all
Of all the joys that may surround me,
The best of all is Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O, let me tell to others,
The story of His grace,
Rejoicing in His service,
Until I see His face.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: But Jesus is the best of all
Yes Jesus is the best of all
Of all the joys that may surround me,
The best of all is Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And when I view the glories,
Within the jasper wall,
I'll sing with all the ransomed,
My Saviour's best of al

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: But Jesus is the best of all
Yes Jesus is the best of all
Of all the joys that may surround me,
The best of all is Jesus

hymns.title: Thee Will I Love, My Strength My Tower

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thee will I love, my strength my tower,
Thee will I love, my joy, my crown,
Thee will I love with all my power,
In all Thy works, and Thee alone,
Thee will I love, till the pure fire
Fill my whole soul with chaste desire.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I thank Thee, uncreated Sun,
That Thy bright beams on me have shined;
I thank Thee, who hast overthrown
My foes, and healed my wounded mind;
I thank Thee, whose enlivening voice
Bids my freed heart in Thee rejoice.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Uphold me in the doubtful race,
Nor suffer me again to stray,
Strengthen my feet with steady pace
Still to press forward in Thy way;
My soul and flesh, O Lord of might
Fill, satiate, with Thy heav'nly light

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thee will I love, my joy, my crown,
Thee will I love, my Lord, my God
Thee will I love, beneath Thy frown,
Or smile, Thy sceptre, or Thy rod;
What though my flesh and heart decay?
Thee shall I love in endless day!

hymns.title: I Gave My Life for Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I gave My life for thee,
My precious blood I shed,
That thou might'st ransomed be,
And quicken'd from the dead
I gave My life for thee,
What hast thou giv'n for Me?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I spent long years for thee
In weariness and woe,
That an eternity
Of joy thou mightest know,
I spent long years for thee:
Hast thou spent one for Me?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My Father's home of light,
My rainbow-circled throne
I left, for earthly night,
For wand'rings sad and lone
I left it all for thee;
Hast thou left aught for Me?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I suffer'd much for thee,
More than thy tongue can tell,
Of bitterest agony,
To rescue thee from hell
I suffered much for thee;
What canst thou bear for Me?

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And I have brought to thee,
Down from My home above,
Salvation full and free,
My pardon and My love,
Great gifts I brought to thee;
What hast thou brought to Me?

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Oh, let thy life be given,
Thy years for Me be spent,
World-fetters all be riven,
And joy with suffering blent,
I gave Myself for thee;
Give thou thyself to Me.

hymns.title: Jesus, My Lord, My God, My All

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, my Lord, my God, my all,
Hear me, blest Saviour, when I call;
Hear me, and from Thy dwelling place
Pour down the riches of Thy grace;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus, my Lord, I Thee adore;
Oh make me love Thee more and more.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus, too late I Thee have sought;
How can I love Thee as I ought?
And how extol Thy matchless fame,
The glorious beauty of Thy name?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus, my Lord, I Thee adore;
Oh make me love Thee more and more.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus, what didst Thou find in me,
That Thou hast dealt so lovingly?
How great the joy that Thou hast brought
So far exceeding hope or thought!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus, my Lord, I Thee adore;
Oh make me love Thee more and more.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus, of Thee shall be my song,
To Thee my heart and soul belong;
All that I have or am is Thine,
And Thou, blest Saviour, Thou art mine.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus, my Lord, I Thee adore;
Oh make me love Thee more and more.

hymns.title: We Love Thee, Lord; yet Not Alone

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We love Thee, Lord; yet not alone, because Thy bounteous hand
Showers down its rich and ceaseless gifts.
On ocean and on land;
We praise Thee, gracious Lord, for these,
Yet not for these alone
The incense of Thy children's love
Arises to Thy throne.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We love Thee, Lord, because when we had err'd and gone astray,
Thou didst recall our wandering souls into the heavenward way,
When helpless, hopeless, we were lost in sin and sorrow's night
A guiding ray was granted us
From Thy pure fount of light.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Because, O Lord, Thou lovedst us
With everlasting love,
And sentest forth Thy Son to die
That we might live above;
Because, when we were heirs of wrath,
Thou gavest hopes of heaven;
We love because we much have sinn'd,
And much have been forgiven.

hymns.title: Come, Let Us All Unite and Sing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, let us all unite and sing
God is love!
While heaven and earth their praises bring
God is love!
Let every soul from sin awake,
Each in his heart sweet music make.
And sweetly sing for Jesus sake.
God is love!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh, tell to earth's remotest bound,
God is love!
In Christ is full redemption found
God is love!
His blood can cleanse our sins away;
His Spirit turns our night to day,
And leads our souls with joy to say
God is love!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: How happy is our portion here
God is love!
His promises our spirits cheer
God is love!
He is our Sun and Shield by day,
By night He near our tents will stay,
He will be with us all the way
God is love!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In Zion we shall sing again
God is love!
Yet, this shall be our highest strain
God is love!
Whilst endless ages roll along,
In concert with the heav'nly throng,
This shall be still our sweetest song
God is love!

hymns.title: When Peace, Like a River Attendeth My Way

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When peace, like a river attendeth my way,
When sorrows, like sea billows roll;
Whatever my lot, Thou has taught me to know,
"It is well, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: It is well,... With my soul,...
It is well, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Though Satan should buffet,
It trials should come,
Let this blest assurance control,
That Christ hath regarded my helpless estate,

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: It is well,... With my soul,...
It is well, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My sin- oh, the bliss of this glorious thought
My sin-not in part, but the whole
Is nailed to His cross; and I bear it no more:
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, O my soul.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: It is well,... With my soul,...
It is well, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: For me, be it Christ, be it Christ hence to live!
If Jordan above me shall roll,
No pang shall be mine, for in death as in life
Thou wilt whisper Thy peace to my soul.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: It is well,... With my soul,...
It is well, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: But the Lord, 'tis for Thee, for Thy coming we wait,
Thy sky, not the grave, is our goal:
Oh, triumph of the angel! oh, voice of the Lord!
Blessed hope! Blessed rest of my soul.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: It is well,... With my soul,...
It is well, it is well with my soul.

hymns.title: Are You Trusting Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Are you trusting Jesus,
All along the way?
Does He grow more precious
To your heart each day?
Are you His disciple?
Test His word and see
He will give the Spirit,
More abundantly.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: More... abundantly,
More... abundantly,
"That they might have life and
More abundantly."

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For His matchless favour
Magnify the name
Of our gracious Saviour
Who from glory came;
Let the saints adore Him
For this woundrous word
Sealing our redemption
Through the crimson flood.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: More... abundantly,
More... abundantly,
"That they might have life and
More abundantly."

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Come to Him believing,
Harken to His call,
All from Him receiving,
Yield to Him your all;
Jesus will accept you,
When to Him you flee;
He will grant His blessing
More abundantly.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: More... abundantly,
More... abundantly,
"That they might have life and
More abundantly."

hymns.title: Ho, Reapers in the Whitened Harvest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Ho, reapers in the whitened harvest!
Oft feeble, faint, and few:
Come, wait upon the blessed Master,
Our strength He will renew.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For "they that wait upon the Lord
Shall renew their strength
They shall mount up with wings,
They shall mount up with wings as eagles:
They shall run and not be weary;
They shall walk and not faint."
They shall walk and not be weary;
They shall walk and not faint."
They shall run and not be weary;
Shall walk and not faint."

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Too oft a-weary and discouraged
We pour a sad complaint;
Believing in a living Saviour,
Why should we ever faint.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For "they that wait upon the Lord
Shall renew their strength
They shall mount up with wings,
They shall mount up with wings as eagles:
They shall run and not be weary;
They shall walk and not faint."
They shall walk and not be weary;
They shall walk and not faint."
They shall run and not be weary;
Shall walk and not faint."

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Rejoice! for He is with us always,
Lo, even to the end!
Look up! take courage and go forward
All needed grace He'll send!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: For "they that wait upon the Lord
Shall renew their strength
They shall mount up with wings,
They shall mount up with wings as eagles:
They shall run and not be weary;
They shall walk and not faint."
They shall walk and not be weary;
They shall walk and not faint."
They shall run and not be weary;
Shall walk and not faint."

hymns.title: I Need Not Lack for Inward Pow'r

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I need not lack for inward pow'r,
To live a righteous life;
For God is with me,
Ev'ry hour to help me in the strife.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O that I might fully trust Him!
For I know He is nigh;
He will never leave me helpless,
All my needs He will supply.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I need not lack for friendship true,
For Jesus is my Friend;
Tho' other friends are sometimes few,
He loves us to the end.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O that I might fully trust Him!
For I know He is nigh;
He will never leave me helpless,
All my needs He will supply.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I need not lack for joy sublime,
His joy remains with me;
Earth's pleasures last but for a time,
His last eternally.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O that I might fully trust Him!
For I know He is nigh;
He will never leave me helpless,
All my needs He will supply.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I need not lack for anything,
For God is all in all;
And so each day His praise I sing,
And on His name I call.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O that I might fully trust Him!
For I know He is nigh;
He will never leave me helpless,
All my needs He will supply.

hymns.title: Jesus Calls Us O'er the Tumult

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus calls us o'er the tumult,
Of our life's wild, restless sea,
Day by day His sweet voice soundeth,
Saying, "Christian, follow Me!"

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: As, of old, apostles heard it
By the Galilean lake,
Turned from home, and toil, and kindred,
Leaving all for His dear sake.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus call us from the worship
Of the vain world's golden store,
From each idol that would keep us,
Saying, "Christain, love Me more."

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In our joys and in our sorrows,
Days of toil and hours of ease,
Still He calls, in cares and pleasures,
"Christian, love Me more than these."

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Jesus call us; by Thy mercies,
Saviour, may we hear Thy call,
Give our hearts to Thy obedience,
Serve and love Thee best of all

hymns.title: To the Work! To the Work! We Are Servants of God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: To the work! to the work! we are servants of God,
Let us follow the path that our Master has trod;
With the balm of His counsel our strength to renew,
Let us do with our might what our hands find to do.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Toiling on, toiling on,
Toiling on, toiling on,
Let us hope, let us watch,
And labour till the Master comes.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: To the work! to the work! let the hungry be fed,
To the fountain of life let the weary be led!
In the cross and its banner our glory shall be,
While we herald the tidings, "Salvation is free!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Toiling on, toiling on,
Toiling on, toiling on,
Let us hope, let us watch,
And labour till the Master comes.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: To the work! to the work! there is labour for all,
For the kingdom of darkness and error shall fall;
And the name of Jehovah exalted shall be,
In the loud-swelling chorus, "Salvation is free!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Toiling on, toiling on,
Toiling on, toiling on,
Let us hope, let us watch,
And labour till the Master comes.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: To the work! to the work! in the strength of the Lord,
And a robe and a crown shall our labour reward,
When the home of the faithful our dwelling shall be,
And we shout with the ransomed, "Salvation is free!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Toiling on, toiling on,
Toiling on, toiling on,
Let us hope, let us watch,
And labour till the Master comes.

hymns.title: Work, for the Night Is Coming

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Work, for the night is coming,
Work thro' the morning hours;
Work while the dew is sparkling;
Work 'mid springing flowers,
Work when the day grows brighter,
Work in the glowing sun;
Work for the night is coming,
When man's work is done.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Work for the night is coming,
Work thro' the sunny noon;
Fill brightest hours with labour,
Rest comes sure and soon.
Give every flying minute
Something to keep in store,
Work, for the night is coming,
When man works no more.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Work for the night is coming,
Under the sunset skies;
While their bright tints are glowing,
Work for daylight flies,
Work till the last beam fadeth,
Fadeth to shine no more;
Work while the night is darkening,
When man's work is o'er.

hymns.title: Onward, Christian Soldiers!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Onward, Christian soldiers!
Marching as to war,
Looking unto Jesus,
Who is gone before;
Christ, the Royal Master,
Leads against the foe;
Forward into battle,
See His banners go.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Onward, Christian soldiers!
Marching as to war,
Looking unto Jesus,
Who is gone before.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: At the name of Jesus
Satan's host doth flee;
On then, Christian soldiers
On to victory!
Hell's foundations quiver
At the shout of praise:
Brothers, lift your voices,
Loud your anthem raise

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Onward, Christian soldiers!
Marching as to war,
Looking unto Jesus,
Who is gone before.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Like a mighty army
Moves the Church of God:
Brothers, we are treading
Where the saints have trod.
We are not divided,
All one body we
One in hope and doctrine,
One in charity.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Onward, Christian soldiers!
Marching as to war,
Looking unto Jesus,
Who is gone before.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Crowns and thrones may perish,
Kingdom's rise and wane;
But the Church of Jesus
Constant will remain:
Gates of hell can never
'Gainst that church prevail;
We have Christ's own promise
And that cannot fail.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Onward, Christian soldiers!
Marching as to war,
Looking unto Jesus,
Who is gone before.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Onward then, ye people,
Join our happy throng;
Blend with ours your voices
In the triumph song:
"Glory, praise and honour,
Unto Christ the King",
This, through countless ages,
Men and angels sing.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Onward, Christian soldiers!
Marching as to war,
Looking unto Jesus,
Who is gone before.

hymns.title: Soldiers of Christ, Arise

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Soldiers of Christ, arise
And put your armour on,
Strong in the strength which God supplies
Thro' His eternal Son!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Strong in the Lord of hosts,
Stand in His mighty power;
Who in the strength of Jesus trusts
Is more than conqueror!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Stand then in His great might,
With all His strength endued;
And take, to arm you for the fight,
The panoply of God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: To keep your armour bright,
Attend with constant care;
Still marching in your Captain's sight,
And watching unto prayer.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: From strength to strength go on,
Wrestle and fight and pray,
Tread all the powers of darkness down
And win the well-fought day.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Then, having all things done,
And every conflict past
Accepted each through Christ alone,
You shall be crowned at last.

hymns.title: Stand Up! Stand up for Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Stand up! stand up for Jesus,
Ye soldiers of the Cross!
Lift high His royal banner;
It must not suffer loss.
From vict'ry unto vict'ry
His army shall He lead,
Till every foe is vanquished,
And Christ is Lord indeed.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Stand up! stand up for Jesus,
The trumpet call obey;
Forth to the mighty conflict,
In this His glorious day;
Ye that are men now serve Him
Against unnumbered foes;
Let courage rise with danger,
And strength to strength oppose.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Stand up! stand up for Jesus!
Stand in His strength alone;
The arm of flesh will fail you,
Ye dare not trust your own:
Put on the gospel armour,
And watching unto prayer;
Where duty calls, or danger,
Be never wanting there.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Stand up! stand up for Jesus!
The strife will not be long;
This day the noise of battle,
The next the victor's song;
To him that overcometh,
A crown of life shall be;
He with the King of glory
Shall reign eternally.

hymns.title: Ho, My Comrades! See the Signal

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Ho, my comrades! see the signal
Waving in the sky!
Reinforcements now appearing,
Victory in nigh!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hold the fort, for I am coming,"
Jesus signals still,
Wave the answer back to heaven,
"By Thy grace we will,

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: See the mighty host advancing
Satan leading on:
Mighty men around us falling,
Courage almost gone!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hold the fort, for I am coming,"
Jesus signals still,
Wave the answer back to heaven,
"By Thy grace we will,

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: See the glorious banner waving!
Hear the trumpet blow!
In our Leader's name we'll triumph
Over ev'ry foe!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hold the fort, for I am coming,"
Jesus signals still,
Wave the answer back to heaven,
"By Thy grace we will,

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Fierce and long the battle rages,
But our help is near:
Onward comes our great commander,
Cheer, my comrades, cheer!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hold the fort, for I am coming,"
Jesus signals still,
Wave the answer back to heaven,
"By Thy grace we will,

hymns.title: Rise, Ye Children of Salvation

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Rise, ye children of Salvation,
All who cleave, To Christ the Head,
Wake, arise! O mighty nation
Ere the foe on Zion thread.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Pour it forth a mighty anthem,
Pour it forth a mighty anthem,
Like the thunders of the sea
Thro' the blood of Christ our ransom,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we,
Thro' the blood of Christ our ransom,
More than conquerors are we.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Saints and heroes long before us,
Firmly on this ground have stood;
See their banners waving o'er us,
Conquerors through Jesus blood.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Pour it forth a mighty anthem,
Pour it forth a mighty anthem,
Like the thunders of the sea
Thro' the blood of Christ our ransom,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we,
Thro' the blood of Christ our ransom,
More than conquerors are we.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Deathless, are we all unfearing,
Life laid up with Christ in God;
In the morn of His appearing
Floweth forth a glory flood.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Pour it forth a mighty anthem,
Pour it forth a mighty anthem,
Like the thunders of the sea
Thro' the blood of Christ our ransom,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we,
Thro' the blood of Christ our ransom,
More than conquerors are we.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Soon we all shall stand before Him,
See and know our glorious Lord;
Soon in joy and light adore Him,
Each receiving his reward.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Pour it forth a mighty anthem,
Pour it forth a mighty anthem,
Like the thunders of the sea
Thro' the blood of Christ our ransom,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we,
Thro' the blood of Christ our ransom,
More than conquerors are we.

hymns.title: Christian, Seek Not yet Repose

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Christian, seek not yet repose;
Hear thy guardian angel say,
"Thou art in the midst of foes:
Watch and pray!"

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Principalities and powers,
Mustering their unseen array,
Wait for thy unguarded hours:
"Watch and pray."

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Gird thy heavenly armour on;
Wear it every night and day
Ambush'd lies the evil one:
"Watch and pray."

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Hear the victors who o'ercame;
Still they mark each warrior's way;
All with one sweet voice exclaim,
"Watch and pray!"

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Hear, above all, hear they Lord,
Him thou lovest to obey;
Hide within my heart His word
"Watch and pray!"

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Watch, as if on that alone
Hung the issue of the day;
Pray, that help may be sent down:
Watch and pray.

hymns.title: Where He May Lead Me I Will Go

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Where He may lead me I will go,
For I have learned to trust Him so,
And I remember 'twas for me,
That He was slain on Calvary.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus shall lead me night and day,
Jesus shall lead me all the way,
He is the truest Friend to me,
For I remember Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh, I delight in His command,
Love to be led by His dear hand;
His divine will is sweet to me,
Hallowed by blood-stained Calvary.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus shall lead me night and day,
Jesus shall lead me all the way,
He is the truest Friend to me,
For I remember Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Onward I go, nor doubt nor fear,
Happy with Christ my Saviour near,
Trusting some day that I shall see
Jesus, my Friend of Calvary.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus shall lead me night and day,
Jesus shall lead me all the way,
He is the truest Friend to me,
For I remember Calvary.

hymns.title: Down in the Valley with My Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Down in the valley with My Saviour I would go,
Where the flow'rs are blooming and the sweet waters flow;
Ev'rywhere He leads me I would follow, follow on;
Walking in His footsteps till the crown be won.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Follow! Follow! I would follow Jesus;
Anywhere, ev'rywhere, I would follow on!
Follow! Follow! I would follow Jesus!
Ev'rywhere He leads me I would follow on!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Down in the valley with my Saviour I would go,
Where the storms are sweeping and the dark waters flow;
With His hand to lead me I will never, never fear;
Danger cannot harm me if my Lord is near.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Follow! Follow! I would follow Jesus;
Anywhere, ev'rywhere, I would follow on!
Follow! Follow! I would follow Jesus!
Ev'rywhere He leads me I would follow on!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Down in the valley or upon the mountains steep,
Close beside my Saviour would my soul ever keep;
He will lead me safely in the path that He has trod,
Up to where they gather on the hills of God.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Follow! Follow! I would follow Jesus;
Anywhere, ev'rywhere, I would follow on!
Follow! Follow! I would follow Jesus!
Ev'rywhere He leads me I would follow on!

hymns.title: Whither, Pilgrims, Are You Going

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Whither, pilgrims, are you going,
Going each with staff in hand?
We are going on a journey,
Going at our King's command;
Over hills and plains and valleys,
We are going to His palace,
We are going to His palace,
Going to the better land,
We are going to His palace,
Going to the better land.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Tell us, pilgrims, what you hope for
In that far-off better land?
Spotless robes, and crowns of glory
From a Saviour's loving hand;
We shall drink of life's clear river,
We shall dwell with God for ever,
We shall dwell with God for ever,
In that bright, that better land,
We shall dwell with God for ever,
In that bright, that better land.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Pilgrims, may we travel with you
To that bright and better land?
Come and welcome, come and welcome,
Welcome to our pilgrim band,
Come, oh, come! and do not leave us;
Christ is waiting to receive us,
Christ is waiting to receive us,
In that bright, that better land,
Christ is waiting to receive us,
In that bright, that better land.

hymns.title: When You Start for the Land of Heavenly Rest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When you start for the land of heavenly rest,
Keep close to Jesus all the way;
For He is the Guide, and He knows the way best,
Keep close to Jesus all the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Keep close to Jesus, keep close to Jesus,
Keep close to Jesus all the way,
By day or by night, never turn from the right
Keep close to Jesus all the way.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Keep close to Jesus, keep close to Jesus,
Keep close to Jesus all the way,
By day or by night, never turn from the right
Keep close to Jesus all the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Keep close to Jesus, keep close to Jesus,
Keep close to Jesus all the way,
By day or by night, never turn from the right
Keep close to Jesus all the way.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: To be safe from the darts of the evil one,
Keep close to Jesus all the way;
Take the shield of faith till the victory is won,
Keep close to Jesus all the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Keep close to Jesus, keep close to Jesus,
Keep close to Jesus all the way,
By day or by night, never turn from the right
Keep close to Jesus all the way.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: We shall reach our home in heaven by and by,
Keep close to Jesus all the way;
Where to those we love we'll never say goodbye,
Keep close to Jesus all the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Keep close to Jesus, keep close to Jesus,
Keep close to Jesus all the way,
By day or by night, never turn from the right
Keep close to Jesus all the way.

hymns.title: It Is Glory Just to Walk With

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: It is glory just to walk with Him whose blood has ransomed me;
It is rapture for my soul each day,
It is joy divine to feel Him near where'er my path may be,
Bless the Lord, it's glory all the way!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: It is glory just to walk with Him,
It is glory just to walk with Him,
He will guide my steps a-right,
Thro' the vale and o'er the height;
It is glory just to walk with Him.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It is glory when the shadows fall to know that He is near;
Oh! what joy to simply trust and pray!
It is glory to abide in Him when skies above are clear;
Yes with Him, it's glory all the way!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: It is glory just to walk with Him,
It is glory just to walk with Him,
He will guide my steps a-right,
Thro' the vale and o'er the height;
It is glory just to walk with Him.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: "Twill be glory when I walk with Him on heaven's golden shore,
Never from His side again to stray.
"Twill be glory, wondrous glory with the Saviour evermore,
Everlasting glory all the way!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: It is glory just to walk with Him,
It is glory just to walk with Him,
He will guide my steps a-right,
Thro' the vale and o'er the height;
It is glory just to walk with Him.

hymns.title: My Jesus, I Love Thee, I Know Thou Art Mine

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My Jesus, I love Thee, I know Thou art mine,
For Thee all the follies of sin I resign;
My gracious Redeemer, my Saviour art Thou;
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I love Thee, because Thou hast first loved me,
And purchased my pardon on Calvary's tree;
I love Thee for wearing the thorns on Thy brow:
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I'll love Thee in life, I will love Thee in death,
And praise Thee as long as Thou lendest me breath;
And say when the death-dew lies cold on my brow,
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In mansions of glory and endless delight,
I'll ever adore Thee in heaven so bright;
I'll sing with the glittering crown on my brow,
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

hymns.title: God of All Wisdom and Goodness

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God of all wisdom and goodness
Give us Thy light and truth,
To show the strait and narrow way
And our footsteps to guide.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When in danger to be our guide,
And on the rocky steep;
To pilot our ship safely through,
Until we reach the shore.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And as we grow more in Thy grace,
To teach them as Thy word;
Help us to teach all our children,
According to Thy ways.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In time, destroy their vain desire,
The lust and pride of life,
Help to teach them the holy way,
To their Saviour and Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: We want to look up and follow
Thy good example, Lord
Channel their hope and fear to Thee,
Their thoughts to be renewed.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: We want to woo them to have faith
And show their zeal for Thee;
Grant that we teach not peevishly
Rather, teach them with love.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: In faith we ask for this from Thee,
E'en wisdom from above;
Grant them a childish fear in Thee
And with a perfect love.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Help us guide their bent to evil
Away from all dangers,
That we may gently bend their hearts
And draw them close to Thee.

hymns.title: It's Not an Easy Road

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: It's not an easy road we are trav'ling to heaven,
For many are the thorns on the way;
It's not an easy road but the Saviour is with us,
His presence gives us joy ev'ry day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: No, no, it's not an easy road,
No, no, it's not an easy road;
But Jesus walks with me and brightens my journey,
And lightens ev'ry heavy load.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It's not an easy road there are trials and troubles,
And many are the dangers we meet;
But Jesus guards and keeps so that nothing can harm us,
And smooth the rugged path for our feet.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: No, no, it's not an easy road,
No, no, it's not an easy road;
But Jesus walks with me and brightens my journey,
And lightens ev'ry heavy load.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Though I am often foot-sore and weary from travel,
Though I am often bowed down with care;
A better day is coming when Home in the glory,
We'll rest in perfect peace over there.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: No, no, it's not an easy road,
No, no, it's not an easy road;
But Jesus walks with me and brightens my journey,
And lightens ev'ry heavy load.

hymns.title: What Shall We Offer Our Good Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: What shall we offer our good Lord,
Poor nothings, for His boundless grace?
Fain would we His great name record
And worthy set forth His praise.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Great object of our growing love,
To whom our more than all we owe,
Open the fountain from above,
And let it our full souls o'erflow.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: So shall our lives Thy pow'r proclaim
Thy grace for every sinner free;
Till all mankind shall learn Thy name,
Shall all stretch our their hands to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Open a door which earth and hell
May strive to shut, but strive in vain;
Let Thy word richly in us dwell,
And let our gracious fruit remain.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: O multiply the sower's seed!
And fruit we every hour shall bear,
Throughout the world Thy gospel spread,
Thy everlasting truth declare.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: We all, in perfect love renewed,
Shall know the greatness of Thy pow'r,
Stand in the temple of our God
As pillars, and go out no more.

hymns.title: I Lay My Sins on Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I lay my sins on Jesus,
The spotless Lamb of God;
He bears them all, and frees us,
From the accursed load
I bring my guilt to Jesus,
To wash my crimson stains
White in His blood most precious
Till not a spot remains.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I lay my wants on Jesus,
All fullness dwells in Him
He heals all my diseases,
He doth my soul redeem,
I lay my griefs on Jesus,
My burdens and my cares,
He from them all releases,
He all my sorrows shares.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I rest my soul on Jesus,
This weary soul of mine;
His right hand me embraces,
I on His breast recline,
I love the name of Jesus,
Immanuel, Christ the Lord,
Like fragrance on the breezes,
His name abroad is poured.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I long to be like Jesus,
Meek, loving, lowly, mild;
I long to be like Jesus,
The Father's holy Child,
I long to be with Jesus,
Amid the heav'nly throng,
To sing with saints His praises,
To learn the angel's song.

hymns.title: Hark! The Voice of the Jesus Crying

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hark! The voice of the Jesus crying,
Who will go and work to-day?
Fields are white, and harvests waiting,
Who will bear the sheaves away?
Lord and long the Master calleth
Rich reward He offer free;
Who will answer? Gladly saying,
Here I am, send me, send me!.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: If you cannot cross the ocean,
And the heathen lands explore,
You can find the heathen nearer,
You can help them at your door;
If you cannot give your thousands,
You can give the widow's mite,
And the least you give for Jesus
Will be precious in His sight.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: If you cannot be the watchman
Standing high on Zion's wall,
Pointing out the path to heaven,
Off'ring life and peace to all,
With your pray'rs and with your bounties,
You can do what Heav'n demands;
You can be like faithful Aaron
Holding up the prophet's hands.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Let none hear you idly saying
There is nothing I can do!
While the souls of men are dying
And the Master calls for you,
Take the task He gives you gladly,
Let His work your pleasure be;
Answer quickly when He calleth,
Here am I; send me, send me!

hymns.title: I Strive Earnestly Day by Day

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I strive earnestly day by day,
And with my might, I strive to be;
That I may inherit the home,
Which Jesus had prepared for me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I crane earnestly day by day,
And to grasp it with all my might;
The crown of glory that is bright,
That is prepared for the lov'd ones.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I hope earnestly day by day,
To listen to the voice of joy;
When here on earth my labour ends,
Enter into thy Father's joy.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When friends and world and foes now seek
To draw me to perdition way,
Let me now with boldness repeat,
That I'll follow Thee to the end.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Look unto me my Lord and God,
Make me victorious o'er the flesh:
That I may not stumble and fall
Away from path of glorious home.

hymns.title: It May Be in the Valley

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: It may be in the valley where countless dangers hide;
It may be in the sunshine, that I in peace abide:
But this one thing I know, If it be dark or fair,
If Jesus is with me, I'll go anywhere!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: If Jesus goes with me,
I'll go... anywhere!
'Tis heaven to me,
Where'er I may be
If He is there!
I count it a privilege here...
His cross to bear;
If Jesus goes with me,
I'll go anywhere!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It may be I must carry the blessed word of life
Across the burning deserts to those in sinful strife;
And though it be my lot to bear my colours there,
If Jesus is with me, I'll go anywhere!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: If Jesus goes with me,
I'll go... anywhere!
'Tis heaven to me,
Where'er I may be
If He is there!
I count it a privilege here...
His cross to bear;
If Jesus goes with me,
I'll go anywhere!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: But if it be my portion to bear my cross at home,
While others bear their burdens' beyond the billow's foam,
I'll prove my faith in Him confess His judgements fair,
And if He stay with me, I'll stay anywhere!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: If Jesus goes with me,
I'll go... anywhere!
'Tis heaven to me,
Where'er I may be
If He is there!
I count it a privilege here...
His cross to bear;
If Jesus goes with me,
I'll go anywhere!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: It is not mine to question the judgements of my Lord,
It is mine to follow the leadings of His Word;
But if I go or stay, or whether here or there,
I'll be with my Saviour, content anywhere!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: If Jesus goes with me,
I'll go... anywhere!
'Tis heaven to me,
Where'er I may be
If He is there!
I count it a privilege here...
His cross to bear;
If Jesus goes with me,
I'll go anywhere!

hymns.title: Brightly Gleams Our Banner

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Brightly gleams our banner,
Pointing to the sky,
Waving on Christ's soldiers
To their home on high
Marching through the desert
Gladly thus we pray,
Still with hearts united
Singing on our way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Brightly gleams our banner,
Pointing to the sky,
Waving on Christ's soldiers,
To their home on high.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus, Lord and Master,
At Thy sacred feet,
Here, with hearts rejoicing,
See Thy children meet,
Often have we left Thee,
Often gone astray;
Keep us, mighty Saviour,
In the narrow way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Brightly gleams our banner,
Pointing to the sky,
Waving on Christ's soldiers,
To their home on high.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Pattern of our childhood
Once Thyself a child
Make our childhood holy,
Pure, and meek, and mild,
In the hour of danger
Whither can we flee?
Save to Thee, dear Saviour,
Only unto Thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Brightly gleams our banner,
Pointing to the sky,
Waving on Christ's soldiers,
To their home on high.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: All our days direct us,
In the way we go:
Lead us on victorious
Over every foe;
Bid Thine angels shield us
When the storm-clouds lower,
Pardon Thou and save us,
In the last dread hour.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Brightly gleams our banner,
Pointing to the sky,
Waving on Christ's soldiers,
To their home on high.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Then with saints and angels
May we join above,
Off'ring pray'rs and praises
At Thy throne of love,
When the march is over,
Then come rest and peace,
Jesus in His beauty,
Songs that never cease.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Brightly gleams our banner,
Pointing to the sky,
Waving on Christ's soldiers,
To their home on high.

hymns.title: Thou Art the Way: To Thee Alone

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thou art the Way: to Thee alone,
From sin and death we flee;
And he who would the Father seek,
Must seek Him, Lord, by Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou art the Truth, Thy word alone,
True wisdom can impart;
Thou only canst inform the mind,
And purify the heart.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou art the Life: the rending tomb
Proclaim Thy conqu'ring arm;
And those who put their trust in Thee,
Nor death nor hell shall harm.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou art the Way, the Truth, the Life,
Grant us that Way to know,
That Truth to keep, that Life to win,
Whose joys eternal flow.

hymns.title: Take up Thy Cross, the Saviour Said

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Take up thy cross, the Saviour said,
If thou wouldst My disciple be;
Deny thyself, the world forsake,
And humbly follow after Me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Take up thy cross; let not its weight
Fill thy weak spirit with alarm;
His strength shall bear thy spirit up,
And brace thy heart, and nerve thine arm.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Take up the cross; nor heed the shame,
Nor let thy foolish pride rebel;
Thy Lord for thee the cross endured,
To save thy soul from death and hell.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Take up thy cross; then in His strength,
And calmly every danger brave;
'Twill guide thee to a better home,
And lead to victory o'er the grave.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Take up thy cross; and follow Christ,
Nor think till death to lay it down;
For only he who bears the cross
May hope to wear the glorious crown.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: To Thee, Great Lord, the One in Thee,
All praise for evermore ascend;
O grant us in our Hope to see
The heav'nly life that knows no end.

hymns.title: God Doth See All the Work We Do

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God doth see all the work we do,
They are not hid from Him,
And all the thoughts down deep within;
Are all well known to Him.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We cannot hide our sins from Him,
He knows them everyone,
We lie and we deceive ourselves,
If we think He knows not.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: All things are manifest to Him,
With whom we have to do,
Both night and day, darkness and light,
Are the same in His sight.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O God, let us remember that,
Your eyes are e'er on us,
And help us, Lord, always to fear,
Not to sin against Thee.

hymns.title: Hark! On the Highway of Life a Sound

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hark! on the highway of life a sound,
As crested waves of ocean roar,
Lashed by the storm in its fury spent
As they beat upon, the shore.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hear the tramp, tramp, tramp of the Army,
As they march along the way of life,
They are weary of the toil and the travel
Of the bitterness of strife,
But they hope and trust, looking ever
On the path the saints before have trod,
And as they march along their faith grows strong
In the church of the Living God.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Onward they march with a faith unmoved,
By any change of time or creed,
There's to believe that the Word of God,
Can supply the world's great need.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hear the tramp, tramp, tramp of the Army,
As they march along the way of life,
They are weary of the toil and the travel
Of the bitterness of strife,
But they hope and trust, looking ever
On the path the saints before have trod,
And as they march along their faith grows strong
In the church of the Living God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Step in the ranks, you are needed there,
Cling to the Church and God will bless,
He is the hope of the whole wide world
For the cause of righteousness.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hear the tramp, tramp, tramp of the Army,
As they march along the way of life,
They are weary of the toil and the travel
Of the bitterness of strife,
But they hope and trust, looking ever
On the path the saints before have trod,
And as they march along their faith grows strong
In the church of the Living God.

hymns.title: Am I a Soldier of the Cross

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Am I a soldier of the cross,
A foll'wer of the Lamb?
And shall I fear to own His cause,
Or blush to speak His name?.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Must I be carried to the skies
On flowery beds of ease,
While others fought to win the prize,
And sailed through bloody seas?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Are there no foes for me to face?
Must I not stem the flood?
Is this vile world a friend to grace,
To help me on to God?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Since I must fight, if I would reign;
Increase my courage, Lord;
I'll bear the toil, endure the pain,
Supported by Thy Word.

hymns.title: By Faith, I Crave to Walk with God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: By faith, I crave to walk with God,
The end of my journey is heaven
"Thy rod and staff, they comfort me"
Thy way Thou hast pav'd is the best.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I walk amidst great wilderness
Where many souls have lost their way
But He that leads me on the way
Will not allow my foot to stray.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I walk amidst dangers and snares
Earth and hell against me arrayed
Through Thy great pow'r I have gone through
By faith alone, I have vict'ry.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I pity those who are boasting
Of fleeting pleasures of this life
Oh, Jesus, let me walk with Thee
My Lord, my Saviour and my Friend.

hymns.title: We Give Thee but Thine Own

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We give Thee but Thine own,
Whate'er the gift may be;
All that we have is Thine alone,
A trust, O Lord, from Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: May we Thy bounties thus
As stewards true receive,
And gladly, as Thou blessest us,
To Thee our first-fruits give.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O hearts are bruis'd and dead,
And homes are bare and cold;
And lambs, for whom the Shepherd bled,
Are straying from the fold.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: To comfort and to bless
To find a balm for woe,
To tend the lone and fatherless
Is angels' work below.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: The captives to release,
To God the lost to bring,
To teach the way of lif and peace,
It is a Christ-like thing.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: And we believe Thy word,
Though dim our faith may be;
Whate'er for Thine we do, O Lord,
We do it unto Thee. Amen.

hymns.title: Anywhere with Jesus I Can Safely Go

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Anywhere with Jesus I can safely go,
Anywhere He leads me in this world below!
Anywhere without Him dearest joys would fade,
Anywhere with Jesus, I am not afraid!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Anywhere: anywhere!
Fear I cannot know
Anywhere with Jesus
I can safely go!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Anywhere with Jesus I am not alone!
Other friends may fail me, He is still my own!
Though His hand may lead me over dearest ways,
Anywhere with Jesus is a house of praise!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Anywhere: anywhere!
Fear I cannot know
Anywhere with Jesus
I can safely go!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Anywhere with Jesus I can go to sleep,
When the darkening shadows round about me creep!
Knowing I shall waken, never more to roam:
Anywhere with Jesus will be home, sweet home!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Anywhere: anywhere!
Fear I cannot know
Anywhere with Jesus
I can safely go!

hymns.title: Gladly, Gladly, Toiling for the Master

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Gladly, gladly, toiling for the Master,
Go we forth with willing hands to do,
Whatsoe'er to us He hath appointed,
Faithfully our mission we'll pursue.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Toiling for Jesus,
Joyfully we go, joyfully we go,
Toiling for Jesus,
In His vineyard here below.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Sweetly, sweetly, we will tell the story,
Of His love to mortals here below;
Christ, the brightness of the Father's glory
Freely here His blessings will bestow.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Toiling for Jesus,
Joyfully we go, joyfully we go,
Toiling for Jesus,
In His vineyard here below.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Meekly, meekly, toiling for the Master,
Walking, faithfully the path He trod;
Leading wand'rers to the dear Redeemer
Pointing sinners to the Lamb of God.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Toiling for Jesus,
Joyfully we go, joyfully we go,
Toiling for Jesus,
In His vineyard here below.

hymns.title: When in His Beauty My Saviour I See

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When in His beauty my Saviour I see,
When I shall look on His face,
Tongue cannot tell of the joy it will be,
Saved by His wonderful grace.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saved, saved, Saved by His wonderful grace!
Saved, saved, Granted in heaven a place;
Saved, saved, Saved by His wonderful grace!
Glory to Jesus, I know I am saved,
Saved by His wonderful grace!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Long I had wondered in pathways of sin,
Often His grace had I spurned;
Often resisted His striving within,
Ere to the Saviour I turned.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saved, saved, Saved by His wonderful grace!
Saved, saved, Granted in heaven a place;
Saved, saved, Saved by His wonderful grace!
Glory to Jesus, I know I am saved,
Saved by His wonderful grace!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: How I rejoice that Salvation is free,
That I was not turned away:
How I rejoice that my Saviour I'll see,
Where I may praise Him for aye.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saved, saved, Saved by His wonderful grace!
Saved, saved, Granted in heaven a place;
Saved, saved, Saved by His wonderful grace!
Glory to Jesus, I know I am saved,
Saved by His wonderful grace!

hymns.title: Oh, the Best Friend to Have Is Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Oh, the best Friend to have is Jesus,
When the cares of life upon you roll,
He will heal the wounded heart,
