He will strength and grace impart:
Oh! the best friend to have is Jesus.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: The best friend to have is Jesus!
The best friend to have is Jesus!
He will help you when you fall,
He will hear you when you call,
Oh! the best friend to have is Jesus.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: What a Friend I have found in Jesus!
Peace and comfort to my soul He brings;
Leaning on His mighty arm,
I will fear no ill nor harm,
Oh! the best friend to have is Jesus!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: The best friend to have is Jesus!
The best friend to have is Jesus!
He will help you when you fall,
He will hear you when you call,
Oh! the best friend to have is Jesus.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Though I pass through the night of sorrow,
And the chilly waves of Jordan roll,
Never need I shrink nor fear
For my Saviour is so near;
Oh! the best friend to have is Jesus!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: The best friend to have is Jesus!
The best friend to have is Jesus!
He will help you when you fall,
He will hear you when you call,
Oh! the best friend to have is Jesus.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When at last to our home we gather,
With the loved ones who have gone before,
We will sing upon the shore
Praising Him for evermore;
Oh! the best friend to have is Jesus.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: The best friend to have is Jesus!
The best friend to have is Jesus!
He will help you when you fall,
He will hear you when you call,
Oh! the best friend to have is Jesus.

hymns.title: When upon Life's Billow You Are Tempest Tossed

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When upon life's billow you are tempest tossed,
When you are discouraged, thinking all is lost,
Count your many blessings, name them one by one,
And it will surprise you what the Lord has done.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Count your blessings, name them one by one,
Count your blessings, see what God has done,
Count your blessings, name them one by one;
And it will surprise you what the Lord has done.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Are you ever burdened with a load of care?
Does the cross seem heavy you are called to bear?
Count your many blessings, ev'ry doubt will fly,
And you will be singing as the days go by.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Count your blessings, name them one by one,
Count your blessings, see what God has done,
Count your blessings, name them one by one;
And it will surprise you what the Lord has done.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When you look at others with their lands and gold,
Think that Christ has promised you His wealth untold,
Count your many blessings, money cannot buy
Your reward in heaven, nor your home on high.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Count your blessings, name them one by one,
Count your blessings, see what God has done,
Count your blessings, name them one by one;
And it will surprise you what the Lord has done.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: So amid the conflict, whether great or small.
Do not be discouraged, God is over all,
Count your many blessings, angels will attend,
Help and comfort give you to your journey's end.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Count your blessings, name them one by one,
Count your blessings, see what God has done,
Count your blessings, name them one by one;
And it will surprise you what the Lord has done.

hymns.title: When We Walk with the Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When we walk with the Lord,
In the light of His word,
What a glory He sheds on our way!
While we do His good will;
He abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and obey.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trust and obey!
For there's no other way,
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Not a shadow can rise,
Not a cloud in the skies,
But His smile quickly drives it away;
Not a doubt nor a fear,
Not a sigh nor a tear,
Can abide while we trust and obey.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trust and obey!
For there's no other way,
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Not a burden we bear,
Not a sorrow we share,
But our toil He doth richly repay;
Not a grief nor a loss,
Nor a frown nor a cross,
But is blest if we trust and obey.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trust and obey!
For there's no other way,
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: But we never can prove,
The delights of His love,
Until all on the altar we lay,
For the favour He shows;
And the joy He bestows,
Are for them who will trust and obey.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trust and obey!
For there's no other way,
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Then in fellowship sweet,
We will sit at His feet,
Or we'll walk by His side in the way,
What He says we will do,
Where He sends we will go,
Never fear, only trust and obey.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trust and obey!
For there's no other way,
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

hymns.title: Simply Trusting Every Day

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Simply trusting every day,
Trusting through a stormy way;
Even when my faith is small,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trusting as the moments fly,
Trusting as the days go by;
Trusting Him whate'er befall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Brightly doth His Spirit shine,
Into this poor heart of mine;
While He leads I cannot fall;
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trusting as the moments fly,
Trusting as the days go by;
Trusting Him whate'er befall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Singing if my way is clear;
Praying if the path be drear;
If in danger, for Him call;
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trusting as the moments fly,
Trusting as the days go by;
Trusting Him whate'er befall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Trusting Him while life shall last,
Trusting Him till earth be past;
Till within the jasper wall;
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trusting as the moments fly,
Trusting as the days go by;
Trusting Him whate'er befall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

hymns.title: Trust on, Trust on, Believer

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Trust on, trust on, believer,
Though long the conflict be,
Thou yet shall prove victorious,
Thy God shall fight for thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trust on! trust on!
Tho' dark the night and drear:
Trust on! trust on!
The morning dawn is near.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Trust on, the danger presses,
Temptation strong is near,
Over life's dangerous rapids,
He shall thy passage steer.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trust on! trust on!
Tho' dark the night and drear:
Trust on! trust on!
The morning dawn is near.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The Lord is strong to save us,
He is a faithful Friend:
Trust on, trust on, believer!
Oh trust Him to the end!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Trust on! trust on!
Tho' dark the night and drear:
Trust on! trust on!
The morning dawn is near.

hymns.title: My Trust I Place Now and Ever

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My trust I place now and ever
In one my soul can deliver,
A Refuge strong failing never,
For His Word is sure.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am Alpha, and Omega,
The beginning and the ending,
Which is, and which was,
And which is to come,
I am Alpha, and Omega,
The beginning and the ending,
The Almighty, the almighty
Saith the Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: My heart with joy now is telling
Of Him who finds there a dwelling,
Whose love is gently compelling,
On His Word to rest.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am Alpha, and Omega,
The beginning and the ending,
Which is, and which was,
And which is to come,
I am Alpha, and Omega,
The beginning and the ending,
The Almighty, the almighty
Saith the Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jehovah God, still attend me,
From doubt and fear still defend me
Faith to sustain ever send me,
That my soul fail not.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am Alpha, and Omega,
The beginning and the ending,
Which is, and which was,
And which is to come,
I am Alpha, and Omega,
The beginning and the ending,
The Almighty, the almighty
Saith the Lord.

hymns.title: Simply Trusting Christ My Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Simply trusting Christ my Saviour,
In His presence I'm so blest,
That the storms which beat around me,
Drive me closer to His breast:

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Simply trusting day by day;
Trusting Jesus all the way;
Doubting not whate'er befall;
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Humbly trusting in the shadow,
When the sun is hid from view;
Not a cloud so dense and low'ring,
But His love can still shine through.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Simply trusting day by day;
Trusting Jesus all the way;
Doubting not whate'er befall;
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Ever trusting in the sunshine,
With all fear and doubting gone;
On the mountain top with Jesus,
Still 'tis "better farther on."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Simply trusting day by day;
Trusting Jesus all the way;
Doubting not whate'er befall;
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

hymns.title: They that Trust in the Lord Are Secure

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: They that trust in the Lord are secure,
Tho' the storm rages dark o'er the sea;
For this anchor of promise is sure,
"My grace is sufficient for thee."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: My grace is sufficient for thee,"
"My grace is sufficient for thee;"
"Oh matchless, boundless grace of God!"
"My grace is sufficient for thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: What a boon to the pilgrim opprest,
What a balm such a promise must be!
To the laden ones seeking for rest,
"My grace is sufficient for thee."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: My grace is sufficient for thee,"
"My grace is sufficient for thee;"
"Oh matchless, boundless grace of God!"
"My grace is sufficient for thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: In the race for the prize, fainting soul,
Though a weary you bow down the knee,
Rise again, and press on to the goal;
"My grace is sufficient for thee.".

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: My grace is sufficient for thee,"
"My grace is sufficient for thee;"
"Oh matchless, boundless grace of God!"
"My grace is sufficient for thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Neither trial nor doubt brings dismay,
Nor from dangers that come will I feel,
For I stand on this promise today
"My grace is sufficient for thee."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: My grace is sufficient for thee,"
"My grace is sufficient for thee;"
"Oh matchless, boundless grace of God!"
"My grace is sufficient for thee.

hymns.title: Sometimes a Light Surprises

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Sometimes a light surprises
The Christian while he sings;
It is the Lord who rises
With healing in His wings:
When comforts are declining,
He grants the soul again
A season of clear shining,
To cheer it after rain.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In holy contemplation,
We sweetly then pursue
The theme of God's salvation,
And find it ever new.
Set free from present sorrow,
We cheerfully can say,
E'en let th' unknown tomorrow
Bring with it what it may.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: It can bring with it nothing
But He will bear us through;
Who gives the lillies clothing
Will clothe His people too:
Beneath the spreading heavens
No creature but is fed;
And He who feeds the ravens
Will give His children bread.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Though vine nor fig tree neither
Their wonted fruit should bear,
Though all the field should wither,
Nor flocks nor herds be there,
Yet, God the same abiding,
His praise shall tune my voice;
For, while in Him confiding,
I cannot but rejoice.

hymns.title: Fight the Good Fight with All Thy Might

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Fight the good fight with all thy might,
Christ is thy strength, and Christ thy right;
Lay hold on life, and it shall be
Thy joy and crown eternally.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Run the straight race through God's good grace,
Lift up thine eyes, and seek His Face;
Life with its way before thee lies,
Christ is the path, and Christ thy prize.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Cast care aside, lean on thy Guide;
His boundless mercy will provide;
Lean, and the trusting soul shall prove,
Christ is its life, and Christ its love.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Faint not, nor fear, His arms are near,
He changeth not, and thou art dear;
Only believe, and thou shalt see
That Christ is all in all to thee.

hymns.title: Christ, Our Mighty Captain

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Christ, our mighty Captain leads against the foe,
We will never falter when He bids us go;
Tho' His righteous purpose we may never know,
Yet we'll follow all the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Forward! forward! 'tis the Lord's command
Forward! forward! to the promised land;
Forward! forward! let the chorus ring
We are sure to win with Christ our King.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Satan's fearful on-slaughts cannot make us yield
While we trust in Christ, our Buckler and our Shield
Pressing ever on the spirits sword we wield,
And we follow all the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Forward! forward! 'tis the Lord's command
Forward! forward! to the promised land;
Forward! forward! let the chorus ring
We are sure to win with Christ our King.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let our glorious banner ever be unfurled
From its mighty stronghold evil shall be hurled;
Christ, our mighty Captain, overcomes the world,
And we follow all the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Forward! forward! 'tis the Lord's command
Forward! forward! to the promised land;
Forward! forward! let the chorus ring
We are sure to win with Christ our King.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Fierce the battle rages, but 'twill not be long,
Then triumphant shall we join the blessed throng;
Joyfully uniting in the victor's song,
If we follow all the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Forward! forward! 'tis the Lord's command
Forward! forward! to the promised land;
Forward! forward! let the chorus ring
We are sure to win with Christ our King.

hymns.title: Conquerors and Overcomers Now Are We

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Conquerors and overcomers now are we,
Thro' the precious blood of Christ we've victory
If the Lord be for us, we can never fail,
Nothing 'gainst His mighty pow'r can e'er prevail.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Conquerors are we, through the blood of Jesus,
God will give us victory, through the blood of Jesus,
Thro' the Lamb for sinners slain,
Yet who lives and reigns again,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In the name of Israel's God we'll onward press,
Overcoming sin and all unrighteousness;
Not to us, but unto Him the praise shall be,
For salvation and for blood bought victory.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Conquerors are we, through the blood of Jesus,
God will give us victory, through the blood of Jesus,
Thro' the Lamb for sinners slain,
Yet who lives and reigns again,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Unto him that overcometh shall be given,
Here to eat of hidden manna sent from heav'n,
Over yonder he the victors palm shall bear,
And a robe of white, and golden crown shall wear.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Conquerors are we, through the blood of Jesus,
God will give us victory, through the blood of Jesus,
Thro' the Lamb for sinners slain,
Yet who lives and reigns again,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we.

hymns.title: Be Not Dismayed Whate'er Betide

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Be not dismayed whate'er betide,
God will take care of you!
Beneath His wings of love abide,
God will take care of you!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: God will take care of you!
Through ev'ry day, o'er all the way;
He will take care of you;
God will take care of you!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Through days of toil when heart doth fail,
God will take care of you!
When dangers fierce your path assail,
God will take care of you!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: God will take care of you!
Through ev'ry day, o'er all the way;
He will take care of you;
God will take care of you!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: All you may need He will provide,
God will take care of you!
Trust Him, and you will be satisfied,
God will take care of you!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: God will take care of you!
Through ev'ry day, o'er all the way;
He will take care of you;
God will take care of you!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lonely or sad, from friends apart,
God will take care of you!
He will give peace to your aching heart,
God will take care of you!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: God will take care of you!
Through ev'ry day, o'er all the way;
He will take care of you;
God will take care of you!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: No matter what may be the test,
God will take care of you!
Lean, weary one, upon His breast,
God will take care of you!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: God will take care of you!
Through ev'ry day, o'er all the way;
He will take care of you;
God will take care of you!

hymns.title: O Thou, From Whom All Goodness Flows

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Thou, from whom all goodness flows,
I lift my heart to Thee;
In all my sorrows, conflicts, woes,
Dear Lord, remember me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When on my aching burden'd heart
My sins lie heavily,
Thy pardon grant, Thy peace impart;
In love, remember me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When trials sore obstruct my way,
And ills I cannot flee,
Oh let my strength be as my day;
For good, remember me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: If on my face for Thy dear name
Shame and reproaches be;
All hail reproach, and welcome shame
If Thou remember me.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And oh, when in the hour of death
I own Thy just decree,
Be this the prayer of my last breath,
Dear Lord, remember me.

hymns.title: O Holy Saviour, Friend Unseen

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Holy Saviour, Friend unseen,
The faint, the weak on Thee may lean;
Help me, throughout life's varying scene,
By faith to cling to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Blest with communion so divine,
Take what Thou wilt, shall I repine,
When, as the branches to the vine,
My soul may cling to Thee?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Far from her home, fatigued, opprest,
Here she has found a place of rest;
An exile still, yet not unblest,
While she can cling to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: What though the world deceitful prove,
And earthly friends and joys remove,
With patient uncomplaining love,
Still would I cling to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Oft when I seem to tread alone
Some barren waste with thorns o'er grown,
A voice of love in gentlest tone
Whisper, "still cling to Me."

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Though faith and hope awhile be tried,
I ask not, need not, aught besides,
How safe, how calm, how satisfied?
The souls that cling to Thee!

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: They fear not life's rough storms to brave,
Since Thou art near and strong to save,
Nor shudder e'en at death's dark wave,
Because they cling to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Blest is my lot, whate'er befall
What can disturb me, who appal,
While, as my strength, my rock, my all,
Saviour, I cling to Thee.

hymns.title: Master, the Tempest Is Raging

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Master, the tempest is raging!
The billows are tossing high!
The sky is o'ershadowed with blackness,
No shelter or help is nigh;
"Carest Thou not that we perish?"
How canst Thou lie asleep,
When each moment so madly is threatening
A grave in the angry deep?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "The wind and the waves shall obey My will,
Peace, be still!"
Whether the wrath of the stormed-tossed sea,
Or demons, or men, or whatever it be,
No waters can swallow the ship where lies
The Master of ocean, and earth, and skies,
They all shall sweetly obey My will;
Peace be still! Peace be still!
They all shall sweetly obey My will:
Peace be still! Peace be still!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Master, with anguish of spirit
I bow in my grief today;
The depth of my sad heart are troubled;
Oh, waken and save, I pray!
Torrents of sin and of anguish
Sweep o'er my sinking soul!
And I perish! I perish! dear Master;
Oh hasten, and take control!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "The wind and the waves shall obey My will,
Peace, be still!"
Whether the wrath of the stormed-tossed sea,
Or demons, or men, or whatever it be,
No waters can swallow the ship where lies
The Master of ocean, and earth, and skies,
They all shall sweetly obey My will;
Peace be still! Peace be still!
They all shall sweetly obey My will:
Peace be still! Peace be still!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Master, the terror is over,
The elements sweetly rest;
Earth's sun in the calm lake is mirrored,
And heaven's within my breast.
Linger, O blessed Redeemer,
Leave me alone no more;
And with joy I shall make the blest harbour,
And rest on the blissful shore.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "The wind and the waves shall obey My will,
Peace, be still!"
Whether the wrath of the stormed-tossed sea,
Or demons, or men, or whatever it be,
No waters can swallow the ship where lies
The Master of ocean, and earth, and skies,
They all shall sweetly obey My will;
Peace be still! Peace be still!
They all shall sweetly obey My will:
Peace be still! Peace be still!

hymns.title: Peace, Perfect Peace, in This Dark World of Sin

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus, this is rest.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round?
On Jesus' bosom nought but calm is found.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Peace, perfect peace, with lov'd ones far away?
In Jesus' keeping we are safe and they.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Peace, perfect peace, death shad'wing us and ours?
Jesus has vanquish'd death and all its pow'rs.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: It is enough, earth's struggles soon shall cease,
And Jesus call us to heaven's perfect peace.

hymns.title: When Shadows Darken My Earthly Way

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When shadows darken my earthly way,
And long and dreary seems the day,
This promise sweet comes my soul to greet,
He never forgets His own.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He never forgets His own.
He never forgets His own.
Though friends deny there is one so nigh,
Who never forgets His own.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When cherished plans all here seem to fail,
And doubt and fear my soul assail,
'Tis then I rest on His loving breast,
Who never forgets His own.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He never forgets His own.
He never forgets His own.
Though friends deny there is one so nigh,
Who never forgets His own.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O no, He never forgets His own,
And dearer He has daily grown,
Since that glad day when He came to stay,
He never forgets His own.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He never forgets His own.
He never forgets His own.
Though friends deny there is one so nigh,
Who never forgets His own.

hymns.title: My Sufferings All to Thee Are Known

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My sufferings all to Thee are known,
Tempted in every point like me;
Regard my grief, regard Thy own,
Jesus, remember Calvary!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Art Thou not touched with human woe?
Hath pity left the Son of Man?
Dost Thou not all my sorrows know
And claim a share in all my pain?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Have I not heard, have I not known,
That Thou, the everlasting Lord,
Whom heav'n and earth their Maker own,
Art always faithful to Thy word?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The day of small and feeble things
I know Thou never wilt despise;
I know, with healing in His wings,
The Sun of Righteousness shall rise.

hymns.title: My God My Father, While I Stray

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My God my Father, while I stray,
Far from my home, in life's rough way,
Oh teach me from my heart to say,
"Thy will be done."

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Though dark my path and sad my lot,
Let me be still and murmur not;
Or breathe the pray'r divinely taught,
"Thy will be done."

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: What though in lonely grief I sigh
For friends belov'd no longer nigh,
Submissive still would I reply,
"Thy will be done."

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: If Thou should'st call me to resign
What most I prize, it ne'er was mine;
I only yield Thee what is Thine;
"Thy will be done."

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Let but my fainting heart be blest,
With Thy sweet Spirit for its guest,
My God, to Thee I leave the rest,
"Thy will be done."

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Renew my will from day to day,
Blend it with Thine, and take away,
All that now makes it hard to say,
"Thy will be done."

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Then, when on earth I breathe no more,
The pray'r, oft mix'd with tears before,
I'll sing upon a happier shore,
"Thy will be done."

hymns.title: Lord, I Care Not for Riches

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord, I care not for riches,
Neither silver nor gold;
I would make sure of heaven,
I would enter the fold;
In the book of Thy Kingdom,
With its pages so fair,
Tell me, Jesus my Saviour
Is my name written there?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Is my name written there?
On the page white and fair?
In the book of Thy kingdom
Is my name written there?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lord, my sins they are many,
Like the sands of the sea,
But Thy blood, O my Saviour!
Is sufficient for me;
For Thy promise is written,
In bright letters that glow,
"Tho' your sins be as scarlet,
I will make them like snow.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Is my name written there?
On the page white and fair?
In the book of Thy kingdom
Is my name written there?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O! that beautiful city
With its mansions of light,
With its glorified being,
In pure garments of white
Where no evil thing cometh
To despoil what is fair;
Where the angels are watching,
Yes, my name's written there.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Is my name written there?
On the page white and fair?
In the book of Thy kingdom
Is my name written there?

hymns.title: By Whom, Lord, Shall Jacob Arise?

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "By whom, Lord, shall Jacob arise?"
His friends are very few;
What is surprising is this that
They are not'n one accord.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "By whom, Lord, shall Jacob arise?"
His enemies are cruel
They joy as if they have triumphed
And said, "He is finished."

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: "By whom, Lord, shall Jacob arise?"
Can anybody say?
The dried up branch there on the ground
Can it bloom any more?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O Lord my God, it is Thy work
No one else can do it;
Descend like the dew on Jacob
And Jacob shall arise.

hymns.title: There's a Place I Love to Tarry

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's a place I love to tarry
When my soul is sad, oppressed,
'Tis alone with Christ my Saviour,
Where He bids me "Come and rest,"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just to be alone with Jesus,
Just to hear Him softly say:
"Fear not, though the world forsake you,
"Lo I'm with you always."

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When the cares of life are heavy,
And beneath my cross I bend;
Then I go alone with Jesus,
For He is my dearest Friend.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just to be alone with Jesus,
Just to hear Him softly say:
"Fear not, though the world forsake you,
"Lo I'm with you always."

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When the tempter would assail me,
Jesus bids me to Him flee;
He's my Refuge, Friend and Saviour,
He is all in all to me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just to be alone with Jesus,
Just to hear Him softly say:
"Fear not, though the world forsake you,
"Lo I'm with you always."

hymns.title: Give to the Winds Thy Fears

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Give to the winds thy fears;
Hope, and be undismayed:
God hears thy sighs, and count thy tears,
God shall lift up thy head.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Through waves, and clouds, and storms,
He gently clears the way:
Wait thou His time; so shall this night
Soon end in joyous day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Still heavy is thy heart?
Still sink thy spirits down?
Cast off the weight, let fear depart,
Bid every care be gone.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: What though thou rulest not?
Yet heaven, and earth, and hell
Proclaim, God sitteth on the throne,
And ruleth all things will!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Leave to His sovereign sway
To choose and to command;
So shalt thou, wondering, own His way
How wise, how strong His hand.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Far, far above thy thought
His counsel shall appear,
When fully He the work Hath wrought
That caused thy needless fear.

hymns.title: Toss'd with Rough Winds, and Faint with Fear

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Toss'd with rough winds, and faint with fear,
Above the tempest, soft and clear,
What still small accents greet mine ear?
'Tis I, be not afraid.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: 'Tis I, who washed thy spirit white
'Tis I, who gave thy blind eyes sight;
'Tis I, thy Lord, the life, they light:
'Tis I, be not afraid.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There raging winds, this surging sea,
Have spent their deadly force on Me;
They bear no breath of wrath to thee;
'Tis I, be not afraid

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: This better cup, I drink it first;
To thee it is no drought accurst,
The hand that gives it thee is pierced:
'Tis I, be not afraid.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Mine eyes are watching by thy bed,
Mine arms are underneath thy head,
My blessing is around thee shed;
'Tis I, be not afraid.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: When on the other side thy feet
Shall rest, mid thousand welcomes; sweet,
One well-known Voice thy heart shall greet,
'Tis I, be not afraid.

hymns.title: Safe in the Arms of Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His gentle breast,
There by His love o'er shaded,
Sweetly my soul shall rest,
Hark! 'tis the voice of angels,
Borne in a song to me,
Over the fields of glory,
Over the jasper sea.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His guide breast,
There by His love o'er shaded,
Sweetly my soul shall rest.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe from corroding care,
Safe from the world's temptations,
Sin cannot harm me there
Free from the blight of sorrow,
Free from my doubts and fears;
Only a few more trials,
Only a few more tears!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His guide breast,
There by His love o'er shaded,
Sweetly my soul shall rest.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus, my heart's dear refuge,
Jesus has died for me;
Firm on the Rock of Ages,
Ever my trust shall be
Here let me wait with patience,
Wait till the night is o'er;
Wait till I see the morning
Break on the golden shore.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His guide breast,
There by His love o'er shaded,
Sweetly my soul shall rest.

hymns.title: Time May Tarnish Earthly Treasures

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Time may tarnish earthly treasures,
Take what I have lov'd before,
Jesus gives abiding pleasures,
Having Him, what need I more?
Have Him, what need I more?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I have Christ and need no more
From His hand rich gift out-pour;
Lo, I'm singing o'er and o'er,
I have Christ, I need no more.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Tho' the beams of worldly gladness,
Fail to light the pathway dim,
Jesus takes away my sadness,
All I need I find in Him,
All I need I find in Him.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I have Christ and need no more
From His hand rich gift out-pour;
Lo, I'm singing o'er and o'er,
I have Christ, I need no more.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: To His boundless stores of blessing,
Jesus open wide the door,
All in all in Him possessing,
I shall never want for more,
I shall never want for more.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I have Christ and need no more
From His hand rich gift out-pour;
Lo, I'm singing o'er and o'er,
I have Christ, I need no more.

hymns.title: If You Want Pardon, if You Want Peace

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: If you want pardon, if you want peace,
If you want sorrow or sighing to cease,
Look up to Jesus who died on the tree,
To purchase a full salvation.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Living beneath the shade of the cross,
Counting the jewels of earth but dross;
Cleans'd in the blood that flows from His side,
Enjoying a full salvation.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: If you want Jesus to reign in your soul,
Plung in the fountain and you shall be whole;
Washed in the blood of the crucified One,
Enjoying a full salvation.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Living beneath the shade of the cross,
Counting the jewels of earth but dross;
Cleans'd in the blood that flows from His side,
Enjoying a full salvation.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: If you want boldness take part in the fight;
If you want purity, walk in the light;
If you want liberty, shout and be free,
Enjoying a full salvation.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Living beneath the shade of the cross,
Counting the jewels of earth but dross;
Cleans'd in the blood that flows from His side,
Enjoying a full salvation.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: If you want holiness, cling to the cross,
Counting the riches of earth as dross;
Down at His feet you'll be cleans'd and made free,
Enjoying a full salvation.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Living beneath the shade of the cross,
Counting the jewels of earth but dross;
Cleans'd in the blood that flows from His side,
Enjoying a full salvation.

hymns.title: All Things Are Possible to Him

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: All things are possible to him
That can in Jesus' name believe,
Lord, I no more Thy name blaspheme,
Thy truth I lovingly receive,
I can, I do believe in Thee;
All things are possible to me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: 'Twas most impossible of all
That here sin's reign in me should cease;
Yet shall it be, I know it shall;
Jesus, I trust Thy faithfulness!
If nothing is too hard for Thee,
All things are possible to me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Though earth and hell the word gainsay,
The Word of God shall never fail
The Lord can break sin's iron sway;
'Tis certain, through impossible,
The thing impossible shall be,
All things are possible to me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: All things are possible to God;
To Christ, the power of God in man;
To me when I am all renewed,
In Christ am fully formed again,
And from the reign of sin set free,
All things are possible to me.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: All things are possible to God;
To Christ, the power of God in me;
Now shed Thy mighty Self abroad,
Let me on longer live, but Thee;
Give me this hour in Thee to prove
The sweet omnipotence of love.

hymns.title: 'Tis so Sweet to Trust in Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: 'Tis so sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just to take Him at His Word;
Just to rest upon His promise;
Just to know, "Thus saith the Lord."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him!
How I've proved Him o'er and o'er!
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust Him more!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O how sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just to trust His cleansing blood;
Just in simple faith to plunge me
'Neath the healing cleansing flood!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him!
How I've proved Him o'er and o'er!
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust Him more!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Yes, 'tis sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just from sin and self to cease;
Just from Jesus simply taking
Life and rest, and joy and peace.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him!
How I've proved Him o'er and o'er!
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust Him more!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I'm so glad I learn'd to trust Thee,
Precious Jesus, Saviour, Friend,
And I know that Thou art with me,
Wilt be with me to the end.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him!
How I've proved Him o'er and o'er!
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust Him more!

hymns.title: Rescue the Perishing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Rescue the perishing
Care for the dying
Snatch them in pity from sin and the grave;
Weep o'er the erring one,
Lift up the fallen
Tell them of Jesus the Mighty to save.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rescue the perishing
Care for the dying
Jesus is merciful,
Jesus will save.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Tho' they are slighting Him
Still He is waiting,
Waiting the penitent child to recieve,
Plead with them earnestly,
Plead with them gently:
He will forgive if only they believe.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rescue the perishing
Care for the dying
Jesus is merciful,
Jesus will save.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Rescue the perishing,
Duty demands it;
Strength for thy labour the Lord will provide;
Back to the narrow way
Patiently win them
Tell the poor wand'rer a Saviour has died.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Rescue the perishing
Care for the dying
Jesus is merciful,
Jesus will save.

hymns.title: Summoned My Labour to Renew

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Summoned my labour to renew,
And glad to act my part,
Lord, in Thy name my work I do,
And with a single heart.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: End of my every action Thou,
In all things Thee I see;
Accept my hallow'd labour now,
I do it unto Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Whate'er the Father views as Thine,
He views with gracious eyes:
Jesus, this mean oblation join
To Thy great sacrifice.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Stamp'd with an infinite desert,
My work He then shall own;
Well ples'd with me, when mine Thou art
And I His favoured son.

hymns.title: Lord, if at Thy Command

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord, if at Thy command
The word of life we sow,
Water'd by Thy Almighty hand,
The seed shall surely grow:

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The virtue of Thy grace,
A large increase shall give
And multiply the faithful race
Who to Thy glory live.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Now then the ceaseless show'r
Of gospel blessings send
And let the soul-converting pow'r,
Thy ministers attend.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: On multitudes confer
The heart-renewing love,
And by the joy of grace prepare
For fuller joys above.

hymns.title: Speed Thy Servants, Saviour Speed Them

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Speed Thy servants, Saviour speed them;
Thou art Lord of winds and waves:
They were bound, but Thou has freed them,
Now they go to free the slaves,
Be Thou with them, (2ce)
'Tis Thine arm alone that saves.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Friends, and home, and all forsaking,
Lord, they go at Thy command;
As their stay Thy promise taking,
While they transverse sea and land:
O be with them!
Lead them safely by the hand

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Where no fruit appears to cheer them,
And they seem to toil in vain,
Then in mercy, Lord, draw near them,
Then their sinking hopes sustain;
Thus supported,
Let their zeal revive again.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In the midst of opposition,
Let them trust, O Lord, in Thee,
When success attends their mission,
Let Thy servants humbler be;
Never leave them,
Till Thy face in heav'n they see:

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: There to reap in joy for ever
Fruit that grows from seed here sown,
There to be with Him who never
Ceases to preserve His own,
And with gladness
Give the peace to Him alone.

hymns.title: Nearer, My God to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Nearer, my God to Thee,
Nearer to Thee;
E'en though it be a cross
That raiseth me,
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee, (2ce)
Nearer to Thee!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Though, like the wanderer,
The sun gone down,
Darkness be over me,
My rest a stone,
Yet in my dreams I'd be
Nearer, my God, to Thee, (2ce)
Nearer to Thee!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There let the way appear
Steps unto heaven;
All that Thou send'st to me
In mercy given;
Angels to beckon me
Nearer, my God, to Thee, (2ce)
Nearer to Thee!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Then with my waking thoughts
Bright with Thy praise,
Out of my stony griefs
Bethel I'll raise;
So by my woes to be
Nearer, my God, to Thee, (2ce)
Nearer to Thee!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Or if on joyful wing
Cleaving the sky,
Sun, moon, and stars forgot,
Upward I fly,
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee, (2ce)
Nearer to Thee!

hymns.title: I Must Have the Saviour with Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I must have the Saviour with me
For I dare not walk alone
I must feel His presence near me
And His arm around me thrown.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Then my soul shall fear no ill
Let Him lead me where He will
I will go without a murmur
And His footsteps follow still.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I must have the Saviour with me
For my faith at best is weak
He can whisper words of comfort
That no other voice can speak.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Then my soul shall fear no ill
Let Him lead me where He will
I will go without a murmur
And His footsteps follow still.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I must have the Saviour with me
In the onward march of life
Thro' the tempest and the sunshine,
Thro' the battle and the strife.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Then my soul shall fear no ill
Let Him lead me where He will
I will go without a murmur
And His footsteps follow still.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I must have the Saviour with me
And His eye the way must guide
Till I reach the vale of Jordan
Till I cross the rolling tide.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Then my soul shall fear no ill
Let Him lead me where He will
I will go without a murmur
And His footsteps follow still.

hymns.title: 'Tis the Promise of God Full Salvation to Give

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: 'Tis the promise of God full salvation to give
Unto him who on Jesus, His Son will believe

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Halleluyah! 'tis done,
I believe on the Son;
I am saved by the blood of the Crucified One.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Though the pathway be lonely and dangerous too,
Surely Jesus is able to carry me through.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Halleluyah! 'tis done,
I believe on the Son;
I am saved by the blood of the Crucified One.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Many loved ones have I in yon heavenly throng.
They are safe now in glory, and this is their song.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Halleluyah! 'tis done,
I believe on the Son;
I am saved by the blood of the Crucified One.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There are prophets and kings in that throng I behold,
And they sing while they march through the streets of pure gold.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Halleluyah! 'tis done,
I believe on the Son;

pairs: Oh give me Sam-uel's ear!
The o-pen ear, O Lord,
A-live and quick to hear
Each whis-per of Thy word;
Like him to an-swer at Thy call,
And to o-bey Thee first of all.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh give me Samuel's heart!
A lowly heart, that waits
Where in Thy house Thou art,
Or watches at Thy gates
By day and night, a heart that still
Moves at the breathing of Thy will.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh, give me Samuel's mind!
A sweet unmurm'ring faith,
Obedient and resigned
To Thee in life and death,
That I may read, with childlike eyes,
Truths that are hidden from the wise.

hymns.title: Come, My Soul, Thy Suit Prepare

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, my soul, thy suit prepare,
Jesus loves to answer prayer;
He Himself has bid thee pray,
Therefore will not say thee nay

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou art coming to a King,
Large petitions with thee bring;
For His grace and power are such,
None can ever ask too much.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Lord, I come to Thee for rest,
Take possession of my breast;
There Thy blood-bought right maintain,
And without a rival reign.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: As the image in the glass
Answers the beholder's face,
Thus unto my heart appear,
Print Thine own resemblance there.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: While I am a pilgrim here,
Let Thy love my spirit cheer;
As my guide, my guard, my friend,
Lead me to my journey's end.

hymns.title: Behold the Throne of Grace

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Behold the throne of grace,
The promise calls me near;
There Jesus shows a smiling face,
And waits to answer prayer.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: That rich atoning blood,
Which sprinkled round I see,
Provides for those who come to God,
An all-prevailing plea.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My soul, ask what thou wilt,
Thou canst not be too bold;
Since His own blood for thee He split,
What else can He withhold?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Beyond thine utmost wants,
His love and power can bless;
To praying souls He always grants
More than they can express.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thine image, Lord, bestow,
Thy presence and Thy love;
I ask to serve Thee here below,
And reign with Thee above.

hymns.title: Approach, My Soul, the Mercy Seat

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Approach, my soul, the mercy seat,
Where Jesus answers pray'r;
There humbly fall before His feet,
For none can perish there.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thy promise is my only plea;
With this I venture nigh;
Thou callest burden'd souls to Thee,
And such, O Lord, am I.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Bow'd down beneath a load of sin,
By satan sorely press'd
By wars without, and fears within,
I come to Thee for rest.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Be Thou my shield and hiding place,
That, shelter'd near Thy side,
I may my fierce accuser face,
And tell him, Thou hast died.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Oh wondrous love! to bleed and die,
To bear the Cross and shame,
That guilty sinners, such as I,
Might plead Thy gracious Name!

hymns.title: Jesus My only Strength

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus my only strength,
Thou art all I care for;
With all faith I lift up my eyes,
Thou wilt accept my prayer,
Let me stay here for Thee
That I may do Thy will;
And think O my Almighty God,
Renew me with all strength.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Give me a humble heart
That sacrifices itself;
That threats upon that ridicules
Satan's machinations,
A heart that values much
The pangs of pain and toil,
That with patience and all boldness
Bear its own cross alone.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Give me the heavenly care,
A bold and a sharp face,
That looks to Thee when sins draw near:
That drives away satan;
O give me the Spirit
Which Thou hast provided,
Spirit that stays steadfast for aye,
That watches while praying.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I trust only thy word,
Thou gave me this promise
That all my help and salvation
Shall come only from Thee:
Just let me stand steadfast,
That my hope might not shake
Until Thou shall bring my spirit
To everlasting rest.

hymns.title: Love Others as Thyself

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Love others as thyself,
This is the law of God
His being crucified has proved this
That He loves us so much.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Love others as thyself
In warfare and in peace
He has taught us to love our foes
Love should replace hatred.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Love others as thyself
Jesus is warning thee
We must heed this and get prepared
And we should love ourselves.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Love others as thyself
And also thy neighbours
Including all that surround you
Love also all thy foes.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: We must love our comrades
Just as Jesus loves us
Even Jesus loves all His foes
He also prayed for them.

hymns.title: Come, Sing My Soul, and Praise the Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, sing my soul, and praise the Lord,
Who hath redeemed thee by His blood;
Delivered thee from chains that bound,
And brought thee to redemption ground.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Redemption ground, the ground of peace!
Redemption ground, O wondrous grace!
Here let our praise to God abound,
Who saves us on redemption ground!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Once from my God I wandered far,
And with His holy will made war;
But now my songs to God abound;
I'm standing on redemption.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Redemption ground, the ground of peace!
Redemption ground, O wondrous grace!
Here let our praise to God abound,
Who saves us on redemption ground!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O joyous hour! when God to me
A vision gave of Calvary;
My bonds were loosed, my soul unbound;
I sang upon redemption ground.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Redemption ground, the ground of peace!
Redemption ground, O wondrous grace!
Here let our praise to God abound,
Who saves us on redemption ground!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: No works of merit now I plead,
But Jesus take for all my need;
No righteousness in me is found,
Except upon redemption ground.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Redemption ground, the ground of peace!
Redemption ground, O wondrous grace!
Here let our praise to God abound,
Who saves us on redemption ground!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Come, weary soul, and here find rest;
Accept redemption and be blest;
The Christ who died, by God is crowned
To pardon on redemption ground.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Redemption ground, the ground of peace!
Redemption ground, O wondrous grace!
Here let our praise to God abound,
Who saves us on redemption ground!

hymns.title: Impatient Heart, Be Still!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Impatient heart, be still!
What tho' He tarries long?
What tho' the triumph song is still delayed?
Thou hast His promise sure,
And that is all secure;
Be not afraid! Be not afraid!
Be still! Be still!
Impatient heart, be still!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: My eager heart, be still!
Thy Lord will surely come,
And take thee to His home,
With Him to dwell;
It may not be today;
And yet, my soul, it may;
I cannot tell, I cannot tell.
Be still! Be still!
My eager heart, be still!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My anxious heart, be still!
Watch, work, and pray, and then
It will not matter when
Thy Lord shall come;
At midnight, or at noon;
He cannot come too soon
To take thee home, To take thee home.
Be still! Be still!
My anxious heart be still!

hymns.title: Their Earthly Task Who Fail to Do

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Their earthly task who fail to do,
Neglect their heav'nly business too;
Nor know what faith and duty mean,
Who use religion as a screen:
Asunder put what God hath joined,
A diligent and pious mind.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Full well the labour of our hands
With fervency of spirit stands;
For God, who all our days hath giv'n,
From toil excepts but one in seven:
And lab'ring while we time redeem,
We please the Lord, and work for Him.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Happy we live, when God doth fill
Our hands with work, our hearts with zeal;
For every toil, if He enjoin,
Becomes a sacrifice divine,
And like the bless'd spirits above,
The more we serve, the more we love.

hymns.title: "Thine - Thine for Ever" Blessed: Bond

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "Thine - Thine for ever" blessed: bond
That knits us, Lord to Thee;
May voice, and heart, and soul respond
Amen, so let it be.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When this world strikes its dulcet harp,
And earth our heav'n appears,
Be "Thine for ever," clean and sharp,
God's trumpet in our ears.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When sin in pleasure's soft disguise
Would work us deadliest harm,
May "Thine for ever" from the skies
Steal down, and break the charm.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When satan flings his fiery darts
Against our weary shield,
May "Thine for ever" in our hearts
Forbid us faint or yield.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thine all along the flow'ry spring,
Along the summer prime,
Till autumn fades in welcoming,
The silver frost of time.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: "Thine, Thine for ever," body, soul,
Henceforth devote to Thee,
While everlasting ages roll;
Amen, so let it be.

hymns.title: Quiet Be Thou My Heart

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Quiet be thou my heart
Thy Redeemer liveth
He that has given thee promise
Must surely fulfil it.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He holds you to follow
And He has brought you here
He would keep you safe through danger
Till the end of your life.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Once thou hast been thrown in
Nothing but dreadful sin
Thy repentant voice in the sin
Has made him to save you.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Rugged the way might seem
He is taking you home
When billows of life are over
Just all He has paid for.

hymns.title: Through the Love of God Our Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Through the love of God our Saviour,
All will be well;
Free and changeless is His favour,
All, all is well:
Precious is the blood that healed us;
Perfect is the grace that sealed us:
Strong the hand stretched forth to shield us,
All must be well.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Though we pass through tribulation,
All will be well;
Ours is such a full salvation,
All, all is well:
Happy still in God confiding;
Fruitful if in Christ abiding;
Holy through the Spirit's guiding;
All must be well.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We expect a bright tomorrow;
All will be well;
Faith can sing through day of sorrow,
All, all is well:
On our Father's love relying,
Jesus every need supplying,
Or in living or in dying,
All must be well.

hymns.title: My Hope Is Built on Nothing Less

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My hope is built on nothing less
Than Jesus’ blood and righteousness;
I dare not trust the sweetest frame,
But wholly lean on Jesus name.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: On Christ, the solid Rock, I stand;
All other ground is sinking sand,
All other ground is sinking sand.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When darkness seems to veil His face,
I rest on His unchanging grace;
In every high and stormy gale,
My anchor holds within the veil.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: On Christ, the solid Rock, I stand;
All other ground is sinking sand,
All other ground is sinking sand.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: His oath, His covenant, and blood,
Support me in the whelming flood;
When all around my soul gives way,
He then is all my hope and stay.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: On Christ, the solid Rock, I stand;
All other ground is sinking sand,
All other ground is sinking sand.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When He shall come with trumpet sound,
Oh, may I then in Him be found;
Dressed in His righteousness alone,
Faultless to stand before the throne.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: On Christ, the solid Rock, I stand;
All other ground is sinking sand,
All other ground is sinking sand.

hymns.title: Oh for a Faith that Will Not Shrink

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Oh for a faith that will not shrink,
Tho’ pressed by every foe,
That will not tremble on the brink
Of any earthly woe.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: That will not murmur nor
complain
Beneath the chastening rod,
But in the hour of grief or pain,
Will lean upon its God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: A faith that shines more bright and clear,
When tempests rage without;
That when in danger knows no fear
In darkness feels no doubt !

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: A faith that keeps the narrow way
Till life’s last spark is fled,
And with a pure and heavenly ray
Lights up the dying bed.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Lord, give us such a faith as this;
And then, whate’er may come,
We’ll taste, e’en here, the Hallowed bless
Of our eternal home!

hymns.title: Will Your Anchor Hold in the Storms of Life

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Will your anchor hold in the storms of life
When the clouds unfold their wings of strife?
When the strong tides lift, and the cables strain,
Will your anchor drift, or firm remain?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll;
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour’s love!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It is safely moored, ’twill the storm withstand,
For ’tis well secured by the Saviour’s hand,
And the cables, passed from His heart to mine,
Can defy the blast through strength divine.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll;
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour’s love!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: It will firmly hold in the straits of fear,
When the breakers have told the reef is near;
Though the tempest rage and the wild winds blow,
Not an angry wave shall our bark o’erflow:

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll;
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour’s love!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: It will surely hold in the flood of death,
When the waters cold, chill our latest breath,
On the rising tide it can never fail,
While our hopes abide within the veil!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll;
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour’s love!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: When our eyes behold, through the gathering night
The city of gold, our harbour bright,
We shall anchor fast by the heavenly shore,
With the storms all past for evermore.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll;
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour’s love!

hymns.title: O Jesus My Shepherd Thou Art

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Jesus my shepherd thou art
Let fear and distrust vanish
From the snares of lions and wolves
From devilish animal
His flock of sheep will He safe guard
Jesus will care for His own.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When my foes lay snares for my soul
Jesus hath said "He is mine"
For our redemption He has died
O Jesus Lord what a love!
Victory is his disposition
Jesus is invisible.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He guides me through the way of life
Near the gently flowing stream
In the flourishing green pastures
Where there is poisonous leaves
There I hear the voice of Jesus
There He makes me to rejoice.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When I am nearing the graveyard
Let there be fear on my way
Dauntless and fearless I shall be
Because our shepherd is nigh
When I behold His rod and staff
I know that His sheep rejoice.

hymns.title: Just Lean upon the Arms of Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Just lean upon the arms of Jesus,
He'll help you along, help you along;
If you will trust His love unfailing,
He'll fill your heart with song.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lean on His arms, trusting in His love;
Lean on His arms, all His mercies prove;
Lean on His arms, looking home above,
Just lean on the Saviour's arms!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Just lean upon the arms of Jesus,
He'll brighten the way, brighten the way:
Just follow gladly where He leadeth,
His gentle voice obey.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lean on His arms, trusting in His love;
Lean on His arms, all His mercies prove;
Lean on His arms, looking home above,
Just lean on the Saviour's arms!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Just lean upon the arms of Jesus,
Oh bring every care, bring every care!
The burden that has seeming so heavy,
Take to the Lord in prayer.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lean on His arms, trusting in His love;
Lean on His arms, all His mercies prove;
Lean on His arms, looking home above,
Just lean on the Saviour's arms!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Just lean upon the arms of Jesus,
Then leave all to Him, leave all to Him;
His heart is full of love, and mercy,
His eyes are never dim.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lean on His arms, trusting in His love;
Lean on His arms, all His mercies prove;
Lean on His arms, looking home above,
Just lean on the Saviour's arms!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Just lean upon the arms of Jesus,
He meets every need, Meets every need.
To all who take Him as a Saviour,
He is a Friend indeed.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lean on His arms, trusting in His love;
Lean on His arms, all His mercies prove;
Lean on His arms, looking home above,
Just lean on the Saviour's arms!

hymns.title: Who Can Cheer the Heart Like Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Who can cheer the heart like Jesus,
By His presence all divine?
True and tender, pure and precious,
O how blest to call Him mine!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All that thrills my soul is Jesus;
He is more than life to me;
And the fairest of ten thousand,
In my blessed Lord I see.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Love of Christ so freely given,
Grace of God beyond degree,
Mercy higher than the heaven,
Deeper than the deepest sea.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All that thrills my soul is Jesus;
He is more than life to me;
And the fairest of ten thousand,
In my blessed Lord I see.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: What a wonderful redemption!
Never can a mortal know
How my sin, tho' red like crimson,
Can be whiter than the snow.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All that thrills my soul is Jesus;
He is more than life to me;
And the fairest of ten thousand,
In my blessed Lord I see.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Ev'ry need His hand supplying,
Ev'ry good in Him I see;
On His strength divine relying,
He is all in all to me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All that thrills my soul is Jesus;
He is more than life to me;
And the fairest of ten thousand,
In my blessed Lord I see.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: By the crystal-flowing river
With the ransomed I will sing,
And forever and forever
Praise and glorify the King.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All that thrills my soul is Jesus;
He is more than life to me;
And the fairest of ten thousand,
In my blessed Lord I see.

hymns.title: God Sent His Son, They Called Him Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God sent His Son, they called Him Jesus,
He came to love, heal and forgive,
He lived and died to buy my pardon,
An empty grave is there to prove my Saviour lives.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Because he lives I can face tomorrow,
Because he lives all fear is gone;
Because I know He holds the future,
And life is worth the living, just because He lives.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: How sweet to hold a new-born baby,
And feel the pride and joy he gives;
But greater still, the calm assurance,
This child can face uncertain days
Because He lives.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Because he lives I can face tomorrow,
Because he lives all fear is gone;
Because I know He holds the future,
And life is worth the living, just because He lives.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And then one day I'll cross the river,
I'll fight life's final war with pain;
And then, as death gives way to victory,
I'll see the lights of glory and
I'll know He lives.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Because he lives I can face tomorrow,
Because he lives all fear is gone;
Because I know He holds the future,
And life is worth the living, just because He lives.

hymns.title: Weeping Will Not Save Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Weeping will not save me!
Though my face were bathed in tears
That could not allay my fears
Could not wash the sins of years
Weeping will not save me!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus wept and died for me,
Jesus suffered on the tree,
Jesus waits to make me free,
He alone can save me!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Working, will not save me!
Purest deeds that I can do
Holiest thoughts and feelings too
Cannot form my soul anew
Working will not save me!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus wept and died for me,
Jesus suffered on the tree,
Jesus waits to make me free,
He alone can save me!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Waiting will not save me!
Helpless, guilty, lost, I lie
In my ear is Mercy's cry,
If I wait I can but die
Waiting will not save me!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus wept and died for me,
Jesus suffered on the tree,
Jesus waits to make me free,
He alone can save me!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Faith in Christ will save me!
Let me trust Thy weeping Son
Trust the work that He has done,
To His arms, Lord, help me run
Faith in Christ will save me!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus wept and died for me,
Jesus suffered on the tree,
Jesus waits to make me free,
He alone can save me!

hymns.title: Give Me the Faith Which Can Remove

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Give me the faith which can remove
And sink the mountain to a plain;
Give me the child-like praying love,
Which longs to build Thy house again;
Thy love let it my heart o'er power,
And all my simple soul devour.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I want an even strong desire,
I want a calmly fervent zeal,
To have poor souls out of the fire,
To snatch them from the verge of hell,
And turn them to a pardoning God,
And quench the brands in Jesus' blood.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I would the precious time redeem,
And longer live for this alone,
To spend, and to be spent, for them
Who have not yet my Saviour known,
Fully on these my mission prove,
And only breathe, to breathe Thy love.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: My talents, gifts, and graces, Lord,
Into Thy blessed hands receive;
And let me live to preach Thy word,
And let me to Thy glory live;
My every sacred moment spend
Publishing the sinner's friend.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Enlarge, inflame, and fill my heart
With boundless charity divine!
So shall I all my strength exert,
And love them with a zeal like Thine;
And lead them to Thy open side,
The sheep for whom their Shepherd died.

hymns.title: In All Ways Chosen by the Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: In all ways chosen by the Lord
My journey will I go
Prevent me not ye holy men.
I will follow thee there.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: If Jesus moves in the furnace
I will follow thee there.
Prevent me not will be my word
If the world oppose me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: In adoration, temptation
With Thy command I'll go,
Prevent me not, for I will go
Unto Emmanuel.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And when my Saviour shall call me
And still my cry shall be,
Prevent me not, death is coming
I will follow with joy.

hymns.title: It Is Not Meet for Saints to Fear

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: It is not meet for Saints to fear,
Nor for them to despair,
For when they least expect His help;
The Saviour will appear.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When Abraham took up his knife,
God's voice said to him, "Stop"
The yonder ram caught by the horn
Shall substitute thy son.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When Jonah sank beneath the waves,
No hope of escape near
God sent a fish that swallowed him
And brought him to the shore.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: With such great might and love as this,
Abounding in His word;
I pray to bring my anxious cares
And leave them all to Him.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Lift up your eyes and wait His help
It may be long but wait;
Though the promise may tarry long,
It soon shall come to pass.

hymns.title: O Weary Heart, There Is a Home

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O weary heart, there is a home,
Beyond the reach of toil and care;
A home where changes never come;
Who would not fain be resting there?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O wait, meekly wait, and murmur not!
O wait, meekly wait, and murmur not!
Oh wait, oh wait, oh wait, and murmur not!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Yet when bowed down beneath the load
By heaven allowed, thine earthly lot;
Look up! thou 'lt reach that blest abode;
Wait, meekly wait, and murmur not!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O wait, meekly wait, and murmur not!
O wait, meekly wait, and murmur not!
Oh wait, oh wait, oh wait, and murmur not!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: If in thy path some thorns are found,
Oh, think who bore them on His brow;
If grief thy sorrowing heart has found,
It reached a holier than thou.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O wait, meekly wait, and murmur not!
O wait, meekly wait, and murmur not!
Oh wait, oh wait, oh wait, and murmur not!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Toil on! nor deem, though sore it be,
One sigh unheard, one prayer forgot;
The day of rest will dawn for thee;
Wait, meekly wait, and murmur not!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O wait, meekly wait, and murmur not!
O wait, meekly wait, and murmur not!
Oh wait, oh wait, oh wait, and murmur not!

hymns.title: My Faith Looks up to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My faith looks up to Thee,
Thou Lamb of Calvary,
Saviour divine!
Now hear me while I pray,
Take all my guilt away,
O let me from this day
Be wholly Thine!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: May Thy rich grace impart
Strength to my fainting heart,
My zeal inspire;
As Thou hast died for me,
O may my love to Thee
Pure, warm and changeless be
A living fire!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: While life's dark maze I tread,
And grief around me spread,
Be Thou my guide;
Bid darkness turn to day,
Wipe sorrow's tears away,
Nor let me ever stray
From Thee aside.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When ends life's transient dream,
When death's cold sullen stream
Shall o'er me roll;
Blest Saviour, then in love,
Fear and distrust remove;
O bear me safe above,
A ransomed soul.

hymns.title: Be Gone, Unbelief; My Saviour Is Near

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Be gone, unbelief; my Saviour is near,
And for my relief will surely appear:
By prayer let me wrestle, and He will perform;
With Christ in the vessel, I smile at the storm.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Though dark be my way, since He is my guide,
'Tis mine to obey 'tis His to provide
Though cisterns be broken and creatures all fail,
The word He hath spoken shall surely prevail.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: His love in time past forbids me to think
He'll leave me at last in trouble to sink;
While each Ebenezer I have in review
Confirms His good pleasure to help me quite through.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Why should I complain of want or distress,
Temptation or pain? He told me no less;
The heirs of salvation, I know from His word,
Through much tribulation must follow their Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: How bitter that cup no heart can conceive,
Which He drank quite up that sinners might live!
His way was much rougher and darker than mine
Did Christ my Lord suffer and shall I repine?

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Since all that I meet shall work for my good,
The bitter is sweet, the medicine, food;
Though painful at present, 'twill cease before long;
And then, O how pleasant the conqueror's song!

hymns.title: I've Found a Friend in Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I've found a friend in Jesus, He's everything to me,
He's the fairest of ten thousand to my soul;
The Lily of the Valley, in Him alone I see
All I need to cleanse and make me fully whole.
In sorrow He's my comfort, in trouble He's my stay,
He tells me every care on Him to roll: (Halleluyah!)

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He's the Lily of the Valley, the Bright and Morning Star,
He's the Fairest of ten thousand to my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He all my griefs has taken, and all my sorrows borne;
In temptation He's my strong and mighty tower;
I have all for Him forsaken, and all my idols torn,
From my heart, and now He keeps me by His power.
Though all the world forsake me, and satan tempt me sore,
Through Jesus I shall safely reach the goal, (Halleluyah!)

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He's the Lily of the Valley, the Bright and Morning Star,
He's the Fairest of ten thousand to my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He'll never, never leave me, nor yet forsake me here,
While I live by faith, and do His blessed will;
A wall of fire about me, I've nothing now to fear;
With His manna, He my hungry soul shall fill.
Then sweeping up to glory, to see His blessed face,
Where rivers of delight shall ever roll! (Halleluyah!).

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He's the Lily of the Valley, the Bright and Morning Star,
He's the Fairest of ten thousand to my soul.

hymns.title: I Am Coming to the Cross

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I am coming to the cross,
I am poor and weak and blind;
I am counting all but dross;
I shall full Salvation find.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am trusting, Lord, in Thee,
Dear Lamb of Calvary,
Humbly at the cross I bow,
Save me, Jesus, save me now.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In the promises I trust;
Now I feel the blood applied;
I am prostrate in the dust;
I with Christ am crucified.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am trusting, Lord, in Thee,
Dear Lamb of Calvary,
Humbly at the cross I bow,
Save me, Jesus, save me now.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Here I give my all to Thee,
Friends and time and earthly store,
Soul and body Thine to be
Wholly Thine forever more.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am trusting, Lord, in Thee,
Dear Lamb of Calvary,
Humbly at the cross I bow,
Save me, Jesus, save me now.

hymns.title: Tho' The World Allure with Its Gilded Charm

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Tho' the world allure with its gilded charm,
I'm a child of God whom it cannot harm;
He will uphold me by His mighty arm,
Ev'ry moment of my day;

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I've a friend who will ev'ry need supply,
I've a home, far beyond the starry sky,
And you know, that is just the reason why,
I am singing Hallelujah!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I can ne'er forget how upon the tree
Laid the Son of God, there to die for me;
Yet to save my soul, thus it had to be,
There could be no other way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I've a friend who will ev'ry need supply,
I've a home, far beyond the starry sky,
And you know, that is just the reason why,
I am singing Hallelujah!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I would e'er be true to my Lord and King,
Ev'ry waking hour praises to Him sing,
Knowing that at last He my soul shall bring,
Evermore with Him to stay.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I've a friend who will ev'ry need supply,
I've a home, far beyond the starry sky,
And you know, that is just the reason why,
I am singing Hallelujah!

hymns.title: He Will Answer Every Pray'r

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: He will answer every pray'r
This, His promise and His will
He has never chang'd nor fail'd
Glory to His name.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He will answer every pray'r
To His promise I will cling
I know He'll ne'er deceive me,
Glory to His name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He will answer every pray'r
Let us ask from Him in faith,
With his Holy Spirit's help
Glory to His name.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He will answer every pray'r
Come thou to the mercy seat
Blest assurance you'll receive,
Glory to His name.

hymns.title: O Lord, Turn Not Thy Face Away

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Lord, turn not Thy face away
From them that lowly lie;
Lamenting sore their sinful life
With tears and bitter cry.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thy mercy's gates are open wide
To them that mourn their sin:
O shut then not against us, Lord!
But let us enter in.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We need not to confess our fault,
For surely Thou canst tell;
What we have done and what we are
Thou knowest very well.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Wherefore to beg and to entreat,
With tears we come to Thee,
As children that have done amiss
Fall at their father's knee.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And need we then, O Lord, repeat
The blessing which we crave,
When Thou dost know before we speak
The thing that we would have?

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Mercy, O Lord! mercy we ask,
This is the total sum:
For mercy, Lord, is all our pray'r,
O let Thy mercy come! Amen.

hymns.title: Lord Jesus, Think on Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord Jesus, think on me,
And purge away my sin;
From earth born passions set me free,
And make me pure within.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lord Jesus, think on me,
With many a care oppress'd
Let me Thy loving servant be,
And taste Thy promised rest.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Lord Jesus, think on me,
Amid the battle's strife;
In all my pain and misery
Be thou my health and life.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lord Jesus, think on me,
Nor let me go astray;
Through darkness and perplexity,
Point Thou the heav'nly way.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Lord Jesus, think on me,
That, when the flood is past,
I may the eternal brightness see
And share Thy joy at last.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Lord Jesus, think on me,
That I may sing above,
To Father, Holy Ghost, and Thee,
The songs of praise and love.

hymns.title: Wherewith, O God, Shall I Draw Near

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Wherewith, O God, shall I draw near,
And bow myself before Thy face?
How in Thy purer eyes appear?
What shall I bring to gain Thy grace?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Whoe'er to Thee themselves approve
Must take the path Thy word hath showed,
Justice pursue, and mercy love,
And humbly walk by faith with God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: But though my life henceforth be Thine,
Present for past can ne'er atone;
Though I to Thee the whole resign,
I only give Thee back Thine own.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: What have I then wherein to trust?
I nothing have, I nothing am;
Excluded is my every boast,
My glory swallow'd up in shame.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Guilty I stand before Thy face,
On me I feel Thy wrath abide;
'Tis just the sentence should take place,
'Tis just but O Thy Sone hath died!

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Jesus, the Lamb of God, hath bled,
He bore our sins upon the tree;
Beneath our curse He bow'd His head;
'Tis finished! He hath died for me!

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: See where before the throne He stands,
And pours the all-prevailing prayer;
Points to His side, and lifts His hands,
And shows that I am graven there.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: He ever lives for me to pray;
He prays that I with Him may reign;
Amen to what my Lord doth say!
Jesus, Thou hast not pray in vain.

hymns.title: No, Not Despairingly

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: No, not despairingly
Come I to Thee
No, not distrustingly
Bend I the knee;
Sin hath gone over me,
Yet is this still my plea;
Yet is this still my plea;
Jesus hath died.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Ah! mine iniquity
Crison has been,
Infinite, infinite,
Sin upon sin;
Sin of not loving Thee,
Sin of not trusting Thee,
Sin of not trusting Thee,
Infinite sin.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Lord, I confess to Thee
Sadly my sin,
All I am tell I Thee
All I have been
Purge Thou my sin away
Wash Thou my soul this day;
Wash Thou my soul this day;
Lord, make me clean.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Faithful and just art Thou,
Forgiving all;
Low at Thy pierced feet
Saviour I fall
Lord, let the cleansing blood,
Blood of the Lamb of God,
Blood of the Lamb of God,
Pass o'er my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Then all is peace and light
This soul within;
Thus shall I walk with Thee,
The loved Unseen;
Leaning on Thee, my God
Guided along the road,
Guided along the road,
Nothing between.

hymns.title: Jesus, Meek and Gentle

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, meek and gentle
Son of God most High
Pitying, loving Saviour,
Hear Thy children's cry.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Pardon our offences,
Loose our captive chains,
Break down every idol
Which our soul detains.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Give us holy freedom,
Fill our hearts with love;
Draw us, holy Jesus,
To the realms above.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lead us on our journey,
Be Thyself the way
Through terrestrial darkness
To celestial day.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Jesus, meek and gentle,
Son of God most High;
Pitying, loving Saviour,
Hear my children's cry.
