hymns.title: Pass Me Not, O Gentle Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Pass me not, O gentle Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saviour, Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let me, at Thy throne of mercy
Find a sweet relief;
Kneeling there in deep contrition,
Help my unbelief.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saviour, Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Trusting only in Thy merit
Would I seek Thy face
Heal my wounded, broken spirit,
Save me by Thy grace.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saviour, Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou, the spring of all my comfort,
More than life to me.
Whom have I on earth beside Thee?
Whom in heaven but Thee?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Saviour, Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

hymns.title: More Holiness Give Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: More holiness give me,
More striving within;
More patience in suff'ring,
More sorrow for sin;
More faith in my Saviour,
More sense of His care;
More joy in His service,
More purpose in prayer.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: More gratitude give me,
More trust in the Lord;
More zeal for His glory,
More hope in His word;
More tears for His sorrows,
More pains at His grief;
More meekness in trial,
More praise for relief.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: More purity give me,
More strength to o'ercome;
More freedom from earth-stains,
More longing for home;
More fit for Thy kingdom,
O Lord would I be,
More fruitful, more holy;
More, Saviour, like Thee.

hymns.title: Command Thy Blessing From Above

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Command Thy blessing from above,
O God, on all assembled here;
Behold us with a Father's love;
While we look up with trembling fear.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Command Thy blessing Jesus, Lord,
May we Thy true disciples be;
Speak, to each heart, the mighty word;
Say to the weakest, Follow me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Command Thy blessing, in this hour,
Spirit of truth, and fill this place
With humbling and with healing power:
With quickening and confirming grace.

hymns.title: Prayer Is the Soul's Sincere Desire

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Prayer is the soul's sincere desire;
Uttered or unexpressed:
The motion of a hidden fire
That trembles in the breast.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Prayer is the burden of a sigh;
The falling of a tear,
The upward glancing of an eye,
When none but God is near.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Prayer is the simplest form of speech,
That infant lips can try:
Prayer, the sublimest strains that reach
The Majesty on high.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Prayer is the Christian's Vital breath;
The Christian's native air:
His watchword at the gates of death,
He enters heaven with prayer.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: The saints in prayer appear as one,
In word, and deed, and mind;
While with the Father and the Son,
Sweet fellowship they find.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: O Thou by Whom we come to God,
The life, the Truth, the Way!
The path of prayer Thyself hast trod,
Lord, teach us how to pray!

hymns.title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: What a friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear;
What a privilege to carry
Ev'rything to God in prayer.
Oh, what peace we often forfeit,
Oh, what needless pain we bear
All because we do not carry
Ev'rything to God in prayer.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged,
Take it to the Lord in prayer,
Can we find a friend so faithful,
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our ev'ry weakness,
Take it to the Lord in prayer.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Are we weak and heavy laden,
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Saviour, still our refuge,
Take it to the Lord in prayer,
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
In His arms He'll take and shield thee,
Thou wilt find a solace there.

hymns.title: From Ev'ry Stormy Wind that Blows

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: From ev'ry stormy wind that blows,
From ev'ry swelling tide of woes,
There is a calm, a sure retreat;
'Tis found beneath the mercy seat.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There is a place where Jesus sheds
The oil of gladness on our heads
A place than all beside more sweet;
It is the blood stained mercy-seat.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There is a scene where spirits blend,
And friend holds fellowship with friend;
Though sundered far, by faith we meet
Around one common mercy seat.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There, there on eagle wing we soar,
And time and sense seem all no more;
And heaven comes down our souls to greet,
And glory crowns the mercy seat.

hymns.title: Jesus, Where'er Thy People Meet

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, where'er thy people meet,
There they behold Thy Mercy-seat;
Where'er they seek Thee, Thou art found,
And every place is hallow'd ground.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For Thou, within no walls confined,
Inhabitest the humble mind;
Such ever bring Thee where they come,
And, going, take Thee to their home.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Dear shepherd of Thy chosen few,
Thy former mercies here renew;
Here to our waiting hearts proclaim
The sweetness of thy Saving Name.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Here may we prove the power of prayer,
To strengthen faih, and sweeten care,
To teach our faint desires to rise,
And bring all heaven before our eyes.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Lord, we are few, but Thou art near,
Nor short Thine arm, nor deaf Thine ear;
O rend the heavens, come quickly down,
And make all hearts, O Lord, Thine own.

hymns.title: Sweet Hour of Prayer! Sweet Hour of Prayer!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer!
That calls me from a world of care,
And bids me at my Father's throne
Make all my want and wishes known;
In seasons of distress and grief,
My soul has often found relief,
And oft escaped the tempter's snare,
By the return, sweet hour of prayer.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer!
Thy wings shall my petition bear,
To Him whose truth and faithfulness
Engage the waiting soul to bless;
And since He bids me seek His face,
Believe His word and trust His grace,
I'll cast on Him my every care,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer!
May I thy consolation share,
Till, from Mount Pisgah's lofty height,
I view my home, and take my flight:
This robe of flesh I'll drop, and rise
To seize the ever lasting prize;
And shout while passing through the air,
Farewell, farewell, sweet hour of prayer.

hymns.title: Pray, Always Pray; the Holy Spirit Pleads

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Pray, always pray; the Holy Spirit pleads,
Within thee all thy daily hourly needs.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Pray, always pray; beneath sin's heaviest load
Prayer sees the blood from Jesus' side that flow'd.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Pray, always pray; though weary, faint, and lone,
Prayer nestless by the Father's shelt'ring throne.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Pray, always pray; amid the world's turmoil
Prayer keeps the heart at rest, and nerves for toil.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Pray, always pray; if joys thy pathway throng
Prayer strikes the harp and sings the angel's song.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Pray, always pray; if loved one pass the veil
Prayer drinks with them of springs that cannot fail.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: All earthly things with earth shall fade away,
Prayer grasps eternity, pray always pray.

hymns.title: Divine Father of All Creatures

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Divine Father of all creatures,
Hearken Thou unto our pray'rs
With Thy grace and mercy fill us
Thy disciple we may be.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Bless us Father we beseech Thee
Answer our supplications
Let us not go empty handed
Bless us with Thy goodness Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All those that sought Thee in thy days
No one empty handed went
As their necessity so great
They receiv'd blessing from Thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Bless us Father we beseech Thee
Answer our supplications
Let us not go empty handed
Bless us with Thy goodness Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Our kneeling ere one before Thee
But with different request came
The infirmities want reliefs
And the needy wants blessings.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Bless us Father we beseech Thee
Answer our supplications
Let us not go empty handed
Bless us with Thy goodness Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Give unto us, our request now
Lord, as we look unto Thee
That all who are here with joy say
Our request are now fulfilled.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Bless us Father we beseech Thee
Answer our supplications
Let us not go empty handed
Bless us with Thy goodness Lord.

hymns.title: Come, Jesus Reveal Thyself

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, Jesus reveal Thyself
Come, our hearts teach to know Thee
Come, and set our hearts on fire
Come, and bless us ere we part.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Come, put peace within our hearts,
Come, that we all may be blessed,
Come, and speak the words of peace,
Come, our faith increase, O Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Come, make all our doubtings flee
Come, and teach us how to pray,
Come, and fill our hearts with love,
Come, and lift our hearts to heaven.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Come, and make our hearts rejoice,
Come, and say, "You are my choice,"
Come, Thy fold in safety keep
Come, and bless Thy sheep today.

hymns.title: Shepherd Divine, Our Wants Relieve

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Shepherd divine, our wants relieve,
In this our evil day;
To all Thy tempted follow'rs give
The pow'r to watch and pray.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Long as our fiery trials last,
Long as the cross we bear,
O let our souls on Thee be cast
In never ceasing prayer!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Spirit of interceding grace,
Give us in faith to claim,
To wrestle till we see Thy face,
And know Thy hidden name.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Till Thou Thy perfect love impart,
Till Thou Thyself bestow,
Be this the cry of every heart,
I will not let Thee go.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: I will not let Thee go, unless
Thou tell Thy name to me,
With all Thy great salvation bless,
And make me all like Thee!

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Then let me on the mountain top
Behold Thy open face
Where faith in sight is swallowed up
And pray'r in endless praise.

hymns.title: Heav'nly Father I Stretch My Hand to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Heav'nly Father I stretch my hand to Thee
There's no other help that is known to me
Thou who covered us with beauty like robe,
With Thy blessing O Lord, now put me on.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Head of the church on earth and triumphant,
Recreate me with Thy Holy Spirit,
Make use of my thoughts, my soul and spirit,
That I may do the work, of my calling.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O God, Thou Creator of all mankind,
O let me find Thee, seek Thee and love Thee
To love and behave well to all people
And to resemble Thee in miracle.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou Fount of blessing of love and of joy
Make me to shine like sun in Thy Kingdom,
And from this world, that I may be for Thee
To have the joy and blessing of the heav'n.

hymns.title: Go when the Morning Shineth

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Go when the morning shineth
Go, when the noon is bright;
Go, when the eve declineth;
Go, in the hush of night;
Go with pure mind and feeling
Fling earthly cares away,
And in thy chamber kneeling
Do thou in secret pray.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Remember all who love thee,
All who are loved by thee;
Pray too for those who hate thee,
If any such there be:
Then for thyself in meekness
A blessing humbly claim,
And link with each petition,
Thy great Redeemer's name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Or if 'tis here denied thee
In solitude to pray,
Should holy thoughts come o'er thee,
When friends are round thy way,
E'en then the silent pleading,
Of thy heart raised above
Will reach His throne of glory,
Who's mercy, truth, and love.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh, not a joy or blessing,
With this can we compare:
The pow'r that He has giv'n us
To pour our souls in pray'r;
Where'er thou pin'st in sadness,
Before His footstool fall,
Remember in thy gladness
His grace who gives thee all.

hymns.title: Here in Thy Name We Are Gathered

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Here in Thy name we are gathered,
Come and revive us, O Lord;
"There shall be showers of blessing,"
Thou hast declar'd in Thy word.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, graciously hear us,
Graciously hear us we pray:
Pour from Thy windows up-on us
Showers of blessing today.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh! that the showers of blessing
Now on our souls may descend,
While at the footstool of mercy
Pleading Thy promise we bend!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, graciously hear us,
Graciously hear us we pray:
Pour from Thy windows up-on us
Showers of blessing today.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: "There shall be showers of blessing,"
Promise that never can fail;
Thou wilt regard our petition;
Surely our faith will prevail.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, graciously hear us,
Graciously hear us we pray:
Pour from Thy windows up-on us
Showers of blessing today.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Showers of blessing, we need them,
Showers of blessing from Thee;
Showers of blessing, oh, grant them,
Thine all the glory shall be.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, graciously hear us,
Graciously hear us we pray:
Pour from Thy windows up-on us
Showers of blessing today.

hymns.title: Be Thou My Vision, O Lord of My Heart

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Be Thou my Vision, O Lord of my heart;
Naught be all else to me, save that Thou art,
Thou my best thought, by day or by night.
Walking or sleeping, Thy presence my light.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Be Thou my Wisdom, Thou my true Word;
I ever with Thee, Thou with me, Lord;
Thou my great Father, I Thy true son;
Thou in me dwelling, and I with Thee one.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Be Thou my battle-shield, sword for the fight,
Be Thou my dignity; Thou my delight,
Thou my soul's shelter, Thou my high tower;
Raise Thou me heavenward, O Power of my power.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Riches I heed not, nor man's empty praise,
Thou mine inheritance, now and always:
Thou and Thou only, first in my heart,
High King of heaven, my treasure Thou art.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: High King of heaven, after victory won,
May I reach heaven's joys, O bright heaven's Sun!
Heart of my own heart, whatever befall,
Still be my Vision, O Ruler of all.

hymns.title: What Various Hindrances We Meet

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: What various hindrances we meet,
In coming to the mercy-seat!
Yet who that knows the worth of prayer
But wishes to be often there?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Pray'r makes the darken'd cloud withdraw;
Pray'r climbs the ladder Jacob saw,
Give exercise to faith and love,
Brings every blessing from above.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Restraining pray'r, we cease to fight;
Pray'r makes the Christian's armour bright;
And Saints trembles when he sees
The weakest saint upon his knees.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O Lord, increase our faith and love,
That we may all Thy goodness prove,
And gain from Thy exhaustless store
The fruits of prayer for evermore.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Were half the breath thus vainly spent,
To heav'n in supplication sent,
Our cheerful song would oftener be,
Hear what the Lord hath done for me.

hymns.title: Saviour, Again to Thy Dear Name We Raise

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Saviour, again to Thy dear name we raise
With one accord our parting hymn of praise;
We stand to bless Thee ere our worship cease
Then, lowly kneeling, wait Thy word of peace.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Grant us Thy peace upon our homeward way;
With Thee began, with Thee shall end the day;
Guard Thou the lips from sin, the hearts from shame.
That in this house have called upon Thy name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Grant us Thy peace, Lord, through the coming night,
Turn Thou for us its darkness into light;
From harm and danger keep Thy children free,
For dark and light are both alike to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Grant us Thy peace throughout our earthly life,
Our balm in sorrow, and our stay in strife;
Then, when Thy voice shall bid our conflict cease,
Call us, O Lord, to Thine eternal peace.

hymns.title: Thou My Everlasting Portion

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thou my everlasting portion
More than friend or life to me
All along my pilgrim journey
Saviour let me walk with Thee.
Close to Thee, close to Thee,
Close to Thee, close to Thee.
All along my pilgrim journey
Saviour, let me walk with Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Not for ease or worldly pleasure
Nor for fame my prayer shall be
Gladly will I toil and suffer
Only let me walk with Thee.
Close to Thee, close to Thee,
Close to Thee, close to Thee.
Gladly will I toil and suffer
Only let me walk with

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Lead me through the vale of shadows
Bear me o’er life’s fitful sea
Then the gate of life eternal
May I enter, Lord, with Thee
Close to Thee, close to Thee,
Close to Thee, dose to Thee.
Then the gate of life eternal
May I enter, Lord with Thee.

hymns.title: Abide with Us Oh in Thy Grace

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Abide with us oh in thy grace
Lord Jesus my Saviour
That never trickish creature
Militate against us.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Abide with us just in Thy word
The only precious Lord
We may have life in salvation
Yonder and here beneath.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Abide with us in thy blessing
The most glorious Saviour
Give thy good heavenly blessing
To us in abundance.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Protect me always oh my Lord
Thou powerful Saviour
That he may sidetrack enemies
To go out of bondage.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Abide with us in thy truth Lord
Oh our merciful God
In afflictions abide with us
Let us surely endure.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Abide with us in thy peace Lord
When death these close our eyes
At that crucial moment O Lord
Speak salvation to us.

hymns.title: Jesus Shepherd of Thy Sheep

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus Shepherd of Thy sheep,
Be merciful unto me;
Lead me and preserve me Lord,
Till Thy love is perfected:
Make me to love well in Thee,
Let my faith be perfected.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I can't wait any longer,
In faith I'm pleading to Thee,
But Thou Lord, remain the same,
The past, today, and future
Make me steadfastly to be,
Strengthen my soul with Thy grace.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let Thy faith uphold me Lord,
In the world's tribulation,
Let holy expectation
Be the anchor of my soul;
Make me perfect in Thy love,
And for ever to be Thine.

hymns.title: Give Me a Gentle Heart

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Give me a gentle heart
Fill'd with meekness,
Diligent heart like Thine
Jesus, my Lord
Humbleness and patience
A heart of compassion,
In every small detail
To be like Him.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Give me contentment in
All conditions
Be it e'en humbler than
His lowly birth
Give me Thou Thy comfort
Give me also Thy help
In every small detail
To be like Him.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Give me enthusiasm
In things of Thine
Earnestness and more love
For things of heav'n
Give me a holy heart
Give me hatred for sin
In every small detail
To be like Him.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Give me a heart of faith
A hope in Thee
Give joy of salvation
In Jesus Christ
Give me a living soul
Give a crown of glory
And when I shall awake
To be like Him.

hymns.title: Hear Thou My Pray'r, O Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hear Thou my pray'r, O Lord,
And listen to my cry;
Remember now Thy faithful word,
And graciously reply.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Do not in judgement rise
Thy servant's life to scan,
For righteous in Thy spotless eyes
Is found no living man.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I stretch my longing hands
Toward Thy holy place,
With soul a thirst, like weary lands,
For Thy refreshing grace.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Haste Thee, O Lord, I pray
My failing heart to save!
Hide not Thy face; I droop as they
That sink into the grave.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thy mercy's early light
My faith desires to see;
O let me walk before Thy sight!
I lift my soul to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Let Thy good Spirit lead
My feet in righteous ways:
And for Thy name's sake, Lord, my head
Above my troubles raise.

hymns.title: When at Thy Footstool, Lord, I Bend

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When at Thy footstool, Lord, I bend,
And plead with thee for mercy there,
Think of the sinner's dying Friend,
And for His sake receive my prayer.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh think not of my shame and guilt,
My thousand stains of deepest dye;
Think of the blood which Jesus split,
My pardon and my life to buy.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Think, Lord, how I am still Thine own,
The trembling creature of Thy hand;
Think how my heart to sin is prone,
And what temptations round me stand.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh think upon Thy holy word
And every plighted promise there;
How pray'r should evermore be heard,
And how Thy glory is to spare.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Oh think not of my doubts and fears,
My strivings with Thy grace divine,
Think upon Jesus' woes and tears,
And let His merits stand for mine.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Thine eye, Thine ear, they are not dull;
Thine arm can never shorten'd be;
Behold me here; my heart is full,
Behold, and spare, and succour me.

hymns.title: The Hallowed Morn Is Dear to Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The hallowed morn is dear to me,
When prayer and praise awake the day,
Or friends with sacred minstrelsy,
Call me from earthly cares away.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: And dear to me the scared hour
Employed within Thy courts, O Lord!
To feel devotion's soothing power,
And taste the manna of Thy word.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And dear to me the loud "Amen,"
Which echoes through the blest abode,
Which swells, and sinks, and swells again,
Dies on the walls, but lives with God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In secret I have often prayed,
And still the anxious tears would fall;
But on Thy secret altar laid,
The fire descends and dries them all.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Let men of pleasure strike their lyre,
Of broken Sabbaths sing the charms,
But I, in prayer's swift car of fire,
Will rise to Jesus's sheltering arms.

hymns.title: The God Who Led His People Thro' The Parted Sea

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The God who led His people thro' the parted sea,
And from Egyptian bondage set His children free,
Who rained down bread from heaven all the pilgrim way
Is the God to whom I pray.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just the same today,
Just the same today,
As when He led His people tho' the sea,
His trustful child I'll be,
For in His word I see,
The God who doeth wonders'
Is just the same today.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The God who rescued Daniel from the lion's den,
And from the fiery furnace sav'd the three young men,
Who speak, and constellation will His voice obey,
Is the God to whom I pray.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just the same today,
Just the same today,
As when He led His people tho' the sea,
His trustful child I'll be,
For in His word I see,
The God who doeth wonders'
Is just the same today.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The God who stills the tempest with a word divine,
And on the clouds of sorrow makes His rainbows shine,
Who from the tomb of Jesus rolled the stone away,
Is the God to whom I pray.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just the same today,
Just the same today,
As when He led His people tho' the sea,
His trustful child I'll be,
For in His word I see,
The God who doeth wonders'
Is just the same today.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The God who clothes the lilly in its robe of snow,
Who in the barren desert makes His rivers flow,
The God who lifts the sinner from the miry clay,
Is the God to whom I pray.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Just the same today,
Just the same today,
As when He led His people tho' the sea,
His trustful child I'll be,
For in His word I see,
The God who doeth wonders'
Is just the same today.

hymns.title: In the Hour of Trial

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: In the hour of trial,
Jesus, pray for me,
Lest by base denial,
I depart from Thee;
When thou seest me waver,
With a look recall
Nor for fear or favour
Suffer me to fall.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: With its witching pleasures
Would this vain world charm,
Or its sordid treasures
Spread to work me harm,
Bring to my remembrance
Said Gethsemane,
Or in darker semblance,
Cross-crown'd Calvary.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: If with sore affliction
Thou in love chastise,
Pour Thy benediction
On the sacrifice,
Then, upon Thine altar,
Freely offer'd up,
Though the flesh may falter,
Faith shall drink the cup.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When in dust and ashes,
To the grave I sink,
While heaven's glory flashes
O'er the shelving brink,
On Thy truth relying,
Through that mortal strife,
Lord, receive me, dying,
To eternal life.

hymns.title: To Thee Our God We Fly

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: To Thee our God we fly,
For mercy and for grace;
O hear our lowly cry,
And hide not Thou Thy face!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord, stretch forth Thy mighty hand,
And guard and bless our fatherland.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Arise, O Lord of Hosts,
Be jealous for Thy name,
And drive from out our coasts,
The sins that put to shame.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord, stretch forth Thy mighty hand,
And guard and bless our fatherland.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thy best gifts from on high
In rich abundance pour,
That we may magnify
And praise Thee more and more.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord, stretch forth Thy mighty hand,
And guard and bless our fatherland.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The pow'rs ordained by Thee
With heav'nly wisdom bless;
May they Thy servants be,
And rule in righteousness.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord, stretch forth Thy mighty hand,
And guard and bless our fatherland.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: The church of Thy dear Son,
In flame with love's pure fire;
Bind her once more in one,
And life and truth inspire.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord, stretch forth Thy mighty hand,
And guard and bless our fatherland.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: The pastors of Thy fold
With grace and pow'r endue,
That, faithful, pure, and bold,
They may be pastors true.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord, stretch forth Thy mighty hand,
And guard and bless our fatherland.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: O let us love Thy house
And sanctify Thy day,
Bring unto Thee our vows
And loyal homage pay.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord, stretch forth Thy mighty hand,
And guard and bless our fatherland.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Give peace, Lord, in our time:
O let no foe draw nigh,
Nor lawless deed of crime.
Insult Thy majesty.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord, stretch forth Thy mighty hand,
And guard and bless our fatherland.

sections.label: VERSE 9
pairs: Though weak and wayward, still
Thy people, Lord, are we;
And for our God we will
None other have but Thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O Lord, stretch forth Thy mighty hand,
And guard and bless our fatherland.

hymns.title: There Is an Eye that Never Sleeps

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is an eye that never sleeps,
Beneath the wing of night;
There is an ear that never shuts,
When sink the beams of light.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There is an arm that never tires,
When human strength gives way;
There is a love that never fails,
When earthly loves decay.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The eye is fix'd on seraph throngs;
That arm upholds the sky;
That ear is fill'd with angel song:
That love is throned on high.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: But there's a power, which man can wield
When mortal aid is vain,
That eye, that arm, that love to reach,
That listening ear to gain.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: That power is prayer, which soars on high
Through Jesus to the throne,
And moves the hand, which moves the world.
To bring salvation down.

hymns.title: Our Blessed Lord, in This Thy Presence Sweet

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Our blessed Lord, in this Thy presence sweet,
Behold us lowly bending at Thy feet,
Vain would we meet Thee on this hallowed ground
Where ev'ry Blood-bought blessing may be found.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Drawn by the strength of Thine own mighty love,
Gladly we come Thy healing touch to prove.
All power is Thine - we echo back Thy word,
In heaven and earth, Thou never changing Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We grasp Thy promises so sure, so free,
To all who in their weakness call on Thee.
Th'effectual fervent prayer Thou dost receive,
With strength renewing all who dare believe.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: If to Thine eye that pierces deep within
There stands refilled the hidden stain of sin
Still unconfessed, Oh, grant us grace that we
May purge our lives afresh and purer be.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thus joined to Thee our living Head above,
Thy life was share, and in Thy truimph move;
Knit with our fellow members here below,
From strength to strength we shall Thy fullness know.

hymns.title: Father, Again in Jesus' Name We Meet

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Father, again in Jesus' name we meet,
And bow in penitence beneath Thy feet:
Again to Thee our feeble voices raise,
To sue for mercy, and to sing Thy praise.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lord, we would bless Thee for Thy ceaseless care,
And all Thy love from day to day declare:
Is not our life with hourly mercies crown'd?
Does not Thine arm encircled us around?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Alas! unworthy of Thy boundless love,
Too oft with careless feet from Thee we rove:
But now, encouraged by Thy voice, we come,
Returning sinners to a Father's home.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh, by that name, in whom all fulness dwells,
Oh, by that love, which every love excels,
Oh, by that blood, so freely shed for sin,
Open blest mercy's gate, and take us in!

hymns.title: Coming Now to Thee, O Christ My Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Coming now to Thee, O Christ my Lord,
Trusting only in Thy precious word,
Let my humble prayer to Thee be heard,
And send a great revival in my soul.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Send a great revival in my soul,
Send a great revival in my soul;
Let the Holy Spirit come and take control,
And send a great revival in my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Send a great revival, Lord, in me,
Help me that I may rejoice in Thee;
Give we strength to win the victory,
And send a great revival in my soul

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Send a great revival in my soul,
Send a great revival in my soul;
Let the Holy Spirit come and take control,
And send a great revival in my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Help me go for Thee, dear Lord, today,
To some lonely soul that's gone astray;
Help me lead them in the homeward way,
Oh, send a great revival in my soul.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Send a great revival in my soul,
Send a great revival in my soul;
Let the Holy Spirit come and take control,
And send a great revival in my soul.

hymns.title: Jesus! And Shall It Ever Be

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus! And shall it ever be,
A mortal man ashamed of Thee,
Ashamed of Thee, whom angels praise,
Whose glories shine through endless days?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Ashamed of Jesus! Sooner far
Let evening blush to own a star,
He sheds the beams of light divine
O'er this benighted soul of mine.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Ashamed of Jesus! Just as soon
Let midnight be ashamed of noon;
'Tis midnight with my soul till He,
Bright Morning Star, bid darkness flee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Ashamed of Jesus, that dear Friend
On whom my hopes of heaven depend!
No! when I blush; be this my shame,
That I no more revere His name.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Ashamed of Jesus! Yes I may
When I've no guilt to wash away,
No tear to wipe, no good to crave,
No fear to quell, no soul to save,

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Till then-nor is my boasting vain
Till then I boast a Saviour slain,
And O may this my glory be,
That Christ is not ashamed of me!

hymns.title: O Jesus Thou Lamb of God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Jesus Thou Lamb of God
Thou who endured agony
Thou hast done Thy father's will
By Thy forgiveness of sins
We now seek for Thy mercy
And from the guilts of our sins
Take us to Thy place of joy
And at last, to live with Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In the trouble of this world
Be Thou our helper O Lord
Save us from all temptations
And from all our enemies
Let us know Thy death's value
That Thou died upon the cross
Every time let our souls be
Thy sufferings to remember.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let Thy love abide in us
And all souls which have now stray'd,
Teach them to know Thy sweetness
Thy life and resurrection which
Thy death hath brought for them
And at last, that they may be
Participants of Thy grace
And for ever reign with Thee

hymns.title: May the Grace of Christ Our Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: May the grace of Christ our Saviour
And the Father's boundless love,
With the Holy Spirit favour,
Rest upon us from above,

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: This may we abide in union
With each other and the Lord.
And possess, in sweet communion
Joys which earth cannot afford.

hymns.title: The Night Is Almost Gone

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The night is almost gone,
The day is near at hand
The veil will soon be rent
That veils the-Saviour’s face
The huge clouds that cover our sight
Shall soon be swept off from our view.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lift up your heads, for your
Salvation draweth nigh
See, the sun in sp1endour
Behold the sky grows bright
Ye saints of God, rejoice, be glad.
The Lord our God will soon appear.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: If men in mockery, laugh
If they would not believe
But. you believe His word
He cannot deceive you
And when the world will pass away
Ye shall behold His glory then.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The Lord has provided’
For you a mansion bright
There is no sorrow there
But joy forever more
Ye saints of God, your joys begin
Ye shall soon hear the angel’s voice.

hymns.title: Jesus Is All the World to Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus is all the world to me
My life, my joy, my all
He is my strength from day to day
Without Him I will fall
When I am sad to Him I go
No other one can cheer me so
When I am sad He makes me glad
He's my Friend.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus is all the world to me
My friend in trials sore
I go to Him for blessings and
He gives them o'er and o'er
He sends the sunshine and the rain
He sends the harvests golden grain
Sunshine and rain, harvest and grain
He's my Friend.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus is all the world to me
And true to Him I'll be
O how could I this Friend deny
When He's so true to me
Following Him, I know I'm right
He watches o'er me day and night
Following Him, by day and night
He's my Friend.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus is all the world to me
I want no better friend
I trust Him now I'll trust Him when
Life's fleating days shall end
Beautiful life with such a Friend
Beautiful life that has no end
Eternal life, eternal joy
He's my Friend.

hymns.title: Quit You Like Men, Be Strong!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Quit you like men, be strong!
Wax valiant in the fight;
See! yonder Captain leads the throng,
In whom is your delight.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Though battle's thunders roar,
And hosts of darkness press,
He is alive for evermore,
And succours our distress.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: List to the swelling strains
Of those who fought and won,
They laud the Lamb, the crimson stains
His vesture are upon:

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: 'Twas through His precious blood,
Confession to His name,
And lives laid down, that they once stood
And every foe o'ercame.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Shall we, then, faint and fail
When strength seems all but gone?
Nay, rather, on your Captain call
And look to Him alone.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: "For I am strong when weak,"
O count this saying true,
The Lord doth strength and comfort speak
As no one else can do.

hymns.title: Oh, Weary Pilgrim, Lift Your Head

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Oh, weary pilgrim, lift your head
For joy cometh in the morning
For God in His own Word hath said
That joy cometh in the morning.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Joy cometh in the morning
Joy cometh in the morning
Weeping may endure for a night
But joy cometh in the morning.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Ye trembling saints, dismiss your fears
For joy cometh in the morning
Oh, weary mourner, dry your tears
For joy cometh in the morning.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Joy cometh in the morning
Joy cometh in the morning
Weeping may endure for a night
But joy cometh in the morning.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Rejoice! the night will soon be gone
For joy cometh in the morning
And then shall come the glorious dawn
For joy cometh in the morning.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Joy cometh in the morning
Joy cometh in the morning
Weeping may endure for a night
But joy cometh in the morning.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh may we all be glad today
For joy cometh in the morning
Our God shall wipe all tears away
For joy cometh in the morning.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Joy cometh in the morning
Joy cometh in the morning
Weeping may endure for a night
But joy cometh in the morning.

hymns.title: A Debtor to Mercy Alone

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: A debtor to mercy alone
Of covenant mercy I sing
Not fear, with God's righteousness on
My person and off'ring to bring
The terrors of law and of God
With me can have nothing to do
My Saviour's obedience and blood
Hide all my transgressions from view.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The work which His goodness began
The arm of His strength will complete
His promise is Yea and Amen
And never was forfeited yet
Things future, nor things that are now
Nor all things below or above
Can make Him His purpose for go
Or sever my soul from His love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My name from the palm of His hand
Eternity will not erace
Impress'd on His heart it remains
In marks to indelible grace
Yes, I to the end shall endure
As sure as the earnest is giv'n
More happy, but not more secure
The glorified spirits in heav'n.

hymns.title: God Is Here, and that to Bless Us

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God is here, and that to bless us,
With the Spirit's quick'ning pow'r,
See, the cloud already bending
Wait to drop the grateful shower.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Let it come, O Lord, we pray Thee!
Let the shower of blessing fall;
We are waiting, we are waiting,
Oh revive the hearts of all!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: God is here! We feel His presence
In this consecrated place;
But we need the soul refreshing,
Of His free, unbounded grace.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Let it come, O Lord, we pray Thee!
Let the shower of blessing fall;
We are waiting, we are waiting,
Oh revive the hearts of all!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: God is here! Oh, then believing
Bring to Him our one desire,
That His love may now be kindled,
Till its flame each heart inspire.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Let it come, O Lord, we pray Thee!
Let the shower of blessing fall;
We are waiting, we are waiting,
Oh revive the hearts of all!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Saviour, grant the pray'r we offer,
While in simple faith we bow;
From the windows of Thy mercy
Pour us out a blessing now

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Let it come, O Lord, we pray Thee!
Let the shower of blessing fall;
We are waiting, we are waiting,
Oh revive the hearts of all!

hymns.title: Welcome, Sweet Day of Rest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Welcome, sweet day of rest,
That saw the Lord arise;
Welcome to this reviving breast,
And these rejoicing eyes.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The King Himself comes near,
And feasts His saints today,
Here may we stay, and see Him here,
And love, and praise and pray.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: One day of pray'r and praise
His sacred courts within,
Is sweeter than ten thousand days
In pleasure's path of sin.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: My willing soul would stay
In such a frame as this;
And was to hail the brighter day
Of everlasting bliss.

hymns.title: Blow, Pentecostal Breeze

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Blow, Pentecostal breeze,
Breathe, apostolic blast,
Stir Pentecostal hearts at ease,
And sinners slumb’ring

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Breathe, holy Ghost today,
Dispel the ancient sloth;
The guilty deadness sweep away
In resurrection growth.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Make sweeter graces bloom,
And lovelier virtues shine,
And mightier influences perfume
A world by purchase thine.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Revive the ancient glow,
The fierce prophetic fire,
The ancient miracle bestow,
The former power inspire.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Breathe till the perfume flows
O’er wastes where sin abound,
Till Calv’ry gospel-incense blows
The stricken world around!

hymns.title: Revive Thy Work, O Lord!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Thy mighty arm make bare;
Speak with the voice that wakes The dead
And make Thy people heart!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Revive Thy work, O Lord,
While here to Thee we bow;
Descend, O gracious Lord, descend,
Oh! come, and bless us now.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Disturb this sleep of death;
Quicken the shouldering embers now
By Thine Almighty breath.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Revive Thy work, O Lord,
While here to Thee we bow;
Descend, O gracious Lord, descend,
Oh! come, and bless us now.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Create soul-thirst for Thee;
And hung’ring for the bread of life,
Oh, may our spirits

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Revive Thy work, O Lord,
While here to Thee we bow;
Descend, O gracious Lord, descend,
Oh! come, and bless us now.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Exalt Thy precious name:
And by the Holy Ghost, our Love
For Thee and Thine inflame.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Revive Thy work, O Lord,
While here to Thee we bow;
Descend, O gracious Lord, descend,
Oh! come, and bless us now.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Revive Thy work, O Lord!
And give refreshing showers;
The glory shall be all Thine own,
The blessings, Lord, be ours.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Revive Thy work, O Lord,
While here to Thee we bow;
Descend, O gracious Lord, descend,
Oh! come, and bless us now.

hymns.title: We Love All the Things of the World

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We love all the things of the world
They are good before us
We love to stay long in the world
Not wanting to leave them.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Why should we love all earthly things
When there’s one world above
There shall no sin or evil found
There is no peril there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The world that exists in the high
O that it’s known to us
There ‘is joy, love and charity
All these are found up there.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In this world, there are death around
There is no death in heav’n,
Only the saints of God stay there,
In the immortal world.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Let’s follow the path of Jesus
Which He hath giv’n to us
Unto the good and resting place,
In the house of our God.

hymns.title: I’m Not Ashamed to Own My Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I’m not ashamed to own my Lord,
Or to defend His cause;
Maintain the honour of His word,
The glory of His cross.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: At the cross, at the cross,
where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away,
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus, my Lord! I know His name-
His name is all my trust,
Nor will He put my soul to shame,
Nor let my hope be lost.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: At the cross, at the cross,
where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away,
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Firm as His throne,
His promise stands,
And He can well secure
What I’ve committed to His hands,
Till the decisive hour.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: At the cross, at the cross,
where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away,
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Then will He own my worthless name
Before His Father’s face;
And in the new Jerusalem,
Appoint my soul a place.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: At the cross, at the cross,
where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away,
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day.

hymns.title: Search Me, O God! My Actions Try

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Search me, O God! my actions try,
And let my life appear,
As seen by Thine all-searching eye
To mine my ways make clear.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Search all my sense, and know my heart,
Who only canst make known,
And let the deep, the hidden part
To me be fully shown.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Throw light into the darkened cells,
Where passion reigns within;
Quicken my conscience till it feels
The loathsomeness of sin.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Search all my thoughts,
the secret springs,
The motives that control;
The chambers where polluted things
Hold empire o’er the soul.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Search, till Thy fiery glance has cast
Its holy light through all,
And I by grace am brought at last
Before-Thy face to fall.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Thus prostrate I shall learn of Thee,
What now I feebly prove,
That God alone in Christ can be
Unutterable love.

hymns.title: I Thirst, Thou Wounded Lamb of God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I thirst, Thou wounded Lamb of God,
To wash me in Thy cleansing blood,
To dwell within Thy wounds; then pain
Is sweet, and life or death is gain.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Take my poor heart, and let it be
For ever closed to all but Thee!
Seal Thou my breast, and let me wear
That pledge of love for ever there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: How can it be, Thou heav’nly King,
That Thou shouldst us to glory bring?
Make slaves the partner of thy throne,
Decked with never-fading crown?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Hence our hearts melt, our eyes overflow,
Our words are lost: nor will we know,
Nor will we think of aught beside,
“My Lord, my love is crucified!”

hymns.title: My Spirit, Soul, and Body

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My Spirit, soul, and body,
Jesus, I give to Thee
A consecrated offering,
Thine evermore to be
My all is on the altar
Lord, I am all Thine own
Oh, my faith ne’er falter!
Lord, keep me Thine alone.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O Jesus, mighty Saviour!
I trust in Thy great name
I look for Thy salvation,
Thy promise now I claim
Now, Lord I yield my members
From sin’s dominion free
For warfare and for triumph
As weapons unto Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh, blissful self-surrender
To live, my Lord by Thee!
Now. Son of God, my Saviour
Live out Thy life in me
I’m Thine, O blessed Jesus
Washed in Thy precious blood
Sealed by Thy Holy Spirit
A sacrifice to God.

hymns.title: Who Is on the Lord’s Side?

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Who is on the Lord’s side?
Who will serve the King?
Who will be His helpers,
Other lives to bring?
Who will leave the world’s side?
Who will face the foe?
Who is on the Lord’s side?
Who for Him will go?
By Thy call of mercy,
By Thy grace divine
We are on the Lords side
Saviour, we are Thine!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Not for weight of glory,
Not for crown and palm,
Enter we the army,
Raise the arrior psalm;
But for love that c1aimeth
Lives for whom He died:
He whom Jesus nameth
Must be on His side!
By Thy love constraining,
By Thy grace divine,
We are on the Lords side,
Saviour, we are Thine!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus, Thou hast bought us,
Not with gold or gem,
But with Thine own life-blood
For Thy diadem;
With Thy blessing filling
All who come to Thee,
Thou hast made us willing,
Thou hast made us free.
By Thy grand redemption,
By Thy grace divine,
We are on the Lords side,
Saviour, we are Thine!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Fierce may be the conflict,
Strong may be the foe,
But the King’s own army
None can overthrow:
Round His standard ranging,
Victory is secure,
For His truth unchanging
Makes the triumph sure.
Joyfully enlisting,
By Thy grace divine,
We are on the Lords side,
Saviour, we are Thine!

hymns.title: O Master, Let Me Walk with Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Master, let me walk with Thee
In lowly paths of service free;
Thy secret tell; help me to bear
The strain of toil, the fret of care.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Help me the slow of heart to move
By some clear winning word of love;
Teach me the wayward feet to stay,
And guide them in the homeward way.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Teach me Thy patience; still with Thee
In closer, dearer company,
In work that keeps faith sweet and strong,
In trust that triumphs over wrong.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In hope that sends a shining ray
Far down the future’s broadening way,
In peace that only Thou canst give,
With Thee, O Master, let me live!

hymns.title: Once It Was the Blessing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Once it was the blessing,
Now it is the Lord
Once it was the feeling,
Now it is His word
Once His gifts I wanted,
Now the Giver own
Once I sought for healing,
Now Himself alone

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All in all forever
Jesus will sing
Ev’ry thing in Jesus
And Jesus ev’ry thing

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Once ’twas painful trying,
Now, ’tis perfect trust
Once a half salvation,
Now the uttermost
Once ’twas ceaseless holding,
Now He holds me fast
Once ’twas constant drifting,
Now my anchor’s cast

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All in all forever
Jesus will sing
Ev’ry thing in Jesus
And Jesus ev’ry thing

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Once ’twas busy planning,
Now ’tis trustful pray’r
Once ’twas anxious caring,
Now He has the care
Once ’twas what I wanted,
Now what Jesus says
Once ’twas constant asking,
Now ’tis ceaseless praise

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All in all forever
Jesus will sing
Ev’ry thing in Jesus
And Jesus ev’ry thing

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Once it was my working,
His it hence shall be
Once I tried to use Him,
Now He uses me Once the pow’r I wanted,
Now the Mighty One
Once for self labour’d,
Now for Him alone

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All in all forever
Jesus will sing
Ev’ry thing in Jesus
And Jesus ev’ry thing

hymns.title: I Am Thine O Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I am Thine O Lord
I have heard Thy voice
And it told Thy love to me
But I long to rise in the arms of faith
And be closer drawn to Thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Draw me nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast died;
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer, blessed Lord
To Thy precious, bleeding side.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Consecrate me now to Thy service, Lord
By the pow'r of grace divine
Let my soul look up with a steadfast hope
And my will be lost in Thine.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Draw me nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast died;
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer, blessed Lord
To Thy precious, bleeding side.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh, the pure delight of a single hour
That before Thy throne I spend
When I kneel in prayer, and with Thee, my God
I commune as friend with friend.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Draw me nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast died;
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer, blessed Lord
To Thy precious, bleeding side.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There are depths of love that I cannot know
Till I cross the narrow sea
There are heights of joy that I may not reach
Till I rest in peace with Thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Draw me nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast died;
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer, blessed Lord
To Thy precious, bleeding side.

hymns.title: There's a Saviour From All Sin

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's a Saviour from all sin;
If you only let Him in
To your heart, He there will reign,
While you trust Him,
He will put the evil out,
Save from ev'ry fear and doubt,
And you'll soon begin to shout,
Hallelujah!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Jesus is my Saviour King,
He does full salvation bring,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Now with heart and voice I sing
Hallelujah!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus is a wondrous name,
Now and evermore the same,
He can cleanse from every stain,
Only trust Him.
He will fill your soul with joy
And your talents will employ,
Satan's kingdom to destroy;
Hallelujah!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Jesus is my Saviour King,
He does full salvation bring,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Now with heart and voice I sing
Hallelujah!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: If from every sin you part,
And let Christ have all your heart,
You need fear no fiery darts,
While you trust Him.
For while Jesus reigns within,
You are proof against all sin,
And his perfect peace you'll win,
Hallelujah!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Jesus is my Saviour King,
He does full salvation bring,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Now with heart and voice I sing
Hallelujah!

hymns.title: Wash Me, O Lamb of God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Wash me, O Lamb of God,
Wash me from sin!
By Thine atoning blood,
Oh, make me clean!
Purge me from ev'ry stain,
Let me Thy image gain,
In love and mercy reign
O'er all within.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Wash me, O Lamb of God,
Wash me from sin!
I long to be like Thee,
All pure within.
Now let the crimson tide,
Shed from Thy wounded side,
Be to my heart applied,
And make me clean.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Wash me, O Lamb of God,
Wash me from sin!
I will not, cannot, rest
Till pure within.
All human skill is vain,
But Thou canst cleanse each stain
Till not a spot remain
Made wholly clean.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Wash me, O Lamb of God,
Wash me from sin!
By faith Thy cleansing blood
Now makes me clean.
So near art Thou to me,
So sweet my rest in Thee
Oh, blessed purity,
Saved, saved from sin!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Wash me, O Lamb of God,
Wash me from sin!
Thou, while I trust in Thee,
Wilt keep me clean.
Each day to Thee I bring
Heart, life-yea, everything;
Saved, while to Thee I cling,
Saved from all sin!

hymns.title: Thy Life Was Giv'n for Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thy life was giv'n for me!
Thy blood, O Lord, was shed
That I might ransomed be,
And quickened from the dead.
Thy life was giv'n for me:
What have I giv'n for Thee?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Long years were spent for me
In weariness and woe,
That through eternity
Thy glory I might know,
Long years were spent for me:
Have I spent one for Thee?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thy Father's home of light,
Thy rainbow-circled throne,
Were left for earthly night
For wanderings sad and lone,
Yea, all, was left for me:
Have I left aught for Thee?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou, Lord, hast borne for me
More than my tongue can tell
Of bitterest agony,
To rescue me from hell.
Thou suff'redst all for me:
What have I borne for Thee?

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And Thou hast brought to me,
Down from Thy home above,
Salvation full and free,
Thy pardon and Thy love.
Great gifts Thou broughtest me:
What have I brought to Thee?

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Oh, let my life be given,
My years for Thee be spent;
World-fetters all be riven,
And joy with suffering blent:
To Thee my all I bring.
My Saviour and my King!

hymns.title: Once More, My Soul, Thy Saviour Thro' The Word

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Once more, my soul, thy Saviour thro' the Word,
Is offered full and free:
And now, O Lord
I must, I must decide;
Shall I accept of Thee?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I will! I will! I will,
God helping me,
I will O Lord, be Thine!
Thy precious blood was shed to purchase me
I will be wholly Thine!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou knowest, Lord, how very weak I am
And how I fear to stray;
For strength to serve I look to Thee alone
The strength Thou must supply!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I will! I will! I will,
God helping me,
I will O Lord, be Thine!
Thy precious blood was shed to purchase me
I will be wholly Thine!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And now, O Lord, give, all with us today
Grace to join this our song
And from the heart to gladly with us stay
"I will, to Christ belong!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I will! I will! I will,
God helping me,
I will O Lord, be Thine!
Thy precious blood was shed to purchase me
I will be wholly Thine!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: To all who came, when Thou wast here below
And said, "O Lord, wilt Thou?"
To them, "I will!" was ever Thy reply
We rest upon it now.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I will! I will! I will,
God helping me,
I will O Lord, be Thine!
Thy precious blood was shed to purchase me
I will be wholly Thine!

hymns.title: If Thou Would'st Have the Dear Saviour From Heaven

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: If thou would'st have the dear Saviour from heaven
Walk by thy side from the morn till the even,
There is a rule that each day you must follow,
Humble thyself to walk with God.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Humble thyself and the Lord will draw near thee,
Humble thyself and His presence shall cheer thee;
He will not walk with the proud or the scornful,
Humble thyself to walk with God.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Just as the Lord in the world's early ages
Walked and communed with the prophets and sages,
He will come now if you meet the conditions,
Humble thyself to walk with God.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Humble thyself and the Lord will draw near thee,
Humble thyself and His presence shall cheer thee;
He will not walk with the proud or the scornful,
Humble thyself to walk with God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Just as the stream finds a bed that is lowly,
So Jesus walks with the pure and the holy;
Cast out thy pride, and in Heart-felt contrition,
Humble thyself to walk with God.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Humble thyself and the Lord will draw near thee,
Humble thyself and His presence shall cheer thee;
He will not walk with the proud or the scornful,
Humble thyself to walk with God.

hymns.title: My Stubborn Will at Last Hath Yielded

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My stubborn will at last hath yielded;
I would be Thine and Thine alone;
And this the prayer my lips are bringing,
Lord, let in me Thy will be done.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sweet will of God, still fold me closer,
Till I am wholly lost in Thee;
Sweet will of God, still fold me closer,
Till I am wholly lost in Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I'm tried of sin, footsore and weary,
The darksome path hath dreary grown,
But now a light has ris'n to cheer me!
I find in Thee my Star, my Sun.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sweet will of God, still fold me closer,
Till I am wholly lost in Thee;
Sweet will of God, still fold me closer,
Till I am wholly lost in Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thy precious will, O conquering Saviour,
Doth now embrace and compass me;
All discords hushed, my peace a river,
My soul, a prisoned bird set free.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sweet will of God, still fold me closer,
Till I am wholly lost in Thee;
Sweet will of God, still fold me closer,
Till I am wholly lost in Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Shut in with Thee, O Lord, for ever,
My wayward feet no more to roam;
What power from Thee my soul can sever?
The center of God's will my home.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Sweet will of God, still fold me closer,
Till I am wholly lost in Thee;
Sweet will of God, still fold me closer,
Till I am wholly lost in Thee.

hymns.title: I Need Thee, Precious Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I need Thee, precious Saviour,
Oh, Thou art all to me;
Before the throne for ever,
I stand complete in Thee.
Though satan loud accuses,
Yet I can ever see,
The blood of Christ most precious,
The sinner's perfect plea.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I need Thee, precious Saviour,
I need a friend like Thee:
A friend to soothe and comfort,
A friend to care for me;
I need Thy heart, Lord Jesus,
To feel each anxious care;
To bear my every burden,
And all my sorrow share.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I need Thee, precious Saviour,
I need Thee day by day,
To fill me with Thy fulness,
To lead me on my way:
I need Thy Holy Spirit
To teach me what I am
To show me more of Jesus,
To point me to the Lamb.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I need Thee, precious Saviour,
And hope to see Thee soon,
Encircled with the rainbow,
And seatled on Thy throne;
There, with Thy blood-bought people,
My joy shall ever be,
To sing Thy praise, Lord Jesus,
And ever gaze on Thee.

hymns.title: My Goal Is God Himself, Not Joy, nor Peace

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My goal is God Himself, not joy, nor peace,
Nor even blessing, but Himself, my God:
'Tis His to lead me there, not mine, but His
"At any cost, dear Lord, by any road!"

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: So faith bounds forward to its goal in God,
And love can trust her Lord to lead her there;
Upheld by Him, my soul is following hard,
Till God hath full fulfilled my deepest prayer.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: No matter if the way be some times dark,
No matter though the cost be oft-times great,
He knoweth how I best shall reach the mark,
The way that leads to Him must needs be strait.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: One thing I know, I cannot say Him nay;
One thing I do, I press toward my Lord:
My God, my glory here, from day to day,
And in the glory there my Great Reward.

hymns.title: In Full and Glad Surrender

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: In full and glad surrender
I give myself to Thee;
Thine utterly, and only,
And evermore to be.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O Son of God, who lov'st me,
I will be Thine alone;
And all I have, and all I am,
Shall henceforth be Thine own.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Reign over me, Lord Jesus;
O make my heart Thy throne;
It shall be Thine, my Saviour,
It shall be Thine alone.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O come and reign, Lord Jesus,
Rule over everything;
And keep me always loyal
And true to Thee, my King.

hymns.title: Come, Saviour, Jesus, From Above

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, Saviour, Jesus, from above,
Assist me with Thy heavenly grace;
Empty my heart of earthly love,
And for Thyself prepare the place.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O let Thy sacred presence fill,
And set my longing spirit free!
Which pants to have no other will,
But day and night to feast on Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: While in this region here below,
No other good will I pursue,
I'll bid this world of noise and show,
With all its glittering snares, adieu!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: That path with humble speed I'll seek,
In which my Saviour's footsteps shine;
Nor will I hear, nor will I speak,
Of any other love but Thine.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Henceforth may no profane deligh
Divide this consecrated soul;
Possess it Thou, who hast the right,
As Lord and Master of the whole.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Wealth, honour, pleasure, and what else
This short-enduring world can give,
Tempt as ye will, my soul repels,
To Christ alone resolved to live.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Thee I can love, and Thee alone,
With pure delight and inward bliss;
To know Thou tak'st me for Thine own,
O what a happiness is this!

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Nothing on earth do I desire
But Thy pure love within my breast;
This, only this, will I require,
And freely give up all the rest.

hymns.title: My Life, My Love I Give to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My life, my love I give to Thee,
Thou Lamb of God who died for me;
Oh, may I ever faithful be,
My Saviour and my God!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I'll live for Him who died for me,
How happy then my life shall be!
I'll live for Him who died for me,
My Saviour and my God!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I now believe Thou dost receive,
For Thou hast died that I might live;
And now henceforth I'll trust in Thee,
My Saviour and my God!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I'll live for Him who died for me,
How happy then my life shall be!
I'll live for Him who died for me,
My Saviour and my God!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O Thou who died on Calvary,
To save my soul and make me free,
I'll consecrate my life to Thee,
My Saviour and my God!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I'll live for Him who died for me,
How happy then my life shall be!
I'll live for Him who died for me,
My Saviour and my God!

hymns.title: All to Jesus I Surrender

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: All to Jesus I surrender,
All to Him I freely give;
I will ever love and trust Him,
In His presence daily live.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I surrender all,
I surrender all;
All to Thee, my blessed Saviour,
I surrender all.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All to Jesus I surrender,
Humbly at His feet I bow;
Worldly pleasures all forsaken,
Take me, Jesus, take me now.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I surrender all,
I surrender all;
All to Thee, my blessed Saviour,
I surrender all.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: All to Jesus I surrender,
Lord, I give myself to Thee;
Fill me with Thy love and power,
Let Thy blessing fall on me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I surrender all,
I surrender all;
All to Thee, my blessed Saviour,
I surrender all.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: All to Jesus I surrender,
Now I feel the sacred flame;
O the joy of full salvation!
Glory, glory to His name!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I surrender all,
I surrender all;
All to Thee, my blessed Saviour,
I surrender all.

hymns.title: Come, Thou Fount of Ev'ry Blessing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, Thou Fount of ev'ry blessing,
Tune my heart to sing Thy grace;
Streams of mercy never ceasing
Call for songs of loudest praise
Teach me some melodious measure
Sung by flaming tongues above;
O the vast, the boundless treasure,
Of my Lord's unchanging love!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Here I raise my Ebenezer
Hither by Thy help I'm come;
And I hope, by Thy good pleasure,
Safely to arrive at home.
Jesus sought me when a stranger,
Wandering from the fold of God;
He, to rescue me from danger,
Interposed His precious blood.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O to grace how great a debtor
Daily I'm constrained to be!
Let that grace, Lord, like a fetter,
Bind my wandering heart to Thee:
Prone to wander, Lord, I feel it,
Prone to leave the God I love,
Take my heart, O take and seal it,
Seal it from Thy courts above!

hymns.title: More Love to Thee, O Christ

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: More love to Thee, O Christ,
More love to Thee!
Hear Thou the prayer I make
On bended knee;
This is my earnest plea:
More love, O Christ, to Thee,
More love to Thee,
More love to Thee!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Once earthly joy I craved,
Sought peace and rest;
Now Thee alone I seek,
Give what is best;
This all my prayer shall be;
More love, O Christ, to Thee
More love to Thee,
More love to Thee!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Then shall my latest breath
Whisper Thy praise;
This be the parting cry
My heart shall raise;
This still its prayer shall be;
More love, O Christ, to Thee
More love to Thee,
More love to Thee!

hymns.title: Jesus, I Will Trust Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, I will trust Thee,
Trust Thee with my soul,
Guilty, lost and helpless,
Thou canst make me whole:
There is none in heaven,
Or on earth like Thee:
Thou hast died for sinners
Therefore, Lord, for me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus, I must trust Thee,
Pondering Thy ways,
Full of love and mercy,
All Thine earthly days;
Sinners gathered round Thee,
Lepers sought Thy face:
None too vile or loathesome
For a Saviour's grace.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus, I can trust Thee,
Trust Thy written Word,
Though Thy voice of pity
I have never heard:
When Thy spirit teacheth,
To my taste how sweet!
Only may I hearken,
Sitting at Thy feet.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus, I do trust Thee,
Trust without a doubt;
Whosoever cometh,
Thou will not cast out:
Faithful is Thy blood:
Precious is Thy blood:
These my soul's salvation,
Thou my Saviour God!

hymns.title: Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, I my cross have taken,
All to leave and follow Thee,
Destitute, despised, forsaken,
Thou from hence my all shalt be.
Perish ev'ry fond ambition,
All I've sought, or hoped, and known;
Yet how rich is my condition!
God and heav'n are still my own.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Take, my soul, Thy full salvation;
Rise o'er sin, and fear, and care;
Joy, to find in every station,
Something still to do or bear;
Think what Spirit dwells within thee;
What a Father's smile is thine;
What thy Saviour died to win thee;
Child of heaven, shouldst thou repine?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Man may trouble and distress me;
'Twill but drive me to Thy breast;
Life with trials hard may press me;
Heaven will bring me sweeter rest;
Oh 'tis not in grief to harm me,
While Thy love is left to me,
Oh, 'twere not in joy to charm me
Were that joy unmixed with Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Haste then on from grace to glory,
Arm'd by faith, and wing'd by prayer;
Heaven's eternal day's before thee;
God's own hand shall guide thee there.
Soon shall close thy earthly mission;
Swift shall pass thy pilgrim days;
Hope shall change to glad fruition,
Faith to sight, and prayer to praise.

hymns.title: Trusting in the Lord Thy God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Trusting in the Lord thy God,
Onward go! onward go!
Holding fast His promised word,
Onward go!
Ne'er deny His worthy name,
Tho' it bring reproach and shame,
Spreading still His wondrous fame,
Onward go!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Has He called thee to the plough?
Onward go! onward go!
Night is coming serve Him now;
Onward go!
Faith and love in service blend;
On His mighty arm depend;
Standing fast until the end;
Onward go!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Has He giv'n thee golden grain?
Onward go! onward go!
Sow, and thou shalt reap again
Onward go!
To thy master's gate repair
Watching be and waiting there;
He will hear and answer prayer:
Onward go!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Has He said the end is near?
Onward go! onward go!
Serving Him with holy fear,
Onward go!
Christ thy portion, Christ thy stay
Heavenly bread upon the way;
Leading on to glorious day:
Onward go!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: In this little moment then,
Onward go! onward go!
In thy ways acknowledge Him;
Onward go!
Let His mind be found in thee;
Let His will thy pleasure be;
Thus in life and liberty,
Onward go!

hymns.title: O Jesus, I Have Promised

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Jesus, I have promised
To serve Thee to the end;
Be Thou for ever near me,
My Master and my Friend:
I shall not fear the battle
If Thou art by my side,
Nor wander from the pathway
If Thou wilt be my Guide.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O let me feel Thee near me;
The world is ever near;
I see the sights that dazzle,
The tempting sounds I hear;
My foes are ever near me,
Around me and within;
But, Jesus, draw Thou nearer,
And shield my soul from sin.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O let me hear Thee speaking
In accents clear and still,
Above the storms of passion,
The murmurs of self-will;
O speak to reassure me,
To hasten or control;
O speak and make me listen,
Thou Guardian of my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O Jesus, Thou hast promised
To all who follow Thee,
That where Thou art in Glory
There shall Thy servant be;
And, Jesus, I have promised
To serve Thee to the end;
O give me grace to follow
My Master and my Friend

hymns.title: I Must Needs Go Home by the Way of the Cross

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I must needs go home by the way of the cross,
There's no other way but this;
I shall ne'er get sight of the gates of Light,
If the way of the cross I miss.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: The way of the cross leads home,
The way of the cross leads home,
It is sweet to know, as I onward go,
The way of the cross leads home.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I must needs go on in the blood sprinkled way,
The path that the Saviour trod,
If I ever climb to the heights sublime,
Where the soul is at home with God.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: The way of the cross leads home,
The way of the cross leads home,
It is sweet to know, as I onward go,
The way of the cross leads home.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Then I bid farewell to the way of the world,
To walk in it never more;
For my Lord says "Come," and I seek my home,
Where He waits at the open door.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: The way of the cross leads home,
The way of the cross leads home,
It is sweet to know, as I onward go,
The way of the cross leads home.

hymns.title: Take My Life, and Let It Be

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Take my life, and let it be
Consecrated, Lord to Thee;
Take my moments and my days,
Let them flow in ceaseless praise.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Take my hands, and let them move
At the impulse of Thy love;
Take my feet, and let them be
Swift and beautiful for Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Take my voice and let me sing
Always, only, for my King;
Take my lips and let them be
Filled with messages from Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Take my silver and my gold;
Not a mite would I withhold;
Take my intellect, and use
Every power as Thou shalt choose.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Take my will and make it Thine,
It shall be no longer mine:
Take my heart, it is Thine own;
It shall be Thy royal throne.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Take my love, my Lord, I pour
At Thy feet its treasure store;
Take myself, and I will be
Ever, only, all for Thee.

hymns.title: Thy Way, Not Mine, O Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thy way, not mine, O Lord,
However dark it be:
Oh, lead me by Thine own right hand,
Choose Thou the path for me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Smooth let it be or rough,
It will be still the best;
Winding or straight, it can but lead
Right onward to Thy rest.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I dare not choose my lot;
I would not if I might;
But choose Thou for me, O my God,
So shall I walk aright.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Take Thou my cup, and it
With joy or sorrow fill,
As ever best to Thee may seem;
Choose Thou my good or ill.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Not mine, not mine the choice
In things or great or small;
Be Thou to me my Guide, my strength,
My wisdom and my all.

hymns.title: I Can Hear My Saviour Call-Ing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I can hear my Saviour call-ing,
I can hear my Saviour call-ing,
I can hear my Saviour call-ing,
"Take thy cross and fol-low, fol-low Me."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where He leads me I will follow,
Where He leads me I will follow,
Where He leads me I will follow,
I'll go with Him, with Him all the way.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I'll go with Him through the garden,
I'll go with Him through the garden,
I'll go with Him through the garden,
I'll go with Him, with Him all the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where He leads me I will follow,
Where He leads me I will follow,
Where He leads me I will follow,
I'll go with Him, with Him all the way.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I'll go with Him through the judgement,
I'll go with Him through the judgement,
I'll go with Him through the judgement,
I'll go with Him, with Him all the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where He leads me I will follow,
Where He leads me I will follow,
Where He leads me I will follow,
I'll go with Him, with Him all the way.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He will give me grace and glory,
He will give me grace and glory,
He will give me grace and glory,
And go with me, with me all the way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where He leads me I will follow,
Where He leads me I will follow,
Where He leads me I will follow,
I'll go with Him, with Him all the way.

hymns.title: I Clasp the Hand of Love Divine

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I clasp the hand of love divine,
I claim the gracious promise mine,
And add to His my countersign,
"I take He undertakes."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I take Thee, blessed Lord,
I give myself to Thee,
And Thou, according to Thy word,
Dost undertake for me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I take salvation full and free,
Thro' Him who gave His life for me,
He undertakes my All to be,
"I take He undertakes."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I take Thee, blessed Lord,
I give myself to Thee,
And Thou, according to Thy word,
Dost undertake for me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I take Him as my holiness,
My spirit's spotless heav'nly dress,
I take the Lord, my righteousness,
"I take He undertakes."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I take Thee, blessed Lord,
I give myself to Thee,
And Thou, according to Thy word,
Dost undertake for me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I take the promised Holy Ghost,
I take the power of Pentecost,
To fill me to the uttermost,
"I take He undertakes."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I take Thee, blessed Lord,
I give myself to Thee,
And Thou, according to Thy word,
Dost undertake for me.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: I take Him for this mortal frame,
I take my healing through His name,
And all His risen life I claim,
"I take He undertakes."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I take Thee, blessed Lord,
I give myself to Thee,
And Thou, according to Thy word,
Dost undertake for me.

hymns.title: As Pants the Hart for Cooling Streams

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: As pants the hart for cooling streams,
When heated in the chase,
So long my soul, O God, for Thee,
And Thy refreshing grace.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For Thee, my God, the living God,
My thirsty soul doth pine,
O when shall I behold Thy face,
Thou majesty divine!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Why restless, why cast down, my soul!
Trust God, who will employ
His aid for thee and change these sighs
To thankful hymns of joy.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: God of my strength, how long shall I,
Like one forgotten, mourn!
Forlorn, forsaken, and exposed
To my oppressor's scorn.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Why restless, why cast down, my soul!
Hope still, and thou shalt sing
The praise of Him who is thy God,
Thy health's eternal spring.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: The Father, Son and Holy Ghost
Thou God that we worship
Worthy of glory and honour,
For ever more be praised.

hymns.title: Far From My Heav'nly Home

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Far from my heav'nly home,
Far from my Father's breast,
Fainting I cry, Blest Spirit, come,
And speed me to my rest.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Upon the willows long
My harp has silent hung:
How should I sing a cheerful song,
Till Thou inspire my tongue?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My spirit homeward turns,
And fain would thither flee:
My heart, O Zion, droops and yearns,
When I remember thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
