pairs: To Thee, to thee I press,
A dark and toilsome road:
When shall I pass the wilderness,
And reach the saints' abode?

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: God of my life be near:
On Thee my hopes I cast;
Oh guide me through the desert here,
And bring me home at last.

hymns.title: Have Thine Own Way, Lord!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Thou art the Porter;
I am the clay.
Mould me and make me
After Thy will,
While I am waiting
Yielded and still.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Search me and try me,
Master, today!
Whiter than snow, Lord,
Wash me just now,
As in Thy presence
Humbly I bow.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Wounded and weary
Help me, I pray!
Power all power
Surely is Thine!
Touch me and heal me,
Saviour Divine!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Hold o'er my being
Absolute sway!
Fill with Thy Spirit
Till all shall see
Christ only, always,
Living in me!

hymns.title: Thou Sweet Beloved Will of God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thou sweet beloved will of God,
My anchor ground, my fortress hill,
My spirit's silent, fair abode,
In thee I hide me, and am still.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O Will, that willest good alone,
Lead Thou the way, Thou guidest best:
A little child, I follow on,
And trusting, lean upon Thy breast.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh, lightest burden, sweetest yoke!
It lifts, it bears my happy soul,
It giveth wings to this poor heart;
My freedom is Thy grand control.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Upon God's will I lay me down,
As child upon its mother's breast;
No silken couch, nor softest bed,
Could ever give me such deep rest.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thy wonderful grand will, my God,
With triumph now I make it mine;
And faith shall cry a joyous, Yes!
To every dear command of Thine.

hymns.title: Nearer, Still Nearer, Close to Thy Heart

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Nearer, still nearer, close to Thy heart,
Draw me, my Saviour, so precious Thou art;
Fold me, O fold me close to Thy breast,
Shelter me safe in that "Haven of Rest,"
Shelter me safe in that "Haven of Rest."

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Nearer, still nearer, nothing I bring,
Naught as an offering to Jesus my King;
Only my sinful, now contrite heart,
Grant me the cleansing Thy blood doth impart,
Grant me the cleansing Thy blood doth impart

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Nearer, still nearer, Lord to be Thine,
Sin, with its follies, I gladly resign;
All of its pleasures, pomp and its pride,
Give me but Jesus my Lord crucified,
Give me but Jesus my Lord crucified.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Nearer, still nearer, while life shall last,
Till all its struggles and trials are past;
Then thro' eternity, ever I'll be
Nearer, my Saviour, still nearer to Thee,
Nearer, my Saviour, still nearer to Thee.

hymns.title: All, All to Jesus, I Consecrate Anew

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: All, all to Jesus, I consecrate anew:
He is my portion for ever,
Only His glory henceforth will I pursue:
He is my portion for ever.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Take, take the world, with all its glided toys,
Take, take the world, I covet not its joys,
Mine is a wealth no moth nor rust destroys:
Jesus my portion for ever.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All, all to Jesus, my trusting heart can say:
He is my portion for ever,
Led by His mercy, I'm walking ev'ry day:
He is my portion for ever.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Take, take the world, with all its glided toys,
Take, take the world, I covet not its joys,
Mine is a wealth no moth nor rust destroys:
Jesus my portion for ever.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Though He may try me, this blessed truth I know;
He is my portion for ever,
He will not leave me, His promise tells me so:
He is my portion for ever.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Take, take the world, with all its glided toys,
Take, take the world, I covet not its joys,
Mine is a wealth no moth nor rust destroys:
Jesus my portion for ever.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: All, all to Jesus, I cheerfully resign:
He is my portion for ever:
I have the witness that He, my Lord, is mine:
He is my portion for ever.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Take, take the world, with all its glided toys,
Take, take the world, I covet not its joys,
Mine is a wealth no moth nor rust destroys:
Jesus my portion for ever.

hymns.title: "Called Unto Holiness," Church of Our God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "Called unto holiness," Church of our God,
Purchase of Jesus, redeemed by His blood;
Called from the world and it's idols to flee,
Called from the bondage of sin to be free.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "Holiness unto the Lord," is our watch-word and song,
"Holiness unto the Lord," as we're marching a-long:
Sing it, shout it, loud and long,
"Holiness unto the Lord," now and forever.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "Called unto holiness," children of light,
Walking with Jesus in garments of white;
Raiment unsullied, nor tarnished with sin,
God's Holy Spirit abiding within.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "Holiness unto the Lord," is our watch-word and song,
"Holiness unto the Lord," as we're marching a-long:
Sing it, shout it, loud and long,
"Holiness unto the Lord," now and forever.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: "Called unto holiness," praise His dear name,
This blessed secret to faith now made plain.
Not our own righteousness, but Christ within,
Living and reigning, and saving from sin.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "Holiness unto the Lord," is our watch-word and song,
"Holiness unto the Lord," as we're marching a-long:
Sing it, shout it, loud and long,
"Holiness unto the Lord," now and forever.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: "Called unto holiness," glorious thought!
Up from the wilderness wandering brought
Out from the shadows and darkness of night
Into the canaan of perfect delight.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "Holiness unto the Lord," is our watch-word and song,
"Holiness unto the Lord," as we're marching a-long:
Sing it, shout it, loud and long,
"Holiness unto the Lord," now and forever.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: "Called unto holiness," Bride of the Lamb,
Waiting the Bridegroom's returning again;
Lift up your heads, for the day draweth near
When in His beauty the King shall appear.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: "Holiness unto the Lord," is our watch-word and song,
"Holiness unto the Lord," as we're marching a-long:
Sing it, shout it, loud and long,
"Holiness unto the Lord," now and forever.

hymns.title: 'Tis the Church Trimphant Singing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: 'Tis the Church trimphant singing
Worthy the Lamb;
Heav'n thro'-out with praises ringing,
Worthy the Lamb;
Thrones an pow'rs before Him bending
Odours sweet with voice ascending,
Swell the chorus never ending,
Worthy the Lamb!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Every kindred, tongue and nation,
Worthy the Lamb;
Join to sing the great salvation,
Worthy the Lamb.
Loud as mighty thunders roaring,
Floods of mighty waters pouring,
Prostrate at his feet adoring,
Worthy the Lamb!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Harps and songs for ever sounding
Worthy the Lamb;
Mighty grace o'er sin abounding,
Worthy the Lamb.
By His blood He dearly bought us;
Wand'ring from the fold He sought us,
And to glory safely brought us:
Worthy the Lamb!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Sin with blest anticipation
Worthy the Lamb;
Through the vale of tribulation,
Worthy the Lamb.
Sweetest notes, all notes excelling,
On the theme for ever dwelling,
Still untold, though ever telling,
Worthy the Lamb!

hymns.title: My God Beholdeth Me Thy Child

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My God beholdeth me thy child,
Show Thy wonderful love to me;
Leave me not alone to my way,
For thou art my sole counsellor.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lead me through this world, my father!
Let enough thy salvation be.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let me seek thy counsel for all,
For thou shall be my only share:
Do all that thou hast planned for me,
From thy great and sure profound will.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lead me through this world, my father!
Let enough thy salvation be.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Lord, thy existence to the world
Can never be comprehended;
Thou art millenial in thy ways,
Where I do not have any one.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lead me through this world, my father!
Let enough thy salvation be.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: As high as heaven is to earth,
So thy thought is higher than mine:
Lead me just to go exactly,
In the way of thy righteousness.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Lead me through this world, my father!
Let enough thy salvation be.

hymns.title: Jesus, My Eyes Are Unto Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, my eyes are unto Thee,
For Thou art all I long to see,
Since Thou hast suffered on the tree,
That I might live.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus, my heart is fixed on Thee,
Waiting for all Thou hast for me,
Seeking a closer walk with Thee,
Thy paths to see.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus, my soul still pants for Thee,
For Thou art all in all to me,
And when Thy blessed face I see,
At rest I'll be.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus, for Thy great love I yearn,
Even for those God's way who spurn,
That through Thy love from death they'll turn,
To Thee and live.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Oh, that my steps may quickened be,
To follow Him who still loves me,
And bids me through eternity,
With him to dwell.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Jesus, of Him shall be my song,
Who loved me patiently and long,
My life, my all, henceforth belong,
To Him alone.

hymns.title: Oh, for a Heart to Praise My God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Oh, for a heart to praise my God,
A heart from sin set free,
A heart that always feels the blood
So freely shed for me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: A heart resigned, submissive, meek,
My great Redeemer's throne,
Where only Christ is heard to speak,
Where Jesus reigns alone.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: A humble, holy, contrite heart,
Believing, true and clean,
Which neither life nor death can part
From Him that dwells within.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: A heart in every thought renewed,
And full of love divine,
Perfect, and right, and pure, and good,
A copy, Lord, of Thine!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thy nature, gracious Lord, impart;
Come quickly from above
Write Thy new name upon my heart,
Thy new, best name of love.

hymns.title: Heav'nly Father I Want to Be in Holiness

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Heav'nly Father I want to be,
In holiness and in truth
But the love of flesh attacks me
Deceiving me everyday.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I am but a feeble creature
In my spirit and body
All my frequent sins committed
Now a burden press'd me down.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There is one command in my heart
Which Thou inserted in me,
For this reason I will follow
Thy love and Thy holy laws.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Even if I want to be good
I will stay immediately
Thy word is always good to me
But evil, I do always.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Many times I permit my soul
To Satan for temptation
Even though Thy word has warn'd me.
To depart from all my sins.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Heav'nly Father, to Thee alone
Thou art worthy to save me
Thou my Saviour who cares for me
I'll embrace Thee all my days.

hymns.title: He Who Would Valiant Be 'Gainst All Disaster

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: He who would valiant be 'Gainst all disaster,
Let him in constancy Follow the Master.
There's no discouragement
Shall make him once relent
His first avowed intent to be a pilgrim.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Who so beset him round With dismal stories,
Do but themselves confound His strength the more is
No foes shall stay his might,
Though he with giants fight:
He will make good his right to be a pilgrim.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Since, Lord, thou dost defend, Us with Thy Spirit,
We know we at the end Shall life inherit.
Then fancies flee away!
I'll fear not what men say,
I'll labour night and day to be a pilgrim.

hymns.title: Rejoice Jesus Reigneth

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Rejoice Jesus reigneth,
Amongst the sons of men,
He doned all the prisoners,
And set them free for aye;
If satan stands 'gainst son of God,
Still his work goes on unhindered.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Mission of righteousness,
Justice and peace combined,
For life, to make easy,
Shall spread over the earth,
All pagans, Jews shall bow their heads:
And confess His holy worship.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The power at His command,
For his own be preserved;
His high authority,
Will many pay respect:
The joyful heavens note His works,
Distant Islands obey His laws.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: This heavenly seedlings
Shall form a mighty tree,
As all the blessed bread;
Were made to feed mankind
Until Son of God shall come back;
We will wait proclaiming the news.

hymns.title: Brethren in Christ, and Well Beloved

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Brethren in Christ, and well beloved,
To Jesus and His servants dear,
Enter and show yourselves approved;
Enter and find that God is here.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Welcome from earth: lo, the right hand
Of fellowship to you we give!
With open hearts and hands we stand,
And you in Jesus' name receive.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Say, are your hearts resolved as ours?
Then let them burn with sacred love;
Then let them taste the heavenly powers,
Partakers of the joys above.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou God that answerest by fire,
The burning Spirit now impart;
And let the flames of pure desire
Rise from the altar of our heart.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: In part we only know Thee here,
But wait Thy coming from above:
And we shall then behold Thee near,
And we shall all be lost in love.

hymns.title: Once, only Once, and Once for All

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Once, only once, and once for all
His precious life He gave;
Before the cross in faith we fall,
And own Him strong to save.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: "One off'ring, single and complete"
With lips and hearts we say
And what He never can repeat
He shows forth day by day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: For as the priest of Aaron's line
Within the holiest stood
And sprinkled all the mercy-seat
With sacrificial blood

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: So He, who once atonement wrought
Our Priest of endless power
Presents Himself for those He bought
In that dark noontide hour.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: His manhood pleads where now it lives
On heaven's eternal throne
And where in mystic pow'r He gives
His presence to His own.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: And so we show Thy death, O Lord
Till Thou again appear
And feel when we approach Thy board
We have an altar here.

hymns.title: I Am Bought Not with Riches

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I am bought not with riches,
Neither silver nor gold,
But Christ hath redeemed me,
I am safe in His fold,
In the Book of His kingdom,
With its pages so fair,
Through Jesus my Saviour;
My name's written there.
My name's written there,
On the page white and fair,
In the Book of God's kingdom;
My name's written there.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: My sins, they were many,
Like the sand of the sea,
But the blood of my Saviour,
Is sufficient for me,
For His promise is written,
In bright letters that glow,
Tho' your sins be as scarlet;
I will make them like snow.
My name's written there,
On the page white and fair,
In the Book of God's kingdom;
My name's written there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh that beautiful city,
With its mansions of light,
With its glorified beings;
In pure garments of white,
Where no evil thing cometh,
To despoil what is fair,
Where the angels are watching;
My name's written there.
My name's written there,
On the page white and fair,
In the Book of God's kingdom;
My name's written there.

hymns.title: Brief Life Is Here Our Portion

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Brief life is here our portion;
Brief sorrow, short-lived care;
The life that knows no ending,
The tearless life, is there.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh happy retribution:
Short toil, eternal rest:
For mortals and for sinners
A mansion with the bless'd.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And now we fight the battle,
But then shall wear the crown
Of full and everlasting
And passionless renown:

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: But He, whom now we trust in,
Shall then be seen and known:
And they, that know and see Him,
Shall have Him for their own.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: The morning shall awaken,
The shadows shall decay,
And each true-hearted servant
Shall shine as doth the day.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: There God, our King and Portion
In fullness of His grace
Shall we behold for ever,
And worship face to face.

hymns.title: I Hear the Words of Love

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I hear the words of love,
I gaze upon the blood,
I see the mighty sacrifice,
And I have peace with God.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: 'Tis everlasting peace!
Sure as Jehovah's name;
'Tis stable as His steadfast throne,
For evermore the same.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The clouds may go and come,
And storms may sweep my sky
This blood-sealed friendship changes not;
The cross is ever nigh.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: My love is ofttimes low,
My joy still ebbs and flows;
But peace with Him remains the same,
No change Jehovah knows.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: I change, He changes not,
The Christ can never die;
His love, not mine, the resting place,
His truth, not mine, the tie.

hymns.title: Sweet the Moments, Rich in Blessing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Sweet the moments, rich in blessing,
Which before the cross I spend;
Life, and health, and peace possessing,
From the sinner's dying Friend.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Here I'll sit, for ever viewing
Mercy's streams in streams of blood
Precious drops, my soul bedewing,
Plead, and claim my peace with God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Truly blessed is this station
Low before His cross to lie;
While I see divine compassion
Beaming in His languis'd eye.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Love and grief my heart dividing,
With my tears His feet I'll bathe;
Constant still in faith abiding,
Life deriving from His death.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Lord, in ceaseless contemplation
Fix my thankful heart on Thee;
Till I taste Thy full salvation,
And Thine unveil'd glory see.

hymns.title: Church of God, Beloved and Chosen

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Church of God, beloved and chosen,
Church of Christ for whom He died,
Claim thy gifts and praise the Giver,
"Ye are washed and sanctified,"
Sanctified by God the Father,
And by Jesus Christ His Son,
And by God the Holy Spirit,
Holy, Holy, Three in one.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: By His will He sanctifieth,
By the Spirit's pow's within;
By the loving hand that chast'neth
Fruits of righteousness to win;
By His truth and by His promise,
By the Word, His gift unpriced,
By His blood, and by our union
With the risen life of Christ.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Holiness by faith in Jesus,
Not by effort of thine own,
Sin's dominion crushed and broken
By the power of grace alone,
God's own holiness within thee,
His own beauty on thy brow;
This shall be thy pilgrim brightness,
This thy blessed portion now.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He will sanctify thee wholly;
Body, spirit, soul shall be
Blameless till thy Saviour's coming
In His glorious majesty!
He hath perfected for ever
Those whom He hath sanctified;
Spotless, glorious, and holy,
Is the Church, His chosen Bride.

hymns.title: Go, Labour on, Spend, and Be Spent

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Go, labour on, spend, and be spent,
Thy joy to do the Father's will;
It is the way the Master went,
Should not the servant tread it still?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Go, labour on; 'tis not for nought,
Thy earthly loss is heav'nly gain;
Men heed thee, love thee, praise thee not,
The Master praises, what are men?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Men die in darkness at your side,
Without a hope to cheer the tomb:
Take up the torch, and wave it wide,
The torch that lights time's thickest gloom.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Toil on, and in thy toil rejoice,
For toil comes rest, for exile home;
Soon shalt thou hear the Bridegroom's voice,
The midnight peal, "Behold, I come!"

hymns.title: The Church's One Foundation

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The Church's one foundation
Is Jesus Christ her Lord:
She is His new creation
By water and the word;
From heaven He came and sought her
To be His holy bride;
With His own blood He bought her,
And for her life He died.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Elect from every nation,
Yet one o'er all the earth,
Her charter of salvation
One Lord, one faith, one birth,
One holy name she blesses
Partakes one holy food,
And to one hope she presses,
With every grace endued.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Though with a scornful wonder
Men see her sore oppressed,
By schisms rent asunder,
By heresies distressed,
Yet saints their watch are keeping,
Their cry goes up, "How long?"
And soon the night of weeping
Shall be the morn of song.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: 'Mid toil and tribulation,
And tumult of her war,
She wait the consummation
Of peace for evermore.
Till with the vision glorious
Her longing eyes are blest,
And the great Church victorious
Shall be the Church at rest.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Yet she on earth hath union
With God the Three in One,
And mystic sweet communion
With those whose rest is won,
O happy ones and holy!
Lord, give us grace that we
Like them, the meek and lowly,
On high may dwell with Thee.

hymns.title: We Love the Place, O God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We love the place, O God,
Wherein Thine honour dwells
The joy of Thine abode,
All earthly joy excels.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It is the house of prayer,
Wherein Thy servants meet;
And Thou, O Lord, art there
Thy chosen flock to greet.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We love the sacred font,
For there the Holy Dove,
Pours out, as He is wont,
The effluence from above.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: We love our father's board,
Oh what on earth so dear!
Where faithful hearts, O Lord,
Still find Thy presence near.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: We love the word of life,
The word that tells of peace,
Of comfort in the strife,
And joys that never cease.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: We love to sing below
For mercies freely given:
But oh! we long to know
The trimph-song of heaven.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Lord Jesus, give us grace
On earth to love Thee more,
In heaven to see Thy face,
And with Thy saints adore.

hymns.title: Jerusalem on High

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jerusalem on high,
My song and city is,
My home whene'er I die,
The centre of my bliss.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh happy place! when shall I be.
My God, with Thee, to see Thy face?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There dwells my Lord, my King,
Judged here unfit to live;
There angels to Him sing,
And lowly homage give.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh happy place! when shall I be.
My God, with Thee, to see Thy face?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The patriarchs of old,
There from their travels cease;
The prophets there behold
Their long'd for Prince of Peace.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh happy place! when shall I be.
My God, with Thee, to see Thy face?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The Lamb's apostles there
I might with joy behold;
The harpers I might hear
Harping on harps of gold.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh happy place! when shall I be.
My God, with Thee, to see Thy face?

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: The bleeding martyrs they,
Within those courts are found;
All clothed in pure array
Their scars with glory crown'd.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh happy place! when shall I be.
My God, with Thee, to see Thy face?

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Ah, woe is me, that I
In Kedar's tents here stay;
No place like that on high;
Lord, thither guide my way.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh happy place! when shall I be.
My God, with Thee, to see Thy face?

hymns.title: Blest Be the Tie that Binds

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Blest be the tie that binds
Our hearts in Christian love;
The fellowship of kindred minds
Is like to that above.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Before our Father's throne,
We pour our ardent prayers;
Our fears, our hopes, our aims are one,
Our comforts and our cares.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We share our mutual woes;
Our mutual burdens bear:
And often for each other flows
The sympathizing tear.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When we asunder part,
It gives us inward pain,
But we shall still be joined in heart,
And hope to meet again.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: This glorious hope revives
Our courage by the way,
While each in expectation lives,
And longs to see the day.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: From sorrow, toil and pain,
And sin we shall be free;
And perfect love and friendship reign
Through all eternity.

hymns.title: Behold, How Good a Thing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Behold, how good a thing
It is to dwell in peace;
How pleasing to our King
This fruit of righteousness;
When brethren all in one agree,
Who like the joys of unity!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When all are sweetly joined,
True followers of the Lamb;
The same in heart and mind,
And think and speak the same;
And all in love together dwell;
The comfort is unspeakable.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Where unity takes place,
The joys of heaven we prove;
This is the gospel grace,
The unction from above,
The Spirit on all believers shed,
Descending swift from Christ our Head.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Where unity is found,
The sweet anointing grace
Extends to all around,
And consecrates the place;
To every waiting soul it comes,
And fills it with divine perfumes.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Grace every morning new,
And every night we feel;
The soft refreshing dew
That falls on Hermon's hill!
On Zion it doth sweetly fall;
The grace of one descends on all.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: E'en now, our Lord doth pour
The blessing from above,
A kindly, gracious shower
Of heart-reviving love,
The former and the latter rain,
The love of God and love of man.

hymns.title: Blest Be the Dear Uniting Love

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Blest be the dear uniting love,
That will not let us part;
Our bodies may far off remove,
We still are one in heart.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Joined in one spirit to our Head,
Where He appoints we go;
And still in Jesus footsteps tread,
And show His praise below.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O may we ever walk in Him,
And nothing know beside,
Nothing desire, nothing esteem,
But Jesus crucified!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Closer and closer let us cleave,
To His beloved embrace,
Expect His fullness to receive,
And grace to answer grace.

hymns.title: Behold How Pleasant for Brethren

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Behold how pleasant for brethren
To dwell in unity,
Brethren whose hearts are in oneness
In holy fellowship.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It is like the precious ointment,
That ran down Aaron's beard,
And on it went down to his skirts
And bought forth sweet perfume.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: For it is pleasant as the dew
That descends on Zion;
Where God reveals His great glory,
And shows to us His grace.

hymns.title: Come, and Let Us Sweetly Join

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, and let us sweetly join
Christ to praise in hymns divine;
Give we all, with one accord,
Glory to our common Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Hands, and hearts, and voices raise;
Sing as in the ancient days;
Antedate the joys above,
Celebrate the feast of love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Strive we, in affection strive;
Let the purer flame revive,
Such as in the martyrs glowed,
Dying champions for their God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: We, like them, may live and love;
Called we are their joys to prove,
Sav'd with them from future wrath,
Partners of like precious faith.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Sing we then in Jesus' name,
Now as yesterday the same;
One in every time and place,
Full for all truth and grace.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: We for Christ, our Master, stand,
Lights in a benighted land:
We our dying Lord confess;
We are Jesus' witnesses.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Witnesses that Christ hath died,
We with Him are crucified;
Christ hath burst the bands of death,
We His quick'ning Spirit breathe

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Christ is now gone up on high,
Thither all our wishes fly;
Sits at God's right hand above
There with Him we reign in love.

hymns.title: Jesus, Lord, We Look to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, Lord, we look to Thee,
Let us in Thy name agree;
Show Thyself the Prince of Peace;
Bid our strife for ever cease.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: By Thy reconciling love,
Every stumbling block remove;
Each to each unite, endear,
Come, and spread Thy banner here.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Make us of one heart and mind,
Courteous, pitiful, and kind,
Lowly, meek, in thought and word,
Altogether like our Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Let us for each other care,
Each the other's burden bear,
To Thy church the pattern give,
Show how true believers live.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Free from anger and from pride,
Let us thus in God abide;
All the depths of love express,
All the heights of holiness.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Let us then with joy remove
To the family above;
On the wings of angels fly,
Show how true believers die.

hymns.title: How Good and Pleasant 'Tis to See

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: How good and pleasant 'tis to see,
When brethren cordially agree,
And kindly think and speak the same!
A family of faith and love,
Combin'd to seek the things above,
And spread the common Saviour's fame.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The God of grace, who all invites
Who in our unity delights,
Vouchsafes our intercourse to bless;
Revives us with refreshing show'rs,
The fulness of his bleeding pours,
And keeps our minds in perfect peace.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus, Thou precious corner stone,
Preserve inseparably one
Whom Thou didst by Thy Spirit join:
Still let us in Thy Spirit live,
And to Thy church the pattern give
Of unanimity divine.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Still let us to each other cleave,
And from Thy pletitude receive
Constant supplies of hallowing grace,
Till to a perfect man we rise,
O'ertake our kindred in the skies,
And find prepar'd our heav'nly place.

hymns.title: Happy the Heart Where Graces Reign

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Happy the heart where graces reign,
Where love inspires the breast;
Love is the brightest of the train,
And perfects all the rest.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Knowledge, alas! 'tis all in vain,
And all in vain our fear;
Our stubborn sins will fight and reign,
If love be absent there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Tis love that makes our cheerful feet
In swift obedience move:
The devils know, and tremble too;
But satan cannot love.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: This is the grace that lives and sings,
When faith and hope shall cease;
'Tis this shall strike our joyful strings
In the sweet realm of bliss.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Before we quite forsake our clay,
Or leave this dark abode,
The wings of love bear us away,
To see our gracious God.

hymns.title: Through the Night of Doubt and Sorrow

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Through the night of doubt and sorrow,
Onward goes the pilgrim band,
Singing songs of expectation,
Marching to the promised land.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Clear before us, through the darkness,
Gleams and burns th guiding light;
Brother clasps the hand of brother,
Stepping fearless through the night;

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: One the light of God's own presence,
O'er His ransomed people shed,
Chasing far the gloom and terror,
Brightening all the path we tread.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: One the object of our journey,
One the faith which never tires,
One the earnest looking forward,
One the hope our God inspires.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: One the strain that lips of thousands
Lift as from the heart of one;
One the conflict, one the peril,
One the march in God begun.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: One the gladness of rejoicing,
On the far eternal shore,
Where the one Almighty Father,
Reigns in love for evermore.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Onward therefore, pilgrim brothers,
Onward with the cross our aid!
Bear its shame, and fight its battle,
Till we rest beneath its shade.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Soon shall come the great awaking,
Soon the rending of the tomb;
Then the scatt'ring of all shadows,
And the end of toil and gloom.

hymns.title: Christ Is Made the Sure Foundation

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Christ is made the sure Foundation,
Christ the Head and Corner-stone,
Chosen of the Lord, and precious,
Binding all the Church in one,
Holy Zion's help for ever,
And her confidence alone.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: To this Temple, where we call Thee,
Come, O Lord of Hosts, today;
With Thy wonted lovingt-kindness,
Hear Thy people as they pray;
And Thy fullest benediction
Shed within its walls within.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Here vouchsafe to all Thy servants
What they ask of Thee to gain,
What they gain from Thee for ever,
With the Blessed to retain,
And hereafter in Thy glory
Evermore with Thee to reign.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Praise and honour to the Father,
Praise and honour to the Son,
Praise and honour to the Spirit,
Ever Three and ever One
One in Might, and One in Glory,
While eternal ages run.

hymns.title: Lord, Speak to Me, that I May Speak

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord, speak to me, that I may speak
In living echoes of Thy tone;
As Thou hast sought, so let me seek
Thy erring children lost and lone.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh, lead me, Lord, that I may lead
The wandering and the wavering feet;
Oh, feed me, Lord, that I may feed
Thy hungering ones with manna sweet.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh, strengthen me, that while I stand
Firm on the Rock, and strong in Thee,
I may stretch out a loving hand
To wrestle with the troubled sea.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh, teach me, Lord, that I may teach
The precious things Thou dost impart,
And wing my words that they may reach
The hidden depths of many a heart.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Oh, give Thine own sweet rest to me,
That I may speak with soothing power
A word in season, as from Thee,
To weary ones in needful hour.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Oh, fill me with Thy fullness, Lord,
Until my very heart o'erflow
In kindling thought, and glowing word,
Thy love to tell, Thy praise to show.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Oh, use me Lord, use even me,
Just as Thou wilt, and how, and where;
Until Thy blessed face I see,
Thy rest, Thy joy, Thy glory share.

hymns.title: Ye Servants of the Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Ye servants of the Lord
Each in his office wait,
Observant of His heav'nly word
And watchful at His gate.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let all your lamps be bright,
And trim the golden flame;
Gird up your loins, as in His sight
For awful is His name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Watch: 'tis your Lord's command;
And while we speak, He's near;
Mark the first signal of His hand,
And ready all appear.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O happy servant be,
In such employment found!
He shall His Lord with rapture see,
And be with honour crowned.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Christ shall the banquet spread
With His own royal hand,
And raise that faithful servant's head
Amid the angelic band.

hymns.title: Glorious Things of Thee Are Spoken

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Glorious things of thee are spoken,
Zion, city of our God;
He whose word cannot be broken,
Formed thee for His own abode.
On the Rock of Ages founded,
What can shake thy sure repose?
With salvation's walls surrounded,
Thou may'st smile at thy foes.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: See! the streams of living waters,
Springing from eternal love,
Well supply Thy sons and daughters,
And all fear of want remove.
Who can faint while such a river
Ever flows their thirst to assuage?
Grace which, like the Lord, the Giver,
Never fails from age to age.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Saviour, if of Zion's city
I through grace, a member am,
Let the world deride or pity,
I will glory in Thy Name.
Fading is the worldling's pleasure,
All his boasted pomp and show;
Solid joys and lasting treasure
None but Zion's children know.

hymns.title: Fairest of All the Earth Beside

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Fairest of all the earth beside,
Chiefest of all unto Thy bride,
Fulness divine in Thee I see,
Wonderful Man of Calvary.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: That man of Calvary
Has won my heart from me,
And died to set me free,
Blest man of Calvary!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Granting the sinner life and peace,
Granting the captive sweet release,
Shedding His blood to make us free,
Merciful Man of Calvary!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: That man of Calvary
Has won my heart from me,
And died to set me free,
Blest man of Calvary!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Giving the gifts obtained for men,
Pouring out love beyond our ken,
Giving us spotless purity,
Bountiful Man of Calvary!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: That man of Calvary
Has won my heart from me,
And died to set me free,
Blest man of Calvary!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Comfort of all my earthly way,
Jesus, I'll meet Thee some sweet day;
Centre of glory Thee I'll see,
Wonderful Man of Calvary!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: That man of Calvary
Has won my heart from me,
And died to set me free,
Blest man of Calvary!

hymns.title: God in Heaven Hath a Treasure

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God in heaven hath a treasure,
Riches none may count or tell;
Hath a deep eternal pleasure,
Christ, the Son, He loveth well.
God hath here on earth a treasure,
None but He its price may know,
Deep, unfathomable pleasure,
Christ revealed in saints below.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: God in tongues of fire descending,
Chosen vessels thus to fill
With the treasure never ending,
Ever spent, unfailing still,
God's own hand the vessel filling
From the glory far above,
Longing hearts for ever stilling
With the riches of His love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thus though worn, and tried, and tempted,
Glorious calling, saint, is thine;
Let the Lord but find Thee emptied,
Living branch in Christ the vine!
Vessels of the world's despising,
Vessels weak, and poor, and base
Bearing wealth God's heart is prizing,
Glory from Christ's blessed face.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh, to be but emptier, lowlier,
Mean, un-noticed and unknown,
And to God a vessel holier,
Filled with Christ and Christ alone!
Naught of earth to cloud the glory,
Naught of self the light to dim,
Telling forth His wondrous story
Emptied-to be filled with Him.

hymns.title: Glory to God, Whose Spirit Draws

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Glory to God, whose Spirit draws
Fresh soldiers to the Saviour's cause,
Who thus, baptized into His name,
His goodness and their faith proclaim.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For these now added to the host,
Who in their Lord and Saviour boast,
And consecrate to Him their days,
Accept, O God, our grateful praise.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thus may Thy mighty Spirit draw
All here to love and keep His law;
Themselves His subjects to declare,
And place themselves beneath His care.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lead them at once their Lord to own,
To glory in His cross alone;
And then, baptized, His truth to teach,
His love to share, His heaven to reach.

hymns.title: "Till He Come" - Oh, Let the Words

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "Till he come" - Oh, let the words
Linger on the trembling chords;
Let the little while between
In their golden light be seen.
Let us think how Heav'n and home
Lie beyond that "Till He come".

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When the weary ones we love,
Enter on their rest above
Seems the earth so poor and vast?
All our life-joy overcast?
Hush! be every murmur dumb:
It is only "Till He come!"

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Clouds and conflicts round us press'd;
Would we have one sorrow less?
All the sharpness of the Cross,
And that tells the world is loss,
Death and darkness, and the tomb,
Only whisper "Till He come."

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: See, the Feast of Love is spread,
Drink the Wine, and break the Bread;
Sweet memorials-till the Lord
Call us round His Heav'nly Board;
Some from earth, from glory some,
Severed only "Till He come."

hymns.title: Come, Ye Thankful People, Come

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, ye thankful people, come,
Raise the song of harvest home:
All is safely gathered in,
Ere the winter storms begin;
God our maker doth provide
For our wants to be supplied;
Come to God's own temple, come,
Raise the song of harvest home!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For the Lord our God shall come,
And shall take His harvest Home;
From His field shall in that day
All offences purge away;
Give His angels charge at last
In the fire the tares to cast;
But the fruitful ears to store
In His garner evermore.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Even so, Lord, quickly come;
To Thy final Harvest-home,
Gather Thou Thy people in,
Free from sorrow, free from sin;
There for ever purified,
In Thy presence to abide:
Come, with all Thine angels, come;
Raise the glorious Harvest home.

hymns.title: Lord of the Harvest, Thee We Hail

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord of the harvest, Thee we hail;
Thine ancient promise doth not fail;
The varying seasons haste their round
With goodness all our years are crown'd,
Our thanks we pay This holy day;
Oh let our hearts in tune be found.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: If spring doth wake the song of mirth;
If summer warms the fruitful earth;
When winter sweeps the naked plain,
Or autumn yields its ripen'd grain,
Still do we sing to Thee, our King;
Through all their changes Thou dost reign.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: But chiefly, when Thy liberal hand
Scatters new plenty o'er the land,
When sounds of music fill the air,
As homeward all their treasures bear;
We too will raise our hymn of praise,
For we Thy common bounties share.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lord of the harvest, all is Thine:
The rains that fall, the suns that shine,
The seed once hidden in the ground,
The skill that makes our fruits abound;
New every year Thy gifts appear;
New praises from our lips shall sound.

hymns.title: We Plough the Fields and Scatter

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We plough the fields and scatter,
The good seed on the land,
But it is fed and watered
By God's Almighty hand;
He sends the snow in winter,
The warmth to swell the grain,
The breezes and the sunshine,
And soft refreshing rain.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All good gifts around us
Are sent from heaven above;
Then thank the Lord,
O thank the Lord,
For all His love.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He only is the Maker,
Of all things near and far,
He paints the wayside flower,
He lights the evening star,
The winds and waves obey Him,
By Him the birds are fed;
Much more to us, His children,
He gives our daily bread.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All good gifts around us
Are sent from heaven above;
Then thank the Lord,
O thank the Lord,
For all His love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We thank Thee then, O Father,
For all things bright and good,
The seed-time and the harvest,
Our life, our health, our food;
Accept the gifts we offer
For all Thy love imparts,
And, what Thou most desirest,
Our humble, thankful hearts.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: All good gifts around us
Are sent from heaven above;
Then thank the Lord,
O thank the Lord,
For all His love.

hymns.title: The Sower Went Forth Sowing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The sower went forth sowing;
The seed in secret slept
Through days of faith and patience,
Till out the green blade crept;
And warmed by golden sunshine,
And fed by silver rain,
At last the fields were whitened
To harvest once again
O praise the heav'nly Sower
Who gave the fruitful seed,
And watch's and water'd duly,
And ripen'd for our need.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Behold! The heav'nly Sower
Goes forth with better seed,
The word of sure Salvation,
With feet and hands that bleed;
Here in His church 'tis scattered,
Our spirits are the soil;
Then let an ample fruitage
Repay His pain and toil.
O beautiful the harvest
Wherein all goodness thrives,
And this the true thanksgiving,
The first-firsts of our lives.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Within a hallowed acre
He sows yet other grain,
When peaceful earth receiveth
The dead He died to gain;
For, though the growth be hidden,
We know that they shall rise;
Yea, even now that they ripen
In sunny paradise.
O summer land of harvest,
O fields for ever white
With souls that wear Christ's raiment
With crowns of golden light!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: One day the heav'nly Sower
Shall reap where He hath sown,
And come again rejoicing,
And with Him bring His own;
And then the fan of judgement
Shall winnow from His floor
The chaff into the furnace
That flameth evermore
O holy, awful Reaper,
Have mercy in the day
Thou puttest in Thy sickle,
And cast us not away.

hymns.title: I Sing Th'almighty Power of God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I sing th'Almighty power of God,
That made the mountains rise,
That spread the flowing seas abroad,
And built the loft skies.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I sing the wisdom that ordained
The sun to rule the day;
The moon shines full at His command,
And all the stars obey.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I sing the goodness of the Lord,
That filled the earth with food;
He formed the creatures with His word,
And then pronounced them good.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lord, how Thy wonders are displayed,
Where'er I turn mine eye,
If I survey the ground I tread,
Or gaze upon the sky;

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: There's not a plant or flower below
But makes Thy glories known,
And clouds arise and tempests blow
By order from Thy throne.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: God's hand is my perpetual guard,
He guides me with His eye;
Why should I then forget the Lord,
Whose love is ever nigh?

hymns.title: God Moves in a Mysterious Way

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God moves in a mysterious way
His wonders to perform;
He plants His footstep in the sea,
And rides upon the storm.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Deep in unfathomable mines
Of never failing skill
He treasures up His bright designs,
And works His sovereign will.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Ye fearful saints, fresh courage take!
The clouds ye so much dread
Are big with mercy, and shall break
In blessings on your head.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Judge not the Lord by feeble sense,
But trust Him for His grace;
Behind a frowning providence
He hides a smiling face.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: His purposes will ripen fast,
Unfolding every hour;
The bud may have a bitter taste,
But sweet will be the flower.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Blind unbelief is sure to err,
And scan His work in vain;
God is His own interpreter,
And He will make it plain.

hymns.title: When the Saviour Dwelt Below

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When the Saviour dwelt below,
Pity in His bosom reigned;
Sympathy He loved to show,
Nor the meanest suit disdained.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Round Him throng'd the blind, the lame,
Deaf and dumb, dieseas'd, possess'd;
None in vain for healing came,
All the Saviour freely bless'd.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He could make the leper whole;
Thousands at a meal He fed;
Winds and waves could He control;
By a word He rais'd the dead.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: List'ning sinners round Him pressed
Whilst He taught the way to bliss;
Even enemies confess'd,
"No man ever spake like this."

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Be Thy love to me reveal'd,
Be Thy grace by me possess'd;
Touch me, and I shall be heal'd;
Bless me, and I shall be bless'd.

hymns.title: I Put My Trust in Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I put my trust in Thee,
As I lay on my bed,
Deliver me from my great pains
Come Thou and make me whole.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For there is no other
In whom I put my trust;
Thou heal'd Peter's mother-in-law
From her fev'rish illness.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The woman, long ago,
With her issue of blood
By touching the hem of Thy robe
She receiv'd Thy healing.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Heal me, O Saviour, Lord,
Raise me from my illness,
I should not fear any sickness,
When my trust is in Thee.

hymns.title: Command Thy Healing Jesus Christ

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Command Thy healing Jesus Christ
Which is as same today
O let the power of Thy name
Heal me, and make me whole.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: If Thou art still a friend O Lord
Unto the needy ones
Perform Thy wondrous work on me
That I may praise Thy name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I call upon Thee Lord today
Perform Thy miracle,
As leper look Thou upon me
That kneel down at Thy feet.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: My ears are deaf unto Thy laws,
Open my ears O Lord
Command and make my wither'd hand
To lift it up to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Like that lame man at Bethsaida,
Let me receive Thy strength,
Then I will jump to praise like pant
I will jump up for joy.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: I am blind from my mother's womb
My soul is very dark
I cannot see the love of God,
The sins' worth, I can't know.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: I heard that Thou art passing by
Come nearer unto me
O Jesus, Thou Son of David
In mercy, hear my cry.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Behold, I'm waiting at thy path
O Thou the light of heav'n
Command, and say Thou unto me
Sinner, receive thy sight.

hymns.title: Jesus Is the Same for Ever

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus is the same for ever,
As of old, so now today;
All the host of hell endeavour
Vainly to obstruct His sway,
In His people's hearts He reigneth,
Finishes what He begins;
Jesus still "all power" retaineth,
Saves His people from their sins.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus is the same for ever;
Yes, He heals the sick today,
As of old, so now, He never
Turns one suffering child away,
He can cure the worst diseases,
For He understands our frame;
Bore our griefs, and so releases
All who dare their rights to claim.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus is the same for ever;
Still He says "In Me abide,"
From His love no power can sever
Those who in their Lord confide,
Sweetly from all care He frees us,
Ours the comfort His the shame
Blessed Saviour; precious Jesus!
There's no music like Thy name.

hymns.title: Hear the Footsteps of Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hear the footsteps of Jesus,
He is now passing by,
Bearing balm for the wounded,
Healing all who apply;
As He spake to the suff'rer
Who lay at the pool,
He is saying this moment
"Wilt thou be made whole?"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Wilt thou be made whole?
Wilt thou be made whole?
Oh, come weary suff'rer,
Oh, come, sin-sick soul;
See the life-stream is flowing
See the cleansing waves roll;
Step into the current and thou shalt be whole.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: 'Tis the voice of that Saviour
Whose merciful call,
Freely offers salvation to one and to all;
He is now beck'ning to Him,
Each sin tainted soul,
And lovingly asking
Wilt thou be made whole?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Wilt thou be made whole?
Wilt thou be made whole?
Oh, come weary suff'rer,
Oh, come, sin-sick soul;
See the life-stream is flowing
See the cleansing waves roll;
Step into the current and thou shalt be whole.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Are you halting and struggling,
O'er pow'rd by your sin,
While the waters are troubled,
Can you not enter in?
Lo, the Saviour stands
Waiting to strengthen your soul,
He is earnestly pleading,
"Wilt thou be made whole?"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Wilt thou be made whole?
Wilt thou be made whole?
Oh, come weary suff'rer,
Oh, come, sin-sick soul;
See the life-stream is flowing
See the cleansing waves roll;
Step into the current and thou shalt be whole.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Blessed Saviour, assist us,
To rest on Thy Word,
Let the soul healing power,
On us now be out-poured:
Wash away every sin spot,
Take perfect control
Say to each trusting spirit,
"Wilt thou be made whole?".

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Wilt thou be made whole?
Wilt thou be made whole?
Oh, come weary suff'rer,
Oh, come, sin-sick soul;
See the life-stream is flowing
See the cleansing waves roll;
Step into the current and thou shalt be whole.

hymns.title: Thine Arm, O Lord, in Days of Old

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thine arm, O Lord, in days of old
Was strong to heal and save
It triumphed o'er disease and death,
O'er darkness and the grave
To Thee they went, the blind, the dumb,
The palsied and the lame,
The leper with his tainted life,
The sick with fever'd frame.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: And lo! Thy touch brought life and health,
Gave speech, and strength, and sight;
And youth renewed, and frenzy calmed,
Owned Thee the Lord of light.
And now, O Lord, be near to bless,
Almighty as of yore,
In crowded street, by restless couch,
As by Gennesaret's shore.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Be Thou our great Deliverer still,
Thou Lord of life and death;
Restore and quicken, soothe and bless,
With Thine Almighty breath.
To hands that work, and eyes that see,
Give wisdom's heavenly lore,
That whole and sick and weak and strong
May praise Thee evermore.

hymns.title: She only Touched the Hem of His Garment

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: She only touched the hem of His garment
As to His side she stole,
Amid the crowd that gathered around Him,
And straight way she was whole.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, touch the hem of His garment,
And thou, too, shalt be free,
His saving pow'r this very hour
Shall give new life to thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: She came in fear and trembling before Him,
She knew her Lord had come;
She felt that from Him virtue had healed her,
The mighty deed was done.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, touch the hem of His garment,
And thou, too, shalt be free,
His saving pow'r this very hour
Shall give new life to thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He turned with, "Daughter, be of good comfort,
Thy faith hath made thee whole;"
And peace that passeth all understanding
With gladness filled her soul.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, touch the hem of His garment,
And thou, too, shalt be free,
His saving pow'r this very hour
Shall give new life to thee.

hymns.title: Jesus Lord, We Look to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus Lord, we look to Thee,
For the healing of the sick
Thou has shown Thy great mercy,
To the sick man near the lake.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There's no physician like Thee
That can heal soul and body,
Thou didst raise Jairus' daughter
And brought her forth from the dead.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Lazarus was sick before,
Died, was buried in the grave;
But Thou the Great Physician,
Rais'd the dead on the fourth day.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus, Lord, pardon our sins,
Help us heal this sickness, Lord;
That he stand, to Thy glory,
So, we may give praise to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thou has never failed to heal
Any sickness, while on earth,
Thou has said in Thy mercy
That Thy promise will not fail.

hymns.title: Jesus, Thou the Great Physician

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, Thou the great Physician
The sick in distress come to Thee;
In time of sickness and great pains
He healed them all of their sickness.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The blind, the lame and the infirm
They all received Thy tender care,
For this reason, we come to Thee,
We plead for Thy mercy alone.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The awful pains that Thou went through
Jesus, Thou canst heal these also,
Who look to the great physician,
We beseech Thee, to heal them all.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lord Jesus, grant that affliction
May draw the sick nearer to Thee
May the scourge with which you afflict
Bring back the backslider to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Heal the broken and contrite heart,
O Lord save Thou our sinful hearts,
Heal us and grant abundant health
So we may praise Thee ever more.

hymns.title: O Thou, Whom Once They Flocked to Hear

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Thou, whom once they flocked to hear,
Thy words to hear, Thy pow'r to feel;
Suffer the sinners to draw near,
And graciously receive us still.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: They that be whole, Thyself hast said,
No need of a physician have;
But I am sick, and want Thine aid,
And want Thine utmost pow'r to save.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thy pow'r, and truth, and love divine,
The same from age to age endure;
A word, a gracious word of Thine,
The most inveterate plague can cure.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Helpless howe'er my spirit lies
And long hath languish'd at the pool,
A word of Thine shall make me rise,
And speak me in a moment whole.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Eighteen, or eight-and-thirty, years
Or thousands, are alike to Thee
Soon as Thy saving grace appears,
My plague is gone, my heart is free.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Make this the acceptable hour,
Come, O my soul's Physician, Thou!
Display Thy sanctifying pow'r,
And show me Thy salvation now.

hymns.title: The One Who Made the Blind to See

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The One who made the blind to see,
And made wise the simple
And He who created the light
For all those in darkness.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The One who can give strength and health
To the infirm and sick
And He who can bring back to life
The ones who were once dead.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The One who bestow'd deliverance
And raised him that did fall
And changed the sorrow of today
To songs and Psalms of praise.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou great physician of my soul,
To Thee we raise our song;
For ever more, world without end
Thine e'er will be the praise.

hymns.title: I Was Once a Sinner, but I Came

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I was once a sinner, but I came
Pardon to receive from my Lord
This was freely given, and I found
That He always kept His word.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: There's a new name written down in glory
And it's mine, (And it's mine)
O yes it's mine (Yes it's mine!)
And the white-robed angels sing the story
"A sinner has come home" (has come home)
For there's a new name written down in glory
And it's mine (And it's mine)
O yes, it's mine! (Yes it's mine!)
With my sins forgiven
I am bound for heaven,
Never more to roam

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I was humbly kneeling at the cross
Fearing naught but God's angry frown
When the heavens opened and I saw
That my name was written down (written down)

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: There's a new name written down in glory
And it's mine, (And it's mine)
O yes it's mine (Yes it's mine!)
And the white-robed angels sing the story
"A sinner has come home" (has come home)
For there's a new name written down in glory
And it's mine (And it's mine)
O yes, it's mine! (Yes it's mine!)
With my sins forgiven
I am bound for heaven,
Never more to roam

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: In the Book 'tis written, "saved by Grace."
O the joy that came to my soul!
Now I am forgiven, and I know
By the blood I am made whole (am made whole)

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: There's a new name written down in glory
And it's mine, (And it's mine)
O yes it's mine (Yes it's mine!)
And the white-robed angels sing the story
"A sinner has come home" (has come home)
For there's a new name written down in glory
And it's mine (And it's mine)
O yes, it's mine! (Yes it's mine!)
With my sins forgiven
I am bound for heaven,
Never more to roam

hymns.title: Since Christ My Soul From Sin Set Free

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Since Christ my soul from sin set free
This world has been a heav'n to me
And 'mid earth's sorrows and its woe
'Tis heav'n my Jesus here to know.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O hallelujah, yes 'tis heav'n
'Tis heav'n to know my sins forgiven
On land or sea, what matters where
Where Jesus is, 'tis heaven there.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Once heaven seemed a far-off place
Till Jesus showed His smiling face
Now it's begun within my soul
'Twill last while endless ages roll

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O hallelujah, yes 'tis heav'n
'Tis heav'n to know my sins forgiven
On land or sea, what matters where
Where Jesus is, 'tis heaven there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: What matters where on earth we dwell?
On mountain top, or in the dell?
In cottage, or in mansion fair
Where Jesus is, 'tis heaven there.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O hallelujah, yes 'tis heav'n
'Tis heav'n to know my sins forgiven
On land or sea, what matters where
Where Jesus is, 'tis heaven there.

hymns.title: Now in a Song of Grateful Praise

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Now in a song of grateful praise,
To Thee, O Lord, my voice I'll raise:
With all Thy saints I'll join to tell
My Jesus hath done all things well.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: How sov'reign, wonderful, and free
Has been Thy love to sinful me!
Thou sav'dst me from the jaws of hell;
My Jesus hath done all things well.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Since e'er my soul has known His love,
What mercies He has made me prove!
Mercies which do all praise excel!
My Jesus hath done all things well.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And when to that bright world I rise,
And join the anthems of the skies
Above the rest this note shall swell,
My Jesus hath done all things well.

hymns.title: One Day when Heaven Was Filled with His Praises

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: One day when heaven was filled with His praises,
One day when sin was as black as could be,
Jesus came forth to be born of a virgin,
Dwelt amongst men, my example is He!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Living, He loved me, dying, He saved me
Buried, He carried my sins far away,
Rising, He justified freely for ever
One day He's coming - O, glorious day.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: One day they led Him up calvary's mountain,
One day they nailed Him to die on the tree,
Suffering anguish, despis'd and rejected,
Bearing our sins, my Redeemer is He!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Living, He loved me, dying, He saved me
Buried, He carried my sins far away,
Rising, He justified freely for ever
One day He's coming - O, glorious day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: One day they left Him alone in the garden,
One day He rested from suffering free,
Angels came down o'er His tomb to keep vigil;
Hope of the hopeless, my Saviour is He!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Living, He loved me, dying, He saved me
Buried, He carried my sins far away,
Rising, He justified freely for ever
One day He's coming - O, glorious day.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: One day the grave could conceal Him no longer,
One day the stone rolled away from the door;
Then He arose, over death He had conquered,
Now is ascended, my Lord ever more!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Living, He loved me, dying, He saved me
Buried, He carried my sins far away,
Rising, He justified freely for ever
One day He's coming - O, glorious day.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: One day the trumpet will sound for His coming,
One day the skies with His glory will shine,
Wonderful day my beloved ones bringing,
Glorious Saviour, this Jesus is mine!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Living, He loved me, dying, He saved me
Buried, He carried my sins far away,
Rising, He justified freely for ever
One day He's coming - O, glorious day.

hymns.title: Once Far From God and Dead in Sin

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Once far from God and dead in sin,
No light my heart could see;
But in God's Word the light I found,
Now Christ liveth in me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Christ liveth in me,
Christ liveth in me,
Oh, what a salvation this,
That Christ liveth in me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: As rays of light from yonder sun
The flowers of earth set free,
So life and light and love came forth
From Christ living in me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Christ liveth in me,
Christ liveth in me,
Oh, what a salvation this,
That Christ liveth in me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: As lives the flower within the seed,
As in the cone the tree,
So, praise the God of truth and grace,
His Spirit dwelleth in me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Christ liveth in me,
Christ liveth in me,
Oh, what a salvation this,
That Christ liveth in me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: With longing all my heart is filled,
That like Him I may be,
As on the wondrous thought I dwell,
That Christ liveth in me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Christ liveth in me,
Christ liveth in me,
Oh, what a salvation this,
That Christ liveth in me.

hymns.title: There's a Sweet and Blessed Story

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's a sweet and bless-ed sto-ry
Of the Christ who came from glo-ry,
Just to res-cue me from sin and mi-se-ry;
He in lov-ing kindness sought me,
And from sin and shame hath brought me,
Hal-le-lu-jah! Jesus ran-somed me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hal-le-lu-jah! What a Saviour!
Who can take a poor lost sinner,
Lift him from the mi-ry clay and set him free (Hal-le-lu-jah)
I will e-ver tell the story,
Shouting glo-ry, glo-ry, glo-ry,
Hal-le-lu-jah! Jesus ran-somed me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: From the depth of sin and sadness
To the heights of joy and gladness,
Je-sus lift-ed me, in mer-cy full and free;
With His precious blood He bought me,
When I knew Him not, He sought me,
And in love di-vine He ransomed me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hal-le-lu-jah! What a Saviour!
Who can take a poor lost sinner,
Lift him from the mi-ry clay and set him free (Hal-le-lu-jah)
I will e-ver tell the story,
Shouting glo-ry, glo-ry, glo-ry,
Hal-le-lu-jah! Jesus ran-somed me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: From the throne of heav'nly glory,
Oh, the sweet and blessed story!
Je-sus came to lift the lost in sin and woe
In-to li-ber-ty all glorious,
Tro-phies of His grace victorious,
E-ver-more re-joic-ing here be-low.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hal-le-lu-jah! What a Saviour!
Who can take a poor lost sinner,
Lift him from the mi-ry clay and set him free (Hal-le-lu-jah)
I will e-ver tell the story,
Shouting glo-ry, glo-ry, glo-ry,
Hal-le-lu-jah! Jesus ran-somed me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: By and by with joy in-creasing,
And with gra-ti-tude un-ceas-ing,
Lifted up with Christ for e-ver more to be;
I will join the host there singing,
In the an-them e-ver ring-ing,
To the King of love who ransomed me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hal-le-lu-jah! What a Saviour!
Who can take a poor lost sinner,
Lift him from the mi-ry clay and set him free (Hal-le-lu-jah)
I will e-ver tell the story,
Shouting glo-ry, glo-ry, glo-ry,
Hal-le-lu-jah! Jesus ran-somed me.

hymns.title: There's No One Like My Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's no one like my Saviour;
No friend can be like Him;
My never-failing sunshine
When earthly lights grow dim;
When summer flow'rs are blooming,
The brightness of my joy,
O, may His happy service
My heart and lift employ.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: No one, no one like my precious Saviour,
No one, no such a friend can be;
No one, no one like my precious Saviour,
Glory, glory, Jesus cares for me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There's no one like my Saviour;
In seasons of distress,
He draws me closer to Him,
To comfort and to bless;
He gives me in temptation,
The strength of His right arm;
His angels camp around me,
To keep me from all harm.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: No one, no one like my precious Saviour,
No one, no such a friend can be;
No one, no one like my precious Saviour,
Glory, glory, Jesus cares for me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There's no one like my Saviour,
He pardons all my sin,
And gives His Holy Spirit,
A springing well within;
He leads me out to service,
With gentle touch and mild;
O, wonder of all wonders,
That I should be His child.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: No one, no one like my precious Saviour,
No one, no such a friend can be;
No one, no one like my precious Saviour,
Glory, glory, Jesus cares for me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There's no one like my Saviour,
Come now, and find it true!
He gave His life a ransom,
His blood was shed for you;
Then when we reach the City
Of everlasting light,
We'll sing with saints and angels,
All honour, power and might.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: No one, no one like my precious Saviour,
No one, no such a friend can be;
No one, no one like my precious Saviour,
Glory, glory, Jesus cares for me.

hymns.title: My Soul Is Now United to Christ

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My soul is now united
To Christ the Living Vine;
His grace I long have slighted,
But now I know He's mine;
I was to God a stranger
Till Jesus took me in;
He freed my soul from danger,
And pardon'd all my sin.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Soon as my all I ventured
On the atoning Blood,
The Holy Spirit entered,
And I was born of God;
Still Christ is my Salvation
What can I covet more?
I fear no condemnation,
My Father's wrath is o'er.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: By floods and flames surrounded,
I now my way pursue;
Nor shall I be confounded,
With glory in my view;
I taste a heavenly pleasure,
And need not fear a frown;
Christ is my joy and treasure,
My glory and my crown.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Christians be not faint-hearted,
Though least among the flock;
From Christ you'll ne'er be parted,
While built upon the Rock;
Let's speed our pace to glory,
We soon shall meet above,
And tell the wondrous story
Of His redeeming love.

hymns.title: I Am Redeemed, Oh, Praise the Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I am redeemed, oh, praise the Lord
My soul from bondage free
Has found at last a resting place
In Him who died for me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am redeem'd! I am redeem'd
I'll sing it o'er and o'er
I am redeem'd! Oh, praise the Lord
Redeem'd for evermore.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I look'd, and lo, from Calv'ry's cross
A healing fountain stream'd
It cleans'd my heart, and now I sing
Praise God, I am redeem'd

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am redeem'd! I am redeem'd
I'll sing it o'er and o'er
I am redeem'd! Oh, praise the Lord
Redeem'd for evermore.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The debt is paid, my soul is free
And by His mighty power
The blood that wash'd my sins away
Still cleanseth ev'ry hour

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am redeem'd! I am redeem'd
I'll sing it o'er and o'er
I am redeem'd! Oh, praise the Lord
Redeem'd for evermore.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: All glory be to Jesus' name
I know that He is mine
For on my heart the Spirit seals
His pledge of love Divine

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am redeem'd! I am redeem'd
I'll sing it o'er and o'er
I am redeem'd! Oh, praise the Lord
Redeem'd for evermore.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And when I reach that world more bright
Than mortal ever dreamed
I'll cast my crown at Jesus' feet
And cry, "Redeemed, redeemed!"

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I am redeem'd! I am redeem'd
I'll sing it o'er and o'er
I am redeem'd! Oh, praise the Lord
Redeem'd for evermore.

hymns.title: I Have a Song I Love to Sing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I have a song I love to sing,
Since I have been redeemed,
Of my Redeemer, Saviour, King,
Since I have been redeemed.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Since I have been redeemed,
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in His name;
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in my Saviour's name.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I have a Christ that satisfies,
Since I have been redeemed;
To do His will is my highest prize,
Since I have been redeemed.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Since I have been redeemed,
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in His name;
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in my Saviour's name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I have a witness bright and clear,
Since I have been redeemed,
Dispelling every doubt and fear,
Since I have been redeemed.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Since I have been redeemed,
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in His name;
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in my Saviour's name.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I have a joy unspeakable,
Since I have been redeemed,
By the cleansing blood of my Lord,
Since I have been redeemed.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Since I have been redeemed,
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in His name;
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in my Saviour's name.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: I have a home prepared for me,
Since I have been redeemed,
Where I shall dwell eternally,
Since I have been redeemed.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Since I have been redeemed,
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in His name;
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in my Saviour's name.

hymns.title: My Sins, O the Peace Giving Thought

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: My sins, O the peace giving thought,
Are buried beneath the wild wave,
Since God in His mercy has brought
His wonderful power to save.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Thou wilt cast all their sins into the depth of the sea
'Tis the word of the Lord, and sufficient for me,
Though the billows may roar and may break on the shore,
They are lost in its depths, and can reach me no more, of the place where they're buried,
Only God holds the key,
In the depths, the depths of the sea.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: No more shall they rise to distress,
Or trouble the peace of my soul,
As o'er them in power to bless
God's waves of forgiveness shall roll

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Thou wilt cast all their sins into the depth of the sea
'Tis the word of the Lord, and sufficient for me,
Though the billows may roar and may break on the shore,
They are lost in its depths, and can reach me no more, of the place where they're buried,
Only God holds the key,
In the depths, the depths of the sea.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: No tempest can bring to the light
The sins He hath buried for aye
My soul is precious in His sight,
And He will protect it always.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Thou wilt cast all their sins into the depth of the sea
'Tis the word of the Lord, and sufficient for me,
Though the billows may roar and may break on the shore,
They are lost in its depths, and can reach me no more, of the place where they're buried,
Only God holds the key,
In the depths, the depths of the sea.

hymns.title: Once I Was Bound by Sin's Galling Fetters

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Once I was bound by sin's galling fetters,
Chained like a slave I struggled in vain,
But I received a glorious freedom
When Jesus broke my fetters in twain.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Glorious freedom, wonderful freedom
No more in chains of sin repine
Jesus the glorious Emancipator
Now and for ever He shall be mine.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Freedom from all the carnal affections,
Freedom from envy hatred and strive
Freedom from vain and worldly ambitions
Freedom from all that sadden'd my life.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Glorious freedom, wonderful freedom
No more in chains of sin repine
Jesus the glorious Emancipator
Now and for ever He shall be mine.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Freedom from pride and all sinful follies
Freedom from love and glitter of gold
Freedom from evil temper and anger,
Glorious freedom, rapture untold.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Glorious freedom, wonderful freedom
No more in chains of sin repine
Jesus the glorious Emancipator
Now and for ever He shall be mine.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Freedom from fear with all of its torments
Freedom from care with all of its pain
Freedom in Christ my blessed Redeemer
He who has sent my fetters in twain.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Glorious freedom, wonderful freedom
No more in chains of sin repine
Jesus the glorious Emancipator
Now and for ever He shall be mine.

hymns.title: I Have Been to the Fountain of Cleansing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I have been to the fountain of cleansing
And plung'd neath the life giving flow
'Tis the blood shed of Calvary's mountain
That makes the soul whiter than snow.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O yes it makes whiter than snow
The blood cleanses me, this I know
Since it cleans'd me from sin
I have Jesus within,
His blood cleanses whiter than snow.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I have been to the fountain of cleansing
Found peace in the crucified One
All my sins by His grace have been cancelled
And heav'n in my soul is begun.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O yes it makes whiter than snow
The blood cleanses me, this I know
Since it cleans'd me from sin
I have Jesus within,
His blood cleanses whiter than snow.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I have been to the fountain of cleansing
And glory is flooding my soul
Hallelujah! My heart is rejoicing
His blood makes me ev'ry white whole.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O yes it makes whiter than snow
The blood cleanses me, this I know
Since it cleans'd me from sin
I have Jesus within,
His blood cleanses whiter than snow.

hymns.title: I've a Saviour, Kind and Tender

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I've a Saviour, kind and tender,
I've a Saviour full of grace,
And a smile of winning sweetness
Ever beems upon His face:
In my heart's shrine of affection
He shall hold the highest place.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: How I love Him! How I love Him
Since for me He bled and died
How I love Him, yes I love Him
More than all the world beside.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For my sake He came from heaven
To this world of sin and shame;
Bore my guilt, though He was guiltless,
And though blameless, took my blame:
Can I ever cease to love Him,
And His goodness to proclaim?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: How I love Him! How I love Him
Since for me He bled and died
How I love Him, yes I love Him
More than all the world beside.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Though I've often been unworthy,
He has constant been, and true;
Though I wronged Him, He forgave me
When I would my vows renew;
Though I spurned Him, He with kindness
My rebellious heart did woo.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: How I love Him! How I love Him
Since for me He bled and died
How I love Him, yes I love Him
More than all the world beside.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I've a Saviour, kind and tender,
He would be your Saviour too;
Will you not accept the pardon
Which He freely offers you?
Take Him now as your Redeemer,
Earth has not a friend so true.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: How I love Him! How I love Him
Since for me He bled and died
How I love Him, yes I love Him
More than all the world beside.

hymns.title: O What a Wonderful, Wonderful Day

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O what a wonderful, wonderful day,
Day I will never forget;
After I'd wandered in darkness away,
Jesus my Saviour I met.
O what a tender, compassionate friend
He met the need of my heart;
Shadows dispelling, with joy I am telling,
He made all the darkness depart!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Heaven came down and glory fill my soul,
When at the cross my Saviour made me whole;
My sins were washed away
And my night was turned to day
Heaven came down and glory filled my soul!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Born of the Spirit with life from above
Into God's family divine,
Justified fully thru Calvary's love,
O what a standing is mine!
And the transaction so quickly was made
When as a sinner I came,

I found in Him a resting place,
And He has made me glad.

sections.label: VERSE 2

"Behold I freely give
