hymns.title: Full Salvation! Full Salvation!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Full Salvation! Full Salvation!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh! the glorious revelation!

Washing stains of condemnation
Whiter than the driven snow;
Full Salvation!
Oh! the rapturous bliss to know!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Love's resistless current sweeping
All the regions deep within;
Thought and wish and senses keeping
Now, and every instant, clean;
Full Salvation!
From the guilt and power of sin.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Life immortal, heaven descending,

God and man in oneness blending
Oh, what fellowship is mine!
Full Salvation!
Raised in Christ to life divine!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Care and doubting, gloom and sorrow,

Full and free for evermore.

sections.label: CHORUS

hymns.title: I've Found a Friend; Oh, Such a Friend!

He drew me with the cords of love,
And thus He bound me to Him;
And round my heart still closely twine
Those ties which naught can sever;
For I am His, and He is mine,
Forever and forever.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!
He bled, He died to save me;
And not alone the gift of life,
But his own self He gave me,
Naught that I have my own I call,
I hold it for the Giver:
My heart, my strength, my life, my all
Are His, and His for ever.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!
All power to Him is given,
To guard me on my onward course

To nerve my faint endeavour;
So now to watch, to work, to war,
And then to rest for ever.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!
So kind, and true, and tender!
So wise a Counsellor and Guide,
So mighty a Defender!

What power my soul shall sever?

hymns.title: Oh, Bless the Lord, My Soul!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh, bless the Lord, my soul!
His mercies bear in mind,
Forget not all His benefits;

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He will not always chide;
He will with patience wait;
His wrath is ever slow to rise

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He pardons all thy sins,
Prolongs thy feeble breath;
He healeth thine infirmities,
And ransoms thee from death.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: He clothes thee with His love,
Upholds thee with His truth,
And, like the eagle, He renews

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Then bless His holy name,
Whose grace hath made thee whole,
Whose loving-kindness crowns thy days;
Oh, bless the Lord, my soul!

I find the promise true,
The mighty arms upholding me
Will bear my burdens too.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Singing I go along life's road,
Praising the Lord, praising the Lord,
Singing I go along life's road,
For Jesus has lifted my load.

hymns.title: What a Wonderful Change in My Life Has Been Wrought

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: What a wonderful change in my life has been wrought,
Since Jesus came into my heart!
I have light in my soul which so long I had sought,
Since Jesus came into my heart!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Since Jesus came into my heart,
Since Jesus came into my heart,
Floods of joy o'er my soul like the sea billows roll,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I have ceased from my wand'ring and going astray,
Since Jesus came into my heart!
And my sins which were many are all washed away
Since Jesus came into my heart!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Since Jesus came into my heart,
Since Jesus came into my heart,
Floods of joy o'er my soul like the sea billows roll,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I'm possessed of a hope that is steadfast and sure
Since Jesus came into my heart!
And no dark clouds of doubt now my pathway obscure,
Since Jesus came into my heart!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Since Jesus came into my heart,
Since Jesus came into my heart,
Floods of joy o'er my soul like the sea billows roll,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There's a light in the valley of death now for me,
Since Jesus came into my heart!
And the gates of the City beyond I can see,
Since Jesus came into my heart!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Since Jesus came into my heart,
Since Jesus came into my heart,
Floods of joy o'er my soul like the sea billows roll,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: I shall go there to dwell in that City I know,
Since Jesus came into my heart!
And I'm happy, so happy as onward I go,
Since Jesus came into my heart!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Since Jesus came into my heart,
Since Jesus came into my heart,
Floods of joy o'er my soul like the sea billows roll,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

hymns.title: There's a Peace in My Heart that the World Never Gave

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's a peace in my heart that the world never gave,
A peace it cannot take away!
Though the trials of life may surround like a cloud,
I've a peace that has come there to stay!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Constantly abiding, Jesus is mine;
Constantly abiding, rapture divine;
He never leaves me lonely, whispers, O so kind:
"I will never leave thee," Jesus is mine.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All the world seemed to sing of a Saviour and King,
When peace sweetly came to my heart;
Trouble all fled away and my night turned to day,
Blessed Jesus, how glorious Thou art!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Constantly abiding, Jesus is mine;
Constantly abiding, rapture divine;
He never leaves me lonely, whispers, O so kind:
"I will never leave thee," Jesus is mine.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: This treasure I have in a temple of clay,
While here on His footstool I roam;
But He's coming to take me some glorious day,
Over there to my heavenly home!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Constantly abiding, Jesus is mine;
Constantly abiding, rapture divine;
He never leaves me lonely, whispers, O so kind:
"I will never leave thee," Jesus is mine.

hymns.title: I Serve a Risen Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I serve a risen Saviour, He's in the world today;
I know that He is living, whatever men may say;
I see his hand of mercy, I hear His voice of cheer,
And just the time I need Him He's always near.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He lives, He lives, Christ Jesus lives today!
He walks with me and talks with me along life's narrow way.
He lives, He lives, salvation to impart!
You ask me how I know He lives?
He lives within my heart.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In all the world around me I see His loving care,
And though my heart grows weary I never will despair;
I know that He is leading, thro' all the stormy blast,
The day of His appearing will come at last.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He lives, He lives, Christ Jesus lives today!
He walks with me and talks with me along life's narrow way.
He lives, He lives, salvation to impart!
You ask me how I know He lives?
He lives within my heart.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Rejoice, rejoice, O Christian, lift up your voice and sing
Eternal Hallelujahs to Jesus Christ the King!
The Hope of all who seek Him, the Help of all who find,
None other is so loving, so good and kind.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: He lives, He lives, Christ Jesus lives today!
He walks with me and talks with me along life's narrow way.
He lives, He lives, salvation to impart!
You ask me how I know He lives?
He lives within my heart.

hymns.title: I've Found the "Pearl of Greatest Price"

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I've found the "Pearl of greatest price,"
My heart doth sing for joy,
And sing I must, for Christ I have,
Oh, what a Christ have I!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: My Christ, He is "the Lord of lords,"
The sovereign "King of kings,"
The risen "Sun of Righteousness,
With healing in His wing."

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My Christ, He is "the Tree of Life,"
That in God's Eden grows;
The living "clear as crystal" stream
Whence life for ever flows.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Christ is my Meat, Christ is my Drink,
My Medicine, and my Health;
My Portion, mine Inheritance,
Yea, all my boundless Wealth.

hymns.title: Amazing Grace! How Sweet the Sound!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Amazing grace! how sweet the sound!
That saved a wretch like me;
I was once lost, but now am found;
Was blind, but now I see.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: 'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Through many dangers, toils and snares,
I have already come;
'Tis grace that brought me safe thus far,
And grace will lead me home.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Yes, when this heart and flesh shall fail,
And mortal life shall cease,
I shall possess within the vail,
A life of joy and peace.

hymns.title: What Though Clouds Are Hov'ring O'er Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: What though clouds are hov'ring o'er me,
And I seem to walk alone,
Longing, 'mid my cares and crosses,
For the joys that now are flown!
If I've Jesus, "Jesus only."
Then my sky will have a gem;
He's the Sun of brightest splendour,
And the star of Bethlehem.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: What though all my earthly journey
Bringeth naught but weary hours;
And, in grasping for life's roses,
Thorns I find instead of flow'rs!
If I've Jesus, "Jesus only,"
I possess a cluster rare;
He's the "Lily of the Valley,"
And the "Rose of Sharon" fair.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: What though all my heart is yearning
For the loved of long ago
Bitter lessons sadly learning
From the shadowy page of woe!
If I've Jesus, "Jesus only,"
He'll be with me to the end;
And, unseen by mortal vision,
Angel bands will o'er me bend.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When I soar to realms of glory,
And an entrance I await,
If I whisper, "Jesus only!"
Wide will open the pearly gate;
When I join the heavenly chorus,
And the angel hosts I see,
Precious Jesus, "Jesus only,"
Will my theme of rapture be.

hymns.title: Father, to Thee My Soul I Lift

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Father, to Thee my soul I lift
My soul on Thee depends,
Convinc'd that every perfect gift
From Thee alone descends.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Mercy and Grace are Thine alone,
And pow'r and wisdom too:
Without the Spirit of Thy Son
We nothing good can do.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We cannot speak one useful word,
One holy thought conceive,
Unless, in answer to our Lord,
Thyself the blessing give.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: His blood demands the purchased grace;
His blood's availing plea
Obtain'd the help for all our race,
And sends it down to me.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Thou all our works in us hast wrought;
Our good is all divine;
The praise of every virtuous thought
And righteous word is Thine.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: From Thee, through Jesus, we receive
The pow'r on Thee to call,
In whom we are, and move, and live;
Our God is all in all.

hymns.title: Standing on the Promises of Christ Our King

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Standing on the promises of Christ our King,
Thro' eternal ages let His praises ring:
Glory in the highest, I will shout and sing,
Standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Standing, Standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
Standing, Standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Standing on the promises that can-not fail,
When the howling storms of doubt and fear assail
By the living word of God I shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Standing, Standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
Standing, Standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Standing on the promises I now can see
Perfect, present cleansing in the blood for me;
Standing in the liberty where Christ makes free,
Standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Standing, Standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
Standing, Standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by love's strong cord,
Overcoming daily with the Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of God.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Standing, Standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
Standing, Standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.

hymns.title: Father, What Can to Thee Be Giv'n

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Father, what can to Thee be giv'n
For all Thy mercies blest;
For riches of Thy glorious grace,
And for the bliss of rest?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: My weary soul doth pant for Thee,
In dry and thorny land;
And in the howling wilderness
I find Thy guiding Hand.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou lovest me with love unknown,
When no one can console,
And, like the apple of Thine eyes,
Preservest Thou my soul.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Thou leadest me, and Thou alone,
In paths Thou knowest best;
I trust Thee when I cannot trace
The ways to future rest.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Within Thy hand I place my own,
And thus my path pursue,
Content to walk with Thee alone,
Till glory fills my view.

hymns.title: I Cherish Thee My Sunday School

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I cherish thee my Sunday School
Oh how precious thou art
Happy I am, I am cheerful
And rejoice in thy joy

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I cherish thee my Sunday school
Thy friends are numerous
Both youths and elders come to sing
Always long to see thee

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I cherish thee my Sunday School
Jesus established thee
Holy Spirit, Holy teacher
‘Tis that caters for thee

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I cherish thee my Sunday School
We have the assurance
That God the Almighty Father
Has poured blessing on thee

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: I cherish thee my Sunday School
Let sun be vehement
The sky may be cloudy with rain
In thee shall I e’er be

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: I cherish thee my Sunday School
I rejoice to see thee
Would thou pass me by unnoticed
Today without blessing

hymns.title: Break Thou the Bread of Life

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Break Thou the bread of life,
O Lord, to me,
As Thou didst break the loaves
Beside the sea:
Beyond the sacred page
I seek thee, Lord;
My spirit pants for Thee,
O living word!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou art the Bread of Life
O Lord, to me,
Thy holy word the truth
That saveth me;
Given me to eat and live
With thee above;
Teach me to love Thy truth
For Thou art love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O send Thy Spirit, Lord,
Now unto me,
That He may touch my eyes,
And make me see
Show me the truth concealed
Within Thy word,
And in Thy book revealed
I see the Lord.

hymns.title: Wounded for Me, Wounded for Me

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Wounded for me, wounded for me,
There on the cross He was wounded for me;
Gone my transgressions and now I am free,
All because Jesus was wounded for me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Risen for me, risen for me,
Up from the grave He has risen for me;
Now evermore from death's sting I am free,
All because Jesus has risen for me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Living for me, living for me,
There on the Throne He is living for me;
Saved to the uttermost now I shall be,
All because Jesus is living for me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Coming for me, coming for me,
One day to earth He is coming for me;
Then with what joy His dear face I shall see,
Oh, how I praise Him - He's coming for me.

hymns.title: There's One Above All Earthly Friends

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's one above all earthly friends
Whose love all earthly love transcends,
It is my Lord and Christ divine,
My Lord because, I know He's mine.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I know He's mine, this friend so dear,
He lives with me, He's ever near,
Ten thousand charms around Him shine,
And best of all, I know He's mine.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He's mine because He died for me
He saved my soul, He set me free,
With joy I worship at His shrine,
And cry, "Praise God," I know He's mine.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I know He's mine, this friend so dear,
He lives with me, He's ever near,
Ten thousand charms around Him shine,
And best of all, I know He's mine.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He's mine because He's in my heart,
And never, never will we part,
Just as the branch is to the vine,
I'm joined to Christ, I know He's mine.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I know He's mine, this friend so dear,
He lives with me, He's ever near,
Ten thousand charms around Him shine,
And best of all, I know He's mine.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Some day upon the streets of gold
Mine eyes His glory shall behold
Then while His arms around me twine,
I'll cry for joy, "I know He's mine."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I know He's mine, this friend so dear,
He lives with me, He's ever near,
Ten thousand charms around Him shine,
And best of all, I know He's mine.

hymns.title: I Know There's Power in Jesus Blood

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I know there's power in Jesus blood
For He wash'd my sins away;
And I know there is joy in serving Him
For He turn'd my night to day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: There is power, power, wonder working power,
There is power, power, purifying power,
There is power in Jesus blood.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I know there is pow'r in Jesus blood
From my guilt He set me free;
When I came unto Him with all my sins
And His blood avail'd for me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: There is power, power, wonder working power,
There is power, power, purifying power,
There is power in Jesus blood.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I know there is pow'r in Jesus blood,
For all things have been made new;
Since His own Precious blood has been applied
And has cleans'd me thro' and thro'.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: There is power, power, wonder working power,
There is power, power, purifying power,
There is power in Jesus blood.

hymns.title: I Hunger and I Thirst

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I hunger and I thirst;
Jesus, my manna be;
Ye living waters, burst,
Out of the rock for me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou bruised and broken bread,
My life-long wants supply;
As living souls are fed,
Oh feed me, or I die.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou true life-giving Vine,
Let me Thy sweetness prove;
Renew my life with Thine,
Refresh my soul with love.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Rough paths my feet have trod,
Since first their course began;
Feed me, Thou Bread of God;
Help me Thou Son of Man.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: For still the desert lies
My thirsting soul before;
O living waters, rise
Within me evermore.

hymns.title: The Day Is Come This Is the Feast

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The day is come this is the feast
I give my flesh for you
And I offer my blood to all
For redemption of sins.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The next in my Father's kingdom
I shall take same with you
Then all tears shall be wiped away
Our joys shall know no end.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We partake of this for ever
But however till then
Throughout the whole world shall many
Eat, drink and be merry.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The blessing of heaven remain
On all participants
From the great throne of my Father
Shall provide room for them.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Yet this better cup I shall drink
For the safety of life
I shall partake this for your sake
Cup of pain unto death.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Yet you won't know all my sorrow
And how great my glory
But continue and admin'ster this
In remembrance of me.

hymns.title: What Can Wash Away My Stain?

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: What can wash away my stain?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow!
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For my cleansing this I see
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
For my pardon this my plea
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow!
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Nothing can for sin atone,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus:
Naught of good that I have done,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow!
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: This is all my hope and peace.
Nothing but the blood of Jesus:
His is all my righteousness
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow!
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

hymns.title: According to Thy Gracious Word

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: According to Thy gracious word,
In meek humility,
This will I do, my dying Lord:
I will remember Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The body, broken for my sake,
My bread from heaven shall be;
Thy testamental cup I take,
And thus remember Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Gethsemane can I forget?
Or there Thy conflict see,
Thine agony and bloody sweat,
And not remember Thee?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When to the cross I turn mine eyes,
And rest on Calvary,
O Lamb of God, my sacrifice,
I must remember Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Remember Thee, and all Thy pains,
And all Thy love to me;
Yea, while a breathe, a pulse remains,
Will I remember Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: And when these failing lips grow dumb,
And mind and memory flee,
When Thou shalt in Thy kingdom come
Then, Lord, remember me.

hymns.title: Jesus, to Thy Table Led

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, to Thy table led,
Now let every heart be fed,
With the true and living Bread.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: While in penitence we kneel,
Thy sweet presence let us feel,
All Thy wondrous love reveal.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: While on Thy dear Cross we gaze
Mourning o'er our sinful ways,
Turn our sadness into praise.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When we taste the mystic wine,
Of Thine outpoured blood the sign,
Fill our hearts with love divine.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Draw us to Thy wounded side,
Whence there flow'd the healing tide;
There our sins and sorrows hide.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: From the bonds of sin release,
Cold and wav'ring faith increase,
Lamb of God, grant us Thy peace.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Lead us by Thy pierced hand
Till around Thy throne we stand
In the bright and better land.

hymns.title: On a Hill Far Away

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: On a hill far away
Stood an old rugged cross,
The emblem of suffering and shame;
And I love that old cross
Where the dearest and best
For a world of lost sinners was slain.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: So I'll cherish that old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to that old rugged cross;
And exchange it some day for a crown.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh, that old rugged cross
So despised by the world,
Has a wondrous attraction for me;
For the dear Lamb of God
Left His glory above,
To bear it to dark Calvary.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: So I'll cherish that old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to that old rugged cross;
And exchange it some day for a crown.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: In the old rugged cross,
Stained with blood so divine,
A wondrous beauty I see;
For 'twas on that old cross
Je-sus suffered and died,
To par-don and sanc-ti-fy me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: So I'll cherish that old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to that old rugged cross;
And exchange it some day for a crown.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: To the old rugged cross
I will ever be true,
Its shame and reproach gladly bear;
Then He'll call me some day
To my home far away,
Where His glory for-ever I'll share.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: So I'll cherish that old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to that old rugged cross;
And exchange it some day for a crown.

hymns.title: Like the Woman at the Well I Was Seeking

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Like the woman at the well I was seeking
For things that could not satisfy;
And then I heard my Saviour speaking,
"Draw from my well that never shall run dry."

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Fill my cup, Lord, I lift it up, Lord!
Come and quench this thirsting of my soul;
Bread of heaven, feed me till I want no more
Fill my cup, fill it up and make me whole!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There are millions in this world who are craving
The pleasures earthly things afford;
But none can match the wondrous treasure
That I find in Jesus Christ my Lord.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Fill my cup, Lord, I lift it up, Lord!
Come and quench this thirsting of my soul;
Bread of heaven, feed me till I want no more
Fill my cup, fill it up and make me whole!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: So, my brother, if the things this world gave you
Leave hungers that won't pass a way;
My blessed Lord will come and save you,
If you kneel to Him and humbly pray.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Fill my cup, Lord, I lift it up, Lord!
Come and quench this thirsting of my soul;
Bread of heaven, feed me till I want no more
Fill my cup, fill it up and make me whole!

hymns.title: Jesus, Thou Joy of Loving Hearts

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, Thou Joy of loving hearts,
Thou Fount of life, Thou Light of men
From the best bliss that earth imparts
We turn unfilled to Thee again.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thy truth unchanged hath ever stood;
Thou savest those that on Thee call;
To them that seek Thee Thou art good,
To them that find Thee, all in all.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We taste Thee, O Thou living Bread,
And long to feast upon Thee still;
We drink of Thee, the fountain head,
And thirst our souls from Thee to fill.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Our restless spirits yearn for Thee;
Where'er our changeful lot is cast;
Glad when Thy gracious smile we see,
Blest when our faith can hold Thee fast.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: O Jesus, ever with us stay;
Make all our moments calm and bright;
Chase the dark night of sin away;
Shed o'er the world Thy holy light.

hymns.title: Lord, to Whom Except to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord, to whom except to Thee,
Shall our wandering spirits go;
Thee whom it is light to see,
And eternal life to know?
Awful is that life of Thine,
Which the Spirit's Breath inspires;
And the food must be Divine
Which each new born soul desires.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Israel on the heavenly seed
Fed and died in days of yore:
But the souls, that on Thee feed,
Never thirst nor hunger more.
Lord, to whom except to Thee
Shall we go when ills betide?
Who except Thyself can be
Hope and help and strength and guide?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Who can cleanse the soul from sin,
Hear the prayer, and seal the vow?
Who can fill the void within,
Blessed Saviour, who but Thou?
Therefore evermore I'll give
Laud and praise, my God, to Thee:
Evermore in Thee I live,
Evermore live Thou in me.

hymns.title: When the Paschal Evening Fell

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When the Paschal evening fell
Deep on Kedron's hallowed dell,
When around the festal board
Sate th'Apostles with their Lord,
Then His parting word He said,
Bless'd the cup and brake the bread
"This when'er ye do and see,
Evermore remember me."

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Years have passed: in every clime,
Changing with the changing time,
Varying through a thousand forms,
Torn by factions, rocked by storms,
Still the sacred table spread,
Flowing cup and broken bread,
With that parting word agree,
"Drink and eat; remember Me."

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When by treason, doubt, unrest,
Sinks the soul, dismayed, opprest;
When the shadows of the tomb
Close us round with deepening gloom,
Then bethink us at the board
Of the sorrowing, suffering Lord,
Who, when tried and grieved as we,
Dying, said, "Remember Me."

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When in this thanksgiving feast
We would give to God our best,
From the treasures of His might
Seeking life and love and light;
Then, O Friend of human kind,
Make us true and firm of mind,
Pure of heart, in spirit free;
Thus may we remember Thee.

hymns.title: Here, O My Lord, I See Thee Face to Face

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Here, O my Lord, I see Thee face to face;
Here would I touch and handle things unseen;
Here grasp with firmer hand th'eternal grace,
And all my weariness upon Thee lean.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Here would I feed upon the Bread of God;
Here drink with Thee the royal Wine of heaven;
Here would I lay aside each earthly load,
Here taste afresh, the calm of sin forgiven.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: This is the hour of banquet and of song,
This is the heavenly table spread for me;
Here let me feast, and, feasting, still prolong
The brief, bright hour of fellowship with Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Too soon we rise; the symbols disappear;
The feast, though not the love, is past and gone,
The bread and wine remove; but Thou art here,
Nearer than ever; still my Shield and Sun.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Mine is the sin, but Thine the righteousness;
Mine is the guilt, but Thine the cleansing blood;
Here is my robe, my refuge, and my peace
Thy blood, Thy righteousness, O Lord, my God.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Feast after feast thus comes, and passes by;
Yet, passing, points to the glad Feast above,
Giving sweet foretaste of the festal joy,
The Lamb's great Bridal Feast of bliss and love.

hymns.title: Prepare O Sinner to Be Wise

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Prepare O sinner to be wise
Do not wait until tomorrow
As long as you decide wisdom
The more hidden wisdom will be.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Get ready to ask for mercy
Do not wait until tomorrow
Before thy days on earth are o'er
Before this world's sunset arrives.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Prepare, O sinner to return
Do not wait until tomorrow
So you do not become accurs'd
Before tomorrow's day begins.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Prepare to receive a blessing
Do not wait until tomorrow
So that your lamp does not burn out
Before you begin a new life.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Lord, make the sinner to repent
Rouse him from his foolish slumber
May he not kick against wisdom
And be slack concerning his doom.

hymns.title: Jesus Thou Kind Hearted Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus Thou kind hearted Lord
To Thy table now lead us
With the true and heav'nly bread.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: While we kneel around Thee Lord
Thy sweet presence let us feel
All Thy wondrous love reveal.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: While we gage on Thee with faith
Weeping o'er our sinful ways
Turn our mourning into joy.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When we taste the mystic wine,
Of Thine out poured blood the sign,
Fill our hearts, Lord, with Thy love.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Draw us to Thy wounded side,
Whence there flowed the healing tide;
There all sins and sorrows hide.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: From the bonds of sin release,
Cold and wavering faith increase,
Lamb of God, grant us Thy peace.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Lead us on with Thy pierced hand
Till we reach Thy throne above
In the bright and better land.

hymns.title: God Make My Life a Little Light

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God make my life a little light,
Within the world to glow;
A little flame that burneth bright
Wherever I may go.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: God make my life a little flower,
That giveth joy to all;
Content to bloom in native bower,
Although the place be small.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: God make my life a little song,
That comforteth the sad;
That helpeth others to be strong,
And makes the singer glad.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: God make my life a little staff,
Whereon the weak may rest;
That so what health and strength I have
May serve my neighbours best.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: God make my life a little hymn
Of tenderness and praise,
Of faith that never waxeth dim,
In all His wondrous ways.

hymns.title: Children of the Heavenly King

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Children of the heavenly King,
As ye journey, sweetly sing;
Sing your Saviour's worthy praise,
Glorious in His works and ways.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We are traveling home of God
In the way the fathers trod;
They are happy now, and we
Soon their happiness shall see.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Sing, ye little flock and blest;
You on Jesus' throne shall rest;
There your seat is now prepared,
There your kingdom and reward.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Lift your eyes, ye sons of light;
Zion's city is in sight;
There our endless home shall be,
There our Lord we soon shall see.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Fear not, brethren; joyful stand
On the borders of your land;
Jesus Christ, your Father's Son,
Bids, you undismay'd go on.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Lord, obediently we go,
Gladly leaving all below:
Only Thou our Leader be,
And we still will follow Thee.

hymns.title: One There Is Above All Others

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: One there is above all others,
Oh, how He loves!
His is love beyond a brother's,
Oh, how He loves!
Earthly friends may fail or leave us,
One day soothe, the next day grieve us,
But this friend will ne'er deceive us,
Oh, how He loves!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: 'Tis eternal life to know Him,
Oh, how He loves!
Think, O think how much we owe Him,
Oh, how He loves!
With His precious blood He bought us,
In the wilderness He sought us,
To His fold He safely brought us,
Oh, how He loves!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We have found a friend in Jesus,
Oh, how He loves!
'Tis His great delight to bless us,
Oh, how He loves!
How our hearts delight to hear Him;
Bid us dwell in safety near Him?
Why should we distrust or fear Him?
Oh, how He loves!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Through His name we are forgiven,
Oh, how He loves!
Backward shall our foes be driven,
Oh, how He loves!
Best of blessings He'll provide us
Nought but good shall e'er betide us,
Safe to glory He will guide us,
Oh, how He loves!

hymns.title: I Want to Be Like Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I want to be like Jesus,
So lowly and so meek;
For no one mark'd an angry word,
That ever heard Him speak.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I want to be like Jesus,
So frequently in prayer;
Alone upon the mountain top,
He met his Father there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I want to be like Jesus,
I never, never find
That He, though persecuted was
To any one unkind.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I want to be like Jesus,
Engaged in doing good;
So that of me it may be said
"He hath done what he could."

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: I want to be like Jesus,
Who sweetly said to all,
"Let little children come to Me;"
I would obey the call.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: But oh I'm not like Jesus,
As any one may see;
O gentle Saviour, send Thy grace,
And make me like to Thee.

hymns.title: Jesus Is Our Shepherd

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus is our Shepherd,
Wiping ev'ry tear;
Folded in His bosom,
What have we to fear?
Only let us follow
Whither He doth lead,
To the thirsty desert
Or the dewy mead.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus is our Shepherd;
Well we know His voice;
How its gentle whisper
Make our heart rejoice!
Even when He chideth,
Tender is His tone;
None but He shall guide us;
We are His alone.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus is our Shepherd:
For the sheep He bled;
Every lamb is sprinkled
With the blood He shed:
Then on each He setteth
His own secret sign;
"They that have My Spirit,
These," saith He, "are mine."

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus is our Shepherd;
Guarded by His arm,
Though the wolves may raven,
None can do us harm:
When we tread death's valley,
Dark with fearful gloom,
We will fear no evil,
Victors o'er the tomb.

hymns.title: Do No Sinful Action

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Do no sinful action,
Speak no angry word.
Ye belong to Jesus,
Children of the Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Christ is kind and gentle
Christ is pure and true;
And His little children
Must be holy too.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There's a wicked spirit
Watching round you still,
And he tries to tempt you,
To all harm and ill.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: But ye must not hear him,
Though 'tis hard for you
To resist the devil,
And the good to do

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: For ye promised truly
In your infant days
To renounce him wholly
And forsake his ways.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Ye are Christians soldiers,
Ye must learn to fight
With the bad within you
And to do the right.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Christ is your own Master,
He is good and true,
And His little children
Must be holy too.

hymns.title: There's a Friend for Little Children

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's a friend for little children
Above the bright blue sky;
A Friend who never changeth
Whose love can never die
Unlike our friends by nature,
Who change with changing years,
This Friend is always worthy
The precious name He bears.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There's a rest for little children
Above the bright blue sky
For those who love the Saviour,
And Abba Father cry
A rest from every trouble
From sin and danger free,
Where every little pilgrim
Shall rest eternally.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There's a home for little children
Above the bright blue sky
Where Jesus reigns in glory;
A home of peace and joy
No home on earth is like it
Nor can with it compare
For every one is happy
Nor can be happier there.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There's a crown for little children
Above the bright blue sky
And all who look to Jesus
Shall wear it by and by
A crown of brighter glory
Which He will then bestow
On those who found His favour,
And loved Him here below.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: There's a song for little children
Above the bright blue sky
A song that will not weary
Though sung continually;
A song which even angels
Can never, never sing,
They know not Christ as Saviour
But worship Him as King.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: There's a robe for little children
Above the bright blue sky,
A harp of sweetest music
A palm of victory
All, all above is treasured
And found in Christ alone
Oh, come, dear little children
That all may be your own.

hymns.title: Around the Throne of God in Heaven

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Around the throne of God in heaven,
Thousands of children stand;
Children whose sins are all forgiven,
A holy, happy band.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Singing: Glory, glory, glory,
Singing: Glory, glory, glory,

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In flowing robes of spotless white
See every one array'd,
Dwelling in everlasting light
And joys that never fade.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Singing: Glory, glory, glory,
Singing: Glory, glory, glory,

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: What brought them to that world above?
That heaven so bright and fair,
Where all is peace, and joy, and love;
How came those children there?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Singing: Glory, glory, glory,
Singing: Glory, glory, glory,

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Because the Saviour shed His blood
To wash away their sin;
Bathed in that pure and precious flood,
Behold them white and clean.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Singing: Glory, glory, glory,
Singing: Glory, glory, glory,

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: On earth they sought the Saviour's grace.
On earth they loved His name;
So now they see His blessed face,
And stand before the Lamb.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Singing: Glory, glory, glory,
Singing: Glory, glory, glory,

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: And is that fountain flowing yet?
Bless'd Saviour, lead us there;
That we those happy ones may meet,
And in their praises share.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Singing: Glory, glory, glory,
Singing: Glory, glory, glory,

hymns.title: Jesus Loves Me! This I Know

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus loves me! this I know,
For the Bible tells me so;
Little ones to Him belong;
They are weak, but He is strong.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
The Bible tells me so.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus loves me He who died,
Heaven's gate to open wide,
He will wash away my sin,
Let His little child come in.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
The Bible tells me so.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus loves me, loves me still,
Tho' I'm very weak and ill
From His shining throne on high
He will watch me where I lie.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
The Bible tells me so.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus loves me He will stay
Close beside me all the way,
If I love Him when I die
He will take me home on high.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
The Bible tells me so.

hymns.title: There Is a Path that Leads to God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is a path that leads to God
All others go astray;
Narrow but pleasant is the road
And Christians love the way.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It leads straight through this world of sin,
And dangers must be pass'd;
But those who boldly walk therein
Will get to heaven at last.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: How shall an infant pilgrim dare
This dangerous path to tread?
For on the way's many asnare
For youthful travellers spread.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: While the broad road, where thousand go,
Lies near and opens fair;
And many turn aside, I know,
To walk with sinners there.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: But lest my feeble steps should slide,
Or wander from Thy way,
Lord, condescend to be my guide,
And I shall never stray.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Then I may go without alarm
And trust His word of old
"The lambs, He'll gather with His arm,
And lead them to the fold."

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Thus I may safely venture through
Beneath my shepherd's care;
And keep the gate of hearven in view,
Till I shal enter there.

hymns.title: Little Drops of Water

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Little drops of water,
Little grains of sand,
Make the mighty ocean
And the beauteous land.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: And the little moments,
Humble though they be,
Make the mighty ages
Of eternity.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Little deeds of kindness,
Little words of love,
Make our earth an Eden
Like the heaven above.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: So our little errors
Lead the souls astray
From the paths of virtue
Into sin to stray.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Little seeds of mercy
Sown by youthful hands
Grow to bless the nations
Far in heathen lands.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Little ones in glory
Swell the angels song;
Make us meet, dear Saviour,
For their holy throng.

hymns.title: When Little Samuel Woke

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When little Samuel woke,
And heard his master's voice;
At ev'ry word he spoke,
How much did he rejoice;
Oh, blessed happy child to find,
The God of heav'n so near and kind.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: If God would speak to me,
And say He is my Friend,
How happy I should be
Oh how would I attend?
The smallest sin I then should fear
If God Almighty were so near.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And does He never speak?
Oh, yes, for in His word
He bids me come and seek
The God that Samuel heard,
In almost ev'ry page I see
The God of Samuel calls to me.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And I beneath His care,
May safely rest my head;
I know that God is there
To guard my humble bed,
And every sin I well may fear
Since God Almighty is so - near.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Like Samuel let me say
Whene'er I read Thy word,
Speak, Lord, I would obey
The voice that I have heard,
And when I in Thy house appear
Speak for Thy servant waits to hear.

hymns.title: Jesus, Who Calledst Little Ones to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, who calledst little ones to Thee,
To Thee I come;
O take my hand in Thine, and speak to me;
And lead me home;
Lest from the path of life my feet should stray,
And Satan prowling make Thy lamb his prey.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I love to think that Thou with holy feet
My path hast trod,
Along life's common lanes and dusty street
Hast walk'd with God,
On Mary's bosom drawn a baby's breath,
And serv'd Thy parents dear at Nazereth.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O gentle Jesus, make this heart of mine,
So full of sin,
As holy, harmless, undefiled, as Thine
And dwell therein,
Then God my Father, I like Thee, shall know,
And grow in wisdom as in strength I grow.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: To Thee, my Saviour, then, with morning light
Glad songs I'll raise,
My saddest hours and darkest shall be bright.
With silent praise;
And should my work or play my thoughts employ,
Thy will shall be my law, Thy love my joy.

hymns.title: Be Present at Our Table, Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Be present at our table, Lord,
Be here and everywhere adore;
Bless these Thy gifts and grant that we
May feast in Paradise with Thee.

hymns.title: We Thank Thee, Lord, for This Our Food

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We thank Thee, Lord, for this our food,
For life, and health, and every good:
May manna to our souls be given,
The bread of life sent down from heaven.

hymns.title: Jesus, High in Glory

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, high in glory,
Lend a list'ning ear;
When we bow before Thee,
Children's praises hear.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Though Thou art so holy,
Heav'n's almighty King,
Thou wilt stoop to listen
When Thy praise we sing.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We are little children,
Weak and apt to stray;
Saviour, guide and keep us
In the heav'nly way.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Save us, Lord, from sinning;
Watch us day by day;
Help us now to love Thee;
Take our sins away.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Then, when Thou shalt call us
To our heav'nly home,
We will gladly answer,
Saviour, Lord, we come!

hymns.title: Ye Little Ones Keep Close to God

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Ye little ones keep close to God,
In trembling and humility,
Let all knees bow down before Him,
Our Lord and Saviour and our Friend.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O Saviour, let Thy great mercy
Fill us with gratitude to Thee,
And in our pilgrimage on earth
May we receive more of Thy grace.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O Saviour, may all evil thoughts
Be far away flung from our hearts,
And each day, give us Thy wisdom
To choose to walk the narrow way.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: In times of sickness and good health,
In times of pleanty or in need,
And when the hour of death shall come
Deliver us with Thy great pow'r.

hymns.title: Gentle Jesus, Meek and Mild

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Gentle Jesus, meek and mild
Look upon a little child
Pity my simplicity
Suffer me to come to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Fain I would to Thee be brought
Blessed Lord, forbid it not
In the Kingdom of Thy grace,
Give a little child a place.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Fain I would be as Thou art
Give me Thy obedient heart
Thou art pitiful and kind
Let me have Thy loving mind.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Above all O Jesus Christ
Let me do my Father's will
Not to frustrate the Spirit
And Thy glory to be shown.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Lamb of God, I look to Thee,
Thou shalt my example be
Thou art gentle, meek, and mild
Thou wast once a little child.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Loving Jesus, gentle Lamb
In Thy gracious hand I am
Make me Saviour what Thou art
Live Thyself within my heart.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Thy praise, O Lord will I show
I will serve Thee all my days,
The world shall see Jesus Christ
Father's Holy Son in me.

hymns.title: By Cool Siloam's Shady Rill

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: By cool Siloam's shady rill
How sweet the lily grows!
How sweet the breath, beneath the hill,
Of Sharon's dewy rose!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lo! Such the child whose early feet
The paths of peace have trod,
Whose secret heart with influence sweet
In upward drawn to God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: By cool Siloam's shady rill
The lily must decay,
The rose that blooms beneath the hill
Must shortly fade away.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O Thou whose infant feet were found
Within Thy Father's shrine,
Whose years, with changeless virtue crowned,
Were all alike divine.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: O Thou whose infant feet were found
Within Thy Father's shrine,
Whose years, with changeless virtue crowned,
Were all alike divine.

hymns.title: Once in Royal David's City

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Once in royal David's city
Stood a lowly cattle-shed,
Where a mother laid her baby
In a manger for His bed
Mary was that mother mild,
Jesus Christ her little child.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He came down to earth from heaven
Who is God and Lord of all,
And His shelter was a stable,
And His cradle was a stall,
With the poor, and mean, and lowly
Lived on earth our Saviour holy.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And through all His wondrous childhood
He would honour and obey
Love, and watch the lowly maiden
In whose gentle arms He lay
Christian children all must be
Mild, obedient, good as He.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: For He is our childhood's pattern;
Day by day like us He grew;
He was little, weak, and helpless;
Tears and smiles like us He knew
And He feeleth for our sadness,
And He shareth in our gladness.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And our eyes at last shall see Him,
Through His own redeeming love;
For that child so dear and gentle
Is our Lord in heaven above;
And He leads His children on
To the place where He is gone.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Not in that poor lowly stable,
With the oxen standing by,
We shall see Him; but in Heaven,
Set at God's right hand on high;
When like stars His children crown'd
All in white shall wait around.

hymns.title: Saviour, Like a Shepherd Lead Us

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Saviour, like a shepherd lead us;
Much we need Thy tender care;
In Thy pleasant pastures feed us,
For our use Thy folds prepare:
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are,
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We are Thine, do Thou befriend us;
Be the Guardian of our way;
Keep Thy flock, from sin defend us,
Seek us when we go astray:
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Hear us when we praise and pray,
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Hear us when we praise and pray.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou hast promised to receive us,
Poor and sinful though we be;
Thou hast mercy to relieve us,
Grace to cleanse, and make us free:
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Early let us turn to Thee.
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Early let us turn to Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Early let us seek Thy favour;
Early let us do Thy will;
Gracious Lord, our only Saviour,
With Thyself our bosoms fill:
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Thou hast loved us love us still;
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Thou hast loved us love us still.

hymns.title: It Is a Thing Most Wonderful

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: It is a thing most wonderful,
Almost too wonderful to be,
That God's own Son should come from heaven
And die to save a child like me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: And yet I know that it is true;
He came to this poor world below,
And wept and toiled and mourned and died,
Only because He loved us so.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I cannot tell how He could love
A child so weak and full of sin;
His love must be most wonderful,
If He could die my love to win.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: It is most wonderful to know
His love for me so free and sure;
But 'tis more wonderful to see
My love for Him so faint and poor.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And yet I want to love Thee, Lord:
Oh, light the flame within my heart,
And I will love Thee more and more
Until I see Thee as Thou art.

hymns.title: Children of Jerusalem

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Children of Jerusalem
Sang the praise of Jesus' name;
Children, too, of modern days,
Join to sing the Saviour's praise.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hark, hark, hark! while infant voices sing,
Hark, hark, hark! while infant voices sing
Loud Hosannas, loud Hosannas,
Loud Hosannas, to our King.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We are taught to love the Lord,
We are taught to read His word,
We are taught the way to heaven;
Praise for all to God be given.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hark, hark, hark! while infant voices sing,
Hark, hark, hark! while infant voices sing
Loud Hosannas, loud Hosannas,
Loud Hosannas, to our King.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Parents, teachers, old and young,
All unite to swell the song;
Higher and yet higher rise,
Till hosannas reach the skies.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Hark, hark, hark! while infant voices sing,
Hark, hark, hark! while infant voices sing
Loud Hosannas, loud Hosannas,
Loud Hosannas, to our King.

hymns.title: Jesus Love the Little Children

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus love the little children,
Once He took them on His knee,
Gently put His arm around them,
Saying, "Let them come to Me!"

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh! He loves to see them kneeling,
And with hands together pray;
Love to hear them call Him Jesus,
If they mean the words they say.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: If they trust Him as their Saviour,
He will wash their sins away;
He will take their hand and lead them
All along the narrow way.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He would have them love each other,
And be truthful, meek, and mild,
Doing as their parents bid them,
As He did when once a Child.

hymns.title: Come, Thou Long-Expected Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, Thou long-expected Jesus,
Born to set Thy people free;
To release us from sin's terror,
And our rest to find in Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou art Israel's consolation,
And the hope of earth, Thou art
Thou art every nation desire
Filling longing hearts with joy.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Thou art born to deliver us
Thou art King, but born as a child
Eternally, to reign in us
Thy gracious Kingdom to bring.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Let Thy own eternal Spirit
Govern in our hearts alone
By Thy all sufficient merit
Take us to Thy glorious throne.

hymns.title: Rest in the Lord From Harps Above

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Rest in the Lord from harps above
The music seems to thrill
Rest in His everlasting love
Rest and be still.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Rest thou, who claimest for thine own
Thy chosen bride today,
Affianced in his faith alone
Thy bride for aye.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And thou whose trustful hand is given
Avouching here thy spouse
Rest for a father seals in heaven
His children's vows.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Rest ye who cluster round them both
To mingle praise and prayers
Your God affirms the plighted troth,
Your God and theirs.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Rest, for the heavenly Bridegroom here
Is standing by your side,
And in this union draws more near
His mystic bride.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Rest in the Lord thrice Holy dove,
In us thy word fulfil,
Rest in his everlasting love,
Rest and be still.

hymns.title: The Voice that Breathed O'er Eden

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The voice that breathed o'er Eden,
That earliest wedding day,
The primal marriage blessing,
It hath not passed away.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Still in the pure espousal
Of Christian man and maid
The Holy Three are with us,
The threefold grace is said.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: For dower of blessed children,
For love and faith's sweet sake,
For high mysterious union
Which nought on earth may break.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Be present, heavenly Father,
To give away this bride,
As Eve Thou gav'st to Adam
Out of his own pierced side.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Be present, gracious Saviour,
To join their loving hands,
As Thou didst bind two natures
In Thine eternal bands.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Be present, Holy Spirit
To bless them as they kneel
As Thou for Christ the Bridegroom
The heavenly spouse dost seal.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: O spread Thy pure wings o'er them!
Let no ill power find place,
When onward throught life's journey
The hallowed path they trace.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: To cast their crowns before Thee,
In perfect sacrifice,
Till to the home of gladness
With Christ's own bride they rise.

hymns.title: O Perfect Love, All Human Thought Transcending

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O perfect Love, all human thought transcending,
Lowly we kneel in pray'r before Thy throne,
That theirs may be the love which knows no ending,
Whom Thou for evermore dost join in one.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O perfect Life, be Thou their full assurance,
Of tender charity and steadfast faith,
Of patient hope, and quiet brave endurance,
With childlike trust that fears nor pain nor death.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Grant them the joy which brightens earthly sorrows,
Grant them the peace which calms all earthly strife,
And to life's day the glorious unknown morrow
That dawns upon eternal love and life.

hymns.title: O Father, All-Creating

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Father, all-creating,
Whose wisdom and Whose power
First bound two lives together
In Eden's primal hour;
Today to these Thy children
Thine earliest gift renew;
A home by Thee made blessed,
A love by Thee kept true.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O Saviour, Guest most bounteous
Of old in Galilee,
Vouchsafe to-day Thy presence,
With these who wait on Thee;
Their store of earthly gladness
Transform to heavenly wine,
And teach them, in the tasting,
To know the gift is Thine.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O Spirit of the Father,
Breathe on them from above
So searching in Thy pureness,
So tender in Thy love;
That guarded by Thy presence,
From sin and strife kept free,
Their lives may own Thy guidance
Their hearts be ruled by Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Except Thou build it, Father,
The house is built in vain;
Except Thou, Lord, sustain it,
The joy will turn to pain:
But nought can break the union
Of hearts in Thee made one,
And love which Thou hast hallowed,
Is endless love begun.

hymns.title: Jesus, Do Manifest Thyself

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus, do manifest Thyself
At this matrimony
We beseech Thee to come, O Lord
Reveal Thyself to us.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Pour Thy blessings upon these ones
Whose hands are joined in one
Look down in favour of their match
And bless this their union.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Fill both their bosoms with Thy love,
Give to them contentment
Give them Thy peace O Lord, we pray
And supply all their needs.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Through Thy perfect love, make them one
That they, may by Christ's love,
Make domestic cares become light
By helping each other.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Let them be help to each other
In matters of their faith
And bless thou them with good children
Who will stablish their home.

hymns.title: For in Cana of Galilee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: For in Cana of Galilee,
At the blest marriage feast,
Jesus was present in that place
And His disciples too.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus, reveal Thyself we pray
At this holy wedding,
And bestow all Thy blessing,
Upon husband and wife.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let them both be in fellowship
All the days of their life,
Let Thy divine love be the tie
That the world cannot break.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: That they may one another help
By working together,
Grant them Thy peace, O Lord, we pray
And true satisfaction.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Like the first blessings Thou gave in
The garden of Eden,
That they may go and multiply
Until their lives shall end.

hymns.title: God Give Us Christian Homes

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God give us Christian homes
Homes where the Bible is loved and taught
Homes where the Master's will is sought
Homes crowned with beauty Thy love hath wrought
God give us Christian homes
God give us Christian homes.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: God give us Christian homes
Homes where the father is true and strong
Homes that are free from the blight of wrong
Homes that are joyous with love and song
God give us Christian homes
God give us Christian homes.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: God give us Christian homes
Homes where the mother in queenly quest
Strives to show others Thy way is best
Homes where the Lord is an honoured guest.
God give us Christian homes
God give us Christian homes.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: God give us Christian homes
Homes where the children are led to know
Christ in His beauty who loves them so
Homes where the altar fire burn and glow
God give us Christian homes
God give us Christian homes.

hymns.title: God's Peace Be Unto This House

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God's peace be unto this house
And all those dwelling therein
May Gods's peace form heav'n above
Dwell on earth with men of peace;
Let the Holy Ghost descend
That the blessing may come down;
Prince of peace, receive Thy crown,
And the fullness of Thy grace.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Christ, Thou art my Lord and God
Let me Thy good herald be;
Remember Thy word, we pray,
Visit them and visit me;
Let salvation enter in
This house and all that dwell there,
Deliver our hearts from sin,
Make us Thy holy abode.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Do not let us grow weary
Till the promise is fulfilled,
Until we shall be Thine own
By our being sanctified,
Grant that our love be renewed,
That we find our lost blessing,
And may we be temple of
Father, Son and Holy Ghost.

hymns.title: Christ Is the Foundation

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Christ is the foundation
Of the house we raise;
Be its walls salvation,
And its gateways praise:
May its threshold lowly
To the Lord be dear;
May the hearts be holy
That shall worship here.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Here the vow be sealed
By Thy Spirit, Lord;
Here the sick be healed,
And the lost restored;
Here the broken-hearted
Thy forgiveness prove;
Here the friends long parted
Be restored to love.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Here may every token
Of Thy precious be:
Here may chains be broken,
Prisoners here set free;
Here may light illumine
Every soul of Thine,
Lifting up the human
Into the divine.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Here may God the Father,
Christ the Saviour - Son,
With the Holy Spirit,
Be adored as One;
Till the whole creation
At Thy footstool fall,
And in adoration
Own Thee Lord of all.

hymns.title: O Lord, We Praise Thee for Thy Care

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Lord, we praise Thee for Thy care
Upon this holy temple here,
The devil must not fight and cause
Panic to the worshipers there.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We build this wall for Thy honour
Use it for Thy great praise always
And when Thou be pleas'd to descend,
Fill all its corners with thy grace.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: And when that terrible day comes
When God shall judge the heav'n and earth
Let it be known that in this house
Many were born to Thy glory.

hymns.title: Christ Is Our Corner-Stone

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Christ is our Corner-stone;
One Him alone we build;
With His true Saints alone
The courts of Heaven are filled;
On His great Love
Our hopes we place
Of present grace,
And joys above.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh, then with hymns of praise
These hallow'd courts shall ring:
Our voice we will raise,
The Three in One to sing;
And thus proclaim
In joyful song,
Both loud and long,
That glorious Name.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Here, gracious God, do Thou
For evermore draw nigh;
Accept each faithful vow,
And mark each suppliant sigh;
In copious shower
On all who pray,
Each holy day,
Thy blessings pour.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Here may we gain from Heaven,
The grace which we implore,
And may that grace, once given
Be with us evermore;
Until that day,
When all the blest,
To endless rest
Are call'd away.

hymns.title: We Lay Down This Foundation, Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We lay down this foundation, Lord
In Thy name, Our Lord Jesus Christ,
We beseech Thee our dear Saviour
Keep this holy place in Thy care.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: And when these Thy people seek Thee,
And sinners seek Thee in this house
Hear, Almighty from heav'n above
O Lord our God, forgive their sins.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When Thy ministers preach the Word
The gospel of Jesus Thy Son,
Almighty God, in Thy great name
Wrought our wonderful miracles.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And when the little children sing
Their hymns of praise unto their king
Let angels join them in His praise
And earth and heav'n lend their chorus.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Jehovah will Thou dwell with us
In this our wicked, sinful world?
Jesus Christ will Thou be our King?
Holy Ghost will Thou find rest here?

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: May Thy glory never depart
From this house that we are building,
Make thy kingdom within our hearts
And establish Thy throne within.

hymns.title: In Thy Great Name, God Almighty

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: In Thy great name, God Almighty
We build this house of praise for Thee;
Choose it for Thy special abode
And keep it safe from all error.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When Thy people shall seek Thee here
And sinners seek and plead for life;
Hear us from Thy dwelling on high
And when Thou shall hear, do forgive.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When Thy servant shall preach the word
The gospel of Jesus Christ here,
By the power in Thy great name
May signs and wonders be perform'd.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: When infant voices sing their songs,
Hossana to their king on high,
May earth and heav'n join the refrain
And all angels sing Hossana.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: May The glory never depart
Yet, keep Thy presence in this house;
Thy kingdom come to every heart
Until Thou be enthroned on earth.

hymns.title: Be with Us, Gracious Lord, Today

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Be with us, gracious Lord, to-day;
This house we dedicate to Thee:
O hear Thy servants as they pray,
And let Thine ear attentive be!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Within these walls let holy peace,
Let love and truth be always found;
May burdened hearts find sweet release,
And souls with richest grace be crown'd.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: May here be heard the suppliant's sigh,
The weary enter into rest;
Here may the contrite to Thee cry,
And waiting souls be richly bless'd.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Here, when the gospel sound is heard,
And here proclaimed the saving name,
May hearts be quicken'd, mov'd and stirr'd,
And souls be kindled into flame.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Here may the dead be made to live,
The dumb to sing, the deaf to hear;
And do Thou to the humble give
Pardon and peace instead of fear.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Make this, O Lord, Thine own abode;
Thy presence in these courts be giv'n;
Be this, indeed, the house of God,
And this in truth the gate of heaven.

hymns.title: A Few More Years Shall Roll

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: A few more years shall roll,
A few more seasons come,
And we shall be with those that rest
Asleep within the tomb.
Then, O my Lord, prepare
My soul for that great day;
Oh, wash me in Thy precious blood,
And take my sins away.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: A few more suns shall set,
O'er these dark hills of time;
And we shall be where suns are not,
A far serener clime
Then, O my Lord, prepare
My soul for that great day;
Oh, wash me in Thy precious blood,
And take my sins away.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: A few more storms shall beat
On this wild rocky shore;
And we shall be where tempests cease,
And surges swell no more.
Then, O my Lord, prepare
My soul for that great day;
Oh, wash me in Thy precious blood,
And take my sins away.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: A few more struggles here,
A few more partings o'er;
A few more tolls, a few more tears,
And we shall weep no more tears,
Then, O my Lord, prepare
My soul for that great day;
Oh, wash me in Thy precious blood,
And take my sins away.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: A few more sabbaths here,
Shall cheer us on our way;
And we shall reach the endless rest,
The eternal sabbath.
Then, O my Lord, prepare
My soul for that great day;
Oh, wash me in Thy precious blood,
And take my sins away.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: 'Tis but a little while
And He shall come again,
Who died that we might live; who lives
That we with Him may reign.
Then, O my Lord, prepare
My soul for that great day;
Oh, wash me in Thy precious blood,
And take my sins away.

hymns.title: Days and Moments Quickly Flying

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Days and moments quickly flying
Speed us onward to the dead
Oh, how soon shall we be lying,
Each within his narrow bed!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus, merciful Redeemer
Rouse dead souls to hear Thy voice
Wake, oh wake each idle dreamer
Now to make th'eternal choice.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Mark we whither we are wending
Ponder how we soon must go
To inherit bliss un-ending
Or eternity of woe.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Life passeth soon death draweth near
Keep us, Lord till Thou appear
With Thee to live with Thee to die
With Thee to reign evermore.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: As a shadow life is fleeting
As a vapour so it flies,
For the bygone years retreating
Pardon grant, and make us wise.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Wise that we our days may number
Strive and wrestle with our sin
Stay not in our work nor slumber
Till Thy holy rest we win.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Soon before the Judge all glorious
We with all the dead shall stand
Saviour, over death victorious
Place us then on Thy right hand.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Life passeth soon death draweth near
Keep us, Lord till Thou appear
With Thee to live with Thee to die
With Thee to reign evermore.

hymns.title: Face to Face with Christ My Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Face to face with Christ my Saviour,
Face to face what will it be?
When with rapture I behold Him,
Jesus Christ who died for me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Face to face I shall behold Him,
Far beyond the starry sky;
Face to face in all His glory,
I shall see Him by and by.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Only faintly now I see Him,
With the darkling veil between;
But a blessed day is coming,
When His glory shall be seen.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Face to face I shall behold Him,
Far beyond the starry sky;
Face to face in all His glory,
I shall see Him by and by.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: What rejoicing in His presence,
When are banished grief and pain;
When the crooked ways are straightened,
And the dark things shall be plain.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Face to face I shall behold Him,
Far beyond the starry sky;
Face to face in all His glory,
I shall see Him by and by.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Face to face! O blissful moment!
Face to face - to see and know;
Face to face with my Redeemer,
Jesus Christ who loves me so.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Face to face I shall behold Him,
Far beyond the starry sky;
Face to face in all His glory,
I shall see Him by and by.

hymns.title: How Bright These Glorious Spirits Shine

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: How bright these glorious spirits shine!
Whence all their white array?
How came they to the blissful seats
Of everlasting day?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lo! these are they from sufferings great
Who came to realms of light;
And in the blood of Christ have washed
Those robes that shine so bright.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Now with triumphal palms they stand
Before the throne so high,
And serve the God they love amidst
The glories of the sky.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Hunger and thirst are felt no more,
Nor suns with scorching ray;
God is their Sun, whose cheering beams
Diffuse eternal day.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: The Lamb which dwells amidst the throne,
Shall o'er them still preside,
Feed them with nourishment Divine,
And all their footsteps guide.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: 'Midst pastures green He'll lead His flock,
Where living streams appear;
And God the Lord from every eye
Shall wipe off every tear.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: To Father, Son, and Holy Ghost,
The God whom we adore,
Be glory, as it was, is now,
And shall be evermore.

hymns.title: I Shall See the King Where the Angels Sing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I shall see the King where the an-gels sing,
I shall see the King some day,
In the bet-ter land, On the gold-en strand,
And with Him shall ev-er stay.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In His glo-ry, I shall see the King,
And for-ev-er end-less prais-es sing;
'Twas on Cal-va-ry Jesus died for me;
I shall see the King someday.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: In the land of song, In the glo-ry throng,
Where there ne-ver comes a night,
With my Lord once slain I shall ev-er reign
In the glo-ry land of light.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In His glo-ry, I shall see the King,
And for-ev-er end-less prais-es sing;
'Twas on Cal-va-ry Jesus died for me;
I shall see the King someday.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I shall see the King, All my tri-butes bring,
And shall look up-on His face;
Then my song shall be How He ran-somed me,
And has kept me by His grace.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In His glo-ry, I shall see the King,
And for-ev-er end-less prais-es sing;
'Twas on Cal-va-ry Jesus died for me;
I shall see the King someday.

hymns.title: Let Us Sing of His Love Once Again

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Let us sing of His love once again
Of the love that can never decay,
Of the blood of the Lamb who was slain,
Till we praise Him again in that day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In the sweet by and by
We shall meet on the beautiful shore;
In the sweet by and by
We shall meet on the beautiful shore.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There are cleansing and healing for all
Who will wash in the life-giving flood,
There is life everlasting and joy
At the right hand of God through the blood.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In the sweet by and by
We shall meet on the beautiful shore;
In the sweet by and by
We shall meet on the beautiful shore.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Even now while we taste of His love
We are filled with delight at his name;
But what will it be when above
We shall join in the song of the Lamb!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In the sweet by and by
We shall meet on the beautiful shore;
In the sweet by and by
We shall meet on the beautiful shore.

hymns.title: When This Passing World Is Done

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When this passing world is done,
When has sunk yon glaring sun,
When we stand with Christ on high,
Looking o'er life's history,
Then, Lord, shall I fully know,
Not till then, how much I owe.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When I stand before the throne,
Dress'd in beauty not my own,
When I see Thee as Thou art,
Love Thee with unsinning heart,
Then, Lord, shall I fully know,
Not till then, how much I owe.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When the praise of heaven I hear,
Loud as thunders to the ear,
Loud as many water's noise,
Sweet as harp's melodious voice,
Then, Lord, shall I fully know,
Not till then, how much I owe.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Ev'n on earth, as through a glass,
Darkly, let Thy glory pass;
Make forgiveness feel so sweet,
Make Thy Spirit's help so meet;
Ev'n on earth, Lord make me know
Something of how much I owe.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Chosen not for good in me,
Waken'd up from wrath to flee,
Hidden in the Saviour's side
By the Spirit sanctified,
Teach me, Lord, on earth to show,
By my love, how much I owe.

hymns.title: I Shall Wear a Golden Crown

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I shall wear a golden crown
When I get home
I shall lay my burdens down
When I get home
Clad in robes of glory
I shall sing the story
Of the Lord who bought me
When I get home.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: When I get home
When I get home
All sorrow will be over
When I get home
When I get home
When I get home
All sorrow will be over
When I get home.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All the darkness will be past
When I get home
I shall see the light at last
When I get home
Light from heaven streaming
O'er my pathway beaming
Ever guides me onward
Till I get home.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: When I get home
When I get home
All sorrow will be over
When I get home
When I get home
When I get home
All sorrow will be over
When I get home.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I shall see my Saviour's face
When I get home
Sing again of saving grace
When I get home
I shall stand before him
Gladly I'll adore Him
Ever to be with Him
When I get home.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: When I get home
When I get home
All sorrow will be over
When I get home
When I get home
When I get home
All sorrow will be over
When I get home.

hymns.title: I Am a Stranger Here

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I am a stranger here,
Heav'n is my home,
Only a sojourner,
Heav'n is my home;
Danger and sorrow stand
Round me on every hand;
Heav'n is my Fatherland
Heav'n is my home.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: What though the tempest rage,
Heav'n is my home;
Short is my pilgrimage,
Heav'n is my home;
And time's wild wintry blast
Soon will be overpast;
I shall reach home at last,
Heav'n is my home.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There at my Saviour's side
Heav'n is my home;
I shall be glorified,
Heav'n is my home;
Where all the saints of God,
After life's weary road,
Have their divine abode,
Heav'n is my home.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Therefore I'll murmur not,
Heav'n is my home;
Whate'er my earthly lot,
Heav'n is my home;
For I shall surely stand
There at my Lord's right hand
Heaven is my Fatherland,
Heav'n is my home.

hymns.title: For Ever with the Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: For ever with the Lord!
Amen, so let it be!
Life from the dead is in that word;
'Tis immortality.
Here in the body pent,
Absent from Him I roam;
Yet nightly pitch my moving tent
A day's march nearer home.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: My Father's house on high,
Home of my soul, how near
At times to faith's foreseeing eye
Thy golden gates appear!
My thirsty spirit faints
To reach the land I love,
To bright inheritance of saints
Jerusalem above.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: For ever with the Lord!
Father, if 'tis Thy will,
The promise of that faithful word,
E'en here to me fulfil.
Be Thou at my right hand,
Then can I never fail;
Uphold Thou me, so shall I stand,
Fight, and I must prevail.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: So when my latest breath
Shall rend the veil in twain,
By death I shall escape from death,
And life eternal gain.
Knowing as I am known,
How shall I love that word!
And oft repeat before the throne,
For ever with the Lord!

hymns.title: Jerusalem, My Happy Home

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jerusalem, my happy home,
Name ever dear to me!
When shall my labours have an end,
In joy, and peace, and thee?
When shall these eyes thy heav'n built walls
And pearly gates behold,
Thy bulwarks with salvation strong,
And streets of shining gold?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There happier bowers than Eden's bloom,
Nor sin nor sorrow know:
Blest seats, through rude and stormy scenes
I onward press to you.
Why should I shrink at pain and woe,
Or feel, at death, dismay?
I've Canaan's goodly land in view,
And realms of endless day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Apostles, prophets, martyrs there,
Around my Saviour stand
And soon my friends in Christ below
Will join the glorious band.
Jerusalem, my happy home,
