My soul still pants for thee!
Then shall my labours have an end
When I thy joys shall see.

hymns.title: For All the Saints Who From Their Labours Rest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: For all the saints who from their labours rest,
Who Thee by faith before the world confessed,
Thy name, O Jesus, be for ever blest.
Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou was their Rock, their Fortress, and their Might;
Thou, Lord, their Captain in the well fought fight;
Thou in the darkness drear their one true light.
Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh, may Thy soldiers, faithful, true and bold,
Fight as the saints who nobly fought of old,
And win, with them, the victor's crown of gold.
Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O blest communion! fellowship Divine!
We feebly struggle, they in glory shine;
Yet all are one in Thee, for all are Thine.
Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And when the strife is fierce, the warface long,
Steals on the ear the distant triumph - song,
And hearts are brave again, and arms are strong
Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: The golden evening brightens in the west;
Soon, soon, to faithful warriors comes their rest;
Sweet is the calm of Paradise the blest,
Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: But lo! there breaks a yet more glorious day;
The saints triumphant rise in bright array:
The King of glory passes on His way.
Alleluia!

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: From earth's wide bounds, from ocean's farthest coast,
Through gates of pearl streams in the countless host,
Singing to Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.
Alleluia!

hymns.title: In the Land of Fadeless Day

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: In the land of fadeless day,
Lies the city four square,
It shall never pass away,
And there is no night there,

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: God shall wipe away all tears;
There's no death, no pain, nor fears;
And they count not time by years,
And there is no night there.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All the gates of pearl are made
In the city foursquare;
All the streets with gold are laid,
And there is no night there.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: God shall wipe away all tears;
There's no death, no pain, nor fears;
And they count not time by years,
And there is no night there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: All the gates shall never close
To the city foursquare;
There life's crystal river flows,
And there is no night there.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: God shall wipe away all tears;
There's no death, no pain, nor fears;
And they count not time by years,
And there is no night there.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There they need no sunshine bright,
In the city foursquare;
For the Lamb is all the light,
And there is no night there.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: God shall wipe away all tears;
There's no death, no pain, nor fears;
And they count not time by years,
And there is no night there.

hymns.title: We Speak: Of the Realms of the Blest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We speak: of the realms of the Blest,
Of that country so bright and so fair;
And oft are its glories confess’d;
But what must it be to be there?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We speak: of its pathways of gold,
Of its wallsdeck’d with jewels most rare,
Its wonders and pleasures untold;
But what must it be to be there?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We speak: of its freedom from sin,
From all sorrow, temptation, and cares,
From trials without and within;
But what must it be to be there.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: We speak: of its anthems of praise,
With which we can never compare,
The sweetest on earth we can raise;
But what must it be to be there?

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: We speak: of its service of love,
Of the robes which the glorified wear,
The church of the First Born above;
But what must it be to be there?

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Do Thou, Lord, midst pleasure or woe,
Still for heaven our spirits prepare;
And shortly we also shall know
And feel what it is to the there.

hymns.title: Here We Suffer Grief and Pain

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Here we suffer grief and pain,
Here we meet to part again;
In heaven we part no more.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, that will be joyful!
Joyful, joyful, joyful!
Oh, that will be joyful!
When we meet to part no more.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All who love the Lord below,
When they die to heaven will go,
And join with saints above.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, that will be joyful!
Joyful, joyful, joyful!
Oh, that will be joyful!
When we meet to part no more.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Little children will be there,
Who have sought the Lord by prayer,
From every Sunday School.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, that will be joyful!
Joyful, joyful, joyful!
Oh, that will be joyful!
When we meet to part no more.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Teachers, too, will meet above,
Pastors, parents, whom we love,
Shall meet to part no more.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, that will be joyful!
Joyful, joyful, joyful!
Oh, that will be joyful!
When we meet to part no more.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Oh, how happy we shall be!
For our Saviour we shall see;
Exalted on His throne.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, that will be joyful!
Joyful, joyful, joyful!
Oh, that will be joyful!
When we meet to part no more.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: There, we all shall sing for joy,
And eternity employ:
In praising Christ, the Lord.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, that will be joyful!
Joyful, joyful, joyful!
Oh, that will be joyful!
When we meet to part no more.

hymns.title: Shall We Gather at the River

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Shall we gather at the river,
Where bright angel feet have trod;
With its crystal tide for ever
Flowing by the throne of God?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: On the margin of the river,
Guided by our Shepherd King,
We will walk and worship ever:
His dear footsteps following.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: But before we gain the river,
Lay we every burden down,
Jesus, here from sin deliver;
Those whose there Thy grace will crown.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Soon we'll reach the crystal river,
Soon our pilgrimage will cease,
Soon our golden harp strings quiver,
With the melody of peace.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.

hymns.title: Blessed Are They in Jesus

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Blessed are they in Jesus,
Who are all children of God:
Redeemed by His precious blood,
From death to life evermore.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Thank God, I'm counted worthy
In this world and in Heaven.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: All them who are forgiven
Through His ever bourteous grace,
They are rid of all their sins;
All are free on judgement's day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Thank God, I'm counted worthy
In this world and in Heaven.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There they shall bear gracious fruits,
Since they work in righteousness:
Enemies of sins they are,
The Word of God lives in them.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Thank God, I'm counted worthy
In this world and in Heaven.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And by the Blood of the Lamb,
They with God all keep company:
With Jesus' great Majesty,
They are clad in glorious robe.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Thank God, I'm counted worthy
In this world and in Heaven.

hymns.title: Who Are These, Like Stars Appearing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Who are these, like stars appearing,
These, before God's throne who stand?
Each a golden crown is wearing:
Who are all these glourious band?
Hallelujah! hark, they sing,
Praising loud their heavenly King.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Who are these, in dazling brightness,
Clothed in God's own righteousness;
These, whose robes of purest whiteness
Shall their lustre still possess,
Still untouch'd by time's rude hand?
Whence come all these glorious bands?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: These are they who have contended
For their Saviour's honour long,
Wrestling on till life was ended,
Following not the sinful throng,
These, who well the fight sustain'd,
Triumph by the Lamb have gain'd.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: These are they whose hearts were riven,
Sore with woe and anguish tried
Who in prayer full oft have striven
With the God they glorified;
Now, their painful conflict o'er,
God has bid them, weep no more.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: These are they who watch'd and waited,
Offering up to Christ their will;
Soul and body consecrated
Day and night to serve Him still;
Now in God's most holy place,
Blest they stand before His face.

hymns.title: When All My Labor and Trial Are O'er

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When all my labor and trial are o'er,
And I am safe on that beautiful shore,
Just to be near the dear Lord I adore,
Will thro' the ages be glory for me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O that will be glory for me.
Glory for me, glory for me;
When by His grace
I shall look on His face,
That will be glory, be glory for me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When, by the gift of His infinite grace,
I am accorded in Heaven a place,
Just to be there and to look on His face,
Will thro' the ages be glory for me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O that will be glory for me.
Glory for me, glory for me;
When by His grace
I shall look on His face,
That will be glory, be glory for me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Friends will be there I have loved long ago;
Joy like a river around me will flow;
Yet, just a smile from my Saviour, I know,
Will thro' the ages be glory for me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: O that will be glory for me.
Glory for me, glory for me;
When by His grace
I shall look on His face,
That will be glory, be glory for me.

hymns.title: We Shall Meet Beyond the River

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We shall meet beyond the river,
By and by, by and by;
And the darkness shall be o'er,
By and by, by and by;
With the toilsome journey done,
And the glorious battle won,
We shall shine forth as the sun,
By and by, by and by;

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We shall strike the harps of glory,
By and by, by and by;
We shall sing redemption's story,
By and by, by and by;
And the strains, for evermore,
Shall resound in sweetness o'er
Yonder everlasting shore
By and by, by and by;

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We shall see and be like Jesus,
By and by, by and by;
Who a crown of life will give us,
By and by, by and by;
And the angels who fulfil
All the mandates of His will
Shall attend and love us still,
By and by, by and by;

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There our tears shall all cease flowing,
By and by, by and by;
And with sweetest rapture knowing,
By and by, by and by;
And all the blest ones, who have gone,
To the land of life and song,
We with shouting shall rejoin,
By and by, by and by;

hymns.title: They Have Reach'd You Golden Shore

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: They have reach'd you golden shore,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n;
They shall hunger there no more,
They are ever free from pain;
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There, they need no light of lamp,
Up in heav'n. up in heav'n.
There they have perpetual light,
Jesus is their shinning light,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Ah, the streets are made of gold,
Up in heav'n. up in heav'n.
There the glory never fades,
For the flock of Christ they are,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: It is never chilly there,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.
For their winter is all past,
Every day is ever bright,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: They have all ceased from their fight,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.
Jesus Christ has saved their souls,
They with Him walk hand in hand,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: They shall no more cry nor weep,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.
Jesus is always with them,
With Him is abundant joy,
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Ah we shall soon join the throng
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.
We except our time to come,
When our Lord shall call us home
Up in heav'n; up in heav'n.

hymns.title: For All Thy Saints, O Lord

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: For all Thy saints, O Lord,
Who strove in Thee to live,
Who followed Thee, obey'd ador'd,
Our grateful hymn receive.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: For all Thy saints, O Lord,
Accept our thankful cry;
Who counted Thee their great reward,
And strove in Thee to die.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: They all, in life and death,
With Thee their Lord in view,
Learned from Thy Holy Spirit's breath
To suffer and to do.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: For this Thy name we bless,
And humbly pray that we
May follow them in holiness,
And live and die in Thee.

hymns.title: "He's Asleep" Jesus Said

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "He's asleep" Jesus said
Of Lazarus His friend
He who was dead, and was buried
And laid in His own grave.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He who died for four days
Jesus said, he's asleep
He's the resurrection and life
For all those that trust Him.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus' friends never die
But their bodies conceal
Away from worm, below the ground
Now to fly in the sky.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Sleep on thou beloved
Jesus is by your side
Be not afraid, for He promised
Resurrection to us.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: His voice will soon be heard,
From thy now resting place
His sweet voice will now call on thee
Into resurrection.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Let's not be sorrowful
Like one that has no hope
We bid thee farewell dear belov'd
Sleep on and take thy rest.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: And we also shall sleep
At the time of our call
O that we at dawn meet again
At the feet of our Lord.

hymns.title: Come, Let Us Join Our Friends Above

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Come, let us join our friends above,
That have obtained the prize,
And on the eagle wings of love
To joys celestial rise.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let all the saints terrestrial sing,
With those to glory gone;
For all the servants of our King,
In earth and heav'n, are one.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: One family we dwell in Him,
One church, above, beneath,
Though now divided by the stream,
The narrow stream of death.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: One army of the living God,
To His command we bow;
Part of His host have cross'd the flood,
And part are crossing now.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Our spirits too shall quickly join,
Like theirs with glory crowned,
And shout to see our Captain's sign
To hear His trumpet sound.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: O Jesus be our guard and guide
O that the word were given!
Come, Lord of hosts, the waves divide,
And land us all in heaven.

hymns.title: When Ends Earth's Long and Evil Day

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When ends earth's long and evil day,
This world of mis'ry and of woes,
There is a place so bright,
No change or decay there to find,
No night, but all eternal day,
Tell me, will you be there?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: It's pearly gates are closed to sin
No unclean thing shall enter in,
To spoil the place so bright,
That happy, shining golden shore,
No curse will ever there be found,
Tell me, will you be there?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Who will be there the lowly heart?
Who served the Lord in godly fear,
Who count the world but loss
Those led by the Holy Spirit
Those who walk in the narrow way,
They are those to be there.

hymns.title: Some Day, but when I Cannot Tell

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Some day, but when I cannot tell
To toil and tears I'll bid farewell
For I shall with the angels dwell
Some day, some blessed day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Some day... some day
I'll be at home with Christ to stay,
Some day, some blessed day.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Some day within the gates so fair
A golden harp my hands shall bear
And glistening robes of white I'll wear
Some day, some blessed day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Some day... some day
I'll be at home with Christ to stay,
Some day, some blessed day.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Some day I'll see my Saviour's face,
And welcome to His blest embrace
Shall with His people find a place,
Some day, some blessed day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Some day... some day
I'll be at home with Christ to stay,
Some day, some blessed day.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Some day, some blessed day I know
I'll find the loved of long ago
And learn how much to Christ I owe
Some day, some blessed day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Some day... some day
I'll be at home with Christ to stay,
Some day, some blessed day.

hymns.title: What Are Those Sabbaths of Joy without End

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: What are those Sabbaths of joy, without end,
Angels in light and the glorified spend:
Rest for the weary; for victors reward;
There God Himself all and in all adored?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Who is the Monarch? who circle His throne?
What is the calm restful bliss of His own?
Tell us, ye blessed ones worshiping there,
Tell us, if words can your rapture declare

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh true Jerusalem, city most bright,
Whose perfect peace is eternal delight;
Longings in thee are fulfill'd ere express'd:
More than was long'd for embraced and possessed.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Troubles all past, in the courts of our King,
We without fear Zion's anthems shall sing,
Off'ring Thee, Lord, in Thy presence above
Love's pure responses for gifts of thy love.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: There never Sabbath to Sabbath give place:
One is their Sabbath who gaze on Thy face,
There never cease heaven's jubilee songs,
Chanted by saints and by sweet angel tongues.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Meantime in heart and with faith-winged prayers,
Seek we our Fatherland yonder and theirs:
While to Jerusalem bounden we roam,
Exiles returning from Babylon home.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Now before Him we adoringly fall,
Of whom and through whom and in whom are all;
Of whom the Father, and through whom the Son,
In whom the Spirit of Both, ever One.

hymns.title: There Is a Home Eternal

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is a Home eternal,
Beautiful and bright,
Where sweet joys supernal
Never are dimm'd by a night,
White-rob'd angels are singing,
Ever around the bright throne;
When, oh, when shall I see thee,
Beautiful, beautiful Home?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Home! beautiful Home!
Bright, beautiful Home!
Bright, Home of our Saviour,
Bright, beautiful Home!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Flowers are ever springing
In that Home so fair,
Little children singing
Praises to Jesus there,
How they swell the glad' anthem,
Ever around the bright throne!
When, oh, when shall I see thee,
Beautiful, beautiful Home!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Home! beautiful Home!
Bright, beautiful Home!
Bright, Home of our Saviour,
Bright, beautiful Home!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Soon shall I join the ransomed,
Far beyond the sky;
Christ is my salvation,
Why should I fear to die?
Soon my eyes shall behold Him
Seated upon the bright throne;
Then, oh, then shall I see thee,
Beautiful, beautiful Home!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Home! beautiful Home!
Bright, beautiful Home!
Bright, Home of our Saviour,
Bright, beautiful Home!

hymns.title: Give Me the Wings of Faith to Rise

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Give me the wings of faith to rise
Within the veil, and see
The saints above, how great their joys,
How bright their glories be.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I ask them whence their victory came;
They with united breath,
Ascribe their conquest to the Lamb,
Their triumph to His death.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: They marked the footsteps that He trod,
His zeal inspired their breast,
And foll'wing their incarnate God,
Possess the promised rest.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Our glorious Leader claims our praise
For His own pattern given:
While the long cloud of witnesses
Show the same path to haven.

hymns.title: Servant of God, Well Done

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: "Servant of God, well done
From all your labours, rest;
Thou has fought and Thou has triumphed
Enter Thy Master's joy,"
The call came in the night,
He rais'd himself to hear,
The arrow of death enter'd in,
He fell, but did not fear.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The midnight cry went forth,
"Arise to meet Thy God"
He woke, and saw his commander,
Through prayer and in faith
His soul rose up at once,
Left this body of clay:
When morn broke, this body of clay
Was found lying down dead.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The pangs of death is past,
Cares and distress are o'er
The days of fighting are all gone,
His heart has found real peace;
Soldier of Christ, "well done"
Keep singing songs of joy:
Take thy rest in Thy Saviour's breast,
And rest eternally.

hymns.title: There Is a Happy Land

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is a happy land,
Far, far away,
Where saints in glory stand,
Bright, bright as day.
O, how they sweetly sing,
'Worthy is our Saviour King!'
Loud let His praises ring,
Praise, praise for aye.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Come to this happy land,
Come, come away;
Why will ye doubting stand?
Why still delay?
O, we shall happy be,
When, from sin and sorrow free,
Lord, we shall live with Thee,
Blest, blest for aye.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Bright in that happy land,
Beams every eye;
Kept by a Father's hand,
Love cannot die;
On then to glory run;
Be a crown, a kingdom won;
And, bright above the sun,
Reign, reign for aye.

hymns.title: Jerusalem the Golden

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jerusalem the golden,
With milk and honey blest,
Beneath thy contemplation
Sink heart and voice oppressed;
I know not, oh! I know not,
What joys await us there,
What radiancy of glory,
What bliss beyond compare.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: They stand, those halls of Zion,
All jubilant with song;
And bright with many an angel,
And all the martyr throng:
The Prince is ever in them,
The daylight is serene,
The pastures of the blessed
Are decked in glorious sheen.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There is the throne of David,
And there from care released,
The shout of them that triumph,
The song of them that feast;
And they who with their Leader,
Have conquered in the fight,
For ever and for ever
Are clothed in robes of white.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Oh, sweet and blessed country,
The home of God's elect!
Oh, sweet and blessed country
That eager hearts expect!
Jesus, in mercy bring us
To that dear land of rest,
Who art, with God the Father,
And Spirit, ever blest.

hymns.title: There Is a Blessed Home

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is a Blessed Home
Beyond this land of woe,
Where trials never come,
Nor tears of sorrow flow;
Where faith is lost in sight,
And patient hope is crown'd,
And everlasting light
Its glory throws around.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There is a land of peace;
Good Angels know it well;
Glad songs that never cease
Within its portals swell;
Around its glorious Throne,
Ten thousand saints adore
Christ, with the Father, One,
And Spirit, evermore.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Oh! joy all joys beyond,
To see the Lamb who died,
For ever there enthroned,
For ever glorified;
To give to Him the praise,
Of every triumph won,
And sing, through endless days,
The great things He hath done.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Look up, ye saints of God!
Nor fear to tread below,
The path your Saviour trod
Of daily toil and woe;
Wait but a little while
In uncomplaining love,
His own most gracious smile
Shall welcome you above.

hymns.title: Sleep on, Beloved, Sleep and Take Thy Rest

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Sleep on, beloved, sleep and take thy rest;
Lay down thy head upon thy Saviour's breast;
We love thee well; but Jesus loves thee best
Good-night! Good-night! Good-night!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Calm is thy slumber as an infant's sleep;
But thou shalt wake no more to toil and weep;
Thine is a perfect rest, secure and deep
Good-night! Good-night! Good-night!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Until the shadows from this earth are cast;
Until He gathers in His sheaves at last;
Until the twilight gloom is over past
Good-night! Good-night! Good-night!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Until the Easter glory lights the skies:
Until the dead in Jesus shall arise,
And He shall come, but not in lowly guise.
Good-night! Good-night! Good-night!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Until made beautiful by Love Divine,
Thou in the likeness of thy Lord shalt shine,
And He shall bring that golden crown of thine
Good-night! Good-night! Good-night!

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Only "Good-night" beloved not "farewell"
A little while, and all His saints shall dwell,
In hallowed union, indivisible
Good-night! Good-night! Good-night!

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Until we meet again before His throne,
Clothed in the spotless robe He gives His own,
Until we know even as we are known
Good-night! Good-night! Good-night!

hymns.title: As the Morning Bell Is Ringing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: As the morning bell is ringing
Calling upon the passing souls
Let every one now ask himself
Are we ready if death now calls?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where loyal hearts and true
Stand ever in the light,
All rapture through and through,
In God's most holy sight?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Now to forsake all earthly wealth
And straight depart the judgement throne
And the voice of the judge to hear
Who will make known my way to go.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where loyal hearts and true
Stand ever in the light,
All rapture through and through,
In God's most holy sight?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Will I love it, if He should say
Get thee away from me thou cursed,
Into everlasting furnace
Prepar'd for Satan and his hosts.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where loyal hearts and true
Stand ever in the light,
All rapture through and through,
In God's most holy sight?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O Lord my Saviour, now save me
I put all my trust upon Thee
Teach me to see perdition way
Teach me to live ever with Thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where loyal hearts and true
Stand ever in the light,
All rapture through and through,
In God's most holy sight?

hymns.title: There's No Further Dwelling Place Here

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's no further dwelling place here,
Therefore, let us not be trifle
E'en tho' thou built a sky scrapper
Thou hast six feet as bed for rest.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There's no further dwelling place here,
Torch and leave is treasure of earth
We came to the world nakedly,
And nakedly we shall return.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There's no further dwelling place here,
We are only sojourners here
Go to the grave and see the hades
They had now reached their resting place.

hymns.title: Oh Think of the Home over There

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Oh think of the Home over there,
By the side of the river of light,
Where the saints, all immortal and fair,
Are robed in their garments of white.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Over there,....over....there,
O think of the Home over there,
Over there,....over there, over there,
O think of the Home over there.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oh, think of the friends over there,
Who before us the journey have trod,
Of the songs that they breathe on the air,
In their home in the palace of God.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Over there,....over....there,
O think of the Home over there,
Over there,....over there, over there,
O think of the Home over there.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: My Saviour is now over there,
There my kindred and friends are at rest,
Then, away from my sorrow and care,
Let me fly to the land of the blest.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Over there,....over....there,
O think of the Home over there,
Over there,....over there, over there,
O think of the Home over there.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: I'll soon be at home over there,
For the end of my journey I see;
Many dear to my hearts, over there,
Are watching and waiting for me.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Over there,....over....there,
O think of the Home over there,
Over there,....over there, over there,
O think of the Home over there.

hymns.title: The Saints of God! Their Conflict Past

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The saints of God! their conflict past,
And life's long battle won at last,
No more they need the shield or sword;
They cast them down before their Lord;
O happy saints! for ever blest;
At Jesus feet how safe their rest!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The saints of God! their wanderings done,
No more their weary course they run,
No more they faint, no more they fall,
No foes oppress, no fears appal;
O happy saints! for ever blest,
In that dear home, how sweet their rest!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The saints of God! life's voyage o'er,
Safe landed on that blissful shore,
No stormy tempests now they dread,
No roaring billows lift their head;
O happy saints! for ever blest,
The great things He hath done.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The saints of God their vigil keep
While yet their mortal bodies sleep,
Till from the dust they too shall rise.
And soar triumphant to the skies;
O happy saints! rejoice and sing:
He quickly comes, our Lord and King.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: O God of saints, to Thee we cry;
O Saviour, plead for us on high;
O Holy Ghost, our Guide and Friend,
Grant us Thy grace till life shall end:
That with all saints our rest may be
In that bright paradise with Thee.

hymns.title: Blessed City, Heav'nly Salem

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Blessed city, Heav'nly Salem,
Vision dear of peace and love,
Who of living stones art builded
In the height of Heav'n above:
And, with Angel-hosts encircled,
As a bride to earth dost move.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: From celestial realms descending,
Bridal glory round there shed,
Meet for Him, Whose love espoused thee,
To thy Lord shalt thou be led;
All thy streets, and all thy bulwarks
Of pure gold are fashioned.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Bright thy gates of pearl are shining,
They are open evermore,
And by virtue of His merits
Thither faithful souls may soar,
Who for Christ's dear Name in this world.
Pain and tribulation bore.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Many a blow and biting sculpture
Polish'd well those stones elect,
In their places now compacted
By the Heav'nly Architect,
Who therewith hath willed for ever
That His palace should be deck'd.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Praise and honour to the Father,
Praise and honour to the Son,
Praise and honour to the Spirit
Ever Three and ever One,
One in Might, and One in Glory,
While Eternal Ages run.

hymns.title: When the Mists Have Rolled in Splendour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When the mists have rolled in splendour
From the beauty of the hills,
And the sunlight falls in gladness
On the river and the rills,
We recall our Father's promise
In the rainbow of the spray;
We shall know each other better
When the mists have rolled away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We shall know... as we are known,
Nevermore... to walk alone,
In the dawning of the morning
Of that bright and happy day,
We shall know each other better
When the mists have rolled away.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oft we tread the path before us
With a weary, burdened heart;
Oft we toil amid the shadows,
And our fields are far apart,
But the Saviour's "Come, ye blessed!"
All our labour will repay,
When we gather in the morning.
Where the mists have rolled away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We shall know... as we are known,
Nevermore... to walk alone,
In the dawning of the morning
Of that bright and happy day,
We shall know each other better
When the mists have rolled away.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: We shall come with joy and gladness,
We shall gather round the throne;
Face to face with those that love us,
We shall know as we are known:
And the song of our redemption
Shall resound through endless day,
When the shadows have departed,
And the mists have rolled away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We shall know... as we are known,
Nevermore... to walk alone,
In the dawning of the morning
Of that bright and happy day,
We shall know each other better
When the mists have rolled away.

hymns.title: O There's No Sorrow in Heaven

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O there's no sorrow in heaven,
No parting and no goodbye;
To those with sins all forgiven,
There'll be no tears in the sky,

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: No sorrow is found in that city,
No heartache and no goodbye:
For all will be bright in that city of light,
For there are no tears in the sky.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O there's no sad disappointment,
No eyes fill'd with tears to dry,
For there will be glad contentment,
There are no tears in the sky.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: No sorrow is found in that city,
No heartache and no goodbye:
For all will be bright in that city of light,
For there are no tears in the sky.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Up there no hearts that are broken,
There no one to breathe a sigh,
No unkind word will be spoken,
There'll be no tears in the sky.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: No sorrow is found in that city,
No heartache and no goodbye:
For all will be bright in that city of light,
For there are no tears in the sky.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Here hearts are sorrow'd by sadness,
For lov'd ones and friends must die,
But there is sunshine and gladness,
There'll be no tears in the sky.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: No sorrow is found in that city,
No heartache and no goodbye:
For all will be bright in that city of light,
For there are no tears in the sky.

hymns.title: How Sweet the Hour of Closing Day

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: How sweet the hour of closing day,
When all its peaceful and serene,
And the broad sun's retiring ray,
Sheds a mild lustre o'er the scene!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Such is the Christian's parting hour,
So peacefully he sinks to rest;
And faith, rekindling all its pow'r,
Lights up the languour of his breast.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There is a radiance in his eye,
A smile upon his wasted cheek,
That seems to tell the glory nigh
In language that no tongue can speak.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: A beam from heav'n is sent to cheer
The pilgrim on his gloomy road;
And angels are attending near
To bear him to their bright abode.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: O Lord, that we may thus depart,
Thy joys to share, Thy face to see,
Impress Thine image on our heart,
And teach us now to walk with Thee.

hymns.title: King of Saints, to Whom the Number

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: King of Saints, to whom the number,
Of Thy starry host is known,
Many a name, by man forgotten
Lives for ever round Thy throne.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lights, which earth-born mists have darken'd.
There are shining full and clear
Princes in the courts of heaven,
Nameless, unremembered here.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: How they toil'd for Thee and suffer'd:
None on earth can now record:
All their saintly life is hidden
In the knowledge of their Lord.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: All is veiled from us, but written
In the Lamb's great book of life,
All the faith, and prayer, and patience,
All the toiling, and the strife.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: There are told Thy hidden treasures,
Number us, O Lord, with them,
When Thou makest up the jewels
Of Thy living diadem.

hymns.title: Ten Thousand Times Ten Thousand

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Ten thousand times ten thousand,
In sparkling raiment bright,
The armies of the ransomed saints
Throng up the steeps of light;
'Tis finished, all is finished,
Their fight with death and sin;
Fling open wide the golden gates,
And let the victors in.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: What rush of hallelujahs
Fills all the earth and sky!
What ringing of a thousand harps
Bespeaks the triumph nigh!
O day for which creation
And all its tribes were made!
O joy, for all its former woes
A thousand-fold repaid!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O then what raptured greetings,
On Canaan's happy shore,
What knitting severed friendships up
Where partings are no more!
Then eyes with joy shall sparkle
That brimmed with tears of late;
Orphans no longer fatherless,
Nor widows desolate.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Bring near Thy great salvation,
Thou Lamb for sinners slain;
Fill up the roll of Thine elect,
Then take Thy power and reigns;
Appear, Despire of nations,
Thine exiles long for home;
Show in the heav'n Thy promised sign;
Thou Prince and Saviour, come.

hymns.title: O Paradise! O Paradise!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Paradise! O Paradise!
Who doth not crave for rest?
Who would not seek the happy land
Where they that loved are blest:

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where loyal hearts and true
Stand ever in the light,
All rapture through and through,
In God's most holy sight?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: O Paradise! O Paradise!
The world is growing old;
Who would not be at rest and free
Where love is never cold.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where loyal hearts and true
Stand ever in the light,
All rapture through and through,
In God's most holy sight?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O Paradise! O Paradise!
I want to sin no more,
I want to be as pure on earth
As on thy spotless shore.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where loyal hearts and true
Stand ever in the light,
All rapture through and through,
In God's most holy sight?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O Paradise! O Paradise!
I shall not wait for long
E'en now the loving ear may catch
Faint fragments of Thy song.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where loyal hearts and true
Stand ever in the light,
All rapture through and through,
In God's most holy sight?

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Paradise! O Paradise!
O keep me in Thy love
And guide me to that happy land
Of perfect rest above.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Where loyal hearts and true
Stand ever in the light,
All rapture through and through,
In God's most holy sight?

hymns.title: The Flow'rs that Beautified the Field

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The flow'rs that beautified the field,
That looked tender and fresh
When touched by sickle, it will die;
It falls and withers off.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: This example is fit for us
According to God's word;
Let young and old take heed and know
That they are but like grass.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Put not your trust on fleeting breath,
Call not your times your own
Around, we see sickle of death
Cut down thousands of soul.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Those who are spared until this day
Soon, life will also end;
Prepare, be wise before the time
The death angel will come.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: The grass, when dead, will wake no more,
Die, thou, that thou may live,
What, if death were the door that leads
To everlasting pain.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: O Lord, help us answer Thy call,
Let us depart from sin
And when we fall down like the grass
Let our souls come to Thee.

hymns.title: Where High the Heav'nly Temple Stands

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Where high the heav'nly temple stands,
The house of God not made with hands,
A great High Priest our nature wears,
The patron of mankind appears.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He, who for men their Surety stood,
And pour'd on earth His precious blood,
Pursues in heav'n His mighty plan,
The Saviour and the Friend of man.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Though now ascended up on high,
He bends on earth a Brother's eye;
Partaker of the human name,
He knows the frailty of our frame.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Our Fellow-suff'rer yet retains
A fellow-feeling of our pains;
And still remembers in the skies
His tears, His agonies, and cries.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: In every pang, that rends the heart,
The Man of sorrows had a part;
He sympathizes with our grief
And to the suff'rer sends relief.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: With boldness, therefore, at the throne,
Let us make all our sorrows known;
And ask the aid of heav'nly pow'r
To help us in the evil hour.

hymns.title: There's a Land that Is Fairer than Day

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There's a land that is fairer than day,
And by faith we can see it afar:
For the Father waits over the way,
To prepare us a dwelling place there.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on the beautiful shore,
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on the beautiful shore.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We shall sing on that beautiful shore
The melodious songs at the blest,
And our spirits shall sorrow no more,
Not a sigh for the blessing of rest.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on the beautiful shore,
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on the beautiful shore.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: To our bountiful Father above,
We will offer the tribute of praise,
For the glorious gift of His love,
And the blessings that hallow our days.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on the beautiful shore,
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on the beautiful shore.

hymns.title: There Is a Land of Pure Delight

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: There is a land of pure delight
Where saints immortal reign,
Infinite day excludes the night,
And pleasures banish pain.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We're feeding on the living Bread,
We're drinking at the fountain-head;
And who-so drinketh, Jesus said,
Shall never, never thirst again.
What! never thirst again? No, never thirst again!
What! never thirst again? No, never thirst again!
And who-so drinketh, Jesus said,
Shall never, never thirst again!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There everlasting spring abides,
And never withering flowers;
Death, like a narrow sea, divides
This heavenly land from ours.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We're feeding on the living Bread,
We're drinking at the fountain-head;
And who-so drinketh, Jesus said,
Shall never, never thirst again.
What! never thirst again? No, never thirst again!
What! never thirst again? No, never thirst again!
And who-so drinketh, Jesus said,
Shall never, never thirst again!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O could we make our doubts remove
Those gloomy thoughts that rise,
And see the Canaan that we love
With unbeclouded eyes.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We're feeding on the living Bread,
We're drinking at the fountain-head;
And who-so drinketh, Jesus said,
Shall never, never thirst again.
What! never thirst again? No, never thirst again!
What! never thirst again? No, never thirst again!
And who-so drinketh, Jesus said,
Shall never, never thirst again!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Could we but climb where Moses stood
And view the landscape o'er
Not Jordan's stream, nor death's cold flood,
Should fright us from the shore.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: We're feeding on the living Bread,
We're drinking at the fountain-head;
And who-so drinketh, Jesus said,
Shall never, never thirst again.
What! never thirst again? No, never thirst again!
What! never thirst again? No, never thirst again!
And who-so drinketh, Jesus said,
Shall never, never thirst again!

hymns.title: When Jesus Comes to Reward His Servants

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: When Jesus comes to reward His servants,
Whether it be noon or night,
Faithful to Him will He find us watching,
With our lamps all trimmed and bright?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, can we say we are ready, brother?
Ready for the soul's bright home?
Say, will He find you and me still watching,
Waiting, waiting when the Lord shall come?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: If, at the dawn of the early morning,
He shall call us one by one,
When to the Lord we restore our talents,
Will He answer thee-well done?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, can we say we are ready, brother?
Ready for the soul's bright home?
Say, will He find you and me still watching,
Waiting, waiting when the Lord shall come?

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Have we been true to the trust He left us?
Do we seek to do our best?
If in our hearts there is naught condemns us,
We shall have a glorious rest.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, can we say we are ready, brother?
Ready for the soul's bright home?
Say, will He find you and me still watching,
Waiting, waiting when the Lord shall come?

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Blessed are those whom the Lord finds watching,
In His glory they shall share;
If He shall come at the dawn or midnight,
Will He find us watching there?

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Oh, can we say we are ready, brother?
Ready for the soul's bright home?
Say, will He find you and me still watching,
Waiting, waiting when the Lord shall come?

hymns.title: I Have Found a Wondrous Saviour

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: I have found a wondrous Saviour,
Jesus Christ, The Soul's delight;
Ev'ry blessing of His favour,
Fill my heart with hope so bright.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus is the Joy of Living,
He's the King of Life to me;
Unto Him my all I'm giving,
His for evermore to be.
I will do what He commands me.
Any where He leads I'll go;
Jesus is the Joy of Living,
He's the dearest Friend I know.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Life is growing rich with beauty,
Toil has lost its weary strain,
Now a halo crowns each duty,
And I sing a glad refrain.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus is the Joy of Living,
He's the King of Life to me;
Unto Him my all I'm giving,
His for evermore to be.
I will do what He commands me.
Any where He leads I'll go;
Jesus is the Joy of Living,
He's the dearest Friend I know.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Heav'nly wisdom He provides me,
Grace to keep my spirit free;
In His own sweet way He guides me
When the path I cannot see.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus is the Joy of Living,
He's the King of Life to me;
Unto Him my all I'm giving,
His for evermore to be.
I will do what He commands me.
Any where He leads I'll go;
Jesus is the Joy of Living,
He's the dearest Friend I know.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O what splendor, O what glory,
O what matchless pow'r divine,
Is the Christ of Gospel story,
Christ the Saviour, who is mine.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus is the Joy of Living,
He's the King of Life to me;
Unto Him my all I'm giving,
His for evermore to be.
I will do what He commands me.
Any where He leads I'll go;
Jesus is the Joy of Living,
He's the dearest Friend I know.

hymns.title: Those Eternal Bowers Man Hath Never Trod

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Those eternal bowers man hath never trod,
Those unfading flowers, round the Throne of God;
Who may hope to gain them after weary fight?
Who at length attain them, clad in robes of white?

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: He who wakes from slumber at the Spirit's voice,
Daring here to number things unseen his choice;
He who casts his burden down at Jesus' cross
Christ's reproach his guerdon, all beside but loss.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: He who gladly barters all on earthly ground;
He who, like the Martyrs, says 'I will be crown'd',
He whose one oblation is a life of love,
Knit in God's salvation to the blest above.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Shame upon you, legions of the heavenly King,
Citizens of regions past imagining!
What, with pipe and tabor dream away the light,
When He calls to labour and faith's arduous fight?

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Jesus, Lord of glory, as we breast the tide,
Whisper Thou the story of the other side;
Where the Saints are casting crowns before Thy feet,
Safe for everlasting, in Thyself complete.

hymns.title: In This World There Are Burdens We Must Bear

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: In this world there are burdens we must bear
And our eyes are made wet and dim with tear
There's no grief, neither sorrow over there
In that land where there are no days nor years.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In that land where there are no days nor years
Neither sorrow nor anguish or tears
We shall dwell there in peace and our joy ne'er shall cease
In that land where there are no days nor years.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Tho' we toil, oft our labour seems in vain
We have faith tho' no fruit our vision cheers
But the Lord will all mystery make plain
In that land where there are no days nor years.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In that land where there are no days nor years
Neither sorrow nor anguish or tears
We shall dwell there in peace and our joy ne'er shall cease
In that land where there are no days nor years.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: So we smile as we labour day by day
And forget all our sorrows, griefs and fears
For when all earthly things have passed away
We shall dwell where there are no days nor years.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: In that land where there are no days nor years
Neither sorrow nor anguish or tears
We shall dwell there in peace and our joy ne'er shall cease
In that land where there are no days nor years.

hymns.title: Now the Labourer's Task Is O'er

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Now the labourer's task is o'er,
Now the battle-day is past:
Now upon the farther shore
Lands the voyager at last.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Father, in Thy gracious keeping
Leave we now Thy servant sleeping.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: There the tears of earth are dried:
There its hidden things are clear:
There the work of life is tried
By a juster Judge than here.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Father, in Thy gracious keeping
Leave we now Thy servant sleeping.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: There the Shepherd, bringing home
Many lamb forlorn and stray'd
Shelters each, no more to roam,
Where the wolf can ne'er invade.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Father, in Thy gracious keeping
Leave we now Thy servant sleeping.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: There the penitents who turn
To the cross their dying eyes
All the love of Jesus learn
At His feet in paradise.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Father, in Thy gracious keeping
Leave we now Thy servant sleeping.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: There no more the pow'rs of hell
Can prevail to mar their peace
Christ the Lord shall guard them well,
He who died for their release.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Father, in Thy gracious keeping
Leave we now Thy servant sleeping.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Earth to earth, and dust to dust!
Calmly now the words we say:
Let behind, we wait in trust
For the resurrection day.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Father, in Thy gracious keeping
Leave we now Thy servant sleeping.

hymns.title: Hark, Hark, My Soul!

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Hark, hark, my soul! angelic song are swelling
O'er earth's green fields and ocean's wave beat shore;
How sweet the truth those blessed strains are telling
Of that new life when sin shall be no more!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Angels of Jesus, angels of light,
Singing to welcome the Pilgrims of the night!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Onward we go, for still we hear them singing,
"Come, weary souls, for Jesus bids you come;"
And thro' the dark, its echoes sweetly ringing,
The music of the Gospel leads us home.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Angels of Jesus, angels of light,
Singing to welcome the Pilgrims of the night!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Far, far away, like bells at evening pealing,
The voice of Jesus sounds o'er land and sea,
And laden souls, by thousands meekly stealing,
Kind Shepherd, turn their weary steps to Thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Angels of Jesus, angels of light,
Singing to welcome the Pilgrims of the night!

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Rest come at length; though life be long and dreary,
The day must dawn and darksome night be past;
Faith journey ends in welcome to the weary,
And heav'n, the heart's true home, will come at last.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Angels of Jesus, angels of light,
Singing to welcome the Pilgrims of the night!

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Angels, sing on! Your faithful watches keeping;
Sing us sweet fragment of the songs above;
Till morning's joy shall end the night of weeping,
And life's long shadows break in cloudless love.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Angels of Jesus, angels of light,
Singing to welcome the Pilgrims of the night!

hymns.title: Trials Dark on Every Hand

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Trials dark on every hand;
And we cannot understand
All the ways that God would lead
us to that blessed promised land;
But He'll guide us with His eye,
And we'll follow till we die;
We will understand it better by and by.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: By and by, when the morning comes,
When the saints of God are gathered home,
We will tell the story
How we've overcome;
We will understand it better by and by.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Oft our cherished plans have failed,
Disappointments have prevailed,
And we've wandered in the darkness,
Heavy hearted and alone;
But we're trusting in the Lord,
And, according to His word,
We will understand it better by and by.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: By and by, when the morning comes,
When the saints of God are gathered home,
We will tell the story
How we've overcome;
We will understand it better by and by.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Temptations, hidden snares,
Often take us unawares,
And our hearts are made to 't
bleed for some tho't less word or deed
And we wonder why the test
When we try to do our best,
But we'll understand it better by and by.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: By and by, when the morning comes,
When the saints of God are gathered home,
We will tell the story
How we've overcome;
We will understand it better by and by.

hymns.title: Let Me Be with Thee Where Thou Art

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Let me be with Thee where Thou art,
My Saviour, my Eternal Rest!
Then, only, will this longing heart
Be fully and for ever blest!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Let me be with Thee where Thou art,
Thine unveiled glory to behold;
Then, only, will this wand'ring heart
Cease to be faithless, treach'rous, cold.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Let me be with Thee where Thou art,
Where spotless saints Thy Name adore;
Then, only, will this sinful heart
Be evil and defiled no more.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Let me be with Thee where Thou art,
Where none can die, where none remove;
Where life, nor death, my soul can part
From Thy blest presence and Thy love!

hymns.title: O God From All Generations

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O God from all generations,
Thou art our rest and shelter too
Ere the world and this earth were made
Thy love is high above the sky.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thou reigneth ere the world exist
Before the creation of men,
Thy Kingdom shall for ever be
Until that time the world shall end.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Death sweeps us away like river
The world exist in vanity
Like rays of sun in the morning
Cut and wither'd in the evening.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O let us know our wickedness,
And further our days here on earth
Until we are prepar'd for death
By sanctification of grace.

hymns.title: Some Glad Morning when This Life Is O'er

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Some glad morning when this life is o'er;
I'll fly away;
To a home on God's celestial shore,
I'll fly away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I'll fly away, O glory,
I'll fly away;
When I die, hallelujah, by and by,
I'll fly away.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When the shadows of this life have gone,
I'll fly away;
Like a bird from prison bars has flown,
I'll fly away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I'll fly away, O glory,
I'll fly away;
When I die, hallelujah, by and by,
I'll fly away.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Just a few more weary days and then,
I'll fly away;
To a land where joys shall never end,
I'll fly away.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: I'll fly away, O glory,
I'll fly away;
When I die, hallelujah, by and by,
I'll fly away.

hymns.title: What Are These Arrayed in White

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: What are these arrayed in white,
Brighter than the noonday sun?
Foremost of the sons of light,
Nearest the eternal throne?
These are they that bore the cross,
Nobly for their Master stood;
Sufferers in His righteous cause,
Followers of the dying God.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Out of great distress they came,
Washed their robes by faith below
In the blood of yonder Lamb,
Blood that washes white as snow:
Therefore are they next the throne,
Serve their Maker day and night;
God resides among His own,
God doth in His saints delight.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: More than conquerors at last,
Here they find their trials o'er;
They have all their sufferings pass'd,
Hunger now and thirst no more;
No excessive heat they feel
From the sun's directer ray,
In a milder clime they dwell,
Region of eternal day.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: He that on the throne doth reign
Them the Lamb shall always feed,
With the tree of life sustain,
To the living fountains lead;
He shall all their sorrows chase,
All their want at once remove,
Wipe the tears from every face,
Fill up every soul with love.

hymns.title: Abide with Me; Fast Falls the Even Tide

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Abide with me; fast falls the even tide
The darkness deepens; Lord with me abide
When other helpers fail, and comfort flee
Help of the helpless, O abide with me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Swift to its close ebbs out life's little day
Earth's joys grow dim, its glories pass away
Change and decay in all around I see
O Thou who changest not abide with me.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: I need Thy presence every passing hour;
What but Thy grace can foil the tempter's power?
Who like Thyself my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine, O, abide with me.

hymns.title: At Even, Ere the Sun Was Set

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: At even, ere the sun was set
The sick, O Lord, around Thee lay
O in what divers pains they met
O with what joy they went away.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Once more 'tis eventide and we
Oppressed with various ills, draw near
What if Thy form we cannot see
We know and feel that Thou art here.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: O Saviour Christ, our woes dispel
For some are sick, and some are sad
And some have never loved Thee well
And some have lost the love they had.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: And some are pressed with worldly care
And some are tried with sinful doubt
And some such grievous passions tear
That only Thou canst cast them out.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: And some have found the world is vain
Yet from the world they break not free
And some have friends who give them pain
Yet have not sought a friend in Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: O Saviour Christ, Thou too art Man
Thou hast been troubled, tempted, tried
Thy kind but searching glance can scan
The very wounds that shame would hide.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: Thy touch has still its ancient power
No word from Thee can fruitless fall
Hear in this solemn evening hour
And in Thy mercy heal us all.

hymns.title: Glory to Thee My God, This Night

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Glory to Thee my God, this night
For all the blessings of the light
Keep me, O keep me, King of kings
Beneath thy own almighty wings.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Forgive me, Lord, for thy dear Son
The ill that I this day have done
That with the world, myself, and Thee
I, ere I sleep, at peace may be.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Teach me to die, that I may dread
The grave as little as my bed
Teach me to die, that so I may
Rise glorious at the aweful day.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: O may my soul on Thee repose
And with sweet sleep mine eyelids close
Sleep that may more vigorous make
To serve my God when I awake.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: When in the night I sleepless lie
My soul with heavenly thoughts supply
Let no ill dreams disturb my rest
No powers of darkness me molest.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Praise God, from whom all blessings flow
Praise Him, all creatures here below
Praise Him above, ye heavenly host
Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost

hymns.title: Lead, Kindly Light, Amid the Encircling Gloom

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lead, kindly light, amid the encircling gloom
Lead Thou me on.
The night is dark, and I am far from home
Lead Thou me on.
Keep Thou my feet; I do not ask to see
The distant scene; one step enough for me.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: I was not ever thus, nor pray'd that Thou
Shouldst lead me on
I loved to choose and see my path but now
Lead Thou me on
I loved the garish day, and spite of fears
Pride ruled my will: remember not past years.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: So long Thy power hath blest me sure it still
Will lead me on
O'er moor and fen o'er crag and torrent till
The night is gone
And with the morn those angel faces smile
Which I have loved long since, and lost awhile.

hymns.title: O Saviour, Bless Us Ere We Go

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: O Saviour, bless us ere we go,
Thy word into our minds instill,
And make our luke-warm hearts to glow
With lowly love and fervent will.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Through life's long day and death's dark night
O gentle Jesus, be our light.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The day is gone, its hours have run;
And Thou hast taken count of all,
The scanty triumphs grace hath won,
The broken vow, the frequent fall.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Through life's long day and death's dark night
O gentle Jesus, be our light.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Forgive us, Lord; yea, give us joy,
Sweet fear, and sober liberty,
And loving hearts without alloy
That only long to be like Thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Through life's long day and death's dark night
O gentle Jesus, be our light.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Labour is sweet, for Thou hast toil'd,
And care is light, for Thou hast cared:
Let not our work with self be soil'd
Nor in unsimple ways ensnared.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Through life's long day and death's dark night
O gentle Jesus, be our light.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: For all we love, the poor, the sad,
The sinful, unto Thee we call;
Oh let Thy mercy make us glad;
Thou art our Saviour, and our all.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Through life's long day and death's dark night
O gentle Jesus, be our light.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: O Saviour, bless us; night is come,
Thy holy presence with us be,
Good Angels watch about our home,
And we are one day nearer Thee.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Through life's long day and death's dark night
O gentle Jesus, be our light.

hymns.title: We Lift up Our Eyes to Thee

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: We lift up our eyes to Thee,
And our hands and all our hearts,
Lord accept the pray'r we make,
Though unworthy, weak and faint.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Lord grant that we may know Thee,
May we all know Thy great name.
Help us here to do Thy will,
As is done up there in heav'n.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: When we sleep, at dead of night,
Guard us, keep and stand by us,
And when breaks forth morning light,
Let us wake, and praise Thy name.

hymns.title: Thy Love Has Spared Our Lives Today

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Thy love has spared our lives today,
Though we lay-down, spent and worn,
Guard us in the stillness of night,
Us no pow'rs of darkness harm;
Jesus be our guardian ever,
It is sweet to trust in Thee.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Pilgrims in this world and strangers
Dwelling in the midst of foes;
Keep us and dear ones from danger,
On thy wings in comfort sleep;
And when life's distress is over,
May our souls repose in Thee.

hymns.title: Sun of My Soul, Thou Saviour Dear

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Sun of my soul, Thou Saviour dear,
It is not night if Thou be near;
O may no earth-born cloud arise,
To hide Thee from Thy servant's eyes!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: When the soft dews of kindly sleep
My wearied eyelids gently sleep,
Be my last thought, How sweet to rest
For ever on my Saviour's breast!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Abide with me from morn till eve,
For without Thee I cannot live;
Abide with me when night is nigh,
For without Thee I dare not die.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: If some poor wand'ring child of Thine
Have spurned to day the voice divine,
Now, Lord, the gracious work begin;
Let him no more lie down in sin.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Watch by the sick; enrich the poor
With blessings from Thy boundless store;
Be every mourner's sleep to-night
Like infant's slumbers, pure and light.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Come near and bless us when we wake,
Ere through the world our way we take,
Till in the ocean of Thy love
We lose ourselves in heav'n above.

hymns.title: The Day Is Past and Over

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The day is past and over;
All thanks, O Lord, to Thee;
We pray Thee now that sinless
The hours of dark may be;
O Jesus, keep us in Thy sight,
And guard us through the coming night.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: The joys of day are over;
We lift our hearts to Thee,
And ask Thee that offenceless
The hour of dark may be;
O Jesus, make their darkness light,
And guard us through the coming night.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: The toils of day are over,
We raise our hymn to Thee,
And ask that free from peril
The hours of dark may be,
O Jesus, keep us in Thy sight,
And guard us through the coming night.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Be Thou our soul's Preserver,
For thou, O God, dost know
How many are the perils
Awaiting us below,
O loving Jesus, hear our call,
And guard and save us from them all.

hymns.title: The Day Thou Gavest, Lord Is Ended

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: The day Thou gavest, Lord is ended,
The darkness falls at Thy behest;
To Thee our morning hymns ascended.
Thy praise shall sanctify our rest.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: We thank Thee that Thy Church unsleeping,
While earth rolls onward into light,
Through all the world her watch is keeping,
And rests not now by day or night.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: As o'er each continent and island
The dawn leads on another day,
The voice of pray'r is never silent,
Nor dies the strain of praise away.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: The sun that bids us rest is waking
Our brethren 'neath the western sky,
And hour by hour fresh lips are making,
Thy wondrous doings heard on high.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: So be it, Lord; Thy throne shall never,
Like earth's proud empires, pass away;
Thy kingdom stands, and grows for ever,
Till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.

hymns.title: Jesus Our King, Our Lesson Now Is O'er

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus our King, our lesson now is o'er,
Do not allow the devil pick it up.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus our King, we give our thanks to Thee,
As Thou has given us the bread of life.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus our King, no teaching is like Thine,
Thy testimonies are so sweet to us.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Jesus our King, unto Thee we shall look,
Thus Thou has taught us to do in Thy word.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Jesus our King, as we depart for home,
We pray, keep us safely under Thy wings.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Jesus our King, keep us throughout the week,
And bring us back again the coming back.

hymns.title: Now the Day Is Over

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Now the day is over,
Night is drawing nigh,
Shadows of the evening,
Steal across the sky.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Now the darkness gathers,
Stars their watches keep,
Birds, and beasts, and flowers
Soon will be asleep.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus, give the weary
Calm and sweet repose;
With Thy tend'rest blessing
May our eyelids close.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: Grant to little children
Visions bright of Thee;
Guard the sailors tossing
On the deep blue sea.

sections.label: VERSE 5
pairs: Comfort every suff'rer
Watching late in pain;
Those who plan some evil
From their sin restrain.

sections.label: VERSE 6
pairs: Through the long night watches
May Thine angels spread
Their white wings above me,
Watching round my bed.

sections.label: VERSE 7
pairs: When the morning wakens,
Then may I arise
Pure, and fresh, and sinless
In Thy holy eyes.

sections.label: VERSE 8
pairs: Glory to the Father,
Glory to the Son,
And to Thee, blest Spirit,
Whilst all ages run.

hymns.title: Lord, Dismiss Us with Thy Blessing

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Lord, dismiss us with Thy blessing,
Fill our hearts with joy and peace;
Let us each, Thy love possessing,
Triumph in redeeming grace:
Oh, refresh us, oh refresh us,
Trav'ling thro' this wilderness!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Thanks we give, and adoration,
For Thy Gospel's joyful sound;
May the fruits of Thy salvation,
In our hearts and lives abound;
May Thy presence,
With us evermore be found!

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: So, whene'er the signal's given,
Us from earth to call away,
Borne on angels' wings to heaven,
Glad the summons to obey;
We shall surely,
Reign with Christ in endless day.

hymns.title: God Be with You Till We Meet Again

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: God be with you till we meet again,
By His counsels guide, uphold you,
With His sheep securely fold you:
God be with you till we meet again!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Till we meet! Till we meet,
Till we meet at Jesus' feet;
Till we meet! Till we meet,
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: God be with you till we meet again;
'Neath His wings securely hide you,
Daily manna still provide you:
God be with you till we meet again!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Till we meet! Till we meet,
Till we meet at Jesus' feet;
Till we meet! Till we meet,
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: God be with you till we meet again;
When life's perils thick confound you,
Put His arms unfailing round you;
God be with you till we meet again!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Till we meet! Till we meet,
Till we meet at Jesus' feet;
Till we meet! Till we meet,
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: VERSE 4
pairs: God be with you till we meet again,
Keep love's banner floating o'er you,
Smite death's threat'ning wave before you:
God be with you till we meet again!

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Till we meet! Till we meet,
Till we meet at Jesus' feet;
Till we meet! Till we meet,
God be with you till we meet again.

hymns.title: Jesus Will Be with You

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: Jesus will be with you wheresoe'er you stray,
Jesus will be with you and will guide your way,
Thro' the lonely deserts, over mountains bare,
Jesus will be with you, brother ev'ry where.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus will be with you, Jesus will be with you,
He will be your friend to comfort and defend
Jesus will be with you, Jesus will be with you,
Jesus will be with you to the end.

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Jesus will be with you wheresoe'er you stray,
Jesus will be with you and will be your stay;
Thro' the darksome valley with its griefs and care,
Jesus will be with you, brother don't despair.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus will be with you, Jesus will be with you,
He will be your friend to comfort and defend
Jesus will be with you, Jesus will be with you,
Jesus will be with you to the end.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: Jesus will be with you wheresoe'er you stray,
Jesus will be with you all along life's way;
Thro' the chilly waters to the land to fair,
Jesus will be with you brother trust His care.

sections.label: CHORUS
pairs: Jesus will be with you, Jesus will be with you,
He will be your friend to comfort and defend
Jesus will be with you, Jesus will be with you,
Jesus will be with you to the end.

hymns.title: And Are We yet Alive

sections.label: VERSE 1
pairs: And are we yet alive,
And see each other's face?
Glory and praise to Jesus give
For His redeeming grace!

sections.label: VERSE 2
pairs: Preserved by power divine
To full salvation here,
Again in Jesus' praise we join,
And in His sight appear.

sections.label: VERSE 3
pairs: What troubles have we seen,
